cards.audioText: B: Now you are at gate 51, you have got information W, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 51 号登机口，已收到 W 情报，请求前往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, QFA 923, gate 51, information W, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，QFA 923，51 号登机口，收到 W 情报，申请前往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: QFA 923, cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 2515
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 923，许可按飞行计划航路飞往洛杉矶，Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 2515。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 2515, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往洛杉矶，Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 2515，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, expect 10 minutes delay due taxiway A3 is temporarily blocked by a broken down vehicle.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，预计延误 10 分钟，因 A3 滑行道被一辆故障车辆临时阻塞。
cards.referenceText: Roger, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, monitor Ground 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，守听地面 119.35。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA 923, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA 923，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, there is a Citation next to you being pushed, once the aircraft is clear, push back onto Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，你旁边有一架 Citation 正在推出，该机离开后，推出至 Z4，正对 213 号登机口，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Roger, once Citation is clear, push back onto Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，Citation 离开后，推出至 Z4，正对 213 号登机口，机头向东，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA 923, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA 923，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: QFA 923, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 923，经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi via taxiway Z four, A tree and A to holding point Runway 36R, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: as you are taxiing on taxiway A3, you noticed several baggage are scattered on A3 about 400m ahead of your aircraft, tell Ground control why you have stopped taxiing and ask ground services/staff to retrieve the baggage.
cards.audioTextZh: 当你在 A3 滑行道上滑行时，注意到你前方约 400m 的 A3 上散落着数件行李，告诉地面管制你停止滑行的原因，并请求地面服务人员收走行李。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA 923, we found several baggage (scattered) on A tree, 400 meters ahead, we have stopped taxiing, request ground services to retrieve the baggage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA 923，我们发现 A3 上散落着数件行李，位于前方 400 米，我们已停止滑行，请求地面服务人员收走行李。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, hold position, we have notified the ground handling department.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，保持位置，我们已通知地面保障部门。
cards.referenceText: Hold position, roger, thanks, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持位置，收到，谢谢，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: QFA 923, taxiway A3 is clear, expedite taxi via taxiway A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 923，A3 滑行道已清空，经 A3 和 A 滑行道加速滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: roger, expedite taxi via taxiway A tree and A to holding point Runway 36R, QFA 923
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，经 A3 和 A 滑行道加速滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, leaving 1200 meters for 2400 meters, contact Wuhan Departure and request further climb.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，离开 1200 米爬升至 2400 米，联系武汉离场并请求继续爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, QFA 923, leaving 1200 meters for 2400 meters, request further climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，QFA 923，离开 1200 米爬升至 2400 米，请求继续爬升。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, expedite climb to 6000 meters due crossing traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，武汉离场，雷达识别，因穿越航空器，加速爬升至 6000 米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, expedite climb to 6000 meters, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，加速爬升至 6000 米，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: B: During climbing, 1 of your hydraulic systems has failed, make an Urgency call and ask to level off at 4500 meters and then return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升过程中，你的 1 套液压系统失效，发出紧急呼叫，请求在 4500 米改平，然后返回武汉机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, QFA 923, 1 of our hydraulic systems has failed, request level off at 4500 meters and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，QFA 923，我们 1 套液压系统失效，请求在 4500 米改平并返回武汉机场着陆。

cards.audioText: QFA 923, roger PAN, climb and maintain 4500 meters, turn left, track direct to LKO, expect LKO02A, ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 923，收到 PAN，爬升并保持 4500 米，左转直飞 LKO，预计执行 LKO-02A 进场，ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: climb and maintain 4500 meters, turn left, direct to LKO, expect LKO02 A Arrival, ILS approach Runway 36R, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 4500 米，左转直飞 LKO，预计执行 LKO-02A 进场，ILS 进近 Runway 36R，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1012.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，下降至 QNH 1012 上 2700 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1012, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 QNH 1012 上 2700 米，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，联系武汉塔台124.35。

cards.audioText: B: The purser informs you that a passenger has become ill, possibly suffering from hyperventilation, ask for an ambulance to wait at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B：乘务长通知你有一名旅客生病，可能过度换气，请求救护车在登机口等待。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 923, a passenger has become ill, possibly suffering from hyperventilation, request an ambulance to wait at the gate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 923，有一名旅客生病，可能过度换气，请求救护车在登机口等待。

topics.name: QFA 701 起落架问题 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is QFA 701, from Sydney to Wuhan, cruising at 10,700 meters, squawking 3211, you are entering Wuhan Control area, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 QFA 701，从悉尼飞往武汉，正以 10,700 米巡航，应答机 3211，正在进入武汉管制区，首次联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, 1700 meters, squawking 3211.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，正保持 1,700 米，应答机 3211。

cards.audioText: QFA 701, Wuhan Control, radar contact, maintain 10,700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 701，武汉管制，雷达识别，保持 10,700 米。
cards.referenceText: Maintaining 10,700 meters, QFA 701.

cards.audioText: B: There is a thunderstorm buildup near LKO, asked how the preceding aircraft avoided the weather.
cards.audioTextZh: B：LKO 附近有雷暴发展，询问前机如何避开天气。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, there is a thunderstorm buildup near LKO, how did the preceding aircraft avoid the weather ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，LKO 附近有雷暴发展，前机如何避开天气？

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 701, the preceding aircraft just deviate 5 miles to the east, what's your intention?
B: tell Wuhan Control you want to deviate 20 miles to the east to avoid the weather.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： QFA 701，前机刚刚向东偏航 5 英里，你的意图是什么？
B： 告诉武汉管制，为避开天气，你希望向东偏航 20 英里。
cards.referenceText: request deviate 20 miles to the east, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求向东偏航 20 英里，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: B: You are approaching the top of decent point but there are CBs at lower level, ask Wuhan Control to delay your descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你正接近下降顶点，但低高度有 CB，请求武汉管制延迟下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, request delay descent due CBs at lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，因低高度有 CB，请求延迟下降。

cards.audioText: B: There are thunderstorms sources the south of the airport, arrival through LKO is difficult, ask Wuhan Control for an approach from the North and use ZF arrivals.
cards.audioTextZh: B：机场南侧有雷暴，难以经 LKO 进场，请求武汉管制从北侧进近并使用 ZF 进场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, request approach from the north and ZF arrival due thunderstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，因雷暴，请求从北侧进近并使用 ZF 进场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 701, turn right heading 020, expect ZF-02 arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 701，右转航向 020，预期 ZF-02 进场。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 020, expect ZF-02 arrival, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 020，预期 ZF-02 进场，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: Now there is a small cumulonimbus in front of you, request maneuver to the right within 2 miles.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你前方有一小块积雨云，请求在右侧 2 英里范围内机动。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, request maneuver two miles to the right due a small CB.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，因一小块 CB，请求向右机动 2 英里。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your nose wheel steering failed, informed Wuhan Approach of the situation and tell him that you will stop on the runway after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中，你的前轮转弯失效，通知武汉进近情况，并告诉他你将在落地后停在跑道上。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 701, our nose wheel steering failed, we will stop on the runway after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 701，我们的前轮转弯失效，落地后将停在跑道上。

cards.audioText: You are told to use Runway 22VOR/DME approach, but the weather is deteriorating, ask Wuhan Tower for ILS approach Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 你被告知使用 Runway 22 VOR/DME 进近，但天气正在恶化，向武汉塔台请求 ILS 进近 Runway 18L。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 701, request ILS approach Runway 18L, deteriorating weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 701，因天气恶化，请求 ILS 进近 Runway 18L。

cards.audioText: QFA 701, ILS approach Runway 18L is approved.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 701，批准 ILS 进近 Runway 18L。
cards.referenceText: cleared ILS approach Runway 18L, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可 ILS 进近 Runway 18L，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: B: The approach lights are not bright enough, asked Tower to increase the brightness of the approach lights.
cards.audioTextZh: B：进近灯不够亮，请塔台提高进近灯亮度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 701, the approach lights are not bright enough, request brighten up the approach lights.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 701，进近灯不够亮，请求调亮进近灯。

cards.audioText: B: You executed missed approach because of poor visibility, inform Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你因能见度差执行复飞，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 701, going around due poor visibility.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 701，因能见度差，正在复飞。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 701, roger, follow the standard missed approach procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 701，收到，执行标准复飞程序。
cards.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行标准复飞程序，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: QFA 701, the visibility has improved now, expect radar vectors for another approach.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 701，现在能见度已经改善，预计雷达引导再次进近。
cards.referenceText: roger, expect radar vectors for another approach, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，预计雷达引导再次进近，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: QFA 701, turn right heading 090, cleared for ILS approach Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 701，右转航向 090，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 18L。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 090, cleared for ILS approach Runway 18L, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 090，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 18L，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: B: You have landed at Wuhan Airport, but the tow truck is not in position, ask for a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已在武汉机场着陆，但拖车未就位，请求牵引车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA 701, the tow truck is not in position, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA 701，拖车未就位，请求牵引车。

topics.name: QFA 160 机翼/控制面损坏 燃油紧急 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is QFA 160, a flight from Tokyo to Guangzhou, you are maintaining 11,000 meters, over WXI, your transponder code is 4525, make an initial contact with Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 QFA 160，这是一趟从东京飞往广州的航班，正保持 11,000 米飞越 WXI，应答机代码 4525，首次联系郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, maintaining 2000 meters, over WXI, squawking 4525.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，正保持 2,000 米，飞越 WXI，应答机 4525。

cards.audioText: QFA 160, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 10,400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 160，郑州管制，雷达识别，下降至并保持 10,400 米。
cards.referenceText: descend and maintain 10 thounsand 400 meters, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至并保持 10,400 米，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: You wish to know until what time you can expect high level, ask Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你想知道什么时候可以预期高高度，询问郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, until what time we can expect high level ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，我们什么时候可以预期高高度？

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, Zhengzhou Control, you can expect further climb after passing ZHO, but for now, continue descent to 9200 meters, reduced to minimum speed due to temporary airways restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，郑州管制，飞越 ZHO 后可预期继续爬升，但现在继续下降并保持 9200 米，因临时航路限制减至最小速度。
cards.referenceText: Roger, expect further climb after passing ZHO, continue descend and maintain 9200 meters, reduced to minimum speed, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，飞越 ZHO 后预期继续爬升，继续下降并保持 9200 米，减至最小速度，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, orbit right from present position until further advised.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，从当前位置右盘旋，直到进一步通知。
cards.referenceText: Orbit right from present position until further advised, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从当前位置右盘旋，直到进一步通知，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: After several orbits, you have calculated that if you hold any longer, the fuel on board will approach the required minimums, inform Zhengzhou Control about your situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B：几次盘旋后，你计算出如果继续等待，机上燃油将接近所需最低量，通知郑州管制你的情况。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, we will reach our minimum fuel if we are delayed any further.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，如果再被延误，我们将达到最低燃油。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, Zhengzhou Control, roger, after this orbit, direct to AKOMA.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，郑州管制，收到，本次盘旋后，直飞 AKOMA。
cards.referenceText: After this orbit, direct to AKOMA, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 本次盘旋后，直飞 AKOMA，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: Now you find you don't have enough fuel to fly to Guangzhou and you decide to divert to Changsha Airport, notify Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你发现燃油不足以飞往广州，决定备降长沙机场，通知郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, we don't have enough fuel to fly to Guangzhou, request divert to Changsha Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，我们没有足够燃油飞往广州，请求备降长沙机场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, stand by for your request, temporary restriction is now cancelled, resume normal speed, direct to OBLIK.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，等待你的请求，临时限制现已取消，恢复正常速度，直飞 OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Resume normal speed, direct to OBLIK, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 恢复正常速度，直飞 OBLIK，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: you have a navigation system problem, your instrument is showing inaccurate position of your aircraft, notify Zhengzhou Control ad ask for radar monitoring.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的导航系统出现问题，仪表显示的航空器位置不准确，通知郑州管制并请求雷达监控。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, we have navigation system problem, our aircraft position might be inaccurate, request radar monitoring.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，我们的导航系统出现问题，航空器位置可能不准确，请求雷达监控。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, roger, you are slightly deviating to the left, turn right 5 degrees, contact Wuhan Control on 134.7, request diversion from Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，收到，你稍微向左偏航，右转 5 度，联系武汉管制134.7，向武汉管制请求备降。
cards.referenceText: Roger, turn right 5 degrees, 134.7, QFA 160.

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 9200 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 4525, contact Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 9200 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 4525，联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 160, maintaining 9200 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 4525.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 160，保持 9200 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 4525。

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 160, Wuhan Control, radar contact, I understand you have a navigation problem and fuel shortage, confirm you are diverting to Changsha.
B: Tell Wuhan Control you are performing the checklist and tell Wuhan Control to stand by.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：QFA 160，武汉管制，雷达识别，我了解你有导航问题和燃油不足，确认你正在备降长沙。
B：告诉武汉管制你正在执行检查单，并让武汉管制稍等。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 160, stand by, we are performing the checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 160，请稍等，我们正在执行检查单。

cards.audioText: B: Inform Wuhan Control you are flying with basic navigation instruments and you want to change your alternate airport to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：通知武汉管制你正在使用基本导航仪表飞行，并希望将备降机场改为武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 160, we are flying with basic navigation instruments, request divert to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 160，我们正在使用基本导航仪表飞行，请求备降武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, roger, divert to Wuhan approved, descend and maintain 4800 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 120.45 when reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，收到，备降武汉批准，下降并保持 4800 米，到达时联系武汉进近120.45。
cards.referenceText: Divert to Wuhan approved, descend and maintain 4800 meters, 120.45, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 备降武汉批准，下降并保持 4800 米，120.45，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are reaching 4800 meters, you have got information B, make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你正到达 4800 米，已收到 B 情报，与武汉进近首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 160, reaching 4800 meters, information B.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 160，正到达 4800 米，收到 B 情报。

cards.audioText: QFA 160, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, information B is current, follow ZF-01A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 160，武汉进近，雷达识别，当前情报为 B，执行 ZF-01A 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: follow Z Foxtrot0 01A Arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF-001A 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，QFA 160。

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 160, are you declaring fuel emergency?
B: Inform the controller that you still have more than 2 hours fuel endurance and you are not declaring a fuel emergency.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：QFA 160，你是否宣布燃油紧急？
B：通知管制员你仍有超过 2 小时续航燃油，并且不宣布燃油紧急。
cards.referenceText: Negative, we still have more than 2 hours fuel endurance, QFA 160
cards.referenceTextZh: 否定，我们仍有超过 2 小时续航燃油，QFA 160。

topics.name: QFA 358 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动 复飞

cards.audioText: Your call sign is QFA 358, from SIA to Wuhan. You are maintaining 10,100 meters over DAPRO, squawking 3625, contact Wuhan control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 QFA 358，从 SIA 飞往武汉。你正保持 10,100 米飞越 DAPRO，应答机 3625，联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 358, maintaining 1100 meters over DAPRO, squawking 3625.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 358，正保持 1,100 米飞越 DAPRO，应答机 3625。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend to and maintain 6300 meters at your discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，武汉管制，雷达识别，可自行决定时机下降并保持 6300 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 6300 meters at our discretion, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 自行决定时机下降并保持 6300 米，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates a large group of CBs, southwest of LKO, request turn right heading 050 to avoid the weather.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的气象雷达显示 LKO 西南有大范围 CB，请求右转航向 050 以避开天气。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 358, our weather radar indicates a large group of CBs, southwest of LKO, request turn right heading 050 to avoid the weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 358，我们的气象雷达显示 LKO 西南有大范围 CB，请求右转航向 050 以避开天气。

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 358, Negative heading 050 due to restricted area.
B: Tell Wuhan control you want to fly heading 030 for at least 5 minutes before you can resume course.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： QFA 358，因限制区，不能使用航向 050。
B： 告诉武汉管制，你希望保持航向 030 至少 5 分钟，然后才能恢复航路。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 358, request heading 030 for at least five minutes
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 358，请求保持航向 030 至少 5 分钟。

cards.audioText: QFA 358, roger, heading 030 is approved, when clear of weather, track direct to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 358，收到，批准航向 030，脱离天气后直飞 LKO。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 030 is approved, when clear of weather, track direct to LKO, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准右转航向 030，脱离天气后直飞 LKO，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, descend to 5100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，下降至 5100 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 5100 meters, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 5100 米，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: B: You are maintaining 5100 meters, over LKO, ATIS B received, now contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你保持 5100 米，飞越 LKO，已收到 ATIS B，现在联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 358, maintaining 5100 meters, over LKO, information B.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 358，保持 5100 米，飞越 LKO，收到 B 情报。

cards.audioText: QFA 358, Wuhan approach, LKO-2A arrival, descent to and maintain 1,200 meters, information C is now current, you are number l.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 358，武汉进近，执行 LKO-2A 进场，下降至并保持 1,200 米，当前情报为 C，你是第一架落地航空器。
cards.referenceText: LKO two A arrival, descend to and maintain 1200 meters, information C, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 LKO-2A 进场，下降至并保持 1,200 米，C 情报，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar has failed during descent, contact Wuhan Approach to request weather information along your route.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中你的气象雷达失效，联系武汉进近，请求航路沿线天气信息。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 358, our weather radar has failed during descent, request weather information along our route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 358，我们的气象雷达在下降过程中失效，请求航路沿线天气信息。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, roger, our weather radar shows cumulonimbus in the vicinity of DA.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，收到，我们的气象雷达显示 DA 附近有积雨云。
cards.referenceText: Roger, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: Request Wuhan approach for radar assistance to intercept final course of Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 向武汉进近请求雷达引导，以切入 Runway 36L 最后进近航道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 358, request radar vectors to intercept final course Runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 358，请求雷达引导切入 Runway 36L 最后进近航道。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, turn right heading 090, descend to and maintain 900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，右转航向 090，下降并保持 900 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, descend to and maintain 900 meters, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 090，下降并保持 900 米，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: QFA 358, turn left heading 030, descend to and maintain 600 meters, cleared to intercept the localizer RWY 36 Left, contact tower124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 358，左转航向 030，下降至并保持 600 米，许可切入 Runway 36L 航向道，联系塔台 124.35。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading 030, descend to and maintain 600 meters, cleared to intercept the localizer Runway 36L, 124.35, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 030，下降至并保持 600 米，许可切入 Runway 36L 航向道，124.35，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: B: You encountered the downdrafts on short final and executed a missed approach, informed Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在短五边遭遇下沉气流并执行复飞，通知武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 358, we encountered the downdrafts on short final, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 358，我们在短五边遭遇下沉气流，正在复飞。

cards.audioText: QFA 358, roger, when able, Turn right heading 090, climb to 1,500 meters, contact Wuhan approach 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 358，收到，可以时右转航向 090，爬升至 1,500 米，联系武汉进近 119.7。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, climb to 1,500 meters, contact Wuhan approach 119.7, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 090，爬升至 1,500 米，联系武汉进近 119.7，QFA 358。

topics.name: QFA 432 积冰/防冰 烟雾 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is QFA 432, you are parking at gate 24, you have got information H, ask Shanghai Delivery for ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 QFA 432，停在 24 号登机口，已收到 H 情报，向上海放行申请前往北京的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Delivery, QFA 432, gate 24, information H, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海放行，QFA 432，24 号登机口，收到 H 情报，申请前往北京的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: QFA 432, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, runway in use Runway 26, HZ01D, initial climb to 600 meters on QNH, after departure contact 128.75, squawk 3421.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 432，许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，当前使用 Runway 26，执行 HZ-01D，按 QNH 初始爬升至 600 米，离场后联系 128.75，应答机 3421。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, runway in use Runway 26, HZ-01 departure, initial climb to six hunderd meters on QNH, 128.75, squawk 3421, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，当前使用 Runway 26，执行 HZ-01 离场，按 QNH 初始爬升至 600 米，128.75，应答机 3421，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, read back correct, report when ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，复诵正确，准备好推出和开车时报告。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA 432, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，QFA 432，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, push back and start up approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，推出和开车批准。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready to taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA 432, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，QFA 432，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: QFA 432, taxi via taxiway F, C1 and B to holding point Runway 26, caution, work in progress at the end of gate 319.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 432，经 F、C1 和 B 滑行道滑行至 Runway 26 等待点，注意 319 登机口末端正在施工。
cards.referenceText: taxi via taxiway F, C one and B to holding point Runway 26, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 F、C1 和 B 滑行道滑行至 Runway 26 等待点，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: As you are taxiing, you noticed some smoke coming from APU on Boeing 747 ahead of you, report this to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行时，你注意到前方 Boeing 747 的 APU 冒烟，向 ATC 报告。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA 432, we notice some smoke coming from APU on B747 ahead of us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，QFA 432，我们注意到前方 B747 的 APU 冒烟。

cards.audioText: Now you are at holding point Runway 26, tell ATC you are ready to take off.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 Runway 26 等待点，告诉空中交通管制你已准备好起飞。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Tower, QFA 432, holding point Runway 26, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海塔台，QFA 432，Runway 26 等待点，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, behind landing traffic, line up behind.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，在落地航空器之后，跟随其后进跑道。
cards.referenceText: Behind landing traffic, line up behind, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在落地航空器之后，跟随其后进跑道，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are reaching 5100 meters, contact Beijing Approach and request further descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你正到达 5100 米，联系北京进近并请求继续下降。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, reaching 5100 meters, request further descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，正到达 5100 米，请求继续下降。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, descend and maintain 3300 meters on QNH 1031.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，下降并保持 QNH 1031 上 3300 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 3300 meters on QNH 1031, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 QNH 1031 上 3300 米，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 3300 meters, request further descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 3300 米，请求继续下降。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, maintaining 3300 meters, request further descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，保持 3300 米，请求继续下降。

cards.audioText: QFA 432, maintain 3,300 meters, opposite traffic at 2 o'clock 10 miles, report clear of traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 432，保持 3,300 米，反向航空器位于你 2 点钟方向、距离 10 英里，脱离相关航空器后报告。
cards.referenceText: maintaining 3,300 meters, QFA 432.

cards.audioText: B: Tell the controller you are clear of traffic and request further descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉管制员你已脱离该航空器，并请求下降。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, clear of traffic, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，已脱离航空器，请求下降。

cards.audioText: you are cleared to 1,200 meters, the sky is turning dark, the visibility is deteriorating, you suspect a sandstorm, tell Beijing Approach this situation and ask ATC if there is sandstorm forecast.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已获准下降至 1,200 米，天空正在变暗，能见度正在恶化，你怀疑出现沙尘暴，向北京进近报告这一情况，并询问空中交通管制是否有沙尘暴预报。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, descend to 1002 hudnred meters, the sky is turning dark, the visibility is deteriorating, we suspect a sandstorm, is there sandstorm forecast?
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，下降至 1002 百米，天空正在变暗，能见度正在恶化，我们怀疑出现沙尘暴，是否有沙尘暴预报？

cards.audioText: B: The sandstorm is severe and the visibility is very poor, inform ATC the situation, ask to climb to a higher level to get above the sandstorm.
cards.audioTextZh: B：沙尘暴严重，能见度很差，通知 ATC 情况，请求爬升到更高高度以避开沙尘暴上方。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, the sandstorm is severe and the visibility is very poor, request climb to a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，沙尘暴严重，能见度很差，请求爬升到更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, climb to 2100 meters, turn right heading 230.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，爬升至 2100 米，右转航向 230。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 2100 meters, turn right heading 230, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 2100 米，右转航向 230，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: your aircraft is B747, Suddenly No. 1, No 2 engines have failed due to sandstorm, report it to Beijing Approach, ask if weather is clear in Beijing and request radar vector to Beijing for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的航空器为 B747。突然，1 号和 2 号发动机因沙尘暴失效。向北京进近报告，询问北京天气是否晴朗，并请求雷达引导至北京优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, Boeing 747, No. one and No. two engines have failed due to sand storm, request radar vector to Beijing for priority landing. Is weather in Beijing clear?
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，Boeing 747，1 号和 2 号发动机因沙尘暴失效，请求雷达引导至北京优先着陆。北京天气是否晴朗？

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, turn right heading 250, the weather in Beijing is clear.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，右转航向 250，北京天气晴朗。
cards.referenceText: Roger, turn right heading 250, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，右转航向 250，QFA 432。

topics.name: SIA 852 地面车堵滑行道 前轮爆胎

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 852, you are at Wuhan Airport, stand 7, received ATIS M, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 852，在武汉机场 7 号机位，已收到 ATIS M，请求前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 852, stand 7, information M, request clearance to Singapore.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 852，7 号机位，收到 M 情报，申请前往新加坡的放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, follow ZF-03 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, Runway 18L, departure frequency 124.7, squawk 4615.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 852，许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，执行 ZF-03 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，跑道 18 左，离场频率 124.7，应答机 4615。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, follow ZF-03 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, Runway 18L, departure frequency 124.7, squawk 4615, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，执行 ZF-03 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，跑道 18L，离场频率 124.7，应答机 4615，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, push back and start up at your own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 852，自行决定推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up at our own discretion, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 自行决定推出和开车，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: You have completed the push back and start up procedures. You decide to make an intersection departure from E2, contact Ground to request intersection departure from E2.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已完成推出和开车程序。你决定从 E2 交叉口离场，联系地面请求从 E2 交叉口离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, push back and start up completed, request intersection departure from E2.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，推出和开车完成，请求从 E2 交叉口离场。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, roger, intersection departure from E2 is approved, taxi to E2 via A6, A2, hold short of Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 852，收到，E2 交叉口离场批准，经 A6、A2 滑行至 E2，跑道 18 左外等待。
cards.referenceText: Intersection departure from E2 is approved, taxi to E2 via A6, A2, hold short of Runway 18L, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: E2 交叉口离场批准，经 A6、A2 滑行至 E2，跑道 18L 外等待，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: During taxiing you find a vehicle broken down on taxiway A, you have stopped the aircraft, inform ATC about the situation and request airport services to tow away the vehicle.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行期间，你发现一辆车在 A 滑行道上故障，你已停止飞机，通知 ATC 情况，并请求机场服务将车辆拖走。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, a vehicle has broken down on taxiway A, we have to stop our aircraft and request airport service to tow the vehicle away.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，一辆车在 A 滑行道上故障，我们必须停止飞机，请求机场服务将车辆拖走。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, roger, hold at present position, RAM services will be assume in a few minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 852，收到，在当前位置等待，RAM 服务几分钟后会处理。
cards.referenceText: Hold at present position, roger, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在当前位置等待，收到，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: You are now holding short of Runway 18L on E2, request departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 E2 上跑道 18 左外等待，请求离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 852, holding short of Runway 18L on E2, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 852，在 E2 上跑道 18L 外等待，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, cleared for takeoff Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 852，跑道 18 左可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, Runway 18L, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道 18L，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: During the takeoff role, your nose will run over a sharp object on the runway surface and the nose wheel tire burst, you aborted the takeoff, notify Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：起飞滑跑期间，你的前轮压过跑道表面的尖锐物，前轮轮胎爆胎，你中断起飞，通知武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 852, our nose wheel has run over a sharp object on the runway, the tire got burst, we aborted takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 852，我们的前轮压过跑道上的尖锐物，轮胎爆胎，我们中断起飞。

cards.audioText: B: Inform ATC about the situation and request fire trucks and maintenance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：通知 ATC 情况，并请求消防车和维修。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, we have run over a sharp object, and our nose wheel tire got burst, request fire service and maintenance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，我们压过尖锐物，前轮轮胎爆胎，请求消防和维修。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 852, roger, do you require anything else?
B: Tell the ATC that you require a tug to tow your aircraft back to the apron after inspection.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 852，收到，你还需要其他什么吗？
B：告诉 ATC 检查后你需要牵引车将飞机拖回停机坪。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request a tug to tow us back to the apron after inspection, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 肯定，请求检查后用牵引车将我们拖回停机坪，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, tug is on the way.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 852，牵引车正在路上。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: Request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: B：请求客梯和摆渡车在停机坪准备好。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，请求客梯和摆渡车在停机坪准备好。

topics.name: SIA 123 拖把断了 鸟击 放油

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 123, stand 215, from Wuhan to Singapore, information B received, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 123，215 号机位，从武汉飞往新加坡，已收到 B 情报，请求前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 123, stand 215, information B, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 123，215 号机位，收到 B 情报，申请前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, Runway 36R, contact Departure on 119.7, squawk 6325.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，跑道 36 右，联系离场 119.7，应答机 6325。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, runaway 36R, contact Departure on 119.7, squawk 6325, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，跑道 36R，联系离场 119.7，应答机 6325，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: B: You are now ready, contact Ground to request push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在准备好了，联系地面请求推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 123, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 123，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, push back and start up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，推出和开车批准，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头向东，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: B: While being pushed back, the tow bar bent, contact Ground to request another tow bar.
cards.audioTextZh: B：推出过程中，拖把弯曲，联系地面请求另一根拖把。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 123, our tow bar was bent, request another tow bar.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 123，我们的拖把弯曲，请求另一根拖把。

cards.audioText: B: While taxiing, you notice the wind sock shows a strong tailwind, contact Tower to check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行时，你注意到风向袋显示强顺风，联系塔台检查风。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 123, wind sock shows strong tailwind, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 123，风向袋显示强顺风，请求风向风速检查。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 123, surface wind 220 degrees, 8 meters per second.
B: The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact Tower to change to Runway 18L and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 123，地面风 220 度，8 米/秒。
B：顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系塔台改用跑道 18 左并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: The tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to Runway 18L, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求改用跑道 18L，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: B: You have departed from Runway 18L, shortly after lift off you encountered a bird strike, your right engine has failed, make an Emergency call, request to maintain runway heading.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已从跑道 18 左离场，起飞后不久遭遇鸟击，右发失效，发出紧急呼叫，请求保持跑道航向。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Tower, SIA 123, we encountered bird strike, right engine failed, request maintain runway heading.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉塔台，SIA 123，我们遭遇鸟击，右发失效，请求保持跑道航向。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the Tower you want to dump fuel and return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉塔台你想放油并返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 123, request dump fuel and return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 123，请求放油并返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, roger, turn right heading 240 to intercept LKO VOR 030 radial inbound, climb to 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，收到，右转航向 240，截获 LKO VOR 030 径向线入航，爬升至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240 to intercept LKO VOR 030 radio inbound, climb to 3000 meters, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，截获 LKO VOR 030 径向线入航，爬升至 3000 米，SIA 123。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 123, advise the time required for fuel jettison.
B: Tell the controller you need approximately 25 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 123，告知所需放油时间。
B：告诉管制员你大约需要 25 分钟。
cards.referenceText: We need approximately 25 minutes, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们大约需要 25 分钟，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, after passing LKO, heading 220, maintain 3000 meters, report when over LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，飞越 LKO 后，航向 220，保持 3000 米，飞越 LKO 时报告。
cards.referenceText: After passing LKO, heading 220, maintain 3000 meters, report when over LKO, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞越 LKO 后，航向 220，保持 3000 米，飞越 LKO 时报告，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: B: You are over LKO, call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在 LKO 上空，呼叫武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, SIA 123, over LKO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，SIA 123，飞越 LKO。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Wuhan Approach fuel dumping is now completed, request radar vectors for Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉武汉进近放油现已完成，请求跑道 22 雷达引导。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA 123, fuel dumping completed, request radar vectors for Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，SIA 123，放油完成，请求跑道 22 雷达引导。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, turn right track direct to DA, descend and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1015, expect Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，右转直飞 DA，下降并保持 QNH 1015 上 2100 米，预期跑道 22。
cards.referenceText: Turn right track director to DA, descend and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1015, expect Runway 22, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 DA，下降并保持 QNH 1015 上 2100 米，预期跑道 22，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: B: You are now established on ILS approach Runway 22, contact Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 22 ILS 进近，联系塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 123, established on ILS approach Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 123，已建立跑道 22 ILS 进近。

topics.name: SIA 101 雷击 客舱起火

cards.audioText: B: You are encountering severe icing at FL390 and want lower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在 FL390 遭遇严重结冰，想要更低高度。
cards.referenceText:
HongKong Control, SIA 101, we are
encountering severe icing at FL390, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，SIA 101，我们在 FL390 遭遇严重结冰，请求下降。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 101, descend to FL310, reach 310 within 4 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 101，下降至 FL310，4 分钟内到达 310。
cards.referenceText: Descend to FL310, reach FL310 within 4 minutes, SIA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 FL310，4 分钟内到达 FL310，SIA 101。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, you observed lightning to your right and the aircraft was shaking, you suspect you have suffered lightning strike, tell ATC the situation and request 10 miles deviation to the left.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中，你观察到右侧有闪电且飞机晃动，你怀疑遭受雷击，告诉 ATC 情况，并请求向左偏航 10 海里。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Control, SIA 101, we observed lightning to our right and the aircraft was shaking, we suspect we have suffered lightning strike, request 10 miles deviation to the left.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，SIA 101，我们观察到右侧有闪电且飞机晃动，我们怀疑遭受雷击，请求向左偏航 10 海里。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 101, deviation 10 miles to the left is approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 101，向左偏航 10 海里批准。
cards.referenceText: Deviation 10 miles to the left is approved, SIA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 向左偏航 10 海里批准，SIA 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now the purser reports there is a strange smell coming from the rear cabin, tell ATC the situation and request further descent as precaution.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在乘务长报告后客舱有异味，告诉 ATC 情况，并作为预防请求继续下降。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Control, SIA 101, the purser reports there is a strange smell coming from the rear cabin, request further descent as precaution.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，SIA 101，乘务长报告后客舱有异味，作为预防请求继续下降。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 101, continue descent to FL250.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 101，继续下降至 FL250。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to FL250, SIA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至 FL250，SIA 101。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 101, are you carrying any dangerous cargo?
B: Tell ATC you are carrying some flammable liquid in the aft cargo compartment.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 101，你是否载有危险货物？
B：告诉 ATC 你在后货舱载有一些易燃液体。
cards.referenceText: We are carrying some flammable liquid in the aft cargo compartment, SIA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们在后货舱载有一些易燃液体，SIA 101。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 101, roger that.
B: Now smoke is coming out of the floor in the aft cabin, so you decide immediately to divert to HongKong. Declare an emergency and make a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 101，收到。
B：现在后客舱地板冒烟，所以你决定立即备降香港。宣布紧急并发出遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, HongKong Control, SIA 101, request immediately divert to HongKong due cabin fire.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，香港管制，SIA 101，因客舱火警，请求立即备降香港。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 101, roger your MAYDAY, fly heading 010 and descend to FL110.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 101，收到你的 MAYDAY，飞航向 010，下降至 FL110。
cards.referenceText: Fly heading 010 and descend to FL110, SIA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞航向 010，下降至 FL110，SIA 101。

cards.audioText: B: Tell ATC you may stop on the runway and evacuate passengers there.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉 ATC 你可能会停在跑道上并在那里疏散旅客。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Control, SIA 101, we may stop on the runway and evacuate passengers there.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，SIA 101，我们可能会停在跑道上并在那里疏散旅客。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 101, copy that, what kind of emergency services do you need?
B: Tell ATC you need fire service and medical service to be attendance near the runway.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 101，收到，你需要哪种应急服务？
B：告诉 ATC 你需要消防和医疗服务在跑道附近待命。
cards.referenceText: Request fire services and medical service to near the runway, SIA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求消防和医疗服务到跑道附近，SIA 101。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 101, fire and medical services, copy that.
B: After having discharged the fire extinguisher and applied the smoke procedure, the smoke is stopped and is controlled. Tell ATC your situation and cancel the Distress.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 101，消防和医疗服务，收到。
B：释放灭火瓶并执行烟雾程序后，烟雾停止并受控。告诉 ATC 你的情况并取消遇险。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Control, SIA 101, the smoke is under control, cancel distress.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，SIA 101，烟雾已受控，取消遇险。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 101, roger, do you want to continue to HongKong?
B: Tell ATC you still need to land at HongKong as a precaution.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 101，收到，你是否想继续飞往香港？
B：告诉 ATC 作为预防你仍需在香港落地。
cards.referenceText: We still need to land at HongKong as a precaution, SIA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 作为预防，我们仍需在香港落地，SIA 101。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 101, contact Approach on 119.1.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 101，联系进近 119.1。

cards.audioText: B: Now contact HongKong Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在联系香港进近。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Approach, SIA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，SIA 101。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 101, descend to 4000 feet, heading 340 to join right base, report airfield in sight.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 101，下降至 4000 英尺，航向 340 加入右三边，看到机场报告。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4000 feet, heading 340 to join right base, report airfield in sight, SIA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 4000 英尺，航向 340 加入右三边，看到机场报告，SIA 101。

cards.audioText: B: Tell ATC you need to park in a remote area and disembark the passengers there.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉 ATC 你需要停在远机位并在那里让旅客下机。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Approach, SIA 101, we need to park in a remote area and disembark the passengers there.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，SIA 101，我们需要停在远机位并在那里让旅客下机。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 101, we will relay your request to flight operations department.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 101，我们会将你的请求转告飞行运行部门。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, SIA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，SIA 101。

topics.name: SIA 497 询问起落架 前轮转向失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 497, you are parking at gate 215, you have got information P, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 497，停在 215 号登机口，已收到 P 情报，请求前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 497, gate 215, information P, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 497，215 号登机口，收到 P 情报，申请前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 497, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial altitude 1800 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, departure frequency 118.9, squawk 2706.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 497，许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO-01 离场，初始高度 1800 米，巡航高度 10700 米，离场频率 118.9，应答机 2706。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial altitude 1800 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, departure frequency 118.9, squawk 2706, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO-01 离场，初始高度 1800 米，巡航高度 10700 米，离场频率 118.9，应答机 2706，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: B: Tell ATC 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, request 9500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉 ATC 因重量大，10700 米不可接受，请求 9500 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 497, 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, request 9500 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 497，因重量大，10700 米不可接受，请求 9500 米。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 497, cleared cruising level 9500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 497，许可巡航高度 9500 米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared cruising level 9500 meters, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可巡航高度 9500 米，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: B: You are on the taxiway A with engine running, contact Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在 A 滑行道上，发动机运转，联系地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 497, taxiway A, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 497，A 滑行道，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 497, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via Z4 and A, hold short of E7.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 497，经 Z4 和 A 滑行至跑道 36 右等待点，E7 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 36R via Z4 and A, hold short of E7, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，E7 外等待，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: B: Contact Wuhan Tower and request intersection departure E5 Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: B：联系武汉塔台，请求跑道 36 右 E5 交叉口离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 497, request intersection departure E5 Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 497，请求跑道 36R E5 交叉口离场。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 497, negative due sequencing, continue to holding point Runway 36R, hold short of E7.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 497，因排序否决，继续滑行至跑道 36 右等待点，E7 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue to holding point Runway 36R, hold short of E7, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，E7 外等待，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 497, cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, surface wind 350, 5 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 497，跑道 36 右可以起飞，地面风 350，5 节。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 可以起飞，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 497, contact departure on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 497，联系离场 118.9。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，联系武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA 497, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA 497，已离地，正通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 497, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, turn left direct to DA, climb and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1021.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 497，武汉离场，雷达识别，左转直飞 DA，爬升并保持 QNH 1021 上 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to DA, climb and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1021, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞 DA，爬升并保持 QNH 1021 上 3000 米，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: B: You are approaching Singapore Airport, contact Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你正接近新加坡机场，联系进近。
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: B: Your landing gear can't be extended normally, report this situation to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的起落架不能正常放下，向 ATC 报告这个情况。
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA 497, our landing gear can't be extended normally.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，SIA 497，我们的起落架不能正常放下。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 497, what's your intention?
B: Tell ATC you want to terminate the approach, maintain runway heading, climb to 600 meters to complete the abnormal procedures.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 497，你的意图是什么？
B：告诉 ATC 你想中止进近，保持跑道航向，爬升至 600 米以完成非正常程序。
cards.referenceText: Request terminate the approach, maintain 600 meters on runway heading to complete the abnormal procedures, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求中止进近，跑道航向保持 600 米以完成非正常程序，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: B: Your landing gear has been extended manually, but nose wheel steering is lost, request a tug after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的起落架已手动放下，但前轮转弯失效，请求落地后牵引车。
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA 497, our landing gear has been extended manually, but nose wheel steering is lost, request a tug after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，SIA 497，我们的起落架已手动放下，但前轮转弯失效，请求落地后牵引车。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, SIA 497, the tug will be ready upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh: C：收到，SIA 497，牵引车将在落地时准备好。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 497, you are number 1 to land, cleared ILS approach Runway 18L, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 497，你是第一架落地，许可跑道 18 左 ILS 进近，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared ILS approach Runway 18L, report established, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可跑道 18L ILS 进近，建立后报告，SIA 497。

topics.name: SIA 323 地面车堵塞 左发EGT超温

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 323, a flight from Wuhan to Singapore, you are at gate E3, with information C, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 323，从武汉飞往新加坡，在 E3 登机口，收到 C 情报，向武汉放行请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 323, gate E3, information C, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 323，E3 登机口，收到 C 情报，申请前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 323, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3763.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 323，武汉放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，离场跑道 36 右，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3763。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10400m, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3763, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，离场跑道 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3763，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 323, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 323，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 323, push back and start up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 323，推出和开车批准，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头向东，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: B: You have completed push back with engines running, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已完成推出，发动机运转，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 323, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 323，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 323, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 323，经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至跑道 36 右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: B: During taxiing, a ground truck has broken down on taxiway A3 and blocked your way, ask Wuhan Ground for a tug to tow the vehicle away.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行期间，一辆地面车辆在 A3 滑行道上故障并挡住你的路线，请求武汉地面派牵引车将车辆拖走。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 323, a ground truck has broken down on taxiway A3 and blocked our way, request a tug to tow the vehicle away.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 323，一辆地面车辆在 A3 滑行道上故障并挡住我们的路线，请求牵引车将车辆拖走。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 323, hold position, the tug will come soon.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 323，保持位置，牵引车很快会来。
cards.referenceText: Roger, hold position, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持位置，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you notice the wind sock shows strong tailwind, ask Wuhan Tower to check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36 右等待点，注意到风向袋显示强顺风，请武汉塔台检查风。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 323, holding point Runway 36R, the wind sock shows strong tailwind, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 323，跑道 36R 等待点，风向袋显示强顺风，请求风向风速检查。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 323, wind 200 degrees, 8 meters per second.
B: The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, ask Wuhan Tower to change to Runway 18L for departure.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 323，风 200 度，8 米/秒。
B：顺风超过你的起飞限制，请武汉塔台改用跑道 18 左离场。
cards.referenceText: Roger, the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to Runway 18L, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求改用跑道 18L，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 323, taxi via A, A3, T and N to Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 323，经 A、A3、T 和 N 滑行至跑道 18 左。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via A, A3, T and N to Runway 18L, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 A、A3、T 和 N 滑行至跑道 18L，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of Runway 18L, you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 18 左外等待，准备好离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 323, holding short of Runway 18L, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 323，跑道 18L 外等待，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，联系武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA 323, passing 600m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA 323，正通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 323, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, turn right, direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 323，武汉离场，雷达识别，右转，直飞 WHA，爬升并保持 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000m, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 WHA，爬升并保持 3000 米，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, you hear loud noise coming from the left engine, and the instrument shows the EGT of port engine exceeds temperature limit, report this situation to ATC and hold for check.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升过程中，你听到左发有巨大噪音，仪表显示左发 EGT 超温，向 ATC 报告情况并请求等待检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA 323, we hear loud noise coming from the left engine, and the instrument shows the EGT of port engine exceeds temperature limit, request hold for check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA 323，我们听到左发有巨大噪音，仪表显示左发 EGT 超温，请求等待检查。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 323, hold at WHA VOR as published.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 323，按公布程序在 WHA VOR 等待。
cards.referenceText: Hold at WHA VOR as published, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按公布程序在 WHA VOR 等待，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: B: You have shut down the port engine, request immediate descent and return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已关停左发，请求立即下降并返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA 323, we have shut down the port engine, request immediate descent and return for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA 323，我们已关停左发，请求立即下降并返回着陆。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 323, turn left, direct to LKO, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 323，左转，直飞 LKO，预期跑道 36 右 ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, direct to LKO, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 LKO，预期跑道 36R ILS 进近，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 615, from Wuhan to Singapore, you are parking at gate 232, you are fully ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 615，从武汉飞往新加坡，停在 232 号登机口，已完全准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 615, gate 232, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 615，232 号登机口，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 615, push back and start up approved, push back onto taxiway Z4, abeam gate 234.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 615，推出和开车批准，推出至 Z4 滑行道，正对 234 号登机口。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, push back onto taxiway Z4, abeam gate 234, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，推出至 Z4 滑行道，正对 234 号登机口，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: B: During engine start, you have 1 engine starter failure, you wish to have more time to start the engine on taxiway Z4.
cards.audioTextZh: B：发动机启动期间，你有 1 个发动机启动机故障，希望有更多时间在 Z4 滑行道上启动发动机。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 615, we have 1 engine starter failure, we need more time to start the engine on taxiway Z4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 615，我们有 1 个发动机启动机故障，需要更多时间在 Z4 滑行道上启动发动机。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 615, how long do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need approximately 5 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 615，你需要多长时间？
B：告诉管制员你大约需要 5 分钟。
cards.referenceText: We need approximately 5 minutes, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们大约需要 5 分钟，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 615, ready for taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 615，准备好滑行。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 615, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 615，经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至跑道 36 右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: B: There is a Boeing 737 approaching you on E3, ask the controller who has the right of the way.
cards.audioTextZh: B：E3 上有一架 Boeing 737 向你接近，询问管制员谁有通行权。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 615, there is a B737 approaching us on E3, confirm who has the right of the way.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 615，E3 上有一架 B737 向我们接近，请确认谁有通行权。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 615, hold at present position, give way to Boeing 737 from your right, he is number 1 for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 615，在当前位置等待，让你右侧的 Boeing 737 先行，他是第一架离场。
cards.referenceText: Roger, hold at present position, traffic in sight, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，在当前位置等待，看到航空器，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 615, caution work in progress in the vicinity of E3.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 615，注意 E3 附近有施工。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36 右等待点，准备好离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 615, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 615，跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 615, cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, caution birds on the vicinity of airport.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 615，跑道 36 右可以起飞，注意机场附近有鸟。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, roger, thanks, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 可以起飞，收到，谢谢，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: C: Now you are passing 800 meters, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: C：现在你正通过 800 米，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA 615, passing 800 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，SIA 615，正通过 800 米。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 615, climb to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1016.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 615，爬升并保持 QNH 1016 上 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1016, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 QNH 1016 上 3000 米，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: B: During cruise, the flight attendant reports there is smoke coming from the air conditioning system in the cabin, make an Urgency call and advise ATC you want to level off at present level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：巡航期间，乘务员报告客舱空调系统冒烟，发出紧急呼叫，并告知 ATC 你想在当前高度改平。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, SIA 615, the flight attendant reports there is smoke coming from the air conditioning system in the cabin, request level off at present level.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，SIA 615，乘务员报告客舱空调系统冒烟，请求在当前高度改平。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 615, roger PAN, when able, say your further intention.
B: The smoke is removed, you have turned off the air conditioning system, you want radar guidance to return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 615，收到 PAN，可以时说明你的进一步意图。
B：烟雾已消除，你已关闭空调系统，想要雷达引导返回武汉机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, SIA 615, we have turned off the air conditioning system, request radar vectors to return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，SIA 615，我们已关闭空调系统，请求雷达引导返回武汉机场着陆。

cards.audioText: B: You turned off the air conditioning system to avoid high cabin altitude, asked to descend below 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你关闭了空调系统，为避免客舱高度过高，请求下降到 3000 米以下。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, SIA 615, we have turned off the air conditioning system, request descend below 3000 meters to avoid high cabin altitude.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，SIA 615，我们已关闭空调系统，为避免客舱高度过高，请求下降到 3000 米以下。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 615, descend to 2700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 615，下降至 2700 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 2700 meters, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 2700 米，SIA 615。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 615, do you need any emergency services?
B: Tell the controller you don't need any emergency services, because there is no damage to the aircraft or no injuries on board.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 615，你是否需要任何应急服务？
B：告诉管制员你不需要任何应急服务，因为飞机没有损伤，机上也没有人员受伤。
cards.referenceText: Negative, there is no damage to the aircraft or no injuries on board, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 否定，飞机没有损伤，机上也没有人员受伤，SIA 615。

topics.name: SIA 308 客舱烟雾 错过脱离滑行道

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 308, a flight from Wuhan to Frankfurt, you are parking at gate M5, you have got the latest ATIS G, contact Wuhan Delivery for ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 308，从武汉飞往法兰克福，停在 M5 登机口，已收到最新 ATIS G，联系武汉放行申请 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 308, gate M5, information G, request ATC clearance to Frankfurt.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 308，M5 登机口，收到 G 情报，申请前往法兰克福的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 308, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 1500 meters, ZF-05 departure, cruising level 11000 meters, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3763.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 308，武汉放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往法兰克福，离场跑道 04，初始爬升 1500 米，ZF-05 离场，巡航高度 11000 米，离场频率 119.45，应答机 3763。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 1500 meters, ZF-05 departure, cruising level 11000 meters, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3763, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往法兰克福，离场跑道 04，初始爬升 1500 米，ZF-05 离场，巡航高度 11000 米，离场频率 119.45，应答机 3763，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 308, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 308，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 308, Wuhan Ground, taxi to holding point 04 via taxiway Z4, A2, A to holding point E5 Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 308，武汉地面，经 Z4、A2、A 滑行道滑行至 04 等待点，至跑道 04 E5 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point 04 via taxiway Z4, A2, A to holding point E5 Runway 04, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A2、A 滑行道滑行至 04 等待点，至跑道 04 E5 等待点，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding at holding point E5, Runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower, and tell controller you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 E5 等待点，跑道 04，联系武汉塔台并告诉管制员你准备好离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 308, holding point E5, Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 308，E5 等待点，跑道 04，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 308, line up Runway 04 and cleared for immediate takeoff, traffic on final.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 308，进入跑道 04 并立即起飞，五边有航空器。
cards.referenceText: Roger, line up Runway 04 and cleared for immediate takeoff, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，进入跑道 04 并立即起飞，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Departure and ask to cancel SID and proceed to ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，爬升至 1500 米，联系武汉离场并请求取消 SID，直飞 ZF。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA 308, airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1500 meters, request cancel SID and proceed to ZF.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA 308，已离地，正通过 600 米，爬升至 1500 米，请求取消 SID，直飞 ZF。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 308, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, cancel SID, turn right, direct to ZF, climb to and maintain 4500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 308，武汉离场，雷达识别，取消 SID，右转，直飞 ZF，爬升并保持 4500 米。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, turn right, direct to ZF, climb to and maintain 4500 meters, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，右转，直飞 ZF，爬升并保持 4500 米，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are en route Germany, Rhein Radar Control, you are cruising at FL360, make an initial contact with Rhein Radar Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在前往德国航路上，莱茵雷达管制，巡航高度 FL360，与 莱茵雷达管制 首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Rhein Radar, SIA 308, en route, cruising at FL360.
cards.referenceTextZh: Rhein Radar，SIA 308，航路中，巡航高度 FL360。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 308, maintain FL360, offset 3 miles right of track due weather ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 308，保持 FL360，因前方天气，航迹右侧偏置 3 海里。
cards.referenceText: Maintain FL360, offset 3 miles right of track, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 FL360，航迹右侧偏置 3 海里，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have smoke in the cockpit, make a Distress call to Rhein Radar and request emergency descent to remove the smoke.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在驾驶舱有烟雾，向 Rhein Radar 发出遇险呼叫，请求紧急下降以排除烟雾。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Rhein Radar, SIA 308, we have smoke in the cockpit, request emergency descent for smoke removal.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，Rhein Radar，SIA 308，驾驶舱有烟雾，请求紧急下降以排烟。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 308, roger MAYDAY, descend to and maintain FL100, keep us advised the situation on board and your intention.
B: Read back the instructions and tell the controller you are working the checklist and will advise.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 308，收到 MAYDAY，下降并保持 FL100，持续告知机上情况和你的意图。
B：复诵指令并告诉管制员你正在执行检查单，将会通知。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain FL100, we are working the checklist and will advise, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 FL100，我们正在执行检查单，将会通知，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: B: After completing the checklist, the smoke can't be removed and you decide to divert to Paris, inform the controller your situation and intention.
cards.audioTextZh: B：完成检查单后，烟雾无法消除，你决定备降巴黎，通知管制员你的情况和意图。
cards.referenceText: Rhein Radar, SIA 308, the smoke can't be removed, request divert to Paris.
cards.referenceTextZh: Rhein Radar，SIA 308，烟雾无法消除，请求备降巴黎。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 308, roger, turn left heading 350, descend to and maintain 8000 feet, contact Paris Approach on 119.4.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 308，收到，左转航向 350，下降并保持 8000 英尺，联系巴黎进近119.4。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 350, descend to and maintain 8000 feet, 119.4, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 350，下降并保持 8000 英尺，119.4，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 308, descend to and maintain 6000 feet, cleared for ILS approach Runway 08L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 308，下降并保持 6000 英尺，许可跑道 08 左 ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 6000 feet, cleared for ILS approach Runway 08L, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 6000 英尺，许可跑道 08L ILS 进近，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have landed on Runway 08L, but you missed the first rapid exit, report it to Paris Tower and request vacate via the second rapid exit.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已在跑道 08 左落地，但错过了第一个快速出口，向巴黎塔台报告，并请求经第二个快速出口脱离。
cards.referenceText: Paris Tower, SIA 308, we have missed the first rapid exit, request vacate via the second rapid exit.
cards.referenceTextZh: 巴黎塔台，SIA 308，我们错过了第一个快速出口，请求经第二个快速出口脱离。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 308, roger, take second rapid exit, when vacated, contact Paris Ground on 118.5.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 308，收到，使用第二个快速出口，脱离后联系巴黎地面118.5。
cards.referenceText: Take second rapid exit, when vacated, contact Paris Ground on 118.5, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 使用第二个快速出口，脱离后联系巴黎地面118.5，SIA 308。

topics.name: SIA 1334 通讯失效 地面延误

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 334 from Chengdu to Beijing, you are at stand 34, information I received, request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 334，从成都飞往北京，在 34 号机位，已收到 I 情报，请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Delivery, SIA 1334, stand 34, information I, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都放行，SIA 1334，34 号机位，收到 I 情报，申请前往北京的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 334, stand by, I am going to check your flight plan.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 334，等待，我将检查你的飞行计划。
cards.referenceText: Stand by, SIA 1334.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，SIA 1334。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 334, Delivery, cleared to Beijing as filed, fight level #%$@*^#....
B: The ATC clearance has been disturbed, inform ATC and request repeat the clearance.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 334，放行，许可按提交飞行计划飞往北京，高度 #%$@*^#……
B：ATC 放行许可受到干扰，通知 ATC 并请求重复放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Delivery, SIA 1334, the ATC clearance has been disturbed, request repeat the clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都放行，SIA 1334，ATC 放行许可受到干扰，请求重复放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 334 is cleared to Beijing as filed, 10700 meters, D06 departure, Runway 12, runway heading until passing 3000 meters before turning right, squawk 4562.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 334，许可按提交飞行计划飞往北京，10700 米，D06 离场，跑道 12，保持跑道航向直到通过 3000 米后再右转，应答机 4562。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing as filed, 10700m, D06 departure, Runway 12, runway heading until passing 3000m before turning right, squawk 4562, SIA 1334.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按提交飞行计划飞往北京，10700 米，D06 离场，跑道 12，保持跑道航向直到通过 3000 米后再右转，应答机 4562，SIA 1334。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 334, readback correct, when ready for push back and start up, contact Ground 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 334，复诵正确，准备好推出和开车时联系地面 118.9。

cards.audioText: B: Before being pushed back, the chief purser calls you that the general declaration form is not on board, inform ATC the situation and request delay the push.
cards.audioTextZh: B：推出前，乘务长通知你总申报单不在机上，通知 ATC 情况并请求延迟推出。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Ground, SIA 1334, the chief purser reports that the general declaration form is not on board, request delay the push.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都地面，SIA 1334，乘务长报告总申报单不在机上，请求延迟推出。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 334, roger, call me back when ready.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 334，收到，准备好时再叫我。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, SIA 1334.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，SIA 1334。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 334, are you fully ready now? Your slot is 0310.
B: You need to open the cabin door for the release documents, advise Ground you will need another 5 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 334，你们现在完全准备好了吗？你的时隙是 0310。
B：你需要打开客舱门取放行文件，告知地面还需要 5 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Ground, SIA 1334, we need to open the cabin door for the release documents, request another 5min.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都地面，SIA 1334，我们需要打开客舱门取放行文件，请求再给 5 分钟。

cards.audioText: B: Later, the release documents are fully ready, call Ground you are ready.
cards.audioTextZh: B：稍后，放行文件全部准备好，呼叫地面你已准备好。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Ground, SIA 1334, ready for pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都地面，SIA 1334，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 334, push back and startup approved until abeam gate 33, do not block gate 35, there is incoming traffic to the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 334，推出和开车批准，推出至正对 33 号登机口，不得阻挡 35 号登机口，有进港航空器要进该登机口。
cards.referenceText: Push back and startup approved until abeam gate 33, do not block gate35, SIA 1334.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，推出至正对 33 号登机口，不得阻挡 35 号登机口，SIA 1334。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 544. Now you are on the way taxiing to the holding point.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 544。现在你正在滑行前往等待点。
cards.referenceText: Ground, SIA 544, we are on the way taxiing to the holding point.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，SIA 544，我们正在滑行前往等待点。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 544, frozen icy patches on your taxiway, I suggest turning right and using taxiway G instead.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 544，你的滑行道上有结冰斑块，我建议右转改用 G 滑行道。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, we will turn right to taxiway G, SIA 544.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，我们将右转至 G 滑行道，SIA 544。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 544, go beyond Airbus 320 on your left, then turn right.
B: Read back the instruction. Then tell the controller an aircraft is approaching to you from the opposite direction
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 544，越过你左侧的 Airbus 320，然后右转。
B：复诵指令。然后告诉管制员有一架飞机从相反方向接近你。
cards.referenceText: Go beyond A320 on the left, then turn right, an aircraft is approaching to us from the opposite direction, SIA 544.
cards.referenceTextZh: 越过左侧 A320，然后右转，有一架飞机从相反方向接近我们，SIA 544。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 544, disregard the traffic, Boeing 737, he is on his way to the parking stand after you.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 544，不用管那架飞机，Boeing 737，他在你之后前往停机位。
cards.referenceText: Roger, SIA 544.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，SIA 544。

cards.audioText: B: Call Ground and ask if the Ground controller may ask the Airbus 320 to pull in to further left, you want to pass it due your slot time will be expired at 30.
cards.audioTextZh: B：呼叫地面，询问地面管制员是否可以让 Airbus 320 再向左靠一些，你想通过，因为你的时隙将在 30 过期。
cards.referenceText: Ground, SIA 544, please ask the A320 to pull in to the left so that we can pass it, our slot time will expire at 30.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，SIA 544，请让 A320 向左靠一些，以便我们通过，我们的时隙将在 30 过期。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 544, your airplane has been impounded by the airport authorities.
B: You ask the reason.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 544，你的飞机已被机场当局扣押。
B：你询问原因。
cards.referenceText: Ground, SIA 544, why has our airplane been impounded?
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，SIA 544，为什么我们的飞机被扣押？

cards.audioText:
C: I don’t know the exact reason. The only thing I know is that you have not been cleared by Customs.
B: You tell the controller that you have the clearance sheet together with a waybill.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：我不知道确切原因。我只知道你们还没有获得海关放行。
B：你告诉管制员你有放行单和运单。
cards.referenceText: Ground, SIA 544, we have a clearance sheet together with a waybill right here with us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，SIA 544，我们这里有放行单和运单。

cards.audioText:
C: It is not an ATC matter. I am only passing the message.
B: You ask the controller to help you find the reason.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：这不是 ATC 事务。我只是转达信息。
B：你请管制员帮你查明原因。
cards.referenceText: Ground, SIA 544, will you please do us a favor by asking them the reason?
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，SIA 544，能否请你帮我们询问他们原因？

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 544, I have just received the airport authority information that there is a suspected person, perhaps a criminal with a bomb aboard your aircraft.
B: Ask the control what you should do.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 544，我刚收到机场当局信息，你的飞机上有一名可疑人员，可能是一名带有炸弹的罪犯。
B：询问管制你应该怎么做。
cards.referenceText: Ground, SIA 544, what should we do?
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，SIA 544，我们应该怎么做？

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 544, tell the passengers that there is a technical problem. You have to return to the remote apron for repairing.
B: You make a captain announcement.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: SIA 544，告诉旅客飞机有技术问题。你们必须返回远机位维修。
B: 你进行机长广播。
cards.referenceText: Ladies and gentlemen, your captain speaking, I am sorry to tell you we have to return to the terminal due to the technical problem of the aircraft. Please take your seats and fasten your seatbelts. Thank you for your cooperation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 女士们，先生们，我是机长。很抱歉通知大家，由于飞机技术问题，我们必须返回航站楼。请各位就座并系好安全带。感谢您的配合。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 544, enter the runway and expedite taxiing on the runway. Exit the runway via E4.
cards.audioTextZh: C: SIA 544，进入跑道并在跑道上加速滑行。经 E4 脱离跑道。
cards.referenceText: Enter the runway and expedite taxiing on the runway. Exit the runway via E4, SIA 544.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入跑道并在跑道上加速滑行。经 E4 脱离跑道，SIA 544。

cards.audioText: B: You contact Ground and report you have vacated the Runway 36R via E4.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 联系地面，报告你们已通过 E4 脱离跑道 36 right。
cards.referenceText: Ground, SIA 544, we have vacated the Runway 36 right via E4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，SIA 544，我们已通过 E4 脱离跑道 36 right。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 544, take taxiway A8, direct to apron No.5.
cards.audioTextZh: C: SIA 544，走滑行道 A8，直达 5 号机坪。
cards.referenceText: Taxiway A8, direct to apron No.5, SIA 544.
cards.referenceTextZh: 滑行道 A8，直达 5 号机坪，SIA 544。

cards.audioText: B: Report you have reached Apron No.5.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 报告你们已到达 5 号机坪。
cards.referenceText: Ground, SIA 544, we have reached Apron No.5.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，SIA 544，我们已到达 5 号机坪。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 544, wait there. Don’t let the passengers get off the aircraft. The policemen will be on the scene in a minute.
cards.audioTextZh: C: SIA 544，在那里等待。不要让旅客下机。警察一分钟后到现场。
cards.referenceText: Roger, SIA 544.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，SIA 544。

topics.name: SIA 123 鸟击 发动机失效 积冰/防冰

cards.audioText: Your call sign is SIA 123, stand 215, from Wuhan to SIA, information B received, request ATC clearance to SIA.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 SIA 123，停机位 215，从武汉飞往 SIA，已收到 B 情报，请求前往 SIA 的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 123, Stand 215, information B; request ATC clearance to SIA.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 123，停机位 215，已收到 B 情报；请求前往 SIA 的 ATC 放行许可。
