After the flight, the flight crew discussed about the ATC instruction, and they thought the instruction could be understood differently. It was a fortune that they landed safely, so the ATC must use standard words to give clear instructions when they were working.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架飞机从北京飞往上海。途中，飞机向上海进近申请雷达引导下降高度。向台航道157°,高度3000英尺。管制员给出指令："航向130°,切入跑道16航道。"但完成指令后，TCAS显示几个活动目标。然后ATC给出另一指令："不要穿过航道，保持间隔。"飞行员回复："照办。"飞机截获航道时，飞行员向ATC报告，但ATC说："我说的是，不要截获航道。"两位飞行员无法确定ATC的意图，但他们继续进近并安全着陆。飞行结束后，机组对ATC的指令进行讨论，他们认为指令可以有不同的理解方式。幸运的是飞机能够安全着陆，所以ATC在工作时必须使用标准用语来给出指令。

cards.audioText: At 1:30 pm local time, the crew members checked in for a long distance flight, and the aircraft took off after 3:30 pm. Another 2 hours later, the operation asked the aircraft to return back to the airport of departure because of technical fault, so the captain had to tell passengers about what was going on via PA.After landing, the flight crew had worked for about 8 hours, and their work should be taken over under the circumstances, but the operation told them that they had to change to operate another shorter and delayed flight. It was already eight o' clock after the aircraft landed. Three of the crew decided not to operate the flight and I supported their opinion. Two replacement crew members arrived at the aircraft and they still needed to operate their new flight. At about ten o'clock, everything was ready for departure. The crew members hadn't had any formal meal since then.
cards.audioTextZh: 当地时间下午1:30，机组成员到机场报到，为一次长途飞行做准备，飞机在下午3:30之后起飞。约2小时后，由于技术故障，运行控制部门要求飞机返回出发机场，机长只得通过客舱广播向乘客说明情况。飞机着陆时，机组已经工作约8小时，按当时情况本应由其他机组接替，但运行控制部门却通知他们，必须改为执行另一个航程较短但已经延误的航班。飞机落地时已是晚上8点。3名机组成员决定不再执行该航班，我支持他们的决定。两名替换机组成员随后抵达飞机，但原机组仍需执行他们新分配的航班。到晚上10点左右，一切离场准备就绪。自报到以来，机组成员一直没有吃过一顿正式的饭。

cards.audioText: In 2005, direct charter flight between Chinese mainland and Taiwan was opened. Departure and destination airports included Beijing, Guangzhou, Shanghai and Taipei. It was the first ever non-stop, round-trip charter flight across the Taiwan Straits in 56 years. It was also the first time since 1949 that a mainland jetliner flew for Taiwan on normal commercial flight. The first mainland aircraft to take off was CCA1087 which departed from the Beijing Capital Airport at 8:00 am on Saturday. All the 88 passengers on board were Taiwan business people and their families. During the Spring Festival, they went back home for traditional family reunion. The first mainland aircraft to land was CSZ3097. It only took 90 minutes for all the 242 passengers on board to fly from Guangzhou to Taipei. After nearly 4 hours of non-stop flight, a charter plane of Taiwan-based China Airlines landed in Beijing. The flight time was much shorter than the same trip in the past. Previous flight would take about 10 hours, and passengers had to transit in Hong Kong or Macao. The direct charter flight will provide convenience to people on the mainland and Taiwan.
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年，中国大陆与台湾之间开通了直航包机。出发和到达机场包括北京、广州、上海和台北。这是56年来两岸首次开通不经停往返包机，也是自1949年以来，大陆喷气式客机首次执行飞往台湾的正常商业航班。最先从大陆起飞的是国航CCA1087航班，飞机于星期六上午8:00从北京首都机场起飞。机上88名乘客全部是台湾商务人士及其家属，他们在春节期间返乡与家人团聚。最先抵达台湾的是南航CSZ3097航班。机上242名乘客从广州飞往台北，全程仅用90分钟。经过近4小时不经停飞行，一架台湾中华航空公司的包机在北京着陆。与过去相同行程相比，飞行时间大幅缩短；以往需要约10小时，乘客还必须在香港或澳门中转。直航包机将为大陆和台湾民众往来提供便利。

cards.audioText: The breakup of China Airlines Flight 611, a Boeing 747-200, has drawn international attention because it comes at a time of increasing concern over how long older jets can remain airworthy. Some research has suggested that metal fatigue may be a particular problem in planes that are used regularly in very warm, humid places like Taipei and Hong Kong. But Boeing maintains that with proper maintenance, aircraft aging should not be a problem. The flight data recorder shows that the plane began gaining altitude at a significantly faster rate in the 27 seconds before the plane broke apart, although the extra gain in altitude was well within the plane's design limits. The plane was supposed to be leveling off then as it approached its cruising altitude of 35, 000 feet. According to the examination of the wreckage, investigators analyzed that there's no evidence of an explosion or pilot error.
cards.audioTextZh: 中华航空611号航班是一架波音747-200，其空中解体事件引起国际社会关注，因为人们正越来越担忧老旧喷气式飞机能够保持适航状态多长时间。一些研究认为，在台北、香港等炎热潮湿地区频繁运行的飞机尤其容易出现金属疲劳问题。但波音公司坚持认为，只要维护得当，飞机老化不应成为问题。飞行数据记录器显示，在飞机解体前27秒内，飞机的爬升率明显增大，不过增加的高度仍完全处于飞机的设计限制范围内。当时飞机接近35,000英尺巡航高度，本应正在改平。根据对残骸的检查，调查人员认为没有证据显示发生过爆炸，也没有证据表明飞行员操作失误。

cards.audioText: One day, an accident happened because an aircraft was guided improperly by a marshaller when parking. The marshaller first guided the aircraft to a gate. When the aircraft was near the stop line, the marshaller gave a premature crossed wands signal which means stopping taxiing, so the aircraft was stopped abruptly. The pilot set the parking brake and released the seatbelt sign. Unexpectedly, the marshaller showed the separated wands again and stopped them a little forward of the point. He did not give a clear signal, and the sudden stop caused fatigue and a medical emergency of 2 passengers. When the marshaller was asked about the signal, he said he did not give the signal. Anyway, it was not a good guidance but the final position of the aircraft was proper. Luckily there were no injuries on board.
cards.audioTextZh: 一天，一架飞机在停靠机位时因信号员引导不当而发生事件。信号员先引导飞机滑向机位。飞机接近停止线时，信号员过早给出指挥棒交叉信号，表示停止滑行，飞机因此突然停下。飞行员设置停留刹车并关闭安全带指示灯。出乎意料的是，信号员随后又给出指挥棒分开信号，让飞机继续向前移动一点后才再次停下。信号员的指令不清晰，飞机突然停止导致两名乘客身体不适，其中出现医疗紧急情况。被问及相关信号时，信号员否认自己发出过该信号。无论如何，这次引导并不规范，不过飞机最终停靠位置正确。所幸机上没有人员受伤。

cards.audioText: When a B747 was climbing out, its No.1 engine failed. The failure caused the aircraft to yaw the heading about 20 degrees from the original. The Primary Engine Display showed that the thrust was zero, the engine indications were all red, and the temperature was exceeding 680℃.The aircraft had autopilot disconnection, then it suddenly yawed and the heading deviated 10 degrees. The pilot immediately leveled off the aircraft so that he could check the engine. Then he confirmed that No.1 engine was failed. The EGT temperature was still high when all proper procedures were done. So the pilot pulled out the engine fire lever to secure the engine and completed the checklist. Because of the landing weight requirements, the aircraft had to dump fuel before landing. Then the pilot requested radar vector to the fuel dumping area and started dumping fuel at 8000 feet. During the 35 minutes of dumping, the controller asked other aircraft to avoid the dumping area. At last, they made an auto landing then taxied to the gate safely.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架B747在上升，此时1号发动机失效。故障导致飞机从原航线偏航20度。主发动机显示器显示推力为零，发动机故障显示亮起，温度超过680℃。飞机的自动驾驶断开，然后飞机突然偏航10度。飞行员立刻平飞来检查发动机，然后飞行员确定1号发动机已失效。所有程序全部完成后，EGT温度仍然很高，所以飞行员拉出发动机灭火手柄来保护发动机，并完成检查单。由于着陆重量限制，飞机着陆前必须放油。飞行员请求雷达引导到放油区，然后在8000英尺高开始放油。放油持续了35分钟，这期间管制员指挥其它飞机避开放油区。最后，飞机自动着陆并安全滑到停机位。

cards.audioText: A B737 was cleared to taxi to holding point of runway 29 while the pilot saw the landing lights of A320 on landing rollout at the opposite end of the runway. A320 had landed on runway 11 and a conflict was nearly to happen. In order to exit the runway quickly, the pilot of B737 turned 180 degrees. At the same time, tower called and gave him instruction to vacate the runway. The B737 almost collided with A320 but there were nothing wrong with the two aircraft. The cause of this possible accident was that the two operations were conducted in both directions on runway 11/29. A320 was landing on runway 11 while B737 was holding short of runway 29 and waiting for ATC clearance at the same time. Then the tower called them and instructed them to fly SH-01 departure and climb 7000 feet when airborne, but they considered it as a clearance, so they began to taxi onto the runway. At that time, the tower and ground were combined. The pilot had called the tower twice without receiving any response, so he was not sure whether the aircraft had landed.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架波音737获准滑行至29号跑道等待点。此时飞行员看到一架空客A320在跑道另一端亮着着陆灯，正在着陆滑跑；该A320是在11号跑道着陆，两机险些发生冲突。为了尽快退出跑道，波音737飞行员将飞机转向180度。与此同时，塔台呼叫并指令其脱离跑道。波音737与空客A320险些相撞，但两架飞机均未受损。这起险情的原因，是11/29号跑道同时进行相反方向运行：空客A320在11号跑道着陆，而波音737在29号跑道外等待管制许可。随后塔台呼叫波音737，向其发布SH-01离场程序以及离地后爬升至7,000英尺的指令，但机组把这段指令误认为进入跑道的许可，因此开始滑入跑道。当时塔台和地面管制席位合并运行。此前飞行员曾两次呼叫塔台但都没有收到回应，因此无法确定那架飞机是否已经着陆。

cards.audioText: The ATC cleared an aircraft to take off, but shortly after take-off, two of the flight attendants smelled something burning. They immediately informed the purser while found that the captain had already contacted the Tower and requested airport assistance. Some passengers felt panic when they saw the smoke in the cabin. Soon captain told passengers about the situation via PA.A few minutes later, dense smoke spread all over the cabin and some passengers suffered from smoke inhalation. At the same time, the flight attendants consulted their emergency checklist and tried to keep the passengers in order. The aircraft finally returned to the departure airport. Fire trucks arrived and ambulances were ready to meet them at the apron. Fortunately, all the passengers were safely evacuated and got effective first aid. After inspection, the cause of the accident was clear. It was an electrical fire in the cockpit.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架飞机从ATC处得到起飞许可，但在起飞后不久，两名乘务员闻到烧焦的味道，他们立刻通知了乘务长，同时发现机长已经联系塔台并请求机场援助。一些乘客看到客舱有烟开始感到恐慌。很快，机长通过广播将情况告知乘客。几分钟后，客舱内布满浓烟，有些乘客吸入了烟尘。此时，乘务员完成紧急检查单并尽力维持乘客的秩序。飞机最终返回出发机场，消防车和救护车在机坪等待飞机。幸运的是，乘客们全部被安全撤离并得到急救。经检查，事故原因是由于驾驶舱发生电气火灾。

cards.audioText: In 1986, a little girl named Crystal Grant living in Memphis, Tennessee got a liver disease and needed a liver transplant. Her family got information that a liver source became available but she must fly to Houston, Texas, she would be able to take the medical treatment. Before departure, an accident happened that the plane blew a couple of tires and ran off the runway into a fence while taking off. At the same time, a Coca-Cola corporate jet had just arrived at the airport carrying their CEO, and the pilot who saw the accident heard the experience of Crystal. Then the pilot briefed the CEO about the story. After visiting Crystal, the CEO decided to take her to Houston by his corporate jet. Meanwhile, the liver which Crystal needed was in San Diego, California, but the flight to transport the liver got failed. The CEO asked the pilot if they could fly to San Diego to pick up the liver first, but found that they would not have enough time for the transplant. Then the CEO contacted the governor of California and explained the situation. Finally, the governor dispatched an F-18 fighter jet to safely transport the liver container to Houston. Everything ran smoothly and the little girl got a successful transplant.
cards.audioTextZh: 1986年，家住田纳西州孟菲斯的小女孩Crystal Grant患有肝病，需要接受肝脏移植。家人得知已有可用肝源，但她必须飞往得克萨斯州休斯顿才能接受治疗。出发前，她原本要乘坐的飞机在起飞时爆了数个轮胎，冲出跑道并撞上围栏。与此同时，一架搭载可口可乐公司首席执行官的公务机刚刚抵达机场。公务机飞行员目睹了事故并听说Crystal的经历，随后向首席执行官讲述此事。首席执行官探望Crystal后，决定用自己的公务机送她前往休斯顿。Crystal需要的肝脏位于加利福尼亚州圣迭戈，但原计划运输肝脏的航班未能成行。首席执行官询问飞行员能否先飞往圣迭戈取肝脏，却发现这样将赶不上移植手术。首席执行官随后联系加利福尼亚州州长并说明情况。最终，州长派出一架F-18战斗机，将装有肝脏的容器安全运至休斯顿。整个过程进展顺利，小女孩成功接受了移植手术。

cards.audioText: A man was on a flight from Seattle to San Francisco, but along the way, the plane stopped unexpectedly in Sacramento. The flight attendant explained the situation and told passengers that they could get off the aircraft for a walk within 50 minutes before the plane re-boarded. Passengers got off the plane in succession except one person. When the man walked by the only person on board he could tell the person was a blind man. Because the man was wearing sunglasses and a seeing eye dog was lying quietly underneath the seat in front of him. The blind man had flown this flight frequently because the pilot could call him by name. The pilot asked, "Keith, we' re in Sacramento for almost an hour. Would you like to get off and stretch your legs? The blind man said no but he asked the pilot if he could take his dog for a walk. What the pilot did not know was, all the people in the gate area came to a complete standstill when they saw him, because the pilot got off the plane with a seeing eye dog and a pair of sunglasses on. It caused a panic between passengers that they thought the pilot was a blind man. They not only tried to change planes, but also wanted to change airlines! It took time for the pilot and flight attendants to explain to passengers and calm them down. Later the aircraft took off again.
cards.audioTextZh: 一位男士乘坐飞机从西雅图飞往旧金山，途中飞机突然在萨克拉门托降落。乘务员向乘客解释了情况，并告诉他们可以在起飞前下飞机活动50分钟。乘客们依次下飞机，但有一位乘客没走。当男士经过这位乘客时，他注意到这位乘客是盲人。因为他戴着墨镜，一只导盲犬安静地躺在他前方的座位下。这位盲人肯定经常乘坐这趟航班，因为飞行员能够直接叫出他的名字。飞行员问他："Keith,我们将在萨克拉门托停留一小时，你想下飞机活动一下吗?"这位盲人拒绝了，但他问飞行员是否可以带他的导盲犬散个步。但飞行员不知道的是，门口的乘客在看到他时全都停下了，因为他在下飞机时戴着墨镜并牵着一只导盲犬。这引发了乘客们的恐慌，他们以为飞行员是个盲人。乘客们不仅想更换航班，而且还想更换航空公司!飞行员和乘务员花了一段时间向乘客解释情况并让大家冷静下来，之后飞机再次起飞了。

cards.audioText: On a flight, a middle-aged, well-off white South African Lady was not satisfied with her seat for she found herself sitting next to a black man. She called the flight attendant over and asked to change to another seat. The attendant wanted to know the reason, which made the woman more irritable. "Can't you see? You' ve sat me next to a kaffir. I can't possibly sit next to this disgusting human. Find me another seat!" The flight attendant found it hard to deal with because the flight was very full, but she told the woman that she would go and check to see if there was any seat available in club or first class. A few minutes later the attendant returned with good news. Economy and club are both full, but there were one seat in first class. When the attendant delivered the news, the lady cannot help but looked at the people around her with a smug and self-satisfied grin. Then the attendant continued, "We don't make this kind of upgrade as usual, however, I just got special permission from the captain and he felt that it was outrageous for our passenger to be forced to sit next to such an obnoxious person. "She then turned to the black man sitting next to the woman and said, "So if you'd like to get your things, sir, I have your seat ready for you. " The surrounding passengers all stood and gave a standing ovation, the black guy walks up to the front of the plane.
cards.audioTextZh: 一次飞行中，有位来自南非、富有的中年白人女士对自己的座位不满意，因为她发现自己的座位在一位黑人男士旁边，她向乘务员要求换座位。乘务员询问换座位的原因，这让她更加烦躁：“你看不到吗?你们让我坐在黑人旁边，我不能坐在这么恶心的人旁边，给我换个座位!"乘务员很难解决这个问题，因为飞机几乎客满，但她还是告诉女士她会查询公务舱或头等舱是否有空位。几分钟后，乘务员带回了好消息。经济舱和公务舱全部客满，但头等舱还有一个座位。乘务员说到这里时，那位女士禁不住自鸣得意地笑着看向周围的人。乘务员接着说到：“这种情况下通常不会给乘客升舱，然而机长刚才有特别许可，他不能接受我们的乘客要被迫坐在讨厌的人身边。"然后她对女士身边的乘客说：“所以如果您愿意收拾行李，我们已为您准备好座位。"周围的乘客全部起立鼓掌，黑人乘客换到了飞机前部的座位。

cards.audioText: An aircraft broke due to some unexplained problems of the propeller. The pilot tried every method to repair but only to get more confused. So he had to call an experienced engineer to find out the problem. The engineer searched the engine carefully. It took a long time for the engineer to finish the checking procedure, at last he only knocked the engine at a place then the engine was repaired well. The engineer charged the pilot for 5000 dollars, but the pilot was not willing to pay for it since he thought that it was too expensive for just a knock. The engineer was upset about the pilot's words for he didn't understand the value of engineers' work. He said, "It is inexpensive for a knock. A knock only values for 5 dollars, but knowing the correct place to knock values 4995 dollars. "
cards.audioTextZh: 由于螺旋桨的问题飞机损坏，飞行员尝试用各种方法修理，但却只让自己更困惑，所以他不得不叫一位有经验的工程师来解决问题。工程师仔细地检查发动机，检查程序花费很长时间，最后工程师在发动机某处敲了敲，然后发动机就修好了。工程师向飞行员收取5000美金的费用，但飞行员不愿意付，他认为敲一下飞机就收取这些费用太贵了。工程师对此很失望，因为这说明飞行员不懂得工程师工作的价值。工程师说："修理费并不贵，敲一次只需5美金，但知道敲一次的正确位置价值4995美金。"

cards.audioText: A worker in the airport just finished his work, while he was walking along the apron he found a female pilot was struggling with a huge package. The package was stuck, half of the package was in the plane and another half was out. The worker was a very kind and warmhearted man, so he tried to help the female pilot. He went into the plane and tried his best to push the package, but the package did not move and nothing happened. Later the worker and the pilot decided to push and pull at the same time. They tried so hard over and over again and both got exhausted, but they still couldn't move the package. The worker felt hopeless and he said it was impossible to get the package out of the plane. Then he heard the pilot shrieking, "Oh, no! I was trying to stuff it in!"
cards.audioTextZh: 一位机场工人刚结束工作，他在停机坪看到一位女飞行员正在费力处理一个大包裹。包裹被卡住，一半在飞机内一半在飞机外。这位工人很热心，所以他想帮助这个女飞行员。他走到机舱内并尽力将包裹向外推，但是包裹根本没有挪动。之后，工人和飞行员决定一个人推的同时另一个人拉。他们一次次努力，两个人都很累，但仍然没有挪动包裹。工人感到很绝望，他说包裹可能没办法从飞机里拿出来了，然后他听到了飞行员的大叫："不!我是想将包裹放进去!"

cards.audioText: Lately I was on a VFR flight.we were passing within Aerodrome Traffic Zone under the control of Local Approach, visibility was good, and there was not too much traffic on the frequency. The controller requested a position report by asking if we were over an Island, the feature cannot be found on the half million chart and I was not familiar with it. So I looked for it and asked for clarification. During the period a potential Airprox developed. Fortunately the pilot noted it and avoided it by an evasive maneuver. The pilot and I were both annoyed by the controller for using an unrecognizable local feature which caused confusion and distraction for us. We were squawking 7000 Mode C, so our position should be known. If not, or if there were too much traffic on screen, the controller should have asked for a specific squawk. Controllers should know that non-local pilots only navigate according to charted features. To avoid accidents, local knowledge should be taken seriously.
cards.audioTextZh: 最近在一次目视飞行时，我们在当地进近的指挥下通过机场活动区域，能见度很好，频率里也没有很多飞机。管制员要我们报位置报，询问我们是否飞过某个岛，我在地形图上看不到这个岛，我对这里的地形也并不熟悉，所以我试图寻找这个地形并要求管制员进行说明。在这期间，飞机险些与其它飞机相撞。幸运的是，飞行员通过规避机动避免了事故。飞行员和我都很恼火，由于管制员在指挥时使用无法找到的当地地形，导致我们很迷惑并为此分神。我们的应答机是C模式，编码7000,所以管制员应该知道飞机的位置。如果管制员不知道，或屏幕上有太多活动，管制员应向我们要求特定的编码。管制员要了解，非当地的飞行员只能根据图表上的地形导航。为避免事故发生，要谨慎使用当地知识进行指挥。

cards.audioText: The flight was flying to UK, and before landing, we were asked to hold at FL150 for approximately 30 minutes delay due to the weather. The ATC first instructed us to hold at a level around FL100 and the next clearance The situation was embarrassing. I had to apologize on the radio telephone and ATC responded, "No problem", with updated heading and further descent. However, that airport was not the place to be at the wrong level and heading on a busy, rough Sunday night! In the days following, by giving the incident much thought, I found the major contributing factor of my mistake. We were not supposed to hear what we thought we should hear, thus confusing heading and cleared level. Instead, we should pay attention to the ATC instruction.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机正飞往英国。着陆前，由于天气，我们要在高度层150等待30分钟左右。ATC首先指挥我们在高度层100等待，我们认为下个指令应该是下降到更低高度，当我们接近高度层80时，ATC询问我们是否转向航向080。这种情况让人很为难，我不得不在通话时道歉，ATC回复：“没关系”,然后告知我修正后的航向和下降高度。然而，在繁忙的周日晚，错误的高度层和航向会让飞机无法到达机场!接下来的几天中，我对这件事思考了很多，并找到出现错误的主要原因。我们不应假设自己会收到什么指令，从而会弄混航向和高度。相反，我们应关注ATC给出的指令。

cards.audioText: John was the captain of a flight from Shanghai to Hong Kong. On July 20th, he and his first officer, Ted, controlled the airplane to take off from Shanghai airport. When the plane reached 1200 feet, a windshear warning occurred with the warning sound echoed in the cockpit. Under that circumstances, John took over the control immediately and called for the checklist. The result showed the left PFD indicated normally and only a malfunction indication appeared on the right seat PFD.The flight crew came to an agreement it was a false warning, so they continued to climb. The plane safely landed on Hong Kong airport 3 hours later. The crew asked a ground maintenance personnel to fix the problem. Unfortunately, on the way back, the same trouble appeared again.
cards.audioTextZh: John是一架上海飞往香港航班的机长。7月20日，他和副驾驶Ted操纵飞机从上海机场起飞。飞机爬升到1,200英尺时出现风切变警告，警报声在驾驶舱内响起。John立即接管操纵并要求执行检查单。检查结果显示，左座主飞行显示器指示正常，只有右座主飞行显示器出现故障指示。机组一致判断这是一次虚假警告，因此继续爬升。3小时后，飞机在香港机场安全着陆。机组请地面维修人员排除故障。遗憾的是，在返程途中同样的故障再次出现。

cards.audioText: 18. During a flight from Hong Kong to Beijing, we captured an urgency call from UAL320 that they had a bird strike. A bird crashed their left windshield and the captain was badly wounded by the broken glass, so they requested for priority landing and ambulance. We informed this serious incident to the controller. The controller contacted the UAL320 at once without receiving any response. So we were asked to relay the instruction to UAL320. Luckily, we contacted them successfully, "UAL320, CCA830, Beijing Approach cleared you ILS straight in approach runway 16R, you are number one, ambulance and first aid will be ready for you. ""Roger, thank you very much", the UAL320 replied. Finally, the aircraft landed on Beijing airport safely and the captain was sent to hospital immediately. There were no other people injured on the airplane.
cards.audioTextZh: 在香港飞往北京途中，我们接到来自美联航320的紧急呼叫，他们的飞机遭遇鸟击。有鸟撞到左边挡风玻璃，玻璃破损，机长受重伤，所以他们请求优先着陆和救护车。我们将这起严重事故告诉管制员，管制员立刻联系美联航320,但没有收到任何回复。于是管制员要求我们传送指令给美联航320。幸运的是，我们与美联航320成功建立联系，"美联航320,国航830,北京进近同意直接盲降进近跑道16右，你是第一个，救护车和急救已就位。""收到，非常感谢。”美联航320这样回复我们。飞机最终在北京机场安全着陆，机长被立刻送往医院，机上没有其他人员受伤。

cards.audioText: 19. I still remember my solo day. On that day, the vice president of the United States was driven to the airport. Air force 2, a new B757, landed at about 9o'clock but we had to wait until all the formalities were completed on the apron. My CFI had asked me if I was ready for solo. At that time I said yes because of my confidence, and the clear weather also helped, but when I got into the cockpit and knew the CFI wasn't coming, I still felt a bit nervous and I hoped not to screw it up. Everything was as usual and it was even better for me to notice that the plane had a better climb rate and there was a lot more room in the C150 with only one person. Everything went by the book except when I lost mic on the floor and stumbled with repeated clearance of the option. Three landings seemed better than the once I did when the CFI was with me. The airplane finally safely landed with everything going smoothly. On my way home I thought about this experience of flying a real airplane alone. To have the vice president fly all that way just watch me solo gave me more confidence about myself.
cards.audioTextZh: 到现在我还能想起单飞那天的经历。那天，美国副总统到达机场。空军二号，一架全新波音757,在9点左右着陆，但我们必须在机坪等待所有仪式完成。我的总飞行教练之前询问我是否已准备好单飞，由于对自己有信心，并且天气条件好，我回答没问题。但当我走进驾驶舱得知总飞行教练不在时，我还是感到有些紧张，并且希望我不会犯错误。飞行一切正常，我甚至感到飞机有更好的爬升率，单独一个人在塞斯纳150上显得舱内很空旷。所有事情都按照检查单执行除了我把麦克风掉在了地上而且蹩脚的重复执行了许可选项。这三个落地比之前跟总飞行教练飞得都要好。最终，飞机安全降落，飞行顺利。回家的路上，我在回想这次单独飞行的经历。副总统特地赶过来看我单飞这件事情上给了我莫大的自信。

cards.audioText: 20. The flight was from New York to Dallas. When passengers were boarding, an elderly couple found a woman occupied their seats in first class. The flight attendant wanted to see her boarding pass to solve the problem, but the woman responded in fake broken English, "No English, pas anglais. " The attendant knew it was a pretence because the woman had been chatting a bit with another passenger. Then, she tried to persuade the woman to show the boarding pass but only to get disregard. At last, she had to use French to talk with the woman. The woman was so surprised that she let go of her ticket and gave it to the attendant. After checking the boarding pass, the attendant walked the woman all the way to her seat which was at the back of the plane, then she returned to first class. During the flight, the woman continued complaining in French and asking that attendant to serve her. The attendant smiled and served her everything she wanted, but talked with her in English as she spoke in French. Finally, the flight landed safely at Dallas. The woman was one of the last people off the plane. She demanded the attendant's name and worker ID so she could complain about her. Unexpectedly, the attendant smiled and told the woman it would be nice if she stopped pretending that she couldn't speak or understand English. The woman scowled and marched off the plane.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架飞机从纽约飞往达拉斯。登机时，一对老夫妇发现一位女士坐在他们的头等舱座位上。乘务员想检查她的登机牌，但她用蹩脚的英语回复："不会英语。"乘务员知道这是借口，因为她之前在用英语和另一位乘客交谈。之后，乘务员想劝说女士出示登机牌，但是她完全不理。最后，乘务员不得不用法语和她交流，她非常惊讶于是放手把票给了乘务员。检查完登机牌后，乘务员带领女士走到她位于飞机后部的座位，然后乘务员回到了头等舱。整个飞行期间，这位女士一直在用法语抱怨并要求那位乘务员为她提供服务。乘务员微笑着满足她的要求，但始终用英语回复她的法语。最终飞机在达拉斯安全降落，这位女士是最后下飞机的乘客们之一，她想知道乘务员的名字和证件号去投诉。意外的是，乘务员微笑着告诉她，如果她能不再假装不懂英语就好了。这位女士皱着眉走下了飞机。

cards.audioText: A ridiculous accident happened when a flight was coming back from Poland in 1998. The plane had just landed at the airport when a guy on board claimed that he had a bomb. All the passengers started to panic. The pilot immediately contacted ATC and asked for emergency services. Because of the man's allegation the plane couldn't get to the gate, so the plane had to board on a bus. All the luggage on the plane was removed and sniffed by a dog. The flight crew and passengers waited and watched for3 hours without air conditioning and food or anything. After searching, it turned out that there was no bomb on board. The guy was just drunk, and he went mad because they wouldn't give him another beer.
cards.audioTextZh: 1998年，一架从波兰返航的飞机上发生了一起荒唐事件。飞机刚在机场着陆，一名机上乘客就声称自己携带炸弹，所有乘客顿时陷入恐慌。飞行员立即联系空中交通管制并请求应急服务。由于这名男子声称机上有炸弹，飞机无法驶向登机口，乘客只得转乘摆渡车。机上所有行李都被卸下，并由嗅探犬检查。机组和乘客在没有空调、食物或其他保障的情况下等待并观看排查过程长达3小时。检查结果显示机上根本没有炸弹。那名男子只是喝醉了，因为机组不肯再给他一杯啤酒而失控闹事。

cards.audioText: Before the flight, a man used his miles to upgrade to first class. He thought this would make his flight much more comfortable than usual, but what happened later proved he was wrong. He sat next to an old lady whose family members were in economy class. Soon after take-off, when the man was about to begin eating, the old lady suddenly and explosively vomited. The flight attendant rushed to her to deal with the situation, but the old lady did not turn better. Another half an hour later, when the man was stepping around her to use the restroom, she vomited again and some of her vomits even got on the man' s clothes. After cleaning himself out in the restroom, the man came back and found his seat was crowded with the lady's family members. Because of the crowd, he was asked to simply stand and wait during 40 minutes of turbulence, and during that time the sick lady vomited yet again. That whole area smelled terrible. Passengers couldn't just stand while the plane landed, so the man had to exchange his seat with the lady's niece whose seat was in economy class. The worst is, when the man asked if he could get his miles back, he was told "NO". The man was not satisfied and he thought this unforgettable flying experience was a total nightmare.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行前，一位男士用里程升到头等舱。他原以为这次飞行会比以前更舒适，但后来发生的事证明了他的选择是错的。他的座位在一位老妇人旁边，老妇人的家人全都在经济舱。起飞后不久，当他准备用餐时，老妇人猛地呕吐起来。乘务员很快来处理完这个情况，但老妇人的情况并没有转好。半小时后，这位男士从老妇人身边经过去洗手间，这时老妇人再次呕吐起来，有些呕吐物甚至弄到了他的衣服上。在洗手间清理完，他发现自己的座位附近挤满了老妇人的家人。由于人太多，飞机颠簸的40分钟里他只能站着等待，在这期间老妇人再次呕吐起来，整个区域弥漫着可怕的味道。飞机着陆时乘客必须坐下，所以他只能和在经济舱的老妇人的侄女换座位。更糟糕的是，他升舱的里程无法返还。他为此感到很不满意，他认为这次经历简直是个噩梦。

cards.audioText: During a flight from Rhode Island to Washington, an accident happened and brought bad influence on the airline. The aircraft took off from the airport smoothly and the flight was incident-free en route. When the plane was approaching to the airport, the pilot was tired so he missed the controller' s instruction. Then the controller gave the instruction again. This time, the pilot became clear but he applied the brakes suddenly. Because of his sudden operation, the back door of the plane blew off and passengers could see the runway. Fortunately, the cabin had already lost the pressure so no one flew out and all the passengers stayed in their own seats safely. However, the pilot was grounded because of his misoperation.
cards.audioTextZh: 罗德岛飞往华盛顿的航班上发生一起事故，这起事故给航空公司带来不好的影响。飞机从机场顺利起飞，途中也没有事故发生。飞机进近时，飞行员因为疲劳漏听管制员指令。之后管制员再次给出指令，这时飞行员清醒了并突然刹车。因为突然的操作，飞机的后门被吸走，乘客们能直接看到跑道。幸运的是客舱已降压，没有人因此吸出飞机，乘客们都安全待在座位上。然而，飞行员由于这次失误被停飞。

cards.audioText: The flight was from Seattle to Vancouver. After checking the radar, the pilot requested push back and start up. The airplane was approved to push back and start up but few seconds later the controller found the left engine of the plane got fire. So he gave the pilot a warning immediately and asked if fire service was needed. The pilot shut off the engine immediately to prevent the fire from spreading. "The emergency equipment is standing by. "the controller told the pilot. Several minutes later, passengers were all safely evacuated. There was no one injured but passengers had to change to another airline.
cards.audioTextZh: 该航班从西雅图飞往温哥华。检查雷达后，飞行员请求推出和启动发动机。飞机获准推出开车，但几秒钟后，管制员发现飞机左发起火，立即向飞行员发出警告，并询问是否需要消防服务。飞行员立即关闭发动机，防止火势蔓延。管制员告知飞行员：“应急设备正在待命。”几分钟后，所有乘客安全撤离，无人受伤，但乘客不得不改乘另一家航空公司的航班。

cards.audioText: 25. It was a foggy day in 2001, A Flight 126 from Singapore Airlines was cleared to taxi to runway 19 Right. A few minutes later, a Cessna pilot requested engine start, and the ground controller gave start-up clearance. Then the controller asked 126 to contact the Tower controller. From then on, those two aircraft were on two different radio frequencies. The Cessna started to taxi, but the pilot made the mistake of taxiing to the right and entered taxiway Echo 6. But the Ground controller did not realize it and cleared the Cessna to continue its taxi. At the entered the active runway 19 Right. Unfortunately, the two aircraft collided, all 124 people on board died.
cards.audioTextZh: 2001年的一个大雾天，新加坡航空126号航班获准滑行至19右跑道。几分钟后，一架塞斯纳飞机的飞行员请求启动发动机，地面管制员发布开车许可，随后要求126号航班联系塔台管制员。从那时起，两架飞机分别使用不同的无线电频率。塞斯纳飞机开始滑行，但飞行员错误地向右转，进入Echo 6滑行道。地面管制员没有发现这一错误，仍许可塞斯纳继续滑行。与此同时，塔台管制员许可126号航班起飞。126号航班在跑道上加速滑跑时，塞斯纳飞机越过跑道等待标志，进入正在使用的19右跑道。两架飞机不幸相撞，机上124人全部遇难。

cards.audioText: A strong snowstorm hit Chicago International airport in an afternoon. An aircraft from United Airlines circled several times before attempting to land at the airport. The snowstorm had reduced visibility severely. The runway visual range was at 4, 500 feet below the landing minimums for the ILS approach to Runway 13 Center. The controller advised the crew to hold in the air, waiting for the weather to get better, or to divert to another airport with a longer runway. But both suggestions would produce large additional expense for the airline, as well as inconvenience of the flight's passengers. So the crew decided to circle to land on runway 31 Center, which had lower landing minimums. But unfortunately, the strong tailwind made the plane skid off the runway and crash into a stopping truck.
cards.audioTextZh: 某日下午，一场暴风雪袭击了芝加哥国际机场。一架美联航飞机准备在机场着陆，但由于能见度极低，飞机不得不在机场上空盘旋。跑道视程为4500英尺，低于13中跑道的盲降进近标准。管制员建议机组空中等待天气好转，或备降到有较长跑道的另一机场着陆，但是这两种选择均会额外增加公司成本，并给乘客带来不便，于是考虑再三，机组决定在有着较低着陆标准的31中跑道盘旋着陆。很遗憾，强顺风使飞机滑出跑道，撞上了一辆停着的卡车。

cards.audioText: An air traffic controller issued a take-off clearance to the Flight 386 for runway 30R.At the same time, an airport operations officer was operating a vehicle on that runway. The controller had previously issued a clearance to the operations officer to conduct bird dispersal activities on the runway. The operations officer was monitoring his radio and heard Flight 386's take-off clearance. He told the controller that he would vacate the runway. At the same time, the flight crew had observed the vehicle on the runway and did not commence the takeoff. The controller cancelled the take-off clearance until the runway was clear. The investigation found that the controller didn't keep eyes on the runway because he was concentrating on heavy traffic. Another possible reason was that the controller was experiencing some degree of fatigue at the time.
cards.audioTextZh: 一管制员发布起飞许可给386航班，允许该飞机从跑道30右起飞，与此同时，一名机场工作人员正在30右跑道上工作。因为之前管制员让该工作人员在跑道上驱鸟。工作人员在当前频率守听，听到386航班要起飞的许可指令，立刻告诉管制员他会马上离开跑道。同时，机组人员看到跑道上的车辆，没有执行起飞操作。管制员取消了起飞许可，直到跑道被空出来。后据调查，管制员因为指挥飞机过多，没有留意该跑道，导致了这次事件。还有一个可能的原因是管制员此时过于疲惫导致此次事件。

cards.audioText: Getting lost as an airplane flying is a potentially dangerous situation, especially when low on fuel. If a pilot becomes lost, there are some good common sense procedures to follow. If a town or city cannot be seen, the first thing to do is climb. Being mindful of traffic and weather conditions. An increase in altitude increases radio and navigation reception range, and also increases radar coverage. If flying near a town or city, it might be possible to read the name of the town on a water tower. If the airplane has a navigation radio, such as a VOR or ADF receiver, it can be possible to determine position by plotting an azimuth from two or more navigational facilities. If GPS is installed or a pilot has a portable aviation GPS on board, it can be used to determine the position and location of the nearest airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机在飞行中迷航是一种潜在的危险情况，特别是在燃料不足的情况下。如果飞行员迷航，可以遵循一些良好的常识程序。如果无法目视某个城镇或城市，首要的就是爬升。留意其他航空器及天气情况。海拔高度的增加使得无线电和导航的接收范围扩大，也增加了雷达覆盖范围。如果在一个城镇或城市附近飞行，可能会在水塔上看到城镇的名字。如果飞机配备无线电导航，如VOR或ADF接收器，它可以通过两个或更多的导航设施绘制方位角来确定位置。如果安装了全球定位系统(GPS),或者飞行员在飞机上配备了便携式航空全球定位系统，就可以确定最近机场的方位和位置。

cards.audioText: It was a foggy day in 2002, SIA 626 was cleared to taxi to runway 36R.A few minutes later, the Cessna pilot requested engine start. The ground controller gave start-up clearance. Then he requested Flight 626 to contact the Tower controller. From then on, those two aircraft were on two different radio frequencies. The Cessna started to taxi, but the pilot made a mistake of taxiing to right and entered taxiway R6. But the ground controller did not realize it and cleared the Cessna to continue its taxi. At the same time, the Tower controller cleared Flight 626 for takeoff. When the flight 626 was rolling on the runway, the Cessna crossed the runway holding sign and entered the active runway 36R. Unfortunately, the two aircraft collided, all 114 people on board died.
cards.audioTextZh: 2002年的一个大雾天，新加坡航空626号航班获准滑行至36右跑道。几分钟后，一架塞斯纳飞机的飞行员请求启动发动机，地面管制员发布开车许可，随后要求626号航班联系塔台管制员。从那时起，两架飞机分别使用不同的无线电频率。塞斯纳飞机开始滑行，但飞行员错误地向右转并进入R6滑行道。地面管制员没有发现这一错误，仍许可塞斯纳继续滑行。与此同时，塔台管制员许可626号航班起飞。626号航班在跑道上起飞滑跑时，塞斯纳飞机越过跑道等待标志，进入正在使用的36右跑道。两架飞机不幸相撞，机上114人全部遇难。

cards.audioText: Flight 145 nearly collided with Flight 101 at the intersection of runway 16 and runway 22. There were no injuries and no damage to either aircraft. But it was regarded as the most serious incident of this kind. That day, the tower controller cleared Flight 145 to land on runway 22. But he forgot the arriving aircraft when he cleared Flight 101 to take off from the intersecting runway 16. After Flight 145 touched down, the ground radar system alerted. The controller tried to instruct Flight 145 to stop short of runway 16. However, the aircraft just managed to stop in the middle of the intersection. It was impossible for Flight 101 to abort takeoff. So Flight 101 made an early liftoff and flew over Flight 145. The two aircraft missed colliding by only 50 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 145号航班在16号跑道与22号跑道交叉处险些与101号航班相撞。两架飞机均无人受伤，机体也没有损坏，但该事件被认为是此类事件中最严重的一次。当天，塔台管制员许可145号航班在22号跑道着陆；但在许可101号航班从与其相交的16号跑道起飞时，管制员忘记了这架正在进场的飞机。145号航班接地后，地面雷达系统发出警报。管制员试图指令145号航班在16号跑道外等待，但飞机最终只能停在跑道交叉口中央。此时101号航班已无法中断起飞，只能提前离地，从145号航班上方飞过。两架飞机最近时仅相差50英尺，险些相撞。

cards.audioText: When an American Flight 815 was approaching the terminal area of its destination, the flight crew contacted the Approach Control and requested ILS approach for runway 12. The tailwind conditions were reported on runway 12 at that time, so the controller advised the pilot to make a circling approach for runway 30. But the flight crew insisted to land on runway 12 and the controller cleared them to land on that runway. The runway was wet and the braking action was not good. During landing roll, the aircraft skidded to the right side of the runway and went through the airport fences. The fuselage was broken into three pieces, the right engine and right main gear were separated from the aircraft. No one was killed, but many passengers suffered from serious injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 当一架美国航空815航班接近目的地终端区时，机组人员联系进近管制中心，要求在12跑道盲降进近。当时12跑道报告有顺风情况，所以管制员建议飞行员在30跑道盘旋进近。但机组人员坚持在12跑道降落，管制员允许他们在该跑道降落。跑道湿滑，刹车性能也不好。在着陆滑跑过程中，飞机侧滑到跑道右侧，穿过机场围栏。机身断成三段，右发和右主起落架与机身分离。没有人死亡，但许多乘客受了重伤。

cards.audioText: One day, Flight 456, a B737 carrying 152 passengers and 9 crews was flying to land at Tokyo International Airport. When it was transferred from Tokyo Control to Tokyo Approach, flight 456 was instructed to proceed to DA to hold because of traffic congestion. During the holding, the flight crew was informed that the local weather was deteriorating and the controller suggested the pilot to divert to the alternate, but the pilot reported that their fuel was not enough to the alternate. So the controller vectored flight 456 by radar to land at runway 34R. Unfortunately, the pilot couldn't stabilize the aircraft on the localizers due to wind shear. Flight 456 went around and made a second approach. Later, it crashed into a hillside due to fuel shortage. The aircraft was broken into pieces and all the people on board were killed.
cards.audioTextZh: 一天，一架载有152名乘客和9名机组人员的B737执行456航班在东京国际机场降落。当从东京区调转到东京进近时，因为航空器拥堵，456航班被指示前往DA等待。在等待期间，机组人员被告知当地天气正在恶化，管制员建议飞行员备降，但飞行员报告说他们的燃料不够备降。所以管制员雷达引导456航班降落在34右跑道。不幸的是，由于风切变，飞行员无法在航道上建立稳定进近。456航班执行了复飞，执行了二次进近。后来，由于燃油短缺，飞机在山坡上坠毁。飞机被撞成碎片，机上人员全部遇难。

cards.audioText: When SIA128 was approaching the airspace of Chicago center area control, the controller instructed the flight crew to change radio frequency for the next sector on 132.1. The first officer acknowledged the frequency change and read back the correct frequency. However, the flight crew did not contact ATC on the new frequency. Because the controllers in the receiving units were preparing for a shift change, they didn't know that flight 128 did not establish radio contact, 30 minutes later, the controller at the next sector identified SIA128 on the radar. Although they attempted to establish contact with the airplane by calling the company dispatcher, they got no response from the pilots. The controller finally regained contact with SIA128 on the emergency frequency 50 minutes later.
cards.audioTextZh: 当新航128接近芝加哥中心区域管制时，管制员指示机组人员切换频率到下一扇区132.1。副驾驶确认了切换的频率并进行了复诵。然而，机组人员并没有在新的频率中与管制员建立联系。由于管制员正处于交接班时间，他们不知道128次航班没有建立无线电联系，30分钟后，下一扇区的管制员在雷达上发现了新航128。尽管他们试图通过联系公司签派与飞机建立联系，但飞行员仍没有回应。50分钟后，在紧急频率上管制员终于恢复了与新航128的联系。

cards.audioText: Landing light signal could provide useful information to controllers. One day, a B757 vacated runway 36L via taxiway A9 after landing. It was then cleared to cross runway 36R.But it stopped taxiing on taxiway A9 between runway 36L and runway 36R.The tower controller attempted to contact the pilot but received no reply. He saw the aircraft landing lights were also off. This made him believe that the B757 had a radio failure and had not received the clearance to cross runway 36R.So he issued takeoff clearance to A320 on runway 36R.Suddenly, the controller noticed the B757's lights came on and it began to move. Realizing the risk of runway incursion, he canceled A320s takeoff clearance immediately.
cards.audioTextZh: 着陆灯信号可以为管制员提供有用的信息。有一天，一架B757飞机在着陆后经滑行道A9从36左跑道脱离。然后它又被允许可以穿36右跑道。但它在36左和36右跑道之间的A9滑行道上停止了滑行。塔台管制员试图联系飞行员，但没有得到回复。他看到飞机着陆灯也熄灭了，这使他确认B757出现了无线电故障，没有收到通过36右跑道的许可指令。因此他指挥另外一架A320在36右跑道上起飞。突然，管制员注意到B757的灯又亮了，它开始移动。意识到有发生跑道入侵的危险，管制员立即取消了A320的起飞许可。

cards.audioText: A strong snowstorm hit Chicago Internationalairport in an afternoon. An aircraft from United Airlines circled several times before attempting to land at the airport. The snowstorm had reduced visibility severely. The runway visual range was at 4, 500 feet below the landing minimums for the ILS approach to Runway 13 Center. The controller advised the crew to hold in the air, waiting for the weather to get better, or to divert to another airport with a longer runway. But both suggestions would produce large additional expense for the airline, as well as inconvenience of the flight's passengers. Sothe crew decided to circle to land on runway 31 Center, which had lower landing minimums. But unfortunately, the strong tailwind made the plane skid off the runway and crash into a stopping truck.
cards.audioTextZh: 某日下午，一场暴风雪袭击了芝加哥国际机场。一架美联航飞机准备在机场着陆，但由于能见度极低，飞机不得不在机场上空盘旋。跑道视程为4500英尺，低于13中跑道的盲降进近标准。管制员建议机组空中等待天气好转，或备降到有较长跑道的另一机场着陆，但是这两种选择均会额外增加公司成本，并给乘客带来不便，于是考虑再三，机组决定在有着较低着陆标准的31中跑道盘旋着陆。很遗憾，强顺风使飞机滑出跑道，撞上了一辆停着的卡车。

cards.audioText: When SIA188 was approaching the airspace of Chicago Center Area Control, the controller instructed the flight crew to change radio frequency for the next section on 132.1. The first officer acknowledged the frequency change and read back the correct frequency. However, the flight crew did not contact ATC on the new frequency. Because the controllers in the receiving units were preparing for a shift change, they didn't know that flight 188 did not establish radio contact, 30 minutes later, the controller at the next sector identified SIA188 on the radar. Although they attempted to establish contact with the airplane by calling the company dispatcher, they got no response from the pilots. The controller finally regained contact with SIA188 on the emergency frequency 50 minutes later.
cards.audioTextZh: 当新加坡航空公司188号航班（SIA188）接近芝加哥中心区域管制的空域时，管制员指示机组人员将下一段航程的无线电频率切换至132.1。副驾驶确认了频率变更，并正确复诵了该频率。然而，机组人员并未在新频率上与空中交通管制（ATC）取得联系。由于接收单位的管制员当时正在准备交接班，他们并不知道188号航班没有建立无线电联系。30分钟后，下一个扇区的管制员在雷达上识别出了新加坡航空公司188号航班。尽管他们尝试通过呼叫该公司的调度员来与飞机建立联系，但没有得到飞行员的回应。最终，管制员在50分钟后通过应急频率重新与新加坡航空公司188号航班取得了联系。

cards.audioText: Landing light signal could provide useful information to controllers. One day, a B757 vacated runway 36L via taxiway A9 after landing. It was then cleared to cross runway 36R. But it stopped taxiing on taxiway A9 between runway 36L and runway 36R. The tower controller attempted to contact the pilot but received no reply. He saw the aircraft landing lights were also off. This made him believe that the B757 had a radio failure and had not received the clearance to cross runway 36R. So he issued takeoff clearance to A320 on runway 36R. Suddenly, the controller noticed the B757's lights came on and it began to move. Realizing the risk of runway incursion, he canceled A320s takeoff clearance immediately.
cards.audioTextZh: 着陆灯信号可以为管制员提供有用的信息。有一天，一架B757飞机在着陆后经滑行道A9从36左跑道脱离。然后它又被允许可以穿36右跑道。但它在36左和36右跑道之间的A9滑行道上停止了滑行。塔台管制员试图联系飞行员，但没有得到回复。他看到飞机着陆灯也熄灭了，这使他确认B757出现了无线电故障，没有收到通过36右跑道的许可指令。因此他指挥另外一架A320在36右跑道上起飞。突然，管制员注意到B757的灯又亮了，它开始移动。意识到有发生跑道入侵的危险，管制员立即取消了A320的起飞许可。

cards.audioText: It was a foggy day in 2002, SIA 686 was cleared to taxi to runway 36R. A few minutes later, the Cessna pilot requested engine start. The ground controller gave start-up clearance. Then he requested Flight 686 to contact the Tower controller. From then on, those two aircraft were on two different radio frequencies. The Cessna started to taxi, but the pilot made a mistake to taxi to right and entered taxiway R6. But the ground controller did not realize it and cleared the Cessna to continue its taxi. At the same time, the Towercontroller cleared Flight 686 for takeoff. Whenthe flight 686 was rolling on the runway, the Cessna crossed the runway holding sign and entered the active runway 36R. Unfortunately, the two aircraft collided, all 114 people on board died.
cards.audioTextZh: 2002年的一个雾天，新加坡航空公司686号航班获许滑行至36R跑道。几分钟后，一架塞斯纳飞机的飞行员请求启动发动机。地面管制员给予了启动许可。然后，他让686号航班联系塔台管制员。从那时起，这两架飞机就处于两个不同的无线电频率上。塞斯纳飞机开始滑行，但飞行员错误地向右滑行，进入了R6滑行道。然而，地面管制员并未意识到这一点，仍批准塞斯纳飞机继续滑行。与此同时，塔台管制员批准686号航班起飞。当686号航班在跑道上开始滑跑时，塞斯纳飞机越过了跑道等待标志，进入了正在使用的36R跑道。不幸的是，两架飞机相撞，机上114人全部遇难。

cards.audioText: Flight 345 nearly collided with Flight 101 at the intersection of runway 16 and runway 22. There were no injuries and no damage to either aircraft. But it was regarded as the most serious incident of this kind. That day, the tower controller cleared Flight 345 to land on runway 22. But he forgot the arriving aircraft when he cleared Flight 10l to take off from the intersecting runway 16. After Flight 345 touched down, the ground radar system alerted. The controller tried to instruct Flight345 to stop short of runway 16. However, the aircraft managed to stop in the middle of the intersection. It was impossible for Flight 101 to abort takeoff. Flight 101 made an early liftoff and flew over Flight 345. The two aircraft missed colliding by only 50 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 345航班和101航班在16号跑道与22号跑道的交叉处险些相撞。两架飞机均未出现人员伤亡情况，机体也都没有受损。但这起事件仍被视为此类事件中最为严重的一起。当天，塔台管制员批准345航班在22号跑道降落。然而，当他批准101航班从与之交叉的16号跑道起飞时，却忘记了正在进场降落的345航班。345航班触地降落之后，地面雷达系统发出了警报。管制员试图指示345航班在16号跑道前停下。然而，飞机最终在跑道交叉点的中央才停了下来。此时101航班已无法中止起飞程序，于是101航班提前离地升空，从345航班上方飞过。两架飞机仅差50英尺就相撞了。

cards.audioText: As American Flight 835 was approaching the terminal area of its destination, the flight crew contacted the Approach Control and requested ILS approach for runway 12. Tailwind conditions were reported on runway 12 at that time, so the controller advised the pilot to make a circling approach for runway30. But the crew insisted to land on runway 12 and the controller cleared them to land on the runway 12. The runway was wet and braking action was not good. During landing roll, the aircraft skidded to the left of the runway and went through the airport fences. The fuselage was broken into three pieces, the right engine and tight main gear were separated from the aircraft. No one was killed, but many passengers suffered from serious injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 当美国835航班接近其目的地的终端区域时，飞行机组人员联系了进近管制部门，并请求使用仪表着陆系统（ILS）对12号跑道进行进近。当时报告显示12号跑道存在顺风情况，所以管制员建议飞行员对30号跑道进行盘旋进近。但机组人员坚持要在12号跑道降落，管制员便批准他们在12号跑道降落。跑道是湿的，制动效果不佳。在着陆滑跑过程中，飞机向跑道左侧打滑，并冲出了机场围栏。机身断成了三截，右发动机和右主起落架与飞机分离。所幸无人死亡，但许多乘客受了重伤。

cards.audioText: One day, Flight 123, a B737 carrying 152 passengers and 9 crews was flying to land at Tokyo International Airport. When it was transferred from Tokyo Control to Tokyo Approach, flight 123 was instructed to proceed to DA to hold because of traffic congestion. During the holding, the flight crew was informed that the local weather was deteriorating and the controller suggested the pilot diver to the alternate, but the pilot reported that their fuel was not enough to the alternate. So the controller vectored flight 123 by radar to land at runway 34R.Unfortunately, the pilot couldn't stabilize the aircraft on the localizer due to wind shear. Flight 123 went around and made a second approach. Later, it crashed into a hillside due to fuel shortage. The aircraft was broken into pieces and all the people on board were killed.
cards.audioTextZh: 有一天，载有152名乘客和9名机组人员的波音737型123号航班正飞往东京国际机场准备降落。当该航班从东京区域管制移交给东京进近管制时，由于空中交通拥堵，123号航班接到指令前往DA点等待。在等待过程中，机组人员得知当地天气正在恶化，管制员建议飞行员备降其他机场，但飞行员报告称燃油不足以支撑他们飞抵备降机场。于是，管制员通过雷达引导123号航班在34R跑道降落。不幸的是，由于遭遇风切变，飞行员无法使飞机在仪表着陆系统的航向道上保持稳定。123号航班复飞并进行了第二次进近。后来，由于燃油短缺，飞机坠毁在一处山坡上。飞机解体，机上所有人员全部遇难。

cards.audioText: One day, Indonesia 205 took off from Jinan to Hangzhou. About one hour later, the aircraft was transferred to Hangzhou Approach. Hangzhou Approach required Indonesia 205 to slow down to 190 knots and later the controller asked the pilot to reduce speed to 160 knots. Three minutes later, Indonesia 205 passed the outer marker inbound. At that time, the controller issued a missed approach clearance because of separation. He instructed Indonesia 205 to make a right turn to a heading of 180 and climb to 900 m. But during the missed approach, the aircraft was out of control because of mechanical problem. The aircraft continued to descend with a high angle of attack. The aircraft impacted trees and buildings and part of the fuselage was damaged.
cards.audioTextZh: 某日，印尼205航班从济南起飞前往杭州。大约一小时后，该航班被移交给杭州进近管制。杭州进近管制要求印尼205航班将速度降至190节，随后管制员又要求飞行员将速度减至160节。三分钟后，印尼205航班在向台飞行时通过了远距指点标。当时，由于间隔问题，管制员发出了复飞指令。他指示印尼205航班右转至航向180度，并爬升至900米。但在复飞过程中，飞机因机械故障失去控制。飞机以大迎角持续下降，撞上了树木和建筑物，部分机身受损。

cards.audioText: One day, AFR188 crashed at Singapore Changi Airport during takeoff. The tower controller instructed the crew to takeoff on Runway 02L, but the crew lined up runway 02R and began their takeoff rolling. The aircraft overran the runway, and crashed into the fence of the airport. Crew members and 110 passengers were killed, and the co-pilot was badly injured. The plane was destroyed by the impact and caught on an intense fire. According to the investigation, there were three reasons leading to the accidents. First of all, the crew didn't use effective methods to verify their position at the airport. Secondly, the crew forgot to check whether they were on the correct runway or not. Finally, the crew members' idle chatting during the taxi resulted in the loss of situational awareness.
cards.audioTextZh: 有一天，法国航空公司188号航班（AFR188）在新加坡樟宜机场起飞时坠毁。塔台管制员指示机组人员在02L跑道起飞，但机组人员却在02R跑道排队并开始了起飞滑跑。飞机冲出跑道，撞上了机场的围栏。机组人员和110名乘客遇难，副驾驶受了重伤。飞机因撞击而损毁，并燃起了熊熊大火。根据调查，导致此次事故的原因有三个。首先，机组人员没有使用有效的方法来确认他们在机场的位置。其次，机组人员忘记检查他们是否在正确的跑道上。最后，机组人员在滑行过程中的闲聊导致他们对所处情况的认知缺失。

cards.audioText: One day, an A320 collided with a B737 during taxi. The right ailerons of B737 was severely damaged but A320 only had minor damage of its left wing. Luckily, there were no injuries. After receiving ATC taxi instruction, the A320 began to pass the B737 from the right side. The captain of A320 thought they had enough room to pass over the B737. But unfortunately Fortunately, the fuel leak didn'tdevelop into fire. The crew of the Boeing aircraft complained that they just parked stationary with the parking brakes applied when they were hit.
cards.audioTextZh: 一天，一架空客A320在滑行过程中与一架波音737相撞。波音737的右副翼严重受损，空客A320的左翼仅受到轻微损伤。所幸无人受伤。收到空中交通管制的滑行指令后，空客A320开始从波音737右侧通过。空客A320机长认为两机之间有足够空间，可以越过波音737，但随后发生了碰撞。所幸燃油泄漏没有进一步引发火灾。波音737机组表示，发生碰撞时他们的飞机一直停在原地，且已设置停留刹车，却遭到空客A320撞击。

cards.audioText: A Sun Express Germany Boeing 737-800, performirng flight XG-3208 from Burgas to Frankfurt, was cleared to climb to and maintainFL220. At the same time, a Go2Sky Boeing 737-800 performing flight 6D-6129 from Antalya to Bratislava was en route at FL240 did not want to change their flight level. ATC instructed XG-3208 to turn left onto a heading270. The crew however, read back "Climb FL270", which was not picked up by ATC. The crew selected FL270 into their Selected Altitude, and this was duely transmitted by Mode-S to the controller's desk, where a disagree message appeared between cleared and assigned altitude. The aircraft began to climb, about 15 seconds later, the radar issued a short term conflict alert between XG-3208 and 6D-6129. Then ATC instructed XG-3208 to descend back to FL220 immediately, 4 seconds later the crew read that instruction back. Andthe aircraft already climbed through FL236. The separation reduced to 0 feet vertically and2.6 nm horizontally and the aircraft continued to climb reaching FL250, and re-establishing vertical separation. ATC thus instructed XG-3208 to continue the climb to FL260.
cards.audioTextZh: .一架德国阳光快运航空公司（Sun Express Germany）的波音737-800型飞机，执飞从布尔加斯飞往法兰克福的XG-3208航班，获得许可爬升至并保持在220飞行高度层（FL220）。与此同时，一架Go2Sky航空公司的波音737-800型飞机执飞从安塔利亚飞往布拉迪斯拉发的6D-6129航班，正在240飞行高度层（FL240）航路上飞行，且不想改变其飞行高度层。空中交通管制（ATC）指令XG-3208航班左转至航向270度。然而，机组复诵的是“爬升至270飞行高度层（FL270）”，而空中交通管制并未注意到这一错误复诵。机组人员在其选定高度设置中选择了FL270，并且通过S模式适时地将这一信息传输到了管制员的操作台上，此时在许可高度和设定高度之间出现了不一致的提示信息。飞机开始爬升，大约15秒后，雷达发出了XG-3208航班和6D-6129航班之间的短期冲突警报。随后，空中交通管制指令XG-3208航班立即下降至FL220，4秒后机组复诵了该指令。而此时飞机已经爬升至236飞行高度层。两机的垂直间隔缩小至0英尺，水平间隔为2.6海里，并且这架飞机继续爬升，达到了250飞行高度层，随后重新建立了垂直间隔。因此，空中交通管制指令XG-3208航班继续爬升至260飞行高度层。

cards.audioText: On Jan 31st 2022, an ATR 7 2 performing flight 6 1 7 with 18 passengers and 3 crew, was cleared for a rolling takeoff Runway 03L when the crew after aligning with the runway spotted a vehicle on the runway and rejected takeoff. After the vehicle left the runway, the aircraft departed normally. The tower controller had cleared a maintenance vehicle onto the runway just second earlier, when the vehicle was entering the runway from threshold 2 1 Right, tower just cleared the ATR 7 2 for takeoff. The probable causes of the incident were the lack of adherence with procedures by the controller, as the controller cleared Flight 6 1 7 to enter the runway and take off although the runway was occupied causing a runway incursion on 0 3 Left. And the contributing factors were: the failure of the supervising controller to execute recommendations resulting from previous incidents, not paying special attention to runway checks.
cards.audioTextZh: 2022年1月31日，一架执行617号航班的ATR 72载有18名乘客和3名机组人员，获准在03L跑道进行不停顿滑跑起飞。机组对正跑道后发现跑道上有一辆车辆，随即中断起飞。车辆离开跑道后，飞机正常起飞。就在几秒前，塔台管制员曾许可一辆维修车辆进入跑道；当该车辆正从21R跑道头进入跑道时，塔台又许可ATR 72起飞。此次事件的可能原因是管制员没有遵守程序：尽管跑道仍被占用，管制员仍许可617号航班进入跑道并起飞，导致03L跑道发生跑道侵入。促成因素包括：监督管制员未落实此前事件提出的建议，也未特别重视跑道检查。

cards.audioText: On May 11, 2023, an Endeavor CRJ-900 on behalf of Delta Airlines, performing flight Delta 5 1 4 5, was climbing out of Runway 13when the crew did not respond to two calls by ATC repeating the same instruction, on the next repeated call the crew read back to climb to 12,000 feet and turn onto heading 3 2 0 degrees, the controller added he needed them to turn right away, at this time the crew requested for a block clearance, the controller queried what altitude they needed, then the crew explained there had an issue with the heading but were fine with the altitude. The controller instructed the crew to initiate a turn and would tell the crew when to roll out of the turn. The crew requested to stop climb at 10,000 feet and subsequently on ATC instruction descended to 9,000 feet while still rolling in and rolling out of turning on ATC instructions. The crew advised they were reading checklists and talking to maintenance but needed to divert to New York. The aircraft landed safely on JFK's Runway 22R.
cards.audioTextZh: 2023年5月11日，Endeavor的一架CRJ-900代表Delta Airlines执行Delta 5145航班，从13号跑道起飞爬升。机组没有回应空中交通管制连续两次发出的同一指令；管制员再次重复呼叫后，机组复诵爬升至12,000英尺并转向航向320度。管制员补充说，他需要机组立即转弯。此时机组请求高度区间许可，管制员询问他们需要什么高度，随后机组解释称航向方面出现了问题，但高度方面没有问题。管制员指示机组开始转弯，并表示会告诉机组何时改出转弯。机组请求在10,000英尺停止爬升，随后按照空中交通管制指令下降至9,000英尺，同时仍根据空中交通管制指令不断进入和改出转弯。机组表示，他们正在执行检查单并与维修部门通话，但需要备降纽约。飞机最终安全降落在JFK机场22R跑道。

cards.audioText: As Flight 1 4 2 descended from 5,200 meters to 1,400 meters, it entered severe thunderstorm area and encountered a massive amount of hail. The wind shield was broken by hail. Both engines lost power due to ingestion of a lot of water and hail. The crew attempted unsuccessfully to restart the engines. They declared an emergency to the Atlanta Approach control and request radar vector to the nearest airport for emergency landing. The approach control advised the crew to land at an air force base, but they could not make it. Finally, the crew decided to make a forced landing on a highway. During landing rollout, the aircraft collided with a gas station and it exploded. The flight crew and 60 passengers were killed by impact force and post-crash fire. Only 19 of passengers survived.
cards.audioTextZh: 142号航班从5,200米下降至1,400米时，进入强雷暴区并遭遇大量冰雹。风挡玻璃被冰雹击碎。由于吸入大量水和冰雹，两台发动机均失去动力。机组尝试重新启动发动机，但未能成功。他们向Atlanta进近管制宣布紧急情况，并请求雷达引导至最近的机场进行紧急着陆。进近管制建议机组在一处空军基地着陆，但飞机无法飞抵该基地。最后，机组决定在一条公路上迫降。在着陆滑跑过程中，飞机撞上一座加油站并发生爆炸。飞行机组和60名乘客因撞击力及坠机后的火灾遇难。只有19名乘客幸存。

cards.audioText: On November 11, 2019, a Westjet Dash 8 performing flight West jet 3 2 9 7 from Vancouver to Prince George (Canada) with 78 passengers and 4 crew, was holding at Prince George, when the crew received a runway surface report indicating the runway was covered 70% with ice and associated poor braking. The crew decided to return to Vancouver. On the way back, about 17 nautical miles northwest of Vancouver, the DEICE PRESSURE caution illuminated. The crew carried out the relevant checklists, the caution light briefly extinguished and illuminated again. The aircraft suffered vibrations in icing conditions prompting the crew to declare PAN PAN and request an immediate descent to a lower altitude. The aircraft was vectored for the approach and landed safely back in Vancouver.
cards.audioTextZh: 2019年11月11日，Westjet的一架Dash 8执行Westjet 3297航班，从Vancouver飞往Prince George（Canada），机上有78名乘客和4名机组人员。飞机在Prince George等待时，机组收到跑道道面报告，报告显示跑道有70%的面积被冰覆盖，且相关的制动效果较差。机组决定返回Vancouver。在返航途中，飞机位于Vancouver西北约17海里处时，DEICE PRESSURE警戒灯亮起。机组执行了相关检查单，警戒灯曾短暂熄灭，随后再次亮起。飞机在结冰条件下发生振动，促使机组宣布PAN PAN并请求立即下降至较低高度。飞机随后接受雷达引导进近，并安全返回Vancouver着陆。

cards.audioText: On September 6, 2023, Virgin Australia Boeing 737-800, performing flight Virgin 3 3 6 from Brisbane to Melbourne (Australia), was enroute when a flight attendant requested access to the cockpit. The captain, pilot monitoring, attempted to open the door but instead of pressing the relevant button activated the rudder trim causing an inflight upset requiring the first officer to apply significant right aileron to prevent the aircraft from rolling left until the trim exceeded aileron authority. The aircraft rolled left to a maximum of 42 degrees left bank before the captain, upon the first officer's request, checked the rudder trim and discovered the problem. The aircraft returned to normal flight and continued to Melbourne for a landing without further incident. One flight attendant received minor injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 2023年9月6日，Virgin Australia的一架Boeing 737-800执行Virgin 336航班，从Brisbane飞往Melbourne（Australia）。飞机在航路飞行期间，一名乘务员请求进入驾驶舱。作为监控飞行员的机长试图打开舱门，但他没有按下相应按钮，而是启动了方向舵配平，导致飞机在飞行中姿态失稳。副驾驶不得不施加很大的右副翼，以防止飞机向左滚转，直到方向舵配平的作用超过副翼的操纵能力。飞机向左滚转，最大左坡度达到42度。随后，应副驾驶要求，机长检查了方向舵配平并发现问题。飞机恢复正常飞行并继续飞往Melbourne，之后着陆，未再发生其他事件。一名乘务员受轻伤。

cards.audioText: On October 24, 2024, a Westjet Dash 8, performing flight Westjet 3 3 7 1 from Saskatoon to Calgary (Canada) with 70 people on board, was cleared for a RNAV Yankee Runway 35L approach in clear weather and light winds. The aircraft touched down at 7 degrees nose up and the aircraft became airborne again. The pitch was reduced and the aircraft touched down a second time 6 seconds later at +2.17 G, the crew received a "TOUCHED runway" advisory light. The aircraft slowed without further incident and taxied to the apron. The Canadian TSB reported there were no injuries, the aircraft however sustained substantial damage to the lower side of the empennage. The occurrence was rated an accident.
cards.audioTextZh: 2024年10月24日，Westjet的一架Dash 8执行Westjet 3371航班，从Saskatoon飞往Calgary（Canada），机上共有70人。在天气晴朗、风力较小的情况下，飞机获准实施35L跑道RNAV Yankee进近。飞机以机头上仰7度的姿态接地，随后再次升空。机组减小俯仰角，飞机在6秒后第二次接地，过载为+2.17 G，机组收到“TOUCHED RUNWAY”提示灯。飞机随后减速，未再发生其他事件，并滑行至停机坪。加拿大运输安全委员会报告称，没有人员受伤，但飞机尾翼下侧受到严重损坏。该事件被定性为事故。

cards.audioText: navigation equipment failure On December 13, 2024, An American Airlines Boeing 7 7 7, performing flight American 7 3 2 from Charlotte (USA) to London Heathrow (UK), was enroute at FL3 5 0 about 110 nautical miles southsoutheast of New York (USA) when the crew advised ATC they had a failure of one of their redundant navigation systems and were unable to cross the ocean, therefore wanted to return to Charlotte. The crew subsequently consulted with dispatch and changed to divert to New York's JFK Airport. The aircraft needed to burn off fuel and subsequently landed safely on JFK's Runway 04L about 4: 50 hours after the decision to divert.
cards.audioTextZh: 导航设备故障。2024年12月13日，American Airlines的一架Boeing 777执行American 732航班，从Charlotte（USA）飞往London Heathrow（UK）。飞机在纽约（USA）东南偏南约110海里处以FL350飞行时，机组向空中交通管制报告，一套冗余导航系统发生故障，飞机无法飞越大洋，因此希望返回Charlotte。随后，机组与签派部门协商，并改为备降纽约JFK机场。飞机需要消耗燃油，之后在作出备降决定约4小时50分钟后安全降落在JFK机场04L跑道。

cards.audioText: On May 12, 2019, flight 1 0 3 was approach Runway 17when the crew could not extend the nose gear and went around. The crew worked the related checklists and attempted the alternate gear extensions which also could not extend the nose gear. A low approach confirmed the nose gear was still not extended. The crew prepared for nose gear up landing and landed on Runway 17, keeping the nose gear up as long as practical, bringing the aircraft a halt on both main gear struts and the nose of the aircraft. Smoke entered the cabin after the nose touched down. The aircraft was evacuated via slides. There were no injuries and the aircraft sustained substantial damage.
cards.audioTextZh: 2019年5月12日，103号航班正在进近17号跑道时，机组无法放下前起落架并执行了复飞。机组执行了相关检查单，并尝试使用备用起落架放出程序，但前起落架仍无法放下。一次低空通场确认前起落架仍未放出。机组为前起落架未放下着陆做好准备，并在17号跑道着陆，尽可能长时间保持机头不接地，最终飞机依靠两个主起落架支柱和机头停下。机头接地后，烟雾进入客舱。机上人员通过滑梯撤离。没有人员受伤，飞机受到严重损坏。

cards.audioText: On January 17, 2025, an SARAT L 4 1 0, performing a charter flight from Juba to Jebel-Boma County Airstrip (South Sudan), went off or missed the runway while landing at the airstrip and came to a stop on rough terrain and brushland. One passenger received minor injuries. Local Authorities reported the accident occurred at about 16: 00 Local time. The aircraft had been carrying 9 passengers from Juba to Boma, missed the runway and "hit itself" at the side of the runway. A 9 year old girl suffered minor injuries when she collided with the aircraft door while leaving the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年1月17日，一架SARAT L410执行从Juba飞往Jebel-Boma County Airstrip（South Sudan）的包机航班。飞机在该简易机场着陆时偏出或错过跑道，最终停在崎岖地面和灌木丛中。一名乘客受轻伤。当地主管部门报告称，事故发生在当地时间约16:00。飞机当时载有9名乘客，从Juba飞往Boma；飞机错过跑道，并在跑道一侧“撞到了自己”。一名9岁女孩离开飞机时撞到飞机舱门，受了轻伤。

cards.audioText: On January 24, 2025, a United Boeing 7 87, performing flight United 6 13 from Lagos (Nigeria) to Washington Dulles (USA) with 245 passengers and 11 crew, was enroute at FL3 6 0 over Ivory Coast about 170 nautical miles northwest of Abidjan (Ivory Coast) when the aircraft deviated from its assigned flight level twice by about -150 (-175) feet. The aircraft subsequently turned around and returned to Lagos where the aircraft landed without further incident about 100 minutes later. Emergency services treated a number of passengers and crew for minor injuries. Passengers reported while meal service was in progress the aircraft dropped sharply three times, one passenger knocked his head against the ceiling and became unconscious for some time. The airline reported the aircraft turned back to Lagos to address a technical issue. First responders met the passengers and crew to address reports of minor injuries of several passengers and crew.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年1月24日，United的一架Boeing 787执行United 613航班，从Lagos（Nigeria）飞往Washington Dulles（USA），机上有245名乘客和11名机组人员。飞机在Ivory Coast上空以FL360飞行，位于Abidjan（Ivory Coast）西北约170海里处时，两次偏离指定飞行高度层，偏差约为-150（-175）英尺。随后飞机掉头返回Lagos，并在约100分钟后着陆，未再发生其他事件。紧急服务人员为多名受轻伤的乘客和机组人员进行了救治。乘客报告称，当时正在进行餐饮服务，飞机突然急剧下降了三次，一名乘客的头部撞到客舱顶部，并一度失去意识。航空公司报告称，飞机为处理一个技术问题而返航Lagos。第一响应人员接应了乘客和机组人员，以处理多名乘客和机组人员轻伤的报告。

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff due to flock of birds On January 25, 2025, a Transavia Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight 5 1 3 3 from Amsterdam (Netherlands) to Barcelona (Spain), was accelerating for takeoff from Amsterdam's Runway 18L when the crew rejected takeoff reporting they had seen a flock of at least 100 birds ahead. The aircraft slowed and stopped on the runway, the crew advised they did a high speed reject and requested emergency services to check their brakes. The aircraft subsequently returned to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 因鸟群中断起飞。2025年1月25日，Transavia的一架Boeing 737-800执行5133号航班，从Amsterdam（Netherlands）飞往Barcelona（Spain）。飞机正在Amsterdam机场18L跑道加速起飞时，机组中断起飞，并报告他们看到前方有一群至少由100只鸟组成的鸟群。飞机减速并停在跑道上。机组表示，他们实施了一次高速中断起飞，并请求紧急服务人员检查刹车。随后飞机返回停机坪。

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff due to engine anomaly On January 24, 2025, an Asiana Airbus 330-300, performing flight OZ-766 from Chiang Mai (Thailand) to Seoul (South Korea), was accelerating engines for takeoff from Chiang Mai's Runway 36when the crew rejected takeoff at very low speed (about 12 knots over ground) due an engine problem. The aircraft returned to the apron. Passengers reported seeing sparks and flames from the engine. The airline reported the aircraft with about 270 passengers rejected takeoff due to an engine anomaly. The extent of the engine anomaly is currently being assessed.
cards.audioTextZh: 因发动机异常中断起飞。2025年1月24日，Asiana的一架Airbus 330-300执行OZ-766航班，从Chiang Mai（Thailand）飞往Seoul（South Korea）。飞机正在Chiang Mai机场36号跑道加大发动机推力准备起飞时，机组因发动机问题在很低的速度下中断起飞，当时地速约为12节。飞机返回停机坪。乘客报告看到发动机冒出火花和火焰。航空公司报告称，这架载有约270名乘客的飞机因发动机异常中断起飞。目前正在评估发动机异常的程度。

cards.audioText: midair collision with helicopter on final On January 29, 2025, a PSA Airlines CRJ 700 on behalf of American Airlines, performing flight American Airlines 53 42 from Wichita to Washington National (USA) with 60 passengers and 4 crew, had been on approach to National's Runway 01and was asked by tower whether they could land Runway 33, which the crew affirmed, the aircraft was subsequently cleared to land on Runway 33. The aircraft was on final approach to National's Runway 33descending through about 200 feet AGL about 0.6 nautical miles before the runway threshold when the aircraft collided with a military Sikorsky UH-60 helicopter call sign PAT 25 with 3 occupants, both aircraft fell into the Potomac River at 2 0: 4 6 Local time. "Tower, did you see that? " somebody radioed at 0 1: 4 6 Zulu time. All subsequent approaches were instructed to go around, departures were halted. All occupants of both aircraft perished as result of the collision. The airport was closed for the time being. Tower told aircraft waiting for departures that there had been a collision on finals to Runway 33, the airfield was closed and they should return to the apron and shut engines down. Tower diverted several helicopters in the area following the crash.
cards.audioTextZh: 在最后进近阶段与直升机发生空中相撞。2025年1月29日，PSA Airlines的一架CRJ 700代表American Airlines执行American Airlines 5342航班，从Wichita飞往Washington National（USA），机上有60名乘客和4名机组人员。飞机原本正在进近National机场01号跑道，塔台询问机组能否在33号跑道着陆，机组作出肯定答复，随后飞机获准在33号跑道着陆。飞机正在National机场33号跑道最后进近，在距跑道入口约0.6海里处下降通过离地约200英尺时，与一架军用Sikorsky UH-60直升机相撞。该直升机呼号为PAT 25，机上有3人。当地时间20:46，两架航空器均坠入Potomac River。Zulu时间01:46，有人通过无线电呼叫：“塔台，你看到了吗？”随后，所有进近中的航空器均被指示复飞，离场航班也被暂停。两架航空器上的所有人员均因碰撞遇难。机场暂时关闭。塔台告知等待起飞的航空器，33号跑道最后进近航线上发生了碰撞，机场已经关闭，它们应返回停机坪并关闭发动机。坠机后，塔台还指挥该区域的数架直升机改航。

cards.audioText: unsafe gear on approach On January 31, 2025, a Portugalia ERJ 1 9 0 on behalf of Air Portugal, performing flight 1 3 1 0 from Lisbon (Portugal) to Manchester (UK), was on final approach to Manchester's Runway 23R when the crew initiated a go around due to an unsafe gear indication, while overflying the airfield during the go around it became clear, both main gear had extended, however, the nose gear had not extended and its doors were still closed. The aircraft positioned for another approach, the crew managed to lower all gear, and landed safely on Runway 23R about 20 minutes after the go around.
cards.audioTextZh: 进近时起落架状态不安全。2025年1月31日，Portugalia的一架ERJ 190代表Air Portugal执行1310号航班，从Lisbon（Portugal）飞往Manchester（UK）。飞机正在Manchester机场23R跑道最后进近时，机组因收到起落架不安全指示而开始复飞。复飞过程中飞越机场时，可以清楚看到两个主起落架均已放下，但前起落架没有放下，其舱门仍然关闭。飞机重新定位实施另一次进近，机组成功放下全部起落架，并在复飞约20分钟后安全降落在23R跑道。

cards.audioText: captain incapacitated On January 19, 2025, a Lufthansa Boeing 7 47, performing flight Lufthansa 4 6 3 from Miami (USA) to Frankfurt/Main (Germany), was enroute at FL3 5 0 about 140 nautical miles west of Gander (Canada) when the crew decided to turn around and divert to Montreal (Canada) reporting the captain had become incapacitated. The aircraft landed in Montreal about 2 hours 20 minutes later. The Canadian TSB reported the captain became ill in the crew rest area. The senior first officer assumed command, the first officer summoned to the cockpit. Two flight attendants provided first aid. Considering the weather the crew decided to divert to Montreal, the crew declared emergency, dumped fuel enroute to Montreal, the aircraft landed in Montreal without further incident.
cards.audioTextZh: 机长失能。2025年1月19日，Lufthansa的一架Boeing 747执行Lufthansa 463航班，从Miami（USA）飞往Frankfurt/Main（Germany）。飞机在Gander（Canada）以西约140海里处以FL350飞行时，机组报告机长已经失能，并决定掉头备降Montreal（Canada）。飞机约2小时20分钟后在Montreal着陆。加拿大运输安全委员会报告称，机长在机组休息区生病。资深副驾驶接管指挥，另一名副驾驶被召入驾驶舱。两名乘务员提供了急救。考虑到天气情况，机组决定备降Montreal。机组宣布紧急情况，并在飞往Montreal途中放油，飞机最终在Montreal着陆，未再发生其他事件。

cards.audioText: cabin pressure problem On February 4, 2024, a Wizz Air Airbus 3 21 200, performing flight 3 1 7 6 from Barcelona (Spain) to Bucharest Otopeni (Romania), was enroute at FL3 3 0 about 140 nautical miles westsouthwest of Bucharest still in Bulgarian Airspace when the crew initiated an emergency descent to FL1 2 0 initially descending in a circle before crossing into Romania, subsequently descended to FL1 0 0 due to problems with the cabin pressure. In contact with Bucharest Center the crew cancelled Mayday as they were not at FL1 0 0. Later on approach the crew declared Mayday again advising a lady (32) in the middle of the cabin needed medical attention. The aircraft continued to Bucharest for a safe landing on Runway 08R about 35 minutes after leaving FL3 3 0.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱压力问题。2024年2月4日，Wizz Air的一架Airbus 321-200执行3176号航班，从Barcelona（Spain）飞往Bucharest Otopeni（Romania）。飞机当时仍位于Bulgarian空域，在Bucharest西南偏西约140海里处以FL330飞行。由于客舱压力出现问题，机组开始紧急下降，最初在进入Romania之前以盘旋方式下降至FL120，随后又下降至FL100。机组与Bucharest Center联系时取消了Mayday，因为他们当时并不在FL100。之后在进近过程中，机组再次宣布Mayday，并报告客舱中部一名女士（32岁）需要医疗救助。飞机继续飞往Bucharest，并在离开FL330约35分钟后安全降落在08R跑道。

cards.audioText: engine fire On January 21, 2025, a Volaris Airbus 3 2 1, performing flight 3 8 1 from Hermosillo to Mexico City (Mexico), was climbing out of Hermosillo's Runway 23when the crew received a right hand engine fire indication, stopped the climb at 4000 feet and returned to Hermosillo for a safe landing on Runway 23about 10 minutes after departure. Mexico's A I B rated the occurrence a serious incident and reported the crew heard the fire alarm and saw the indication of engine #2 fire on the ECAM, discharged one fire bottle, declared Mayday and returned to Hermosillo. The occurrence is investigated by Mexico's A I B.
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机起火。2025年1月21日，Volaris的一架Airbus 321执行381号航班，从Hermosillo飞往Mexico City（Mexico）。飞机从Hermosillo机场23号跑道起飞爬升时，机组收到右侧发动机火警指示，于是在4,000英尺停止爬升并返回Hermosillo，在起飞约10分钟后安全降落在23号跑道。Mexico的AIB将该事件定性为严重事故征候，并报告称，机组听到火警警报，在ECAM上看到2号发动机起火指示，释放了一瓶灭火剂，宣布Mayday并返回Hermosillo。该事件正由Mexico的AIB调查。

cards.audioText: cracked windshield On February 5, 2025, an Ajet Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight 3 1 8 2 from Istanbul to Batman (Turkey), was climbing out of Runway 06L when the crew stopped the climb at 10,000 feet reporting a cracked windshield. The aircraft returned to Istanbul, went around on final approach to Runway 06R and landed safely on Runway 06R about 15 minutes after the go around and about 45 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 风挡玻璃破裂。2025年2月5日，Ajet的一架Boeing 737-800执行3182号航班，从Istanbul飞往Batman（Turkey）。飞机从06L跑道起飞爬升时，机组报告风挡玻璃破裂，并在10,000英尺停止爬升。飞机返回Istanbul，在对06R跑道实施最后进近时复飞，随后在复飞约15分钟后、起飞约45分钟后安全降落在06R跑道。

cards.audioText: On February 8, 2025, an Easyjet Airbus 3 20 performing flight 2 2 5 2 from Hurghada (Egypt) to Manchester (UK), was enroute at FL3 6 0 about 110 nautical miles southsoutheast of Athens (Greece) when the first officer decided to divert to Athens reporting the captain was ill. The aircraft landed safely on Athens' Runway 03L about one hour later. The airline reported the captain needed medical attention, the first officer performed a routine landing. Paramedics met the aircraft upon arrival. The onward flight was delayed over night and will continue the following day. Hotel rooms and meals were available. Passengers reported about 2 hours into the flight cabin crew were calling for medical staff amongst the passengers, a man had collapsed, several passengers responded to the call, a privacy screen was put in place in the front of the cabin. Cabin crew subsequently told the passengers that the man was in fact the captain of the flight. Emergency services were awaiting the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年2月8日，Easyjet的一架Airbus 320执行2252号航班，从Hurghada（Egypt）飞往Manchester（UK）。飞机在Athens（Greece）东南偏南约110海里处以FL360飞行时，副驾驶报告机长生病，并决定备降Athens。飞机约一小时后安全降落在Athens机场03L跑道。航空公司报告称，机长需要医疗救助，副驾驶完成了一次正常着陆。飞机到达后，医护人员前来接应。后续航班被推迟一夜，将于次日继续，并提供了酒店房间和餐食。乘客报告称，飞行约2小时后，客舱机组呼叫乘客中的医务人员，一名男子已经倒下，多名乘客响应了呼叫，客舱前部还设置了隐私屏风。随后，客舱机组告诉乘客，该男子实际上就是本次航班的机长。紧急服务人员正在等待飞机到达。

cards.audioText: On February 8, 2025, A Southwest Airlines Boeing 7 37 700, performing flight Southwest 2 3 0 1 from Sacramento to Denver (USA), was climbing out of Sacramento's Runway 35L when the crew requested to level off at 4000 feet advising they were looking at something. After levelling off at 4000 feet the crew advised about a minute later, that they needed to return to Sacramento, they had a possible engine (CFM 56) issue. The aircraft landed safely on Sacramento's Runway 35L about 18 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年2月8日，Southwest Airlines的一架Boeing 737-700执行Southwest 2301航班，从Sacramento飞往Denver（USA）。飞机从Sacramento机场35L跑道起飞爬升时，机组表示他们正在查看某个情况，并请求在4,000英尺改平。飞机在4,000英尺改平约一分钟后，机组表示需要返回Sacramento，飞机可能存在发动机（CFM 56）问题。飞机在起飞约18分钟后安全降落在Sacramento机场35L跑道。

cards.audioText: two generators failed leaving no lateral navigation On February 8, 2025, a One Air Boeing 7 47 400 freighter, performing flight 2 1 1 from London Heathrow (UK) to Hong Kong (China), was climbing out of Heathrow's Runway 09R when the crew stopped the climb at FL2 5 0, already over the North Sea reporting they had lost two of their four generators and requested radar vectors advising they had no lateral navigation left. The aircraft initially turned back towards England, then turned again and diverted to Amsterdam (Netherlands) advising they didn't need any fuel dump, and landed safely on Amsterdam's Runway 06about 85 minutes after departure. On May 29th 2024 the AAIB reported the aircraft experienced failures on two electrical busses and lost all pitot heating. The aircraft diverted to Amsterdam due to marginal weather conditions at Heathrow. The occurrence has been rated a serious incident. On Feb 10th 2025 the AAIB reported in an interim statement: "The aircraft departed in weather of rain, thick cloud, and icing conditions. Electrical failures resulted from water having leaked onto the aircraft's avionic equipment - the effects of which included all pitot probe heaters becoming inoperative, and the cabin altitude increasing. The crew began descending the aircraft from FL2 5 0 and experienced unreliable flight instrument indications. They diverted the aircraft to Amsterdam Schipol Airport, which had clear weather." The investigation is still ongoing.
cards.audioTextZh: 两台发电机失效，导致横向导航能力完全丧失。2025年2月8日，One Air的一架Boeing 747-400货机执行211号航班，从London Heathrow（UK）飞往Hong Kong（China）。飞机从Heathrow机场09R跑道起飞爬升，飞抵North Sea上空后，机组在FL250停止爬升，并报告四台发电机中有两台失效。机组请求雷达引导，并表示飞机已经完全失去横向导航能力。飞机最初掉头飞向England，随后再次转弯并备降Amsterdam（Netherlands）。机组表示不需要放油，飞机在起飞约85分钟后安全降落在Amsterdam机场06号跑道。2024年5月29日，AAIB报告称，飞机的两条电气汇流条发生故障，并失去全部空速管加温。由于Heathrow的天气条件处于临界状态，飞机备降Amsterdam。该事件被定性为严重事故征候。2025年2月10日，AAIB在一份临时声明中报告：“飞机在降雨、厚云和结冰天气条件下起飞。水泄漏到飞机的航空电子设备上，导致电气故障，其影响包括所有空速管探头加温器失效，以及客舱高度升高。机组开始操纵飞机从FL250下降，并遇到不可靠的飞行仪表指示。他们将飞机备降至天气晴朗的Amsterdam Schipol Airport。”调查仍在进行中。

cards.audioText: On February 9, 2025, a Hawaiian Airlines Airbus A330-200, performing flight HA-22 from Honolulu to Seattle (USA) with 278 people on board, was in the initial climb out of Honolulu's Runway 08R when the crew requested to level off at 3000 feet and return to the airfield advising, they had a continuous trail coming out of the #1 engine and requested the emergency services on arrival. The aircraft returned to Honolulu for a safe landing on Runway 08L about 15 minutes after departure. The crew shut both engines down and did not activate the APU due to the leak concerns, emergency services confirmed a fuel leak from the left hand engine.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年2月9日，Hawaiian Airlines的一架Airbus A330-200执行HA-22航班，从Honolulu飞往Seattle（USA），机上共有278人。飞机从Honolulu机场08R跑道起飞并处于初始爬升阶段时，机组请求在3,000英尺改平并返回机场，表示1号发动机后方持续出现一条尾迹，并请求紧急服务人员在飞机到达时提供支援。飞机在起飞约15分钟后返回Honolulu，安全降落在08L跑道。机组关闭了两台发动机，并因担心泄漏而没有启动APU。紧急服务人员确认左侧发动机发生燃油泄漏。

cards.audioText: On February 11, 2025, a GOL Boeing 7 37-8 MAX, performing flight Gol 1 6 7 4 from Rio de Janeiro Galeao to Fortaleza (Brazil), was accelerating for takeoff from Galeao's Runway 10when a bang was heard, the aircraft veered sharply to the right towards the right runway edge before steering back towards the center line while the aircraft slowed down. After coming to a stop short of the end of the runway the captain announced they had collided with a service vehicle on the runway. The passengers disembarked via mobile stairs onto the runway. There were no injuries, the aircraft as well as the car received substantial damage. The airport reported there had been an incident between a maintenance car and an aircraft on one of the runways, there had been no injuries. The passengers have disembarked normally, operation of the airport was not affected. The airline reported the aircraft collided with an airport vehicle on the runway during the takeoff procedure. Takeoff was rejected and all passengers and crew disembarked safely. A replacement flight to Fortaleza was made available. The airline is cooperating with CENIPA's investigation into the accident. A passenger (a public prosecutor) stated, that the aircraft was close to becoming airborne, when there was a jolt and a noise followed by the crew braking the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年2月11日，GOL的一架Boeing 737-8 MAX执行Gol 1674航班，从Rio de Janeiro Galeao飞往Fortaleza（Brazil）。飞机正在Galeao机场10号跑道加速起飞时，传来一声巨响，飞机突然向右偏转并冲向跑道右边缘，随后在减速过程中重新转回中线方向。飞机在跑道末端之前停下后，机长宣布飞机与跑道上的一辆勤务车辆发生了碰撞。乘客通过移动式客梯下到跑道上。没有人员受伤，但飞机和车辆均受到严重损坏。机场报告称，一辆维修车辆与一架飞机在其中一条跑道上发生事件，没有人员受伤。乘客已经正常下机，机场运行未受影响。航空公司报告称，飞机在起飞过程中与跑道上的一辆机场车辆相撞，飞机中断起飞，所有乘客和机组人员均安全下机。航空公司安排了前往Fortaleza的替代航班，并正在配合CENIPA对该事故的调查。一名乘客，也是一名检察官，表示飞机接近离地时猛然一震并传来响声，随后机组对飞机实施了制动。

cards.audioText: loss of cabin pressure On February 14, 2025, a Vueling Airbus 3 20 200, performing flight Vueling 1 8 8 4 from Barcelona (Spain) to Berlin (Germany), was climbing through FL3 0 0 out of Barcelona when the crew initiated an emergency descent reporting the loss of cabin pressure. The aircraft levelled off at FL1 0 0 and returned to Barcelona for a safe landing on Runway 24R about 75 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱失压。2025年2月14日，Vueling的一架Airbus 320-200执行Vueling 1884航班，从Barcelona（Spain）飞往Berlin（Germany）。飞机从Barcelona起飞爬升通过FL300时，机组报告客舱失压并开始紧急下降。飞机在FL100改平，随后返回Barcelona，并在起飞约75分钟后安全降落在24R跑道。

cards.audioText: Engine failure On February 13, 2025, a One Air Boeing 7 47 400 freighter, performing positioning flight One Air 9 3 2 Papa from Cardiff (UK) to Zaragoza (Spain), was climbing out of Cardiff's Runway 12when the crew stopped the climb at FL2 4 0 following an engine failure. The aircraft diverted to East Midlands (UK) for a safe landing on Runway 09about 50 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机失效。2025年2月13日，One Air的一架Boeing 747-400货机执行调机航班One Air 932 Papa，从Cardiff（UK）飞往Zaragoza（Spain）。飞机从Cardiff机场12号跑道起飞爬升时发生发动机失效，机组在FL240停止爬升。飞机备降East Midlands（UK），并在起飞约50分钟后安全降落在09号跑道。

cards.audioText: radar altimeter malfunctioning On February 13, 2025, an Air Canada Rouge Airbus 319-100, performing flight RV-1833 from Antigua (Antigua) to Toronto (Canada) with 118 people on board, was in the initial climb out of Antigua's Runway 07when at about 800 feet AGL the crew received numerous successive aural alerts related to the radar altimeter including call outs regarding gear position and throttle position. The crew determined the alerts to be false, stopped the climb at FL110 and entered a hold to troubleshoot. The aircraft subsequently returned to Antigua for a safe landing on Runway 07about 90 minutes after departure. The Canadian TSB reported after consultation with maintenance operations control the crew pulled the RALT2 circuit breaker, that stopped the aural alerts. The aircraft performed an overweight landing back.
cards.audioTextZh: 雷达高度表故障。2025年2月13日，Air Canada Rouge的一架Airbus 319-100执行RV-1833航班，从Antigua（Antigua）飞往Toronto（Canada），机上共有118人。飞机从Antigua机场07号跑道起飞并处于初始爬升阶段，在离地约800英尺时，机组连续收到多条与雷达高度表有关的声音警报，其中包括与起落架位置和油门位置有关的语音提示。机组判定这些警报为虚假警报，在FL110停止爬升，并进入等待以排查故障。随后飞机返回Antigua，并在起飞约90分钟后安全降落在07号跑道。加拿大运输安全委员会报告称，机组与维修运行控制部门协商后拔出了RALT2断路器，声音警报随即停止。飞机返回后实施了超重着陆。
