cards.audioText: complete loss of hydraulics On August, 12, 2024, A Skippers Aviation Swearingen SA 227 DC, performing charter flight PY-6002 from Forrestania to Perth (Australia) with 4 passengers and 2 crew, was enroute nearing the top of descent into Perth when the aircraft experienced a complete loss of hydraulics. The crew entered a hold to prepare for a manual gear extension and flapless landing. The crew requested a ground inspection after landing to check for any fluids leaking from the aircraft and requested a tow truck to pull them off the runway. The aircraft subsequently landed safely on Perth's Runway 24and vacated the runway onto taxiway A. Unable to establish communication with the tow truck and seeing, some hydraulic pressure was still available and testing of the brakes showed brake pressure was present, the captain decided to taxi the aircraft to the apron. Taxiing downslope due to a slight downhill gradient the aircraft accelerated, both crew applied brakes with no effect, the captain briefly applied reverse, but then feathered the propellers and shut the engines down just before the aircraft collided with a hangar. There were no injuries, the aircraft sustained minor damage.
cards.audioTextZh: 液压系统完全失效。2024年8月12日，Skippers Aviation的一架Swearingen SA 227 DC执行包机航班PY-6002，从Forrestania飞往Perth（Australia），机上有4名乘客和2名机组人员。飞机在航路飞行中接近飞往Perth的下降顶点时，液压系统完全失效。机组进入等待，为人工放下起落架和无襟翼着陆做准备。机组请求飞机着陆后由地面人员检查是否有任何液体从飞机泄漏，并请求拖车将飞机拖离跑道。随后，飞机安全降落在Perth机场24号跑道，并从跑道脱离至A滑行道。由于无法与拖车建立通信，同时看到仍有一些液压压力，并且刹车测试显示存在刹车压力，机长决定将飞机滑行至停机坪。飞机沿着轻微下坡坡度向下滑行时开始加速，两名机组人员均踩下刹车，但没有效果。机长曾短暂使用反推，但随后将螺旋桨顺桨，并在飞机撞上机库前关闭了发动机。没有人员受伤，飞机受到轻微损坏。

cards.audioText: brakes problem On February 20, 2025, a Republic Airways Embraer ERJ 1 7 5 on behalf of American Airlines, performing flight American 45 14 from Jacksonville to Philadelphia (USA) with 76 people on board, was descending towards Philadelphia when the crew reported a brakes indication, they might have a problem with the brakes on landing. The aircraft continued for a safe landing on Runway 27L. After landing the crew advised they had normal brakes. Emergency services inspected the aircraft before the aircraft continued to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 刹车问题。2025年2月20日，Republic Airways的一架Embraer ERJ 175代表American Airlines执行American 4514航班，从Jacksonville飞往Philadelphia（USA），机上共有76人。飞机正在向Philadelphia下降时，机组报告出现刹车指示，飞机着陆时的刹车可能存在问题。飞机继续飞行，并安全降落在27L跑道。着陆后，机组表示刹车工作正常。紧急服务人员检查飞机后，飞机继续滑行至停机坪。

cards.audioText: On February 1, 2025, a Sunwing Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight Sunwing 7 2 0 from Toronto (Canada) to Montego Bay (Jamaica), was climbing out of Toronto's Runway 06L when the crew reported they had had a tail strike, stopped the climb at 6000 feet and returned to Toronto for a safe landing on Runway 05about 20 minutes after departure. The Canadian TSB reported the crew carried out an overweight landing. Maintenance found minor scraping to the tail skid assembly that remained within limits. An overweight landing inspection was done and the aircraft returned to service.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年2月1日，Sunwing的一架Boeing 737-800执行Sunwing 720航班，从Toronto（Canada）飞往Montego Bay（Jamaica）。飞机从Toronto机场06L跑道起飞爬升时，机组报告飞机发生过擦尾，在6,000英尺停止爬升并返回Toronto，于起飞约20分钟后安全降落在05号跑道。加拿大运输安全委员会报告称，机组实施了超重着陆。维修人员发现尾橇组件存在轻微刮擦，但仍在限制范围内。完成超重着陆检查后，飞机恢复运行。

cards.audioText: On February 23, 2025, an Asiana Airbus 3 50 900, performing flight Asiana 2 1 2 from Seoul (South Korea) to San Francisco (USA), was on final approach to San Francisco's Runway 28L cleared to land at 1 4 0 1 Local time (2 2 0 1 Zulu time), when tower issued a low altitude alert advising the crew to immediately check their altitude, altimeter 30.26. Tower instructed a go around. The crew initiated a go around, positioned for another approach and landed without further incident about 16 minutes after the go around.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年2月23日，Asiana的一架Airbus 350-900执行Asiana 212航班，从Seoul（South Korea）飞往San Francisco（USA）。飞机正在对San Francisco机场28L跑道实施最后进近，并已于当地时间14:01（Zulu时间22:01）获准着陆。此时，塔台发布低高度警报，提醒机组立即检查高度，高度表拨正值为30.26。塔台指示飞机复飞。机组开始复飞，重新定位实施另一次进近，并在复飞约16分钟后着陆，未再发生其他事件。

cards.audioText: On February 25, 2025, a Southwest Airlines Boeing 737-800, performing flight WN-2504 from Omaha to Chicago Midway (USA), was in the flare to land on Midway's Runway 31C at 08: 48L (14: 48Z), when the crew initiated a go around due to a business jet crossing the runway. The aircraft climbed out to safety, positioned for another approach and landed safely on Runway 31C about 15 minutes later. A Bombardier Challenger 35 was taxiing for departure from Runway 22L and was tracking Runway 04L crossing Runway 31C. Tower was just about to instruct the Boeing to go around when the crew already reported they were going around. Later the crew queried how that happened but was instructed to contact approach. The Bombardier was in contact with ground and had been instructed to hold short of Runway 31C. Following the occurrence ground again advised their holding instructions had been to hold short of Runway 31C, the crew was given a phone number for pilot deviation.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年2月25日，Southwest Airlines的一架Boeing 737-800执行WN-2504航班，从Omaha飞往Chicago Midway（USA）。飞机于当地时间08:48（Zulu时间14:48）在Midway机场31C跑道着陆拉平时，机组因一架公务机正在穿越跑道而开始复飞。飞机爬升至安全高度，重新定位实施另一次进近，并在约15分钟后安全降落在31C跑道。一架Bombardier Challenger 35正滑行前往22L跑道起飞，并沿04L跑道滑行穿越31C跑道。塔台正要指示Boeing飞机复飞时，机组已经报告正在复飞。随后，机组询问此事如何发生，但被指示联系进近管制。Bombardier飞机当时正与地面管制联系，并已被指示在31C跑道外等待。事件发生后，地面管制再次告知机组，之前的等待指令是要求其在31C跑道外等待，并向机组提供了一个用于处理飞行员偏离指令事件的电话号码。

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff due to engine fire On September 30, 2023, a United Boeing 7 37-9 MAX, performing flight united 3 29 from Denver to Boston (USA) with 167 passengers and 6 crew, was accelerating for takeoff from Denver's Runway 16R when the crew rejected takeoff at high speed, in response to the radio transmission tower reported he could see fire from the left hand engine. The crew affirmed and stopped the aircraft, subsequently reporting it appeared they had flat tyres on the right hand side and were disabled. The runway was closed, emergency services responded, tower cleared the crew to evacuate if needed stating "the runway is yours! " While emergency services were responding but had not yet reached the runway tower informed emergency services that they no longer observed any fire, it appears extinguished.
cards.audioTextZh: 因发动机起火中断起飞。2023年9月30日，United的一架Boeing 737-9 MAX执行United 329航班，从Denver飞往Boston（USA），机上有167名乘客和6名机组人员。飞机正在Denver机场16R跑道加速起飞时，机组在高速状态下中断起飞。塔台回应无线电通话时报告，他可以看到左侧发动机冒火。机组予以确认并将飞机停下，随后报告右侧轮胎似乎已经爆胎，飞机无法移动。跑道被关闭，紧急服务人员赶赴现场。塔台许可机组在需要时撤离，并表示：“跑道交给你们！”紧急服务人员正在赶往现场但尚未到达跑道时，塔台通知紧急服务人员，他们已经看不到任何火焰，火似乎已经熄灭。

cards.audioText: hydraulic failure, ran out of fuel, forced landing in a field On September 12, 2023, a Ural Airlines Airbus 3 20 200, performing flight 1 3 8 3 from Sochi to Omsk (Russia) with 161 passengers and 6 crew, was on final approach to Omsk's Runway 07 (length 2500 meters, 8200 feet) when the crew initiated a go around from about 600 meters MSL (2000 feet MSL) due to a hydraulics failure. The aircraft climbed to FL180 and diverted to Novosibirsk at a speed over ground of about 260 knots over ground, however, needed to perform a forced landing on an open field. There were no injuries, the aircraft received damage to gear and wings. The airline reported the green hydraulics system failed on approach to Omsk. The commander decided to divert to an airfield with longer runways, the failure of the green hydraulic system affected operation of spoilers and flaps and increased the landing distance needed. However, the landing gear doors remained open as result of the hydraulic failure and could not be closed. Together with strong headwinds this increased the fuel consumption. The commander realized they could not make it to Novosibirsk and decided to land in an open field with the gear extended. 6 busses have been dispatched to the landing site and take the passengers to Omsk and Novosibirsk. The passengers were supplied with food, water and chargers for mobile phones, the luggage has been handed to the passengers, too.
cards.audioTextZh: 液压系统失效、燃油耗尽并在田野迫降。2023年9月12日，Ural Airlines的一架Airbus 320-200执行1383号航班，从Sochi飞往Omsk（Russia），机上有161名乘客和6名机组人员。飞机正在对Omsk机场07号跑道实施最后进近，该跑道长2,500米，即8,200英尺。机组因液压系统失效，在海拔约600米，即海拔2,000英尺处开始复飞。飞机爬升至FL180，并以约260节地速备降Novosibirsk，但随后不得不在一片开阔田野上迫降。没有人员受伤，飞机的起落架和机翼受到损坏。航空公司报告称，飞机在进近Omsk时绿色液压系统失效。机长决定备降至一座跑道更长的机场，因为绿色液压系统失效影响了扰流板和襟翼的工作，并增加了所需着陆距离。然而，由于液压系统失效，起落架舱门一直保持打开且无法关闭。加上强烈的逆风，这使燃油消耗增加。机长意识到飞机无法飞抵Novosibirsk，决定在起落架放下的状态下于一片开阔田野着陆。已有6辆大巴被派往着陆地点，将乘客送往Omsk和Novosibirsk。乘客获得了食物、饮用水和手机充电器，行李也已交还给乘客。

cards.audioText: loss of separation on runway On February 22, 2023, a Skywest Embraer ERJ 1 7 5 on behalf of United, performing flight United 5 3 2 6 from Burbank to San Francisco (USA) with 73 people on board, had been cleared to line up Runway 33, then waited in position for about two minutes. A Mesa Airlines CRJ 900 on behalf of American Airlines, performing flight American 5 8 2 6 from Phoenix to Burbank (USA) with 41 people on board, was on final approach to Runway 33when tower advised a departure was in position and would take off before them and instructed the aircraft to continue. A private aircraft on approach also to Runway 33got too close to the CRJ 900 and was instructed to go around. About two minutes after the ERJ 1 7 5 had been cleared to line up Runway 33, tower cleared the aircraft for takeoff and in the same sentence cleared the CRJ 900 to land. The CRJ 900 however initiated a go around and was instructed to turn left, the crew reported receiving a TCAS R A, the ERJ 1 7 5 was instructed to continue their climb and was later instructed to turn left after the aircraft were clear of conflict. The ERJ 1 7 5 continued to destination, the CRJ 900 joined a downwind and landed on Runway 33about 12 minutes after the go around.
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道上的间隔丧失。2023年2月22日，Skywest的一架Embraer ERJ 175代表United执行United 5326航班，从Burbank飞往San Francisco（USA），机上共有73人。飞机获准进入33号跑道并对正，随后在跑道上等待了约两分钟。Mesa Airlines的一架CRJ 900代表American Airlines执行American 5826航班，从Phoenix飞往Burbank（USA），机上共有41人。该机正在对33号跑道实施最后进近时，塔台告知机组，一架离场飞机已在跑道上就位，并将在他们之前起飞，同时指示该机继续进近。另有一架私人飞机也在进近33号跑道，该机与CRJ 900距离过近，因此被指示复飞。ERJ 175获准进入33号跑道并对正约两分钟后，塔台许可其起飞，并在同一句话中许可CRJ 900着陆。然而，CRJ 900开始复飞并被指示左转，机组报告收到TCAS RA。ERJ 175被指示继续爬升，随后在两机脱离冲突后被指示左转。ERJ 175继续飞往目的地，CRJ 900加入三边，并在复飞约12分钟后降落在33号跑道。

cards.audioText: engine fire due to bird strike On March 1, 2025, a Fedex Federal Express Boeing 767-300, performing flight FX-3609 from Newark to Indianapolis (USA) with 3 crew, was climbing out of Newark's Runway 22L, tower already instructed to contact departure, when the crew still on tower declared emergency reporting they had taken a bird into the #2 engine (CF6). The crew of another aircraft on the ground advised tower, they believed they saw the right hand engine fall off the aircraft (which was not correct). Ground observers reported they saw the aircraft flying over them with large flames trailing the right hand engine. The aircraft stopped the climb at 2000 feet, shut the engine down, positioned for the approach and landed safely on Runway 22L about 8 minutes after departure, emergency services already at the runway, the right hand engine still emitting continuous large flames through the exhaust, tower advising the crew the right hand engine emitted fire. The aircraft stopped on the runway, emergency services closed the runway. The crew subsequently advised emergency services, that they had discharged both fire bottles onto the engine after receiving an engine fire indication, emergency services confirmed the engine was still on fire and they were putting water on. Tower closed all runways. The crew reported they were just initiating the turn at about 500 feet AGL when birds got into the right hand engine. About 15 minutes after landing tower reopened Runway 29while runways 22L and 22R remained closed.
cards.audioTextZh: 因鸟击导致发动机起火。2025年3月1日，Fedex Federal Express的一架Boeing 767-300执行FX-3609航班，从Newark飞往Indianapolis（USA），机上有3名机组人员。飞机从Newark机场22L跑道起飞爬升，塔台已经指示其联系离场管制，但机组仍在塔台频率上宣布紧急情况，并报告2号发动机（CF6）吸入了一只鸟。地面上另一架航空器的机组告知塔台，他们认为看到该飞机的右侧发动机从机体脱落，但这一判断并不正确。地面目击者报告称，他们看到飞机从上空飞过，右侧发动机后方拖着大面积火焰。飞机在2,000英尺停止爬升，关闭发动机，重新定位实施进近，并在起飞约8分钟后安全降落在22L跑道。紧急服务人员已经在跑道旁待命，右侧发动机仍不断从排气口喷出大面积火焰，塔台也提醒机组右侧发动机正在冒火。飞机停在跑道上，紧急服务人员关闭了跑道。随后机组告知紧急服务人员，他们收到发动机火警指示后，已向发动机释放两瓶灭火剂。紧急服务人员确认发动机仍在燃烧，并正在向其喷水。塔台关闭了所有跑道。机组报告称，飞机在离地约500英尺刚开始转弯时，有鸟进入右侧发动机。飞机着陆约15分钟后，塔台重新开放29号跑道，而22L和22R跑道仍然关闭。

cards.audioText: flaps up landing On March 1, 2025, a Norwegian Air Shuttle Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight 9 3 2 3 from Las Palmas (Spain) to Stavanger (Norway), was on approach to Stavanger when the crew stopped the descent at 3000 feet and entered a hold due to problems with the flaps. The crew subsequently prepared for a flaps up landing, positioned for an approach to Stavanger's Runway 18about 30 minutes later and landed safely at high speed (193 knots over ground). The aircraft stopped at the end of the runway for about 5 minutes before continuing taxi to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 襟翼收上状态着陆。2025年3月1日，Norwegian Air Shuttle的一架Boeing 737-800执行9323号航班，从Las Palmas（Spain）飞往Stavanger（Norway）。飞机正在进近Stavanger时，机组因襟翼问题在3,000英尺停止下降并进入等待。随后，机组为襟翼收上状态着陆做好准备，在约30分钟后重新定位进近Stavanger机场18号跑道，并以较高速度安全着陆，当时地速为193节。飞机在跑道末端停留约5分钟，然后继续滑行至停机坪。

cards.audioText: On March 10, 2025, a Qantas Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight Qantas 5 0 5 from Brisbane to Sydney (Australia) with 127 passengers and 6 crew, was approaching Sydney and needed to enter a hold at FL2 4 0. Just exiting the hold the captain began to suffer from chest pain and requested cabin crew to prepare the defibrilator for him. The first officer took control of the aircraft while cabin crew prepared the pads of the defi on the captain. The aircraft landed safely on Runway 34R about 25 minutes after exiting the hold. Cabin crew did not need to operate the defi, the captain was even able to taxi the aircraft to the apron. Paramedics met the aircraft and transported the captain to a hospital. The airline reported the pilot experienced chest pains during the flight, the other pilot landed the aircraft into Sydney as normal. The pilot was treated by paramedics and taken to a hospital.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年3月10日，Qantas的一架Boeing 737-800执行Qantas 505航班，从Brisbane飞往Sydney（Australia），机上有127名乘客和6名机组人员。飞机正在接近Sydney，需要在FL240进入等待。刚刚退出等待时，机长开始出现胸痛，并请求客舱机组为他准备除颤器。副驾驶接管飞机操纵，客舱机组则将除颤器电极片贴在机长身上。飞机在退出等待约25分钟后安全降落在34R跑道。客舱机组不需要启动除颤器，机长甚至还能够将飞机滑行至停机坪。医护人员前来接应飞机，并将机长送往医院。航空公司报告称，这名飞行员在飞行中出现胸痛，另一名飞行员正常操纵飞机在Sydney着陆。该飞行员接受了医护人员的救治并被送往医院。

cards.audioText: On March 18, 2025, a Japan Air Commuter A T R 4 2, performing flight 2 0 1 from Amakusa to Kumamoto (Japan) with 14 people on board, was climbing out of Amakusa's Runway 31when the crew stopped the climb at 4000 feet after receiving a lightning strike. The aircraft returned to Amakusa for a safe landing on Runway 31about 25 minutes after departure. The airline reported the aircraft was inspected, burn marks were found at the nose wheel area and on the tail of the aircraft. All flights of the aircraft until and including Mar 26th 2025 have been cancelled.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年3月18日，Japan Air Commuter的一架ATR 42执行201号航班，从Amakusa飞往Kumamoto（Japan），机上共有14人。飞机从Amakusa机场31号跑道起飞爬升时遭到雷击，机组在4,000英尺停止爬升。飞机返回Amakusa，并在起飞约25分钟后安全降落在31号跑道。航空公司报告称，飞机接受了检查，在前轮区域和飞机尾部发现烧蚀痕迹。该飞机截至并包括2025年3月26日的所有航班均已取消。

cards.audioText: On March 21, 2025, a Jin Air Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight Jin Air 6 5 9 from Seoul Gimpo to Pohang (South Korea) with 42 passengers and 6 crew, was climbing out of Gimpo's Runway 14L when the crew declared PAN PAN and stopped the climb at about 5500 feet due to unreliable airspeed and altitude indications. The aircraft returned to Gimpo Airport for a safe landing on Runway 14R about 50 minutes after departure. The airline reported discrepancies in indicated airspeed and altitude and returned for an urgent landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年3月21日，Jin Air的一架Boeing 737-800执行Jin Air 659航班，从Seoul Gimpo飞往Pohang（South Korea），机上有42名乘客和6名机组人员。飞机从Gimpo机场14L跑道起飞爬升时，机组因空速和高度指示不可靠而宣布PAN PAN，并在约5,500英尺停止爬升。飞机返回Gimpo Airport，并在起飞约50分钟后安全降落在14R跑道。航空公司报告称，指示空速和高度存在差异，因此飞机返回并实施紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: On March 16, 2025, a Cathay Pacific Boeing 7 47 400 freighter, performing flight Cathay 3 1 9 5 from New York JFK (USA) to Toronto (Canada), had just levelled off at cruise FL3 0 0 when the crew donned their oxygen masks and initiated an emergency descent to 10,000 feet due to the loss of cabin pressure. The aircraft returned to New York's JFK airport for a safe landing on Runway 22L about 100 minutes after departure. The crew requested emergency services to inspect the aircraft for structural damage.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年3月16日，Cathay Pacific的一架Boeing 747-400货机执行Cathay 3195航班，从New York JFK（USA）飞往Toronto（Canada）。飞机刚刚在巡航高度FL300改平，机组便因客舱失压戴上氧气面罩，并开始紧急下降至10,000英尺。飞机返回New York的JFK机场，并在起飞约100分钟后安全降落在22L跑道。机组请求紧急服务人员检查飞机是否存在结构损坏。

cards.audioText: engine fire On March 26, 2025, an AirAsia Airbus 3 20-200, performing flight Air Asia 1 2 8 from Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia) to Shenzhen (China) with 171 people on board, was climbing out of Kuala Lumpur's Runway 33when the crew reported a left engine (CFM 5 6) fire indication, stopped the climb at 4000 feet, worked the related checklist and discharged one of the fire bottles, entered a hold and returned to Kuala Lumpur for a safe landing on Runway 33about 2 hours after departure. The airline reported all 171 passengers and crew disembarked safely, the fire was extinguished by the engine's Halon fire suppression system. The airline believes the fire was caused by a burst pneumatic duct.
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机起火。2025年3月26日，AirAsia的一架Airbus 320-200执行Air Asia 128航班，从Kuala Lumpur（Malaysia）飞往Shenzhen（China），机上共有171人。飞机从Kuala Lumpur机场33号跑道起飞爬升时，机组报告左侧发动机（CFM 56）出现火警指示，在4,000英尺停止爬升，执行相关检查单并释放了一瓶灭火剂。飞机进入等待，随后返回Kuala Lumpur，并在起飞约2小时后安全降落在33号跑道。航空公司报告称，全部171名乘客和机组人员均安全下机，火已由发动机的Halon灭火系统扑灭。航空公司认为，起火是由一条气压导管爆裂造成的。

cards.audioText: EGPWS warning on approach On February 2, 2025, an Easyjet Airbus 3 20 200 Neo, performing flight Easyjet 22 51 from Manchester (UK) to Hurghada (Egypt), was on approach to Hurghada's Runway 34L descending to about 2900 feet on downwind when the EGPWS issued a warning prompting the crew to climb back to 4000 feet while turning for base. The aircraft continued for a safe landing on Runway 34L about 7 minutes later. On Mar 29th 2025 Egypt's AAID reported the occurrence was rated a serious incident characterized as "Near CFIT on approach (EGPWS closure)" and is being investigated. The captain reported the incident himself, the airline forwarded the report to the authorities.
cards.audioTextZh: 进近时出现EGPWS警告。2025年2月2日，Easyjet的一架Airbus 320-200 Neo执行Easyjet 2251航班，从Manchester（UK）飞往Hurghada（Egypt）。飞机正在进近Hurghada机场34L跑道，在三边下降至约2,900英尺时，EGPWS发出警告，促使机组在转向四边的同时重新爬升至4,000英尺。飞机继续进近，并在约7分钟后安全降落在34L跑道。2025年3月29日，Egypt的AAID报告称，该事件被定性为严重事故征候，描述为“进近阶段险些发生可控飞行撞地（EGPWS接近率警告）”，目前正在调查。机长自行报告了该事件，航空公司将报告转交给主管部门。

cards.audioText: TCAS resolution on initial climb On March 28, 2025, a Delta Airlines Airbus 3 19 100, performing flight Delta 29 83 from Washington National to Minneapolis (USA), was in the initial climb through about 1300 feet out of Washington's Runway 19when tower handed the aircraft to departure, the crew read back, immediately afterwards tower attempted to contact Delta 29 83 again with no response. About 20 seconds after the hand off the crew reported on departure frequency, they just had had a TCAS resolution advisory for an aircraft 500 feet below them. The controller confirmed. The aircraft continued the climb and flight to Minneapolis for a safe landing without further incident. The F A A reported: "Delta Air Lines Flight 29 83 was cleared for takeoff at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport around 3 1 5 p.m. local time on Friday, March 28, while four U.S. Air Force T 38 Talons were inbound to Arlington National Cemetery for a flyover. The Delta aircraft received an onboard alert that another aircraft was nearby. Air traffic controllers issued corrective instructions to both aircraft. The F A A will investigate."
cards.audioTextZh: 初始爬升阶段出现TCAS决断咨询。2025年3月28日，Delta Airlines的一架Airbus 319-100执行Delta 2983航班，从Washington National飞往Minneapolis（USA）。飞机从Washington机场19号跑道起飞，并在初始爬升通过约1,300英尺时，塔台将飞机移交给离场管制，机组进行了复诵。紧接着，塔台再次尝试联系Delta 2983，但没有收到回应。移交约20秒后，机组在离场频率上报告，他们刚刚因一架位于本机下方500英尺的航空器收到TCAS决断咨询。管制员予以确认。飞机继续爬升并飞往Minneapolis，最终安全着陆，未再发生其他事件。FAA报告称：“当地时间3月28日星期五下午3:15左右，Delta Air Lines 2983航班在Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport获准起飞，当时四架美国空军T-38 Talon正飞往Arlington National Cemetery执行飞越任务。Delta飞机收到机载警报，提示附近有另一架航空器。空中交通管制员向两架航空器都发布了纠正指令。FAA将对此展开调查。”

cards.audioText: On September 8, 2015, British Airways Flight 2 2 7 6 was preparing to take off from Las Vegas McCarran International Airport to London Gatwick. During the takeoff roll, passengers heard a loud bang from the left side. Flames erupted from the left engine, prompting the pilots to immediately abort the takeoff. The aircraft stopped safely on the runway as smoke began entering the cabin. The crew quickly deployed all emergency slides and began evacuation. Fire trucks arrived within two minutes and extinguished the flames. Twenty-seven passengers suffered minor injuries during evacuation, mostly due to sliding and falls. Investigation revealed a failure in the engine's compressor section caused the fire. Thanks to the crew's training and fast action, all 170 people survived. The event emphasized the importance of precise emergency drills, aircraft evacuation procedures, and immediate decision-making under pressure.
cards.audioTextZh: 2015年9月8日，British Airways 2276航班正准备从Las Vegas McCarran International Airport起飞前往London Gatwick。在起飞滑跑过程中，乘客听到左侧传来一声巨响。左侧发动机喷出火焰，飞行员随即立即中断起飞。飞机安全停在跑道上，此时烟雾开始进入客舱。机组迅速放出全部应急滑梯并开始撤离。消防车在两分钟内到达并扑灭火焰。27名乘客在撤离过程中受轻伤，主要由滑梯滑下和跌倒造成。调查显示，发动机压气机部分发生故障并引发火灾。得益于机组的训练和迅速行动，机上全部170人均幸存。该事件强调了精确应急演练、航空器撤离程序以及在压力下立即作出决定的重要性。

cards.audioText: On September 21, 2005, JetBlue Flight 2 9 2 departed from Burbank, California, heading to New York. Shortly after takeoff, the pilots realized that the nose landing gear was turned sideways and could not retract. The crew informed air traffic control and decided to divert to Los Angeles International Airport. For over two hours, the aircraft circled the area to burn fuel and reduce landing weight. Passengers onboard watched live news coverage of their own situation via the in-flight entertainment system. The aircraft finally landed with its nose gear locked at a 90-degree angle. Sparks flew as the twisted gear scraped the runway, but the pilots kept the aircraft under control. The aircraft came to a complete stop without further incident. No one was injured. The event demonstrated the crew's professionalism and the aircraft's ability to withstand structural problems during landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年9月21日，JetBlue 292航班从California的Burbank起飞，前往New York。起飞后不久，飞行员发现前起落架横向偏转，且无法收起。机组通知空中交通管制，并决定备降Los Angeles International Airport。飞机在该区域盘旋了两个多小时，以消耗燃油并降低着陆重量。机上乘客通过机上娱乐系统观看了关于自身处境的电视新闻直播。飞机最终在前起落架锁定于90度角的情况下着陆。扭转的起落架在跑道上摩擦时火花四溅，但飞行员始终保持对飞机的控制。飞机最终完全停下，未再发生其他事件。没有人员受伤。该事件体现了机组的专业素养，以及飞机在着陆过程中承受结构问题的能力。

cards.audioText: On May 29, 2009, Shenzhen Airlines Flight 9648 was arriving at Guilin Liangjiang International Airport after a routine flight from Nanning. It was raining heavily, and visibility was low. The pilots attempted to land but touched down far along the wet runway. Realizing there was not enough distance to stop, the crew tried maximum braking and reverse thrust. The aircraft skidded, left the runway, and came to rest in soft grass. Passengers panicked, but the crew remained calm and initiated evacuation. All 166 people onboard exited safely, with only minor injuries reported. Investigation found the pilots misjudged approach speed and landing distance in poor weather. The airline implemented stricter training for wet runway operations and emphasized decision-making in unstable approaches. The event showed the risks of landing in adverse conditions and the importance of clear landing criteria.
cards.audioTextZh: 2009年5月29日，Shenzhen Airlines 9648航班完成从Nanning起飞的正常飞行后，正在抵达Guilin Liangjiang International Airport。当时下着大雨，能见度很低。飞行员尝试着陆，但飞机在湿滑跑道上很靠后的位置才接地。机组意识到剩余距离不足以让飞机停下，于是尝试使用最大刹车和反推。飞机打滑，冲出跑道，最终停在松软的草地上。乘客陷入恐慌，但机组保持冷静并开始组织撤离。机上全部166人均安全撤离，仅报告有人受轻伤。调查发现，飞行员在恶劣天气下错误判断了进近速度和着陆距离。航空公司对湿跑道运行实施了更严格的培训，并强调在不稳定进近中作出决定的重要性。该事件表明，在不利条件下着陆存在风险，同时也体现了明确着陆标准的重要性。

cards.audioText: On March 27, 2019, China Eastern Airlines 5 5 1 departed from Shanghai Pudong International Airport en route to London Heathrow. Mid-flight, over international airspace, a passenger suddenly suffered a severe medical crisis, marked by rapid heartbeat, severe asthma, and vomiting. The vigilant cabin crew immediately assisted by having the affected passenger lie down and locating two doctors among the passengers. When the patient's condition deteriorated rapidly, the pilots decided to divert the flight to Beijing. They promptly informed Beijing air traffic control and arranged for an emergency landing. Because the international flight was fully fueled, the pilots released excess fuel midair to meet safety protocols. At 0 5 1 5 PM Beijing time, the aircraft landed safely, and ground medical teams took over. The coordinated effort saved the patient's life and demonstrated effective in-flight crisis management, communication, and adherence to safety procedures.
cards.audioTextZh: 2019年3月27日，China Eastern Airlines 551航班从Shanghai Pudong International Airport起飞，前往London Heathrow。飞行途中，飞机位于国际空域上空时，一名乘客突然出现严重医疗状况，症状包括心跳加快、严重哮喘和呕吐。保持警觉的客舱机组立即提供协助，让患病乘客躺下，并在乘客中找到了两名医生。当患者状况迅速恶化时，飞行员决定备降Beijing。他们立即通知Beijing空中交通管制，并安排紧急着陆。由于该国际航班加注了满量燃油，飞行员在空中释放多余燃油，以符合安全程序。北京时间下午05:15，飞机安全着陆，地面医疗团队随后接手救治。此次协调行动挽救了患者的生命，并体现了有效的空中危机管理、沟通和对安全程序的遵守。

cards.audioText: On November 4, 2010, Qantas Flight 32, an Airbus A380 operated by Qantas-one of the world's largest airlines-departed from Singapore Changi Airport for a long-haul flight to Sydney. Shortly after takeoff, one engine experienced an uncontained failure, showering debris that damaged critical hydraulic systems. The cockpit was flooded with warning signals as the experienced pilots quickly assessed the situation. With remarkable composure, they isolated the malfunctioning engine and managed the cascade of system alerts while maintaining control of the massive aircraft. The crew communicated their predicament to air traffic control and secured priority landing clearance at Sydney Airport. Although passengers endured moments of turbulence and uncertainty, the calm and professional announcements reassured them. Post-flight investigations confirmed that a manufacturing defect compounded by maintenance lapses had caused the failure. Qantas Flight 32 has since become a celebrated case study in effective crew resource management and crisis resolution in modern aviation.
cards.audioTextZh: 2010年11月4日，Qantas 32航班是一架由全球最大航空公司之一Qantas运营的Airbus A380，从Singapore Changi Airport起飞，执行前往Sydney的长途飞行。起飞后不久，一台发动机发生非包容性失效，碎片飞散并损坏了关键液压系统。驾驶舱内出现大量警告信号，经验丰富的飞行员迅速评估情况。他们表现得异常镇定，在保持对这架大型飞机控制的同时，隔离了发生故障的发动机，并处理接连出现的系统警报。机组向空中交通管制通报了所面临的困境，并获得在Sydney Airport优先着陆的许可。尽管乘客经历了一段颠簸和不确定的时刻，机组冷静而专业的广播使他们安心。飞行后的调查证实，一项制造缺陷在维修疏漏的共同作用下导致了这次失效。此后，Qantas 32航班成为现代航空中有效机组资源管理和危机处置的著名案例。

cards.audioText: On July 4, 2001, China Eastern Flight 5 3 9 8 was en route from Shenzhen to Wuhan. As the aircraft approached Wuhan Tianhe Airport, it encountered a strong thunderstorm and severe wind shear. Despite poor weather, the pilots decided to proceed with landing. Just before touchdown, the aircraft suddenly lost altitude and hit the runway hard. The landing gear collapsed, and the right wing broke off, causing a fuel leak and fire. The crew initiated emergency evacuation immediately. Airport fire crews arrived within minutes and contained the fire. Of the 112 people onboard, more than 40 sustained injuries, but no fatalities occurred. The accident highlighted the dangers of wind shear and poor decision-making in stormy weather. Following the investigation, Chinese airlines implemented stricter policies regarding diversion and equipped more airports with wind shear detection systems.
cards.audioTextZh: 2001年7月4日，China Eastern 5398航班正在从Shenzhen飞往Wuhan。飞机接近Wuhan Tianhe Airport时，遭遇强雷暴和严重风切变。尽管天气恶劣，飞行员仍决定继续着陆。就在接地前，飞机突然失去高度并重重撞上跑道。起落架坍塌，右翼折断，导致燃油泄漏和起火。机组立即开始紧急撤离。机场消防人员在数分钟内到达并控制住火势。机上112人中有40多人受伤，但无人死亡。该事故突显了风切变和在暴风雨天气中错误决策的危险。调查结束后，中国各航空公司对备降实施了更严格的政策，并为更多机场配备风切变探测系统。

cards.audioText: On March 29, 2015, Air Canada Flight 624, an Airbus A320, was approaching Halifax Stanfield Airport from Toronto Pearson in heavy snow and poor visibility. As the aircraft descended into the thick weather, the pilots failed to properly monitor altitude, causing the plane to descend too early. At about 1,000 feet, the aircraft struck power lines before hitting the ground about 1.5 kilometers short of the runway. The impact damaged the landing gear and fuselage, but the pilots managed to maintain some control, skidding across the ground and coming to a stop near the runway. The crew quickly evacuated the 133 passengers and five crew members, with 25 people suffering minor injuries. An investigation found that the pilots did not follow the correct descent profile, and poor visibility, snow-covered runways, and inadequate lighting contributed to the incident. In response, Air Canada updated its approach procedures, stressing the use of instrument landing systems and better checklist protocols for low-visibility and winter operations, enhancing safety for future flights in similar conditions.
cards.audioTextZh: 2015年3月29日，Air Canada 624航班是一架Airbus A320，正从Toronto Pearson飞来，在大雪和低能见度条件下进近Halifax Stanfield Airport。飞机下降进入浓厚天气区域时，飞行员未能正确监控高度，导致飞机过早下降。飞机在约1,000英尺高度撞上电线，随后在距跑道入口约1.5公里处撞击地面。撞击损坏了起落架和机身，但飞行员仍设法保持一定程度的控制，飞机在地面滑行后停在跑道附近。机组迅速组织133名乘客和5名机组人员撤离，其中25人受轻伤。调查发现，飞行员没有遵循正确的下降剖面，低能见度、被积雪覆盖的跑道和照明不足也促成了此次事件。作为回应，Air Canada更新了进近程序，强调使用仪表着陆系统，并为低能见度和冬季运行采用更完善的检查单程序，从而提高今后类似条件下飞行的安全性。

cards.audioText: On January 17, 2008, British Airways Flight 3 8, a Boeing 7 7 7, was en route from Beijing to London Heathrow. The flight experienced problems when it began its final approach to Heathrow, and the aircraft experienced a dramatic loss of power just 1,000 feet above the runway. The engines had consumed more fuel than expected, a result of a fuel flow issue. Despite the pilots' attempts to restart the engines, the plane was forced into an emergency landing. The aircraft touched down short of the runway and skidded off the runway. Fortunately, all 136 passengers and 16 crew members survived, but several passengers were injured. The investigation revealed that ice crystals had blocked fuel flow to the engines due to a fault in the design of the fuel system. In response, British Airways and Boeing reviewed fuel management practices, and new safety measures were implemented to prevent such incidents in the future. This event highlighted the importance of thorough maintenance and the complexities of modern aircraft fuel systems.
cards.audioTextZh: 2008年1月17日，British Airways 38航班是一架Boeing 777，正在从Beijing飞往London Heathrow。航班开始对Heathrow实施最后进近时出现问题，飞机在跑道上方仅1,000英尺处突然大幅失去动力。由于燃油流动问题，发动机消耗的燃油多于预期。尽管飞行员尝试重新启动发动机，飞机仍被迫实施紧急着陆。飞机在跑道入口之前接地，随后滑行并冲出跑道。幸运的是，机上136名乘客和16名机组人员全部幸存，但数名乘客受伤。调查显示，由于燃油系统存在设计缺陷，冰晶阻塞了流向发动机的燃油。作为回应，British Airways和Boeing审查了燃油管理做法，并实施了新的安全措施，以防止今后再次发生此类事件。该事件突显了全面维修的重要性以及现代飞机燃油系统的复杂性。

cards.audioText: On August 2, 2005, Air France Flight 358, an Airbus A340, was landing at Toronto Pearson International Airport after a long-haul flight from Paris. The aircraft encountered heavy rain and poor visibility during its final approach. The pilots touched down later than intended, and the aircraft hydroplaned on the wet runway, severely reducing braking efficiency. As a result, the plane overran the runway, veered off the tarmac, and plunged down an embankment. Upon impact, the aircraft caught fire. The crew immediately initiated an emergency evacuation, and all 309 passengers and crew were safely evacuated, though 43 people suffered various injuries, mostly minor. Emergency responders arrived quickly to contain the fire. An investigation into the incident revealed that the pilots failed to execute a go-around despite unstable approach conditions and poor runway visibility. The accident led to changes in runway design to improve drainage, enhanced pilot training for landing in wet conditions, and stricter go-around policies. This incident also highlighted the critical role that well-trained flight attendants played in ensuring a swift and safe evacuation.
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年8月2日，Air France 358航班是一架Airbus A340，完成从Paris出发的长途飞行后，正在Toronto Pearson International Airport着陆。飞机在最后进近过程中遭遇大雨和低能见度。飞行员的接地点晚于预期，飞机在湿滑跑道上发生滑水，严重降低了制动效能。因此，飞机冲出跑道，偏离铺装道面并冲下路堤。飞机撞击后起火。机组立即组织紧急撤离，机上全部309名乘客和机组人员均安全撤离，但有43人受到不同程度的伤害，其中大多数为轻伤。紧急救援人员迅速赶到并控制住火势。事故调查显示，尽管进近状态不稳定且跑道能见度较差，飞行员仍未执行复飞。该事故促使跑道设计发生改变，以改善排水能力，同时加强了飞行员在湿滑条件下着陆的培训，并实施了更严格的复飞政策。该事件还突显了训练有素的乘务员在确保快速、安全撤离方面发挥的关键作用。

cards.audioText: On April 17, 2018, Southwest Airlines Flight 1380, a Boeing 737-700, was en route from New York LaGuardia Airport to Dallas Love Field. About 20 minutes into the flight, a loud explosion occurred when one of the plane's engines suffered a catastrophic failure. A piece of the engine's fan blade broke off and struck the fuselage, causing a loss of cabin pressure and a hole in the side of the aircraft. The crew immediately descended to a safe altitude and declared an emergency. The aircraft turned around and made an emergency landing at Philadelphia International Airport, with fire trucks and emergency crews standing by. Despite the damage, the skilled crew managed a safe landing. Tragically, one passenger was killed, and several others were injured during the decompression. Investigations revealed that the engine failure was caused by metal fatigue in the fan blade. Southwest Airlines and the FAA mandated more frequent inspections of similar engines to prevent further incidents. This event highlighted the need for rigorous maintenance and the quick response required in in-flight emergencies.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年4月17日，Southwest Airlines 1380航班是一架Boeing 737-700，正在从New York LaGuardia Airport飞往Dallas Love Field。飞行约20分钟后，飞机的一台发动机发生灾难性失效，并伴随一声巨响。发动机的一块风扇叶片断裂并撞击机身，导致客舱失压，机身侧面出现一个破洞。机组立即下降至安全高度并宣布紧急情况。飞机掉头并在Philadelphia International Airport实施紧急着陆，消防车和紧急救援人员在现场待命。尽管飞机受损，技术娴熟的机组仍成功安全着陆。遗憾的是，一名乘客死亡，另有数人在失压过程中受伤。调查显示，发动机失效是由风扇叶片的金属疲劳造成的。Southwest Airlines和FAA要求对同类发动机实施更频繁的检查，以防止更多类似事件。该事件突显了严格维修的必要性，以及在空中紧急情况下迅速响应的重要性。

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff due to loss of brakes On April 5, 2025, a Helvetic Airways Embraer ERJ 190 on behalf of Swiss International Airlines, performing flight Swiss 1674 from Zurich (Switzerland) to Florence (Italy), had been taxiing for departure holding short of Runway 28when the crew advised they had a technical problem and needed to return to the apron. The aircraft was instructed to cross Runway 28at the threshold and was given a taxi route. About 20 minutes later the aircraft reported on tower again ready for departure, lined up Runway 28and began takeoff acceleration but stopped on the runway stating they were not able to vacate the runway due to the loss of brakes. The aircraft was towed off the runway. A passenger reported: " We just had a rejected takeoff at low speed, I am still on the plane. The captain announced brake issues, before takeoff I noticed that we didn't lineup on the runway but instead went to another taxiway, possibly to solve the issue. Then we made a 180, attempted the takeoff, rejected, and now we will be towed back to the gate."
cards.audioTextZh: 因刹车失效中断起飞。2025年4月5日，Helvetic Airways的一架Embraer ERJ 190代表Swiss International Airlines执行Swiss 1674航班，从Zurich（Switzerland）飞往Florence（Italy）。飞机正在滑行准备离场，并在28号跑道外等待时，机组表示出现技术问题，需要返回停机坪。飞机被指示从跑道头穿越28号跑道，并获得一条滑行路线。约20分钟后，飞机再次在塔台频率上报告准备起飞，进入28号跑道并对正后开始加速起飞，但随后停在跑道上。机组表示，由于刹车失效，飞机无法脱离跑道。飞机随后被拖离跑道。一名乘客报告：“我们刚刚在低速状态下中断了起飞，我现在仍在飞机上。机长宣布刹车出现问题。起飞前，我注意到我们没有进入跑道并对正，而是前往另一条滑行道，可能是为了解决这个问题。随后我们进行了180度转弯，尝试起飞，又中断了起飞，现在我们将被拖回登机口。”

cards.audioText: On April 16, 2025, an Air Portugal Airbus 3 20 200, performing flight Air Portugal 6 8 7 from Luxembourg (Luxembourg) to Porto (Portugal), was descending towards Porto when the crew reported smoke in the cockpit. The aircraft continued for a landing on Runway 17without further incident. The airport reported two people were taken to a hospital for smoke inhalation. Initial information by Portugal's Civil Protection had suggested a fire and smoke in the aircraft cabin requiring two people to be taken to hospital for smoke inhalation, however, the airline stated there had been no fire and no smoke in the cabin. The airline confirmed two people were treated for smoke inhalation.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年4月16日，Air Portugal的一架Airbus 320-200执行Air Portugal 687航班，从Luxembourg（Luxembourg）飞往Porto（Portugal）。飞机正在向Porto下降时，机组报告驾驶舱内有烟。飞机继续飞行并降落在17号跑道，未再发生其他事件。机场报告称，两人因吸入烟雾被送往医院。Portugal民防部门的初步信息称，飞机客舱内出现火灾和烟雾，导致两人因吸入烟雾需要被送往医院。然而，航空公司表示没有发生火灾，客舱内也没有烟雾。航空公司确认有两人因吸入烟雾接受了治疗。

cards.audioText: On April 15, 2025, a Frontier Airlines Airbus 3 2 1, performing flight Frontier 3 5 0 6 from Orlando (USA) to San Juan (Puerto Rico) with 228 people on board, touched down hard on San Juan's Runway 10and went around. During climb out the left hand engine emitted a continuous streak of flames for several seconds. The airport subsequently closed both runways initially advising crews of arriving aircraft there was debris on the runways subsequently advising there had been a hard landing on one runway and the aircraft is now going to use the other runway, the landing runway is being inspected for debris. The aircraft subsequently entered a hold to work checklists associated with the landing gear. The aircraft positioned for a low approach to San Juan's Runway 08about 27 minutes later and landed without further incident on Runway 08about 40 minutes after the balked landing. The aircraft vacated the runway at the end and stopped on the parallel taxiway. Runway 08was reopened after landing, while Runway 10remained closed for some more time.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年4月15日，Frontier Airlines的一架Airbus 321执行Frontier 3506航班，从Orlando（USA）飞往San Juan（Puerto Rico），机上共有228人。飞机在San Juan机场10号跑道重着陆后复飞。爬升过程中，左侧发动机连续数秒喷出一道火焰。机场随后关闭了两条跑道，最初通知进场航空器的机组跑道上有碎片，随后又通知其中一条跑道发生了重着陆，该飞机现在将使用另一条跑道，原着陆跑道正在接受碎片检查。随后，飞机进入等待，以执行与起落架有关的检查单。约27分钟后，飞机重新定位，对San Juan机场08号跑道实施低空进近，并在中止着陆约40分钟后降落在08号跑道，未再发生其他事件。飞机从跑道末端脱离，并停在平行滑行道上。飞机着陆后，08号跑道重新开放，而10号跑道又继续关闭了一段时间。

cards.audioText: On April 26, 2025, a British Airways Boeing 7 7 7, performing flight speedbird 2 1 6 from Washington Dulles (USA) to London Heathrow (UK) with 243 passengers and 15 crew, had departed Dulles' Runway 01R and suffered a bird strike. The crew continued the climb and was enroute at FL350 about 60nm south of Boston (USA) when the crew declared Mayday and requested to divert to Boston advising, they have had a bird strike and now had fumes in the cabin, the cockpit was okay. The fume event in the cabin was uncontrollable, an evacuation was possible, the crew thus requested emergency services to follow them. On final approach the crew advised they would stop on the runway to check the cabin environment and make a decision whether to evacuate. The aircraft landed on Boston's Runway 22L about 25 minutes after declaring Mayday. The aircraft stopped on the runway for about 5 minutes, then vacated the runway and taxied to the apron. After landing the crew reported they did have a bird strike with a large bird of prey, which impacted the underside of the aircraft, probably the air conditioning system causing fumes in the cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年4月26日，British Airways的一架Boeing 777执行Speedbird 216航班，从Washington Dulles（USA）飞往London Heathrow（UK），机上有243名乘客和15名机组人员。飞机从Dulles机场01R跑道起飞后遭遇鸟击。机组继续爬升，飞机在Boston（USA）以南约60海里处以FL350飞行时，机组宣布Mayday并请求备降Boston。他们表示飞机曾遭遇鸟击，现在客舱内出现烟雾或异味，但驾驶舱情况正常。客舱内的烟雾或异味状况无法控制，可能需要撤离，因此机组请求紧急服务车辆跟随飞机。在最后进近时，机组表示飞机将在跑道上停下，以检查客舱环境并决定是否撤离。飞机在宣布Mayday约25分钟后降落在Boston机场22L跑道。飞机在跑道上停留约5分钟，随后脱离跑道并滑行至停机坪。着陆后，机组报告飞机确实与一只大型猛禽发生鸟击，该鸟撞击了飞机底部，可能撞到了空调系统并导致客舱内出现烟雾或异味。

cards.audioText: On October 18, 2023, a Fedex Federal Express Boeing 7 67-300, performing flight Fedex-541 from Memphis to Las Vegas (USA), was climbing out of Memphis' Runway 18R when the crew heard a loud bang from the left hand side and observed a fire warning for the left hand engine. The crew pulled the fire handle for the left hand engine and discharged both fire bottles and initiated a return to Memphis stopping the climb at about 3700 feet MSL. On approach back to Memphis the fire warning ceased. The aircraft landed safely on Memphis' Runway 18C about 15 minutes after departure. Attending emergency services observed no active fire but damage to the left hand engine.
cards.audioTextZh: 2023年10月18日，Fedex Federal Express的一架Boeing 767-300执行Fedex-541航班，从Memphis飞往Las Vegas（USA）。飞机从Memphis机场18R跑道起飞爬升时，机组听到左侧传来一声巨响，并观察到左侧发动机火警。机组拉出左侧发动机火警手柄，释放了两瓶灭火剂，并开始返回Memphis，在海拔约3,700英尺停止爬升。飞机返回Memphis进近时，火警消失。飞机在起飞约15分钟后安全降落在Memphis机场18C跑道。前来处置的紧急服务人员没有观察到仍在燃烧的火焰，但发现左侧发动机受损。

cards.audioText: On July 15, 2025, a British Airways Boeing 7 7 7, performing flight Speedbird 2 2 0 3 from London Gatwick (UK) to Cancun (Mexico) with 340 people on board, was climbing out of Runway 26L when the crew stopped the climb at FL1 1 0 reporting fumes on board. The aircraft entered a hold to dump fuel and returned to London Gatwick for a safe landing on Runway 26L about 55 minutes after departure. Passengers reported there was a smell of old socks making them feel dizzy, the crew even opened the cockpit side windows for fresh air.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年7月15日，British Airways的一架Boeing 777执行Speedbird 2203航班，从London Gatwick（UK）飞往Cancun（Mexico），机上共有340人。飞机从26L跑道起飞爬升时，机组报告机上出现烟雾或异味，并在FL110停止爬升。飞机进入等待以放油，随后返回London Gatwick，并在起飞约55分钟后安全降落在26L跑道。乘客报告称，机上有一股旧袜子的气味，让他们感到头晕，机组甚至打开了驾驶舱侧窗以获取新鲜空气。

cards.audioText: On July 18, 2025, a Delta Airlines Boeing 7 67, performing flight Delta 4 4 6 from Los Angeles to Atlanta (USA) with 224 people on board, was climbing out of Los Angeles' Runway 25R just being handed off to departure when the crew declared emergency reporting a left hand engine fire indication. Departure cleared them to maintain whatever altitude they needed, the crew chose 3000 feet. All departures from Los Angeles were halted, the next aircraft already having received takeoff clearance had their takeoff clearance cancelled and rejected takeoff. The aircraft positioned for an approach to Los Angeles' Runway 25L and landed safely, engine fire extinguished, about 15 minutes after departure. Runway 25Leftwas temporarily closed after landing. Emergency services inspected the aircraft, which taxied to the apron about 5 minutes after landing. Ground observers reported seeing continuous flames from the left hand engine.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年7月18日，Delta Airlines的一架Boeing 767执行Delta 446航班，从Los Angeles飞往Atlanta（USA），机上共有224人。飞机从Los Angeles机场25R跑道起飞爬升，刚被移交给离场管制时，机组宣布紧急情况并报告左侧发动机出现火警指示。离场管制许可机组保持他们所需的任意高度，机组选择3,000英尺。Los Angeles的所有离场航班均被暂停，下一架已经获得起飞许可的航空器被取消起飞许可并中断起飞。飞机重新定位进近Los Angeles机场25L跑道，并在起飞约15分钟后安全着陆，发动机火已熄灭。飞机着陆后，25L跑道暂时关闭。紧急服务人员检查了飞机，飞机在着陆约5分钟后滑行至停机坪。地面目击者报告看到左侧发动机持续喷出火焰。

cards.audioText: On July 13, 2025, a Bangkok Airways Airbus 3 1 9, performing flight 8 0 5 from Koh Samui (Thailand) to Hong Kong (China), was enroute at FL3 3 0 about 120 nautical miles eastnortheast of Bangkok (Thailand) when the crew decided to divert to Bangkok after a passenger's powerbank had caught fire. Cabin crew extinguished the fire and secured the device. The aircraft landed safely on Bangkok's Runway 19about 30 minutes later.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年7月13日，Bangkok Airways的一架Airbus 319执行805号航班，从Koh Samui（Thailand）飞往Hong Kong（China）。飞机在Bangkok（Thailand）东北偏东约120海里处以FL330飞行时，一名乘客的充电宝起火，机组决定备降Bangkok。客舱机组扑灭了火焰并妥善固定该设备。飞机约30分钟后安全降落在Bangkok机场19号跑道。

cards.audioText: On June 24, 2018, a Lufthansa Airbus 3 4 0, performing flight Lufthansa 4 8 9 from San Jose (USA) to Frankfurt Main (Germany), was enroute over the Atlantic Ocean in Canadian Airspace, when a powerbank in the cabin of the aircraft suffered a thermal runaway and caught fire. Cabin crew quickly extinguished the flames and cooled the device down before securing it in a safe container. The aircraft continued the flight to destination for a safe landing without further incidents. On December 19th 2018 the BFU released their June Bulletin briefly stating the occurrence is being investigated by the BFU. After about 4 hours enroute an accessory battery stored in a passenger's rucksack inflamed emitting lots of smoke. The cockpit crew donned their oxygen masks, cabin crew used halon fire extinguishers, put the fire out, cooled the battery down and kept it under surveillance for the remainder of the flight. About 30 minutes later the flight crew removed their oxygen masks and continued the flight to destination. Two passengers were treated for shock after landing in Frankfurt.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年6月24日，Lufthansa的一架Airbus 340执行Lufthansa 489航班，从San Jose（USA）飞往Frankfurt Main（Germany）。飞机在Atlantic Ocean上空、Canadian空域内飞行时，客舱内一个充电宝发生热失控并起火。客舱机组迅速扑灭火焰，将设备冷却后放入安全容器中妥善存放。飞机继续飞往目的地并安全着陆，未再发生其他事件。2018年12月19日，BFU发布6月公报，简要说明该事件正由BFU调查。飞机飞行约4小时后，一块存放在乘客背包中的配件电池起火并冒出大量烟雾。驾驶舱机组戴上氧气面罩，客舱机组使用Halon灭火器将火扑灭，冷却电池，并在剩余航程中持续监控该电池。约30分钟后，飞行机组摘下氧气面罩并继续飞往目的地。飞机在Frankfurt着陆后，两名乘客因受到惊吓而接受治疗。

cards.audioText: On July 25, 2025, A Southwest Airlines Boeing 7 37, performing flight Southwest 1 4 9 6 from Burbank, to Las Vegas (USA), was climbing through about 14100 feet out of Burbank about 11 nautical miles north of Burbank. A Military Hawker Hunter MK.5 8, from El Paso to Point Mugu (USA), was descending through 14,500 feet towards Point Mugu, when the vertical separation reduced to about 350 feet and the horizontal separation reduced to about 4 nautical miles, when both aircraft received TCAS resolution advisories prompting the Hunter to climb and the Boeing to descend. The Hunter climbed about 100 feet in response to the Resolution Advisory, the Boeing descended about 500 feet before resuming the climb. Both aircraft continued to their destinations for landings without further incident. Two flight attendants on board of the Boeing 737 received minor injuries. The FAA reported: "Southwest Airlines Flight 1 4 9 6 responded to an onboard alert that another aircraft was in the vicinity while in Los Angeles Air Route Traffic Control Center airspace. The FAA is investigating the event that occurred around 12 p.m. local time on Friday, July 25." Passengers reported they were lifted out of their seats and onto flight attendants causing injuries to two flight attendants, when the aircraft went into a sudden descent. The flight crew later came on explaining a collision warning had activated and he needed to avoid the aircraft coming at them. The airline reported the crew reacted to onboard traffic alerts, the airline is working with the FAA to understand the circumstances. Two flight attendants are being treated for injuries, none of the passengers received any injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年7月25日，Southwest Airlines的一架Boeing 737执行Southwest 1496航班，从Burbank飞往Las Vegas（USA）。飞机从Burbank起飞后，在Burbank以北约11海里处爬升通过约14,100英尺。一架军用Hawker Hunter MK.58正从El Paso飞往Point Mugu（USA），并在飞向Point Mugu的过程中下降通过14,500英尺。两机垂直间隔缩小至约350英尺、水平间隔缩小至约4海里时，两架航空器均收到TCAS决断咨询，促使Hunter爬升、Boeing飞机下降。Hunter根据决断咨询爬升约100英尺，Boeing飞机下降约500英尺后恢复爬升。两架航空器均继续飞往各自目的地并着陆，未再发生其他事件。Boeing 737上的两名乘务员受轻伤。FAA报告称：“Southwest Airlines 1496航班位于Los Angeles Air Route Traffic Control Center空域内时，响应了机载系统发出的附近有另一架航空器的警报。FAA正在调查这起发生在7月25日星期五当地时间中午12点左右的事件。”乘客报告称，飞机突然下降时，他们被从座位上抛起并撞到乘务员，导致两名乘务员受伤。随后，飞行机组通过广播解释称，防撞警告已经触发，他需要避让一架迎面而来的航空器。航空公司报告称，机组对机载交通警报作出了反应，航空公司正与FAA合作了解事件经过。两名乘务员正在接受伤情治疗，乘客均未受伤。

cards.audioText: On July 27, 2025, an Air Cairo Airbus 3 20, performing flight Air Cairo 5 0 1 from Cairo (Egypt) to Sharjah (United Arab Emirates), was enroute at FL3 3 0 about 280 nautical miles east of Cairo when the crew initiated an emergency descent to FL1 2 0 due to the loss of cabin pressure. The aircraft returned to Cairo for a safe landing about 1 hour and 55 minutes after departure. According to information The Aviation Herald received the aircraft had been dispatched under minimum equipment list requirements with engine #2 bleed inoperative. In flight engine #1 bleed failed, too, the APU could not be used above FL2 0 0, hence cabin pressure was lost prompting the crew to don their oxygen masks and initiate an emergency descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年7月27日，Air Cairo的一架Airbus 320执行Air Cairo 501航班，从Cairo（Egypt）飞往Sharjah（United Arab Emirates）。飞机在Cairo以东约280海里处以FL330飞行时，机组因客舱失压开始紧急下降至FL120。飞机返回Cairo，并在起飞约1小时55分钟后安全着陆。根据The Aviation Herald收到的信息，该飞机依据最低设备清单要求放行，当时2号发动机引气系统不工作。飞行中，1号发动机引气系统也发生故障，而APU无法在FL200以上使用，因此客舱失压，机组戴上氧气面罩并开始紧急下降。

cards.audioText: On June 16, 2022, a Lufthansa Cityline CRJ 900, performing flight Lufthansa1 3 7 2 from Frankfurt Main (Germany) to Wroclaw (Poland), was descending towards Wroclaw when the crew stopped the descent at FL1 0 0 reporting they had a spoiler problem and needed a longer runway. The crew decided to divert to Warsaw, climbed to FL1 3 0 and landed safely on Runway 15about 45 minutes after aborting the approach to Wroclaw. A passenger reported the aircraft had already been swapped before departure and was delayed by about 90 minutes as a result. The crew announced they needed to divert to Warsaw due to problems with the brakes (the passenger said, it remained unclear in the context whether the wheel brakes or speed brakes), on landing in Warsaw they were told to assume the brace position.
cards.audioTextZh: 2022年6月16日，Lufthansa Cityline的一架CRJ 900执行Lufthansa 1372航班，从Frankfurt Main（Germany）飞往Wroclaw（Poland）。飞机正在向Wroclaw下降时，机组报告扰流板出现问题，需要一条更长的跑道，并在FL100停止下降。机组决定备降Warsaw，爬升至FL130，并在中止进近Wroclaw约45分钟后安全降落在15号跑道。一名乘客报告称，飞机在起飞前已经更换，因此延误了约90分钟。机组宣布，由于刹车出现问题，他们需要备降Warsaw。该乘客表示，结合当时情况，所指的是机轮刹车还是减速板仍不明确。飞机在Warsaw着陆时，乘客被告知采取防冲击姿势。

cards.audioText: On May 24, 2024, an Iran Air Fokker 100, performing flight Iran Air 4 5 5 from Tehran Mehrabad to Tabriz (Iran) with 101 passengers and 9 crew, was enroute at FL3 0 0 about 100 nautical miles before Tabriz when the aircraft was struck by lightning about 10 nautical miles from a thunderstorm cell, which caused the loss of AC Essential Bus which lost further systems like weather radar, transponder, TCAS, captain side instruments and loss of automatic cabin pressure control. The captain handed aircraft control to the first officer, cabin pressure was maintained in manual control. Due to the weather at Tabriz the crew decided to return to Tehran, however, the cabin altitude began to climb at 2000 feet per minute and could no longer be controlled prompting the crew to perform an emergency descent and divert to Ardabil (Iran). Aradabil at that time was not operational and was made operational due to the emergency. After entering a hold waiting for the airport staff to arrive the aircraft landed on Ardabil's Runway 15without further incident.
cards.audioTextZh: 2024年5月24日，Iran Air的一架Fokker 100执行Iran Air 455航班，从Tehran Mehrabad飞往Tabriz（Iran），机上有101名乘客和9名机组人员。飞机在距Tabriz约100海里处以FL300飞行时，于距一处雷暴单体约10海里的位置遭到雷击，导致AC Essential Bus失效，并进一步造成气象雷达、应答机、TCAS、机长侧仪表等系统失效，同时自动客舱压力控制功能丧失。机长将飞机操纵权交给副驾驶，客舱压力通过人工控制维持。由于Tabriz的天气状况，机组决定返回Tehran。然而，客舱高度开始以每分钟2,000英尺的速度上升，并且无法再受控制，促使机组实施紧急下降并备降Ardabil（Iran）。Aradabil当时并未运行，但因这次紧急情况而恢复运行。飞机进入等待，等候机场工作人员到达，随后降落在Ardabil机场15号跑道，未再发生其他事件。

cards.audioText: On July 27, 2025, a Scandinavian Airlines Airbus 3 3 0, performing flight Scandinavian 9 1 0 from Newark (USA) to Copenhagen (Denmark), was enroute at FL4 0 0 about 170 nautical miles northwest of Edinburg (UK) when the crew declared emergency and diverted to Edinburgh due to the failure of another electrical generator, so that only one (main) generator remained online. The aircraft landed safely on Edinburgh's Runway 24about 35 minutes later. A passenger reported the crew announced in Newark, that they had problems with the APU. In flight the crew announced that two of the four generators on board had failed prompting the diversion to Edinburgh. The Airbus 3 3 0 has one engine driven generator (I D G) per engine, the APU, a backup hydraulic emergency generator and the RAM Air Turbine (R A T).
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年7月27日，Scandinavian Airlines的一架Airbus 330执行Scandinavian 910航班，从Newark（USA）飞往Copenhagen（Denmark）。飞机在Edinburg（UK）西北约170海里处以FL400飞行时，由于另一台发电机失效、只剩一台主发电机在线，机组宣布紧急情况并备降Edinburgh。飞机约35分钟后安全降落在Edinburgh机场24号跑道。一名乘客报告称，机组在Newark宣布APU存在问题。飞行中，机组宣布机上四台发电机中有两台失效，因此备降Edinburgh。Airbus 330每台发动机各有一台发动机驱动发电机（IDG），此外还有APU、一台备用液压应急发电机和冲压空气涡轮（RAT）。

cards.audioText: On July 30, 2025, a Delta Airlines Airbus 3 30, performing flight Delta 5 6 from Salt Lake City (USA) to Amsterdam (Netherlands) with 262 passengers and 13 crew, was enroute at FL3 7 0 about 200 nautical miles west of Minneapolis (USA) when the crew decided to divert to Minneapolis after the aircraft had encountered severe turbulence causing 25 injuries on board. The aircraft landed on Minneapolis' Runway 12R about 35 minutes later. The airline reported 25 people were taken to hospitals. Passengers reported they were told one of the flight attendants had suffered a broken rib, another person a fractured leg. The trolleys had been lifted and impacted the cabin ceiling and fell to the floor several times, passengers not wearing their seat belts also hit the cabin ceiling. The crew announced they had lost more than 1000 feet of altitude, they hadn't seen such severe turbulence ever before. According to radar data the aircraft encountered altitude deviations from FL3 7 0 up to FL3 7 6 and down to FL3 6 0 about 80 nautical miles southwest of Casper (USA) about 55 minutes prior to leaving FL3 7 0 for the diversion to Minneapolis.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年7月30日，Delta Airlines的一架Airbus 330执行Delta 56航班，从Salt Lake City（USA）飞往Amsterdam（Netherlands），机上有262名乘客和13名机组人员。飞机在Minneapolis（USA）以西约200海里处以FL370飞行时，遭遇严重颠簸并造成机上25人受伤，机组决定备降Minneapolis。飞机约35分钟后降落在Minneapolis机场12R跑道。航空公司报告称，25人被送往医院。乘客报告称，他们获悉一名乘务员肋骨骨折，另有一人腿部骨折。餐车被抛起撞到客舱顶部，又多次落回地板，没有系安全带的乘客也撞到了客舱顶部。机组宣布飞机曾损失超过1,000英尺高度，他们以前从未遇到过如此严重的颠簸。根据雷达数据，飞机在Casper（USA）西南约80海里处出现高度偏差，从FL370最高偏至FL376、最低偏至FL360；该情况发生在飞机为备降Minneapolis而离开FL370之前约55分钟。

cards.audioText: On August 3, 2025, a United Boeing 7 87, performing flight United 1 1 2 2 from Newark (USA) to Cape Town (South Africa), was enroute at FL3 3 0 over the Atlantic Ocean about 250 nautical miles eastsoutheast of Newark when the crew reported they had a spoiler problem and requested to return to Newark. The aircraft dumped fuel on the way back. On approach the crew advised they needed to fly 260 knots and would be able to reduce to 185 knots later. The aircraft landed safely on Newark's Runway 22R at a higher than normal speed (about 180 knots over ground) about 100 minutes after departure. A passenger reported about 30 minutes into the flight there were noticeable vibrations. The captain announced they had lost part of a wing, they worked all the checklists and were returning to Newark.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年8月3日，United的一架Boeing 787执行United 1122航班，从Newark（USA）飞往Cape Town（South Africa）。飞机在Atlantic Ocean上空、Newark东南偏东约250海里处以FL330飞行时，机组报告扰流板出现问题并请求返回Newark。飞机在返航途中放油。进近时，机组表示需要以260节飞行，随后可以将速度减至185节。飞机以高于正常的速度安全降落在Newark机场22R跑道，着陆地速约为180节，距起飞约100分钟。一名乘客报告称，飞行约30分钟后出现明显振动。机长宣布飞机失去了机翼的一部分，机组执行了全部检查单，正在返回Newark。

cards.audioText: On July 31, 2025, a LATAM Boeing 7 8 7, performing flight 6 0 3 from Los Angeles (USA) to Santiago de Chile (Chile), was climbing out of Los Angeles' Runway 25R when ATC cleared the crew to climb to FL2 3 0 and maintain 2 8 0 knots or greater. The crew requested to level off at FL2 3 0 confirming this would be their final level. ATC queried whether everything was okay, the crew hesitated a moment then said yes. The crew subsequently requested to lower their speed to 2 5 0 knots. Upon second query by the controller the crew stated that they had the R A T deployed). Upon further query by ATC whether they wanted to return the crew indicated a return to Los Angeles. The aircraft dumped fuel and returned to Los Angeles for an ILS approach to and safe landing on Runway 25L about 75 minutes after departure. After landing the crew advised they did not need any assistance and wanted to taxi to their gate.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年7月31日，LATAM的一架Boeing 787执行603号航班，从Los Angeles（USA）飞往Santiago de Chile（Chile）。飞机从Los Angeles机场25R跑道起飞爬升时，空中交通管制许可机组爬升至FL230，并保持280节或更高速度。机组请求在FL230改平，并确认这将是他们的最终高度层。空中交通管制询问一切是否正常，机组犹豫片刻后回答正常。随后，机组请求将速度降低至250节。管制员第二次询问后，机组表示冲压空气涡轮（RAT）已经放出。空中交通管制进一步询问机组是否希望返航，机组表示将返回Los Angeles。飞机放油后返回Los Angeles，实施ILS进近，并在起飞约75分钟后安全降落在25L跑道。着陆后，机组表示不需要任何援助，希望滑行至登机口。

cards.audioText: Your call sign is Lufthansa 1372, while descending towards Wroclaw, you had spoiler problem, you stopped descent at FL100, tell Wroclaw approach you need a longer runway and divert to Warsaw.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Lufthansa 1372。你在向Wroclaw下降时遇到扰流板问题，并在FL100停止下降。请告知Wroclaw进近管制，你需要一条更长的跑道并将备降Warsaw。

cards.audioText: On August 28, 2024, a China Eastern Boeing 7 7 7, performing flight China Eastern 5 6 5 from Shanghai Pudong (China) to Singapore (Singapore) with 220 people on board, was on final approach to Singapore's Runway 20R and was instructed to continue the approach. The preceding aircraft had landed on Runway 20R but had not yet vacated the runway. Assuming that the aircraft would vacate the runway in time, tower cleared the Boeing 7 7 7 to land on Runway 20R. However, the preceding aircraft did not manage to vacate the runway in time. Tower therefore instructed the Boeing 7 7 7 to go around when the aircraft was at 76 feet AGL and about 296 meters ahead of the runway threshold, however, the crew did not respond and continued the landing. When the Boeing 7 7 7 touched down, tower assessed that the tail of the preceding aircraft had already cleared the runway edge line, so that a go around instruction was no longer needed.
cards.audioTextZh: 2024年8月28日，China Eastern的一架Boeing 777执行China Eastern 565航班，从Shanghai Pudong（China）飞往Singapore（Singapore），机上共有220人。飞机正在对Singapore机场20R跑道实施最后进近，并被指示继续进近。前一架航空器已经降落在20R跑道，但尚未脱离跑道。塔台认为该航空器能够及时脱离跑道，因此许可Boeing 777在20R跑道着陆。然而，前一架航空器未能及时脱离跑道。因此，当Boeing 777位于离地76英尺、距跑道入口约296米处时，塔台指示其复飞，但机组没有回应并继续着陆。Boeing 777接地时，塔台判断前一架航空器的尾部已经越过跑道边缘线，因此不再需要复飞指令。

cards.audioText: backup air conditioning system failure On August 11, 2025, a Hawaiian Airlines Airbus 3 2 1, performing flight Hawaiian 5 9 from Sacramento to Kahului (USA), was enroute at FL3 0 0 over the Pacific Ocean about 420 nautical miles westsouthwest of Oakland (USA) when the crew decided to turn around and divert to Oakland. The aircraft descended to FL2 2 0 and landed safely on Oakland's Runway 30about 2 hours 15 minutes after departure. The airline reported the aircraft developed an issue with the backup air conditioning system, which is required for ETOPS operations more than 3 hours away from the nearest airport. While a replacement aircraft was dispatched to Oakland, the flight crew timed out, the flight was postponed to the next day as flight Hawaiian 1 0 5 9.
cards.audioTextZh: 备用空调系统故障。2025年8月11日，Hawaiian Airlines的一架Airbus 321执行Hawaiian 59航班，从Sacramento飞往Kahului（USA）。飞机在Pacific Ocean上空、Oakland（USA）西南偏西约420海里处以FL300飞行时，机组决定掉头并备降Oakland。飞机下降至FL220，并在起飞约2小时15分钟后安全降落在Oakland机场30号跑道。航空公司报告称，飞机的备用空调系统出现问题。对于距离最近机场超过3小时的ETOPS运行，该系统必须可用。虽然一架替代飞机被调往Oakland，但飞行机组的执勤时间已经超限，因此该航班被推迟至次日，并改为Hawaiian 1059航班。

cards.audioText: flaps up landing On August 13, 2025, a Southwest Airlines Boeing 7 3 7, performing flight Southwest 2 1 5 0 from Houston Hobby to Columbus (USA) with 116 people on board, was descending towards Columbus when the crew advised of a flight control problem, the flaps didn't come down so that they would need to do a flaps up landing at 170 knots. The crew requested an extended downwind to complete checklists, then positioned for an approach to Runway 28L and landed at a higher speed than normal. Emergency services checked the aircraft before the aircraft taxied to the apron. A passenger reported they were told the aircraft needed to do a high speed landing due to flaps problems.
cards.audioTextZh: 襟翼收上状态着陆。2025年8月13日，Southwest Airlines的一架Boeing 737执行Southwest 2150航班，从Houston Hobby飞往Columbus（USA），机上共有116人。飞机正在向Columbus下降时，机组报告飞行操纵系统出现问题，襟翼无法放下，因此需要以170节实施襟翼收上状态着陆。机组请求延长三边，以完成检查单，随后重新定位进近28L跑道，并以高于正常的速度着陆。紧急服务人员检查飞机后，飞机滑行至停机坪。一名乘客报告称，他们被告知飞机因襟翼问题需要实施高速着陆。

cards.audioText: hydraulic problems, flaps did not retract On August 17, 2025, an American Airlines Boeing 737-800, performing flight American 1292 from Los Angeles to Nashville (USA) with 172 people on board, was climbing out of Los Angeles' Runway 25R when the crew requested to level off at 16000 feet to run some checklists advising ATC they needed to maintain 230 knots. The aircraft entered a hold advising ATC they had hydraulic problems, the flaps had not retracted. After the hold the crew requested a long final to Runway 25R and emergency services on standby, they might have a hot brake situation, the crew declared emergency. The aircraft landed on Runway 25R at a higher than normal speed (about 182 knots over ground) about 80 minutes after departure, vacated the runway and stopped for a brief check by emergency services before taxiing to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 液压系统出现问题，襟翼未能收回。2025年8月17日，American Airlines的一架Boeing 737-800执行American 1292航班，从Los Angeles飞往Nashville（USA），机上共有172人。飞机从Los Angeles机场25R跑道起飞爬升时，机组请求在16,000英尺改平以执行一些检查单，并告知空中交通管制，他们需要保持230节。飞机进入等待，并告知空中交通管制液压系统出现问题，襟翼未能收回。结束等待后，机组请求对25R跑道实施长五边进近，并要求紧急服务人员待命，因为刹车可能过热。机组宣布紧急情况。飞机在起飞约80分钟后以高于正常的速度降落在25R跑道，着陆地速约为182节。飞机脱离跑道并停下，接受紧急服务人员的简短检查后滑行至停机坪。

cards.audioText: bird strike On August 21, 2025, a Jin Air Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight Jin Air 1 1 5 from Busan (South Korea) to Nha Trang (Vietnam) with 150 passengers and 6 crew, was climbing out of Busan's Runway 36R when the crew stopped the climb at 6000 feet reporting a bird strike into the right hand engine and entered a hold. The crew subsequently decided to divert to Seoul (South Korea), the aircraft climbed to FL1 8 0 and landed safely on Seoul Incheon's Runway 33L about 2 hours 10 minutes after departure. The airline reported due to night curfew at Busan and the availability of a replacement aircraft in Seoul the crew decided to divert to Seoul.
cards.audioTextZh: 鸟击。2025年8月21日，Jin Air的一架Boeing 737-800执行Jin Air 115航班，从Busan（South Korea）飞往Nha Trang（Vietnam），机上有150名乘客和6名机组人员。飞机从Busan机场36R跑道起飞爬升时，机组报告右侧发动机遭遇鸟击，在6,000英尺停止爬升并进入等待。随后，机组决定备降Seoul（South Korea）。飞机爬升至FL180，并在起飞约2小时10分钟后安全降落在Seoul Incheon机场33L跑道。航空公司报告称，由于Busan实施夜间宵禁，且Seoul有替代飞机可用，机组决定备降Seoul。

cards.audioText: On August 27, 2025, an American Airlines Boeing 7 37 8 MAX, performing flight American 3 8 4 from Montego Bay (Jamaica) to Miami (USA), was climbing out of Montego Bay's Runway 07when the aircraft flew through a flock of birds. The crew stopped the climb at about 5000 feet and decided to divert to Kingston (Jamaica) climbing to 14000 feet enroute. The aircraft landed on Kingston's Runway 12about 45 minutes after departure. A passenger reported the aircraft hit a flock of small birds right after rotation, smell developed on board. The crew diverted to Kingston due to the winds at Montego Bay. There was no damage visible to the aircraft. A replacement flight delivered them to Miami with a delay of about 8 hours.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年8月27日，American Airlines的一架Boeing 737-8 MAX执行American 384航班，从Montego Bay（Jamaica）飞往Miami（USA）。飞机从Montego Bay机场07号跑道起飞爬升时穿过一群鸟。机组在约5,000英尺停止爬升，并决定备降Kingston（Jamaica），途中爬升至14,000英尺。飞机在起飞约45分钟后降落在Kingston机场12号跑道。一名乘客报告称，飞机刚抬轮后就撞上一群小鸟，机上随后出现异味。由于Montego Bay的风况，机组备降Kingston。飞机没有可见损坏。一架替代航班将乘客送往Miami，延误约8小时。

cards.audioText: On August 29, 2025, a Delta Airlines Boeing 7 1 7, 200, performing flight Delta 1 7 0 8 from Huntsville to Atlanta (USA), was accelerating for takeoff from Huntsville's Runway 18R when the crew rejected takeoff at low speed and advised ATC they needed emergency services due to smoke. The aircraft vacated the runway at the first exit about 380 meters down the runway and stopped clear of the runway. The crew inquired whether emergency services were seeing anything from the left hand engine, emergency services they were not seeing anything unusual from either engine. About 10 minutes later the aircraft taxied to the apron with emergency services in trail, the crew suggested the airport might sweep the runway as a precaution.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年8月29日，Delta Airlines的一架Boeing 717-200执行Delta 1708航班，从Huntsville飞往Atlanta（USA）。飞机正在Huntsville机场18R跑道加速起飞时，机组在低速状态下中断起飞，并告知空中交通管制由于出现烟雾，他们需要紧急服务人员。飞机从距跑道起点约380米处的第一个出口脱离跑道，并在跑道外停下。机组询问紧急服务人员是否看到左侧发动机有任何异常，紧急服务人员回答没有看到任何一台发动机存在异常。约10分钟后，飞机在紧急服务车辆跟随下滑行至停机坪。机组建议机场出于谨慎考虑清扫跑道。

cards.audioText: flight control problem On September 6, 2025, an A S L Airlines Belgium Boeing 7 37 400 freighter, performing flight 2 7 9 Papa from Helsinki (Finland) to Shannon (Ireland), was climbing out of Helsinki's Runway 04R when the crew reported a flight control problem and stopped the climb at FL1 0 0. The aircraft returned to Helsinki for an approach to Runway 04L and was on final approach when the crew requested to hold for about 10 minutes, climbed back to 5000 feet and entered a hold. The aircraft subsequently positioned for another approach to Runway 04L eftand landed without further incident about 40 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行操纵问题。2025年9月6日，ASL Airlines Belgium的一架Boeing 737-400货机执行279 Papa航班，从Helsinki（Finland）飞往Shannon（Ireland）。飞机从Helsinki机场04R跑道起飞爬升时，机组报告飞行操纵系统出现问题，并在FL100停止爬升。飞机返回Helsinki，准备进近04L跑道。飞机进入最后进近后，机组请求等待约10分钟，随后重新爬升至5,000英尺并进入等待。之后，飞机重新定位，再次进近04L跑道，并在起飞约40分钟后着陆，未再发生其他事件。

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff On September 8, 2025, an Easyjet Europe Airbus 3 20 200, performing flight Easyjet 7 2 7 2 from Basel Mulhouse (Switzerland/France) to Palma Mallorca (Spain), lined up Basel's Runway 15at 0 8 0 9 Zulu. The aircraft commenced takeoff at 0 8 1 1 Zulu but needed to reject takeoff at high speed (about 112 knots over ground). When Easyjet 7 2 7 2 crossed the hold short line to line up the runway, an arriving Easyjet Airbus 3 20 200, performing flight Easyjet 1 2 1 2 from Budapest (Hungary) to Basel/Mulhouse (Switzerland/France), was on final approach to Basel's Runway 15about 6 nautical miles before the runway threshold descending through 1940 feet AGL. When Easyjet 7 2 7 2 began to accelerate, Easyjet 1 2 1 2 was about 1 nautical miles ahead of the runway threshold descending through about 370 feet AGL, shortly afterwards the crew initiated a go around at about 350 feet AGL. Easyjet 7 2 7 2 rejected takeoff about 5 seconds later. The airline reported the captain of Easyjet 7 2 7 2 performed a routine takeoff procedure, however, needed to reject takeoff on ATC instruction and returned to the apron. Passengers of Easyjet 7 2 7 2 reported their crew told them they needed to reject takeoff due to an arriving aircraft that came too close. Their aircraft was able to depart later and reached Palma with a delay of about one hour. Easyjet 7 2 7 2 returned to the hold short line and departed Runway 15about 25 minutes after the rejected takeoff and reached Palma with a delay of about 30 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 中断起飞。2025年9月8日，Easyjet Europe的一架Airbus 320-200执行Easyjet 7272航班，从Basel Mulhouse（Switzerland/France）飞往Palma Mallorca（Spain）。飞机于Zulu时间08:09进入Basel机场15号跑道并对正。飞机于Zulu时间08:11开始起飞，但随后不得不在高速状态下中断起飞，当时地速约为112节。当Easyjet 7272越过跑道等待线进入跑道并对正时，一架执行Easyjet 1212航班、从Budapest（Hungary）飞往Basel/Mulhouse（Switzerland/France）的Easyjet Airbus 320-200正在对Basel机场15号跑道实施最后进近，位于跑道入口前约6海里处并下降通过离地1,940英尺。当Easyjet 7272开始加速时，Easyjet 1212位于跑道入口前约1海里处并下降通过离地约370英尺。不久后，该机机组在离地约350英尺处开始复飞。约5秒后，Easyjet 7272中断起飞。航空公司报告称，Easyjet 7272的机长按照正常程序实施起飞，但随后根据空中交通管制指令中断起飞并返回停机坪。Easyjet 7272的乘客报告称，机组告诉他们，由于一架进场航空器距离过近，飞机需要中断起飞。他们的飞机后来得以起飞，并延误约一小时抵达Palma。Easyjet 7272返回跑道等待线，并在中断起飞约25分钟后从15号跑道起飞，抵达Palma时延误约30分钟。

cards.audioText: On September 10, 2024, an Air China Airbus 320, registration Bravo tree zero five Juliett performing flight Air China four zero tree from Chengdu (China) to Singapore (Singapore) with 146 passengers and 9 crew, was descending towards Singapore when the crew declared emergency reporting they had received a forward cargo hold as well as a lavatory smoke indication. Smoke developed in the cabin. The aircraft landed on Singapore's Runway 20L and stopped on the runway. The aircraft was evacuated via all slides (including the left hand overwing slides). 9 people received minor injuries. Emergency services extinguished a left hand engine fire.
cards.audioTextZh: 2024年9月10日，Air China的一架Airbus 320注册号为B305J，执行Air China 403航班，从Chengdu（China）飞往Singapore（Singapore），机上有146名乘客和9名机组人员。飞机正在向Singapore下降时，机组宣布紧急情况，并报告收到前货舱烟雾指示和卫生间烟雾指示。客舱内出现烟雾。飞机降落在Singapore机场20L跑道并停在跑道上。机上人员通过全部滑梯撤离，其中包括左侧翼上滑梯。9人受轻伤。紧急服务人员扑灭了左侧发动机的火。

cards.audioText: engine vibrations On September 26, 2025, an Eurowings Europe Malta Airbus 3 20-200, registration niner hotel-Echo Uniform Papa performing flight Eurowings 4 3 8 2 from Salzburg (Austria) to Kos (Greece), was climbing out of Salzburg's Runway 33when the crew reported they had engine vibrations, would not continue the departure and requested to enter a hold. The vibrations started already on the runway before becoming airborne, hence the next departure should not immediately depart. The aircraft entered a hold while the crew was working the related checklists, a runway inspection did not find any debris on the runway. The crew advised their left hand engine was vibrating but was kept running, a normal landing back to Salzburg would occur. The aircraft landed safely back on Runway 15about 25 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机振动。2025年9月26日，Eurowings Europe Malta的一架Airbus 320-200注册号为9H-EUP，执行Eurowings 4382航班，从Salzburg（Austria）飞往Kos（Greece）。飞机从Salzburg机场33号跑道起飞爬升时，机组报告发动机发生振动，不会继续离场，并请求进入等待。振动在飞机尚未离地、仍位于跑道上时就已经开始，因此下一架离场航空器不应立即起飞。飞机进入等待，机组执行相关检查单；跑道检查没有发现任何碎片。机组表示左侧发动机正在振动，但仍保持运转，飞机将正常返回Salzburg着陆。飞机在起飞约25分钟后安全返回并降落在15号跑道。

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff due to runway incursion On September 28, 2025, an American Airlines Airbus 3 21 200, registration November 1 1 0 Alpha November performing flight American 2 4 5 3 from Los Angeles to Boston (USA), was accelerating for takeoff from Los Angeles' Runway 25R when the crew rejected takeoff at high speed (about 140 knots over ground) due to a runway incursion. The aircraft slowed safely and returned to the apron. An Aerologic Boeing 7 7 7 200 freighter, registration Delta -Alpha Apha Lima Lima performing flight Aerologic 6 1 9 from Shanghai (China) to Los Angeles (USA), had just landed on Los Angeles's Runway 25L (on Sep 28th 2025 after crossing the date line) and was crossing Runway 25R near the end of the runway without authorization prompting the American Aiebus 3 2 1 to reject takeoff. The FAA reported: "AeroLogic Flight 6 1 9 crossed a runway at Los Angeles International Airport without authorization as American Airlines Flight 2 4 5 3 was taking off. Air traffic control instructed the American crew to cancel their takeoff. The event happened around 10: 35 p.m. local time on Sunday, Sept. 28. The closest proximity of the two aircraft was approximately 5,200 feet."
cards.audioTextZh: 因跑道侵入中断起飞。2025年9月28日，American Airlines的一架Airbus 321-200注册号为N110AN，执行American 2453航班，从Los Angeles飞往Boston（USA）。飞机正在Los Angeles机场25R跑道加速起飞时，机组因跑道侵入在高速状态下中断起飞，当时地速约为140节。飞机安全减速并返回停机坪。Aerologic的一架Boeing 777-200货机注册号为D-AALL，执行Aerologic 619航班，从Shanghai（China）飞往Los Angeles（USA）。该机刚刚在Los Angeles机场25L跑道着陆，即跨越日期变更线后的2025年9月28日，随后未经许可在跑道末端附近穿越25R跑道，促使American的Airbus 321中断起飞。FAA报告称：“AeroLogic 619航班未经许可穿越Los Angeles International Airport的一条跑道，当时American Airlines 2453航班正在起飞。空中交通管制指示American机组取消起飞。该事件发生在9月28日星期日当地时间晚上10:35左右。两架航空器之间的最近距离约为5,200英尺。”

cards.audioText: landed below minimum fuel On October 3, 2025, a Malta Air Boeing 7 37 800 on behalf of Ryanair, registration niner Hotel-Quebec Bravo Delta performing flight Ryanair 3 4 1 8 from Pisa (Italy) to Prestwick (UK), was on final approach to Prestwick's Runway 20when the crew went around due to weather. The aircraft entered a hold, then attempted a second approach to Runway 20about 30 minutes after the go around, but again needed to go around. The aircraft again entered a hold, about 10 minutes after entering the hold the crew decided to divert to Edinburgh (UK) where the aircraft joined the final approach to Runway 24about one hour after the first go around but again went around. The aircraft subsequently diverted to Manchester (UK) where the aircraft landed on Runway 23R about 110 minutes after the first go around. On Oct 5th 2025, the Aviation Herald received information that the aircraft landed below minimum fuel with just 220 kilograms fuel (total, 100 kilograms in left and 120 kilogrames in right tank) remaining.
cards.audioTextZh: 着陆时燃油低于最低标准。2025年10月3日，Malta Air的一架Boeing 737-800代表Ryanair运营，注册号为9H-QBD，执行Ryanair 3418航班，从Pisa（Italy）飞往Prestwick（UK）。飞机正在对Prestwick机场20号跑道实施最后进近时，机组因天气原因复飞。飞机进入等待，并在复飞约30分钟后第二次尝试进近20号跑道，但又一次需要复飞。飞机再次进入等待。进入等待约10分钟后，机组决定备降Edinburgh（UK）。飞机在第一次复飞约一小时后加入Edinburgh机场24号跑道最后进近，但再次复飞。随后飞机备降Manchester（UK），并在第一次复飞约110分钟后降落在23R跑道。2025年10月5日，The Aviation Herald收到信息称，飞机着陆时燃油低于最低标准，仅剩220公斤燃油，其中左侧油箱100公斤、右侧油箱120公斤。

cards.audioText: On October 6, 2025, a Cityjet Canadair CRJ-900 on behalf of Scandinavian Airlines, registration Echo India-Hotel Sierra Echo performing flight Scandinavian1 6 8 4 from Milan Malpensa (Italy) to Copenhagen (Denmark) with 91 people on board, was enroute at FL3 4 0 about 20 nautical miles east of Zurich (Switzerland) when the crew declared Mayday, Mayday, Mayday reporting smoke in the cabin and requested an emergency descent. ATC cleared them to FL2 5 0 maintaining present heading at first. The aircraft subsequently positioned for an approach to Zurich's Runway 16and landed safely on that runway about 20 minutes after leaving FL3 4 0. The crew vacated the runway and stopped on the taxiway requested emergency service to check for any smoke visible on the outside of the aircraft. The crew advised that everything looked okay in the inside of the aircraft, and the aircraft taxied to the apron about 3 minutes later.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年10月6日，Cityjet的一架Canadair CRJ-900代表Scandinavian Airlines运营，注册号为EI-HSE，执行Scandinavian 1684航班，从Milan Malpensa（Italy）飞往Copenhagen（Denmark），机上共有91人。飞机在Zurich（Switzerland）以东约20海里处以FL340飞行时，机组宣布“Mayday，Mayday，Mayday”，报告客舱内有烟并请求紧急下降。空中交通管制最初许可飞机保持当前航向下降至FL250。随后，飞机重新定位进近Zurich机场16号跑道，并在离开FL340约20分钟后安全降落在该跑道。机组脱离跑道并停在滑行道上，请求紧急服务人员检查飞机外部是否能看到烟雾。机组表示飞机内部看起来一切正常，飞机约3分钟后滑行至停机坪。

cards.audioText: passenger battery thermal runaway On October 9, 2025, an All Nippon Airways Boeing 7 87-10, registration Juliett Alpha 9 8 1 Alpha performing flight all nippon 9 9 4 from Okinawa to Tokyo Haneda (Japan), was climbing out of Okinawa when a passenger's power bank placed in his carry on luggage under the seat in front of him began to emit smoke. Cabin crew extinguished the fire and secured the device. The flight crew continued the flight to Tokyo where the aircraft landed without further incident about 2 hours fifteen minutes after departure. The airline reported the Lithium Ion power bank of a passenger caught fire shortly after takeoff, cabin crew secured the device, the flight crew decided to continue to destination as the fire had been extinguished. Japan's Ministry of Transport reported a portable battery by a passenger caught fire at high altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 乘客电池热失控。2025年10月9日，All Nippon Airways的一架Boeing 787-10注册号为JA981A，执行All Nippon 994航班，从Okinawa飞往Tokyo Haneda（Japan）。飞机从Okinawa起飞爬升时，一名乘客放在随身行李中的充电宝开始冒烟，该行李位于其前方座椅下。客舱机组扑灭了火焰并妥善固定该设备。飞行机组继续飞往Tokyo，飞机在起飞约2小时15分钟后着陆，未再发生其他事件。航空公司报告称，一名乘客的锂离子充电宝在起飞后不久起火，客舱机组妥善固定了该设备；由于火已扑灭，飞行机组决定继续飞往目的地。Japan交通运输部门报告称，一名乘客的便携式电池在高空起火。

cards.audioText: toxic fumes on the aircraft On October 13, 2025, an American Airlines Airbus 3 21-200, registration November 5 8 7 Uniform Whiskey performing flight American 2 7 4 from Los Angeles to New York JFK (USA), was climbing out of Los Angeles' Runway 25R when the crew stopped the climb at 5000 feet requesting to return to Los Angeles, subsequently the crew donned their oxygen masks and advised ATC they had "toxic fumes on the aircraft". The aircraft returned to Los Angeles for a landing on Runway 25L without further incident about 15 minutes after departure. Seven passengers reported feeling sick and with bad taste in their mouths, they were assessed by medical stuff at the airport. Nobody was taken to a hospital.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机上出现有毒烟雾或异味。2025年10月13日，American Airlines的一架Airbus 321-200注册号为N587UW，执行American 274航班，从Los Angeles飞往New York JFK（USA）。飞机从Los Angeles机场25R跑道起飞爬升时，机组在5,000英尺停止爬升并请求返回Los Angeles。随后机组戴上氧气面罩，并告知空中交通管制，飞机上出现“有毒烟雾或异味”。飞机返回Los Angeles，并在起飞约15分钟后降落在25L跑道，未再发生其他事件。7名乘客报告感到不适且口中有难闻的味道，他们在机场接受了医务人员的评估。无人被送往医院。

cards.audioText: On October 18, 2025, an Air China Airbus 3 21-200, registration Bravo-8 5 8 3 performing flight Air China 1 3 9 from Hangzhou (China) to Seoul (South Korea), was enroute at FL3 3 0 over the East China Sea about 120 nautical miles east of Shanghai (China) when a passenger's Lithium Battery stored in the overhead locker overheated and burst ablaze. While cabin crew doused the fire and contained the device, flight crew turned the aircraft around to divert to Shanghai Pudong (China). The aircraft landed without further incident on Pudong's Runway 34L about 40 minutes later. No injuries are being reported. The airline reported a Lithium Battery spontaneously combusted within a passenger's luggage, the crew reacted according to procedures and secured the device. No injuries occurred, the aircraft diverted to Shanghai for an emergency landing. A replacement aircraft was provided. Several passengers reported the fire suddenly broke out and posted videos and photos on China's social networks.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年10月18日，Air China的一架Airbus 321-200注册号为B-8583，执行Air China 139航班，从Hangzhou（China）飞往Seoul（South Korea）。飞机在East China Sea上空、Shanghai（China）以东约120海里处以FL330飞行时，一名乘客存放在行李架内的锂电池过热并突然起火。客舱机组扑灭火焰并控制住该设备，同时飞行机组操纵飞机掉头备降Shanghai Pudong（China）。飞机约40分钟后降落在Pudong机场34L跑道，未再发生其他事件。没有人员受伤的报告。航空公司报告称，一块锂电池在乘客行李内自燃，机组按照程序作出反应并妥善固定该设备。没有人员受伤，飞机备降Shanghai并实施紧急着陆。航空公司提供了一架替代飞机。数名乘客报告称，火焰突然出现，并在China的社交网络上发布了视频和照片。

cards.audioText: runway incursion On October, 14, 2025, a DHL Aero Expreso Boeing 7 67-300, registration Hotel Papa-3 6 1 0 Delta Alpha Echo performing flight 1 5 5 8 from Buenos Aires Ezeiza (Argentina) to Santiago (Chile), was taxiing for departure from Runway 29, when the aircraft crossed the runway. An Avianca Airbus 3 20-200 Noe, registration Hotel Kilo-5 3 6 0 performing flight 1 1 1 from Medellin (Colombia) to Buenos Aires Ezeiza (Argentina), was on short final to Runway 29about 1.37 nautical miles before the runway threshold when the 7 67 crossed the hold short line, was about 0.77 nautical miles before the runway threshold when the 7 67 crossed the runway edge line, was about 0.53 nautical miles before the runway threshold when the 7 67 crossed the other runway edge line to exit the runway and was about 100 meters, 330 feet past the runway threshold when the 7 67 crossed the other hold short line and thus vacated the runway. Argentina's JST reported a runway incursion occurred when one aircraft was landing and the other one was taxiing for departure. The occurrence was rated a serious incident and is being investigated.
