cards.audioTextZh: 跑道侵入。2025年10月14日，DHL Aero Expreso的一架Boeing 767-300注册号为HP-3610DAE，执行1558号航班，从Buenos Aires Ezeiza（Argentina）飞往Santiago（Chile）。飞机正在滑行准备从29号跑道起飞时穿越了跑道。Avianca的一架Airbus 320-200 Noe注册号为HK-5360，执行111号航班，从Medellin（Colombia）飞往Buenos Aires Ezeiza（Argentina），正在对29号跑道实施短五边进近。当该机位于跑道入口前约1.37海里处时，Boeing 767越过跑道等待线；当该机位于跑道入口前约0.77海里处时，Boeing 767越过跑道边缘线；当该机位于跑道入口前约0.53海里处时，Boeing 767越过另一侧跑道边缘线驶出跑道；当该机位于跑道入口之后约100米，即330英尺处时，Boeing 767越过另一侧跑道等待线，从而完全脱离跑道。Argentina的JST报告称，一架航空器正在着陆、另一架正在滑行准备离场时发生了跑道侵入。该事件被定性为严重事故征候，目前正在调查。

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff due to bird strike On October 18, 2025, an E A T Leipzig Airbus 300-600 on behalf of Lufthansa, registration Delta Alpha Echo Alpha Bravo performing flight 6 7 3 1 from Amsterdam (Netherlands) to London Heathrow (UK), was accelerating for takeoff from Amsterdam's runway tree six Center when the crew rejected takeoff at high speed (about 100 knots over ground) due to a bird strike into the right hand engine. Tower reported seeing the right hand engine flame out. The crew requested emergency services to inspect the aircraft for damage, shut the right hand engine down for that inspection and subsequently returned to the apron on one engine.
cards.audioTextZh: 因鸟击中断起飞。2025年10月18日，EAT Leipzig的一架Airbus 300-600代表Lufthansa运营，注册号为DAEAB，执行6731号航班，从Amsterdam（Netherlands）飞往London Heathrow（UK）。飞机正在Amsterdam机场36C跑道加速起飞时，机组因右侧发动机遭鸟击而在高速状态下中断起飞，当时地速约为100节。塔台报告看到右侧发动机熄火。机组请求紧急服务人员检查飞机是否受损，关闭右侧发动机以便进行检查，随后使用一台发动机返回停机坪。

cards.audioText: problems with landing gear, overran runway on landing back On October 20, 2025, an AZAL Azerbaijan Airlines Airbus 3 20-200, registration 4 Kilo-Alpha Zulu 8 4 performing flight AZAL 20 from St. Petersburg (Russia) to Baku (Azerbaijan) with 155 people on board, was climbing out of St. Petersburg's Runway 28R when the crew stopped the climb at FL0 6 0 and entered a hold due to problems with the landing gear. The aircraft performed two low approaches to Runway 28R, then entered a hold for about one hour, then performed another low approach to Runway 28R and positioned for a full stop landing on Runway 28R. Upon landing the aircraft overran the end of the runway and came to a stop with all gear on soft ground past the runway around 100 meters, 330 feet past the runway end about 3 hours after departure. There were no injuries. The airline reported the crew decided to return to St. Petersburg due to a technical problem with the landing gear and burned off fuel. A replacement aircraft has been dispatched.
cards.audioTextZh: 起落架出现问题，返航着陆时冲出跑道。2025年10月20日，AZAL Azerbaijan Airlines的一架Airbus 320-200注册号为4K-AZ84，执行AZAL 20航班，从St. Petersburg（Russia）飞往Baku（Azerbaijan），机上共有155人。飞机从St. Petersburg机场28R跑道起飞爬升时，机组因起落架出现问题而在FL060停止爬升并进入等待。飞机对28R跑道实施了两次低空进近，随后进入等待约一小时，又对28R跑道实施了一次低空进近，之后对正28R跑道准备全停着陆。着陆后，飞机冲出跑道末端，并在跑道末端以外约100米，即330英尺处的松软地面上停下，所有起落架均位于松软地面；此时距起飞约3小时。无人受伤。航空公司报告称，机组因起落架技术问题决定返回St. Petersburg，并消耗了燃油。航空公司已派出一架替代飞机。

cards.audioText: engine failure on very short final On October 12, 2025, a Westjet Boeing 7 37-8 MAX, registration Charlie-Golf Foxtrot Juliet Mike performing flight Westjet 7 0 7 from Toronto to Vancouver (Canada) with 183 people on board, was on short final to Vancouver's Runway 08R descending between 700 and 300 feet AGL when the left hand engine (Leap) lost power, the aircraft on autopilot drifted to the left and the airspeed reduced by about 7 knots, the crew observed an engine fail and autothrottle caution light. The captain announced an engine failure, the crew elected to continue the landing. At that time the left engine stabilized again, the parameters returned to normal. The aircraft landed safely with both engines operating normally and taxied to the apron. The Canadian TSB reported maintenance performed numerous activities to troubleshoot the power loss. During a fuel nozzle check a loose B-nut was discovered which was retorqued. The fuel metering unit was also replaced.
cards.audioTextZh: 在极短五边进近时发动机失效。2025年10月12日，Westjet的一架Boeing 737-8 MAX注册号为C-GFJM，执行Westjet 707航班，从Toronto飞往Vancouver（Canada），机上共有183人。飞机正在对Vancouver机场08R跑道实施短五边进近，在离地700至300英尺之间下降时，左侧发动机（Leap）失去动力；处于自动驾驶状态的飞机向左偏移，空速降低约7节，机组观察到发动机失效和自动油门警告灯。机长宣布发动机失效，机组决定继续着陆。此时左侧发动机重新稳定，参数恢复正常。飞机在两台发动机均正常运转的情况下安全着陆，并滑行至停机坪。Canada运输安全委员会报告称，维修人员进行了多项工作以排查动力丧失问题。在检查燃油喷嘴时发现一个松动的B形螺母，并重新按规定扭矩拧紧。燃油计量组件也已更换。

cards.audioText: On October 24, 2025, an Air France Boeing 7 7 7-300, registration Foxtrot-Golf Zulu November Golf performing flight Air France 6 5 2 from Paris Charles de Gaulle (France) to Saint Denis (Reunion) with 312 passengers and 14 crew, was enroute at FL3 1 0 about 50 nautical miles southsoutheast of Zurich (Switzerland) when the crew declared PAN PAN reporting heat in the cabin and requested to return to Paris Charles de Gaulle. The crew subsequently decided to dump fuel on the way back and advised no further assistance was needed. Swiss ATC advised, that upon entering France they would need to declare emergency to be able to dump fuel over French territory, the crew thus upgraded to Mayday, Mayday. The aircraft landed safely on Charles de Gaulle's Runway 26R about 100 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年10月24日，Air France的一架Boeing 777-300注册号为F-GZNG，执行Air France 652航班，从Paris Charles de Gaulle（France）飞往Saint Denis（Reunion），机上有312名乘客和14名机组人员。飞机在Zurich（Switzerland）东南偏南约50海里处以FL310飞行时，机组宣布PAN PAN，报告客舱内发热，并请求返回Paris Charles de Gaulle。机组随后决定在返航途中放油，并表示不再需要其他协助。Switzerland空中交通管制告知机组，进入France后，如需在France领土上空放油，他们必须宣布紧急情况，因此机组将紧急状态升级为“Mayday，Mayday”。飞机在起飞约100分钟后安全降落在Charles de Gaulle机场26R跑道。

cards.audioText: On August 20, 2025, a Thai Airways Airbus 3 5 0 900, registration Hotel Sierra-Tango Hotel Yankee performing flight Thai Airway 9 2 5 from Munich (Germany) to Bangkok (Thailand), was enroute over Thailand when the aircraft encountered turbulence. The aircraft continued for a safe landing on Bangkok's Runway 19. Thailand's AIB reported the aircraft encountered turbulence while enroute resulting in 4 serious and 1 minor injury. The occurrence was rated an accident and is being investigated.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年8月20日，Thai Airways的一架Airbus 350-900注册号为HS-THY，执行Thai Airway 925航班，从Munich（Germany）飞往Bangkok（Thailand）。飞机在Thailand上空飞行时遭遇湍流，随后继续飞往Bangkok并安全降落在19号跑道。Thailand航空事故调查机构报告称，飞机在航路上遭遇湍流，造成4人重伤、1人轻伤。该事件被定性为事故，目前正在调查。

cards.audioText: inflight upset causes injuries On October 30, 2025, a Jetblue Airbus 3 20 200, registration November 6 0 5 Juliet Bravo performing flight Jetblue 1 2 3 0 from Cancun (Mexico) to Newark (USA), was enroute at FL3 5 0 about 70 nautical miles westsouthwest of Tampa (USA) when the aircraft experienced an inflight upset causing injuries to a number of people. The aircraft descended rapidly, briefly maintained about 20,000 feet and continued the descent for an approach to Tampa. The crew reported they had had flight control problems that caused at least three injuries, head injuries, on board. The aircraft landed on Tampa's Runway 01L about 20 minutes after leaving FL3 5 0. Jetblue reported the affected passengers were taken to hospitals, the others were checked by medical staff the airport. The aircraft is now being checked. A replacement aircraft continued the flight but needed to divert to La Guardia before reaching Newark.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中姿态异常造成人员受伤。2025年10月30日，Jetblue的一架Airbus 320-200注册号为N605JB，执行Jetblue 1230航班，从Cancun（Mexico）飞往Newark（USA）。飞机在Tampa（USA）西南偏西约70海里处以FL350飞行时发生飞行中姿态异常，造成多人受伤。飞机迅速下降，短暂保持约20,000英尺，随后继续下降并进近Tampa。机组报告称，飞机出现飞行操纵问题，造成机上至少3人受伤，伤情为头部受伤。飞机在离开FL350约20分钟后降落在Tampa机场01L跑道。Jetblue报告称，受影响的乘客被送往医院，其他人员由机场医务人员进行检查。目前正在检查该飞机。一架替代飞机继续执行该航班，但在抵达Newark前需要备降La Guardia。

cards.audioText: laptop hides away On October 15, 2025, a United Boeing 7 67 400, registration November 7 6 0 5 4 performing flight United 1 2 6 from Washington Dulles (USA) to Rome Fiumicino (Italy) with 216 people on board, was enroute at FL3 1 0 about 80 nautical miles southeast of Boston (USA) when the crew decided to return to Washington as a precaution, after a passenger's laptop had fallen behind a cabin wall and down a small gap leading to the (pressurized) cargo hold causing concerns that the Lithium Ion battery could suffer a thermal runaway. The aircraft landed safely on Washington's Runway 01R about 80 minutes after the decision to turn around. The airline reported maintenance personnel located and retrieved the laptop, the aircraft was able to depart again.
cards.audioTextZh: 笔记本电脑掉入隐蔽位置。2025年10月15日，United的一架Boeing 767-400注册号为N76054，执行United 126航班，从Washington Dulles（USA）飞往Rome Fiumicino（Italy），机上共有216人。飞机在Boston（USA）东南约80海里处以FL310飞行时，机组决定采取预防措施返回Washington。此前，一名乘客的笔记本电脑掉到客舱壁板后方，并沿着一处通往增压货舱的小缝隙落下，引发对其锂离子电池可能发生热失控的担忧。飞机在决定返航约80分钟后安全降落在Washington机场01R跑道。航空公司报告称，维修人员已找到并取回该笔记本电脑，飞机随后得以再次起飞。

cards.audioText: On November 3, 2025, a Ryanair Boeing 7 37-800, registration Echo India-Delta Papa Juliet performing flight Ryanair 2 6 8 2 from Milan Bergamo (Italy) to Cluj (Romania), was descending towards Cluj when the captain declared PAN PAN reporting the first officer had become incapacitated, subsequently the captain upgraded to Mayday. The aircraft landed safely on Cluj's Runway 25and stopped on the runway, where emergency services awaited the aircraft. The first officer, unconscious at that time, was taken to a hospital. About 50 minutes after landing the aircraft was towed to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年11月3日，Ryanair的一架Boeing 737-800注册号为EI-DPJ，执行Ryanair 2682航班，从Milan Bergamo（Italy）飞往Cluj（Romania）。飞机正在向Cluj下降时，机长宣布PAN PAN，报告副驾驶失能，随后将紧急状态升级为Mayday。飞机安全降落在Cluj机场25号跑道并停在跑道上，紧急服务人员已在那里等候。此时处于昏迷状态的副驾驶被送往医院。飞机在着陆约50分钟后被拖至停机坪。

cards.audioText: On August 24, 2025, an Iberia Airbus 3 20-200, registration Echo Charlie-Mike Delta Kilo performing flight Iberia 6 9 4 from Catania (Italy) to Madrid (Spain) with 146 passengers and 6 crew, was enroute at FL3 5 0 overflying Palma Mallorca (Spain) when the crew observed a weather balloon. The aircraft continued to Madrid for a safe landing. On Nov 4th 2025 Spain's CIAIAC reported the weather balloon passed approximately 200 meters (660 feet) to the right of the aircraft and about 30 meters(100 feet) above. The occurrence is being investigated.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年8月24日，Iberia的一架Airbus 320-200注册号为EC-MDK，执行Iberia 694航班，从Catania（Italy）飞往Madrid（Spain），机上有146名乘客和6名机组人员。飞机在飞越Palma Mallorca（Spain）时以FL350飞行，机组观察到一个气象气球。飞机继续飞往Madrid并安全着陆。2025年11月4日，Spain航空事故与事故征候调查委员会报告称，该气象气球从飞机右侧约200米，即660英尺处，以及飞机上方约30米，即100英尺处经过。该事件目前正在调查。

cards.audioText: On August 12, 2025, a Smartwings Boeing 7 37-800 on behalf of Eurowings, registration Oscar Kilo-Tango Sierra Foxtrot performing flight Eurowings 6 8 2 from Cologne (Germany) to Athens (Greece), was descending through FL2 6 0 towards Athens when the cabin altitude warning illuminated prompting the crew to don their oxygen masks and perform the related memory items. The cabin altitude could be controlled at 10,000 feet with the bleed valve fully closed. The aircraft continued for a safe landing on Athens' Runway 03R. Czechia's UZPLN reported a maintenance organisation was called in, which incorrectly released the aircraft back to flight under minimum equipment list requirements after disconnecting the cabin pressure control system. The maintenance engineer did not follow the fault isolation manual which indicated that the "LOW INFLATION/HIGH LEAKING" fault message does not indicate a fault in the digital cabin pressurization system.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年8月12日，Smartwings的一架Boeing 737-800代表Eurowings运营，注册号为OK-TSF，执行Eurowings 682航班，从Cologne（Germany）飞往Athens（Greece）。飞机正在向Athens下降并通过FL260时，客舱高度警告灯亮起，机组因此戴上氧气面罩并执行相关记忆项目。在引气活门完全关闭的情况下，客舱高度能够控制在10,000英尺。飞机继续飞行并安全降落在Athens机场03R跑道。Czechia航空事故调查机构报告称，一家维修机构受邀处理该问题；该机构断开客舱压力控制系统后，错误地依据最低设备清单要求放行飞机重新投入飞行。维修工程师没有遵循故障隔离手册；该手册指出，“LOW INFLATION/HIGH LEAKING”故障信息并不表示数字式客舱增压系统存在故障。

cards.audioText: On November 22, 2025, a Scoot Airbus 3 21, registration 9 Victor-November Charlie Juliet performing flight Scoot 9 3 9 from Hong Kong (China) to Singapore (Singapore), was descending towards Singapore when a passenger's power bank overheated and caught fire. Cabin crew used fire extinguishers and water to put the fire out and put the power bank into a safe container. The aircraft continued for a safe landing on Runway 20C. The airline reported a small fire from a passenger's power bank, which was promptly extinguished by cabin crew. Passengers reported there had been a strong burning odour in the cabin when the aircraft was about to land. Flight attendants were rushing through the aircraft with protective gloves, fire extinguishers and subsequently carried a bag towards the aft galley.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年11月22日，Scoot的一架Airbus 321注册号为9V-NCJ，执行Scoot 939航班，从Hong Kong（China）飞往Singapore（Singapore）。飞机正在向Singapore下降时，一名乘客的充电宝过热并起火。客舱机组使用灭火器和水将火扑灭，并把充电宝放入安全容器。飞机继续飞行并安全降落在20C跑道。航空公司报告称，一名乘客的充电宝引发小火，客舱机组迅速将其扑灭。乘客报告称，飞机即将着陆时，客舱内出现强烈的烧焦气味。乘务员戴着防护手套、拿着灭火器在客舱内快速行动，随后将一个袋子带往后厨房。

cards.audioText: On November 14, 2025, a Ryanair Boeing 7 37-8 MAX, registration Echo India-Hotel Golf Golf performing flight Ryanair 8 5 0 6 from London Stansted (UK) to Malaga (Spain) with 93 passengers and 5 crew, was on final approach to Malaga's Runway 12when the aircraft encountered windshear at about 840 feet AGL prompting the crew to initiate a go around. The aircraft initially settled in a climb to about 1900 feet MSL but then entered a descent reaching a rate of descent of up to 4100 fpm. The GPWS activated and initiated a "Pull UP! Pull Up! " The aircraft descended to about 890 feet at excessive speed then began to climb again. The crew subsequently positioned for another approach to Runway 12and landed without further incident.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年11月14日，Ryanair的一架Boeing 737-8 MAX注册号为EI-HGG，执行Ryanair 8506航班，从London Stansted（UK）飞往Malaga（Spain），机上有93名乘客和5名机组人员。飞机正在对Malaga机场12号跑道实施最后进近时，在离地约840英尺处遭遇风切变，促使机组开始复飞。飞机最初稳定爬升至平均海平面以上约1,900英尺，但随后转为下降，下降率最高达到每分钟4,100英尺。近地警告系统启动并发出“Pull Up！Pull Up！”警告。飞机以过高速度下降至约890英尺，随后再次开始爬升。机组之后重新定位，对12号跑道实施另一次进近，并顺利着陆。

cards.audioText: On December 4, 2025, a United Boeing 7 7 7 200, registration November 7 4 0 0 7 performing flight United 9 4 9 from London Heathrow (UK) to San Francisco (USA) with 162 passengers and 12 crew, was enroute at FL3 4 0 over the Atlantic Ocean about 360 nautical miles northwest of Edinburgh (UK) when the crew decided to turn around and divert to Edinburgh due to a burning odour on board. The aircraft landed safely on Edinburgh's Runway 06about one hour after turning around. The airline reported the aircraft diverted to Edinburgh due to a burning smell on board, the passengers were taken to hotels and rebooked onto other flights.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年12月4日，United的一架Boeing 777-200注册号为N74007，执行United 949航班，从London Heathrow（UK）飞往San Francisco（USA），机上有162名乘客和12名机组人员。飞机在Atlantic Ocean上空、Edinburgh（UK）西北约360海里处以FL340飞行时，机组因机上出现烧焦气味而决定掉头并备降Edinburgh。飞机在掉头约一小时后安全降落在Edinburgh机场06号跑道。航空公司报告称，飞机因机上出现烧焦气味备降Edinburgh，乘客被安排入住酒店并改签至其他航班。

cards.audioText: cabin pressurization problems On December 19, 2025, a Pakistan International Airlines Boeing 7 7 7-300, registration Alpha Papa-Bravo Mike Sierra performing flight Pakistan 8 6 0 from Jeddah (Saudi Arabia) to Lahore (Pakistan) with 381 people on board, was enroute at FL3 5 0 about 200 nautical miles south of Dammam (Saudi Arabia) when the crew initiated a rapid descent to FL1 0 0 (descending through FL2 0 0 about 5 minutes later), the passenger oxygen masks deployed. The aircraft turned north and diverted to Dammam for a safe landing on Runway 34R about 85 minutes after leaving FL3 5 0. The airline reported a technical issue. Passengers reported the oxygen masks deployed in the cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱增压问题。2025年12月19日，Pakistan International Airlines的一架Boeing 777-300注册号为AP-BMS，执行Pakistan 860航班，从Jeddah（Saudi Arabia）飞往Lahore（Pakistan），机上共有381人。飞机在Dammam（Saudi Arabia）以南约200海里处以FL350飞行时，机组开始快速下降至FL100；约5分钟后，飞机正在下降通过FL200，乘客氧气面罩已释放。飞机转向北方并备降Dammam，在离开FL350约85分钟后安全降落在34R跑道。航空公司报告称飞机出现技术问题。乘客报告称，客舱内的氧气面罩已经释放。

cards.audioText: On January 27, 2026, a Southwest Airlines Boeing 7 37 8 MAX, registration November 8 5 6 3 Zulu performing flight Southwest 4 9 9 6 from San Antonio to Dallas Love (USA), was accelerating for takeoff from San Antonio's Runway 22when tower called out a swear word and instructed the flight to cancel takeoff clearance as well as an aircraft on final approach to go around after seeing a private light aircraft entering the runway. The aircraft rejected takeoff at about 90 knots over ground and stopped safely. The Southwest Boeing stopped on the runway, held position, vacated the runway and returned to the hold short line of Runway 22. The aircraft, that had been delayed by about 80 minutes for first attempt of departure, departed about 40 minutes after the rejected takeoff and reached Dallas with a delay of 2 hours.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年1月27日，Southwest Airlines的一架Boeing 737-8 MAX注册号为N8563Z，执行Southwest 4996航班，从San Antonio飞往Dallas Love（USA）。飞机正在San Antonio机场22号跑道加速起飞时，塔台在看到一架私人轻型航空器进入跑道后喊出一句脏话，并指示该航班取消起飞许可，同时指示一架正在最后进近的航空器复飞。飞机在地速约90节时中断起飞并安全停下。这架Southwest Boeing停在跑道上，原地等待，随后脱离跑道并返回22号跑道等待线。该机在第一次尝试离场前已经延误约80分钟，又在中断起飞约40分钟后起飞，最终抵达Dallas时延误2小时。

cards.audioText: spoiler extended uncommandedly On December 31, 2025, an Atlas Air Boeing 7 67-300, registration November 6 4 0 Golf Tango performing flight 8 7 1 3 from Frankfurt Hahn (Germany) to Seattle, (USA), was enroute at FL3 5 0 over southern Greenland when a left outboard spoiler extended fully and uncommandedly resulting in roll. The captain disconnected the autopilot, corrected the bank angle manually, declared Mayday and diverted to Keflavik (Iceland) where the aircraft landed safely about 2 hours later. The Canadian TSB reported the aircraft reached a maximum bank angle of 18.63 degrees before recovery. The spoiler remained extended until the aircraft descended through FL1 9 0, then retracted. The TSB stated: "Maintenance replaced the #2 spoiler power control actuator and the 1 L spoiler control module, with operational and leak checks satisfactory."
cards.audioTextZh: 扰流板未经指令伸出。2025年12月31日，Atlas Air的一架Boeing 767-300注册号为N640GT，执行8713号航班，从Frankfurt Hahn（Germany）飞往Seattle（USA）。飞机在Greenland南部上空以FL350飞行时，左侧外侧扰流板未经指令完全伸出，导致飞机滚转。机长断开自动驾驶，手动修正坡度角，宣布Mayday并备降Keflavik（Iceland），飞机约2小时后安全着陆。Canada运输安全委员会报告称，飞机在恢复前达到的最大坡度角为18.63度。该扰流板一直保持伸出，直至飞机下降通过FL190后才收回。运输安全委员会表示：“维修人员更换了2号扰流板动力控制作动器和1L扰流板控制模块，操作检查和渗漏检查结果均令人满意。”

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff due to runway incursion On February 20, 2026, a LATAM Chile Airbus 3 20 200, registration Charlie Charlie-Charlie Oscar Foxtrot performing flight 4 2 7 8 from Bogota to San Andres Island (Colombia) with 157 people on board, was accelerating for takeoff from Bogota's Runway 14R when the crew rejected takeoff at very high speed (about 160 knots over ground) due to a military helicopter crossing the runway at low height. The aircraft slowed safely and vacated the runway onto the parallel taxiway, where the tyres deflated due to the hot brakes. There were no injuries. Aerocivil Colombia reported the military helicopter was just departing when it crossed about midway of the Runway 14R prompting the crew of the Airbus 3 20 to reject takeoff. The occurrence is being investigated. According to tower tapes it appears both aircraft had been cleared for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 因跑道侵入中断起飞。2026年2月20日，LATAM Chile的一架Airbus 320-200注册号为CC-COF，执行4278号航班，从Bogota飞往San Andres Island（Colombia），机上共有157人。飞机正在Bogota机场14R跑道加速起飞时，因一架军用直升机在低高度穿越跑道，机组在极高速度下中断起飞，当时地速约为160节。飞机安全减速并脱离跑道进入平行滑行道；轮胎因刹车过热而泄气。无人受伤。Colombia民航局报告称，这架军用直升机刚刚起飞，在14R跑道约中部位置穿越跑道，促使Airbus 320机组中断起飞。该事件目前正在调查。根据塔台录音，两架航空器似乎都已获得起飞许可。

cards.audioText: power bank's thermal runaway On February 22, 2026, a Horizon Air Embraer ERJ-1 7 5 on behalf of Alaska Air, registration November 6 4 1 Quebec X-ray performing flight Alaska 2 1 1 7 from Wichita to Seattle (USA), was climbing out of Wichita when the crew stopped the climb at FL2 0 0 after the power bank of a passenger suffered a thermal runaway and caught fire. While cabin crew doused and secured the device, the flight crew returned the aircraft to Wichita for a safe landing on Runway 01L about 40 minutes after departure. The owner of the power bank was taken to a hospital with minor burns.
cards.audioTextZh: 充电宝发生热失控。2026年2月22日，Horizon Air的一架Embraer ERJ-175代表Alaska Air运营，注册号为N641QX，执行Alaska 2117航班，从Wichita飞往Seattle（USA）。飞机从Wichita起飞爬升时，一名乘客的充电宝发生热失控并起火，机组因此在FL200停止爬升。客舱机组在用水浇淋并妥善固定该设备的同时，飞行机组操纵飞机返回Wichita，并在起飞约40分钟后安全降落在01L跑道。充电宝的所有者因轻微烧伤被送往医院。

cards.audioText: bird strike results in engine fire On January 28, 2026, an Amazon Prime Air Airbus 3 30 300, registration November 5 8 2 7 Kilo performing flight 2 6 1 6 from Cincinnati to Houston Intercontinental (USA) with 2 crew, was departing Covington's Runway 27when the left hand engine ingested a number of birds. The aircraft stopped the climb at 3000 feet, the crew donned their oxygen masks reporting smoke in the cockpit, and returned to Cincinnati for a safe landing on Runway 36R about 10 minutes after departure. After landing the crew advised they needed a ladder to the 1 Romeo door as they had an engine fire on the left hand side and wanted the #1 engine checked for fire.
cards.audioTextZh: 鸟击导致发动机起火。2026年1月28日，Amazon Prime Air的一架Airbus 330-300注册号为N5827K，执行2616号航班，从Cincinnati飞往Houston Intercontinental（USA），机上有2名机组人员。飞机从Covington机场27号跑道起飞时，左侧发动机吸入多只鸟。飞机在3,000英尺停止爬升；机组戴上氧气面罩，报告驾驶舱内有烟，并返回Cincinnati，在起飞约10分钟后安全降落在36R跑道。着陆后，机组告知他们需要一架梯子到1R舱门，因为左侧发生了发动机火警，他们希望检查1号发动机是否起火。

cards.audioText: On May 8, 2026, Frontier Airlines Flight 43 45, an Airbus 3 21 neo with 231 people aboard, was preparing for takeoff from Denver International Airport bound for Los Angeles. At 2 3 1 9 local time, during the high-speed takeoff roll on Runway 17L, the aircraft struck a pedestrian who had illegally entered the airfield. The victim was partially ingested into the left engine, causing an immediate fire and smoke in the cabin. The captain swiftly aborted the takeoff and informed ATC: "We just hit a person... engine fire." Airport fire crews arrived within two minutes and extinguished the blaze. All passengers and crew evacuated via emergency slides; 12 sustained minor injuries. Investigations revealed the individual had climbed over the perimeter fence just two minutes prior. The F A A and NTSB launched a full probe into security breaches.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年5月8日，Frontier Airlines 4345航班使用一架Airbus 321neo执飞，机上共有231人，正准备从Denver International Airport起飞前往Los Angeles。当地时间23:19，飞机正在17L跑道高速滑跑起飞时，撞到一名非法进入机场飞行区的行人。该人员的一部分被吸入左侧发动机，随即引发火灾并导致客舱内出现烟雾。机长迅速中断起飞，并通知空中交通管制：“我们刚刚撞到一个人……发动机起火。”机场消防人员在两分钟内抵达并将火扑灭。所有乘客和机组人员均通过应急滑梯撤离，其中12人受轻伤。调查发现，该人员在事件发生仅两分钟前翻越了机场周界围栏。FAA和NTSB已对安保漏洞展开全面调查。

cards.audioText: United Airlines Flight 1 69, a Boeing 7 67 operating from Venice to Newark, encountered a bizarre incident on May 3, 2026. On final approach to Runway 29, the aircraft descended below the glide path. The landing gear and fuselage struck several highway light poles and a semi-truck on the New Jersey Turnpike directly beneath the approach path. Shockingly, the crew and 231 passengers remained completely unaware of the collision. The jet landed safely and taxied to the gate normally. Ground control later notified the pilots of the incident. The truck driver suffered minor cuts from broken glass. The aircraft sustained structural damage to the fuselage and landing gear. The NTSB is investigating pilot awareness, auto-pilot discrepancies, and airport approach zone safety barriers.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年5月3日，United Airlines 169航班使用一架Boeing 767执飞，从Venice飞往Newark，期间发生了一起离奇事件。飞机正在对29号跑道实施最后进近时下降至下滑道以下。起落架和机身撞上了进近航径正下方New Jersey Turnpike公路上的数根路灯杆和一辆半挂卡车。令人震惊的是，机组和231名乘客完全没有意识到发生了碰撞。飞机安全着陆并正常滑行至登机口。地面管制随后将该事件通知飞行员。卡车司机被碎玻璃轻微割伤。飞机机身和起落架受到结构性损伤。NTSB正在调查飞行员的察觉情况、自动驾驶系统异常以及机场进近区安全屏障。

cards.audioText: A Cessna 1 7 2 training flight crashed in Florida on March 23, 2026, resulting in two fatalities. The flight, with a student pilot and instructor onboard, departed from North Perry Airport for a routine navigation exercise. Approximately 25 minutes into the flight, over Boynton Beach, the aircraft experienced a catastrophic failure of the flight control system. Witnesses reported the plane spiraled steeply before impacting a residential neighborhood. The NTSB preliminary report ruled out engine failure, focusing on a faulty elevator control mechanism. No one on the ground was injured. The aircraft was destroyed on impact. This crash highlighted ongoing concerns about aging general aviation aircraft and maintenance oversight. The flight school temporarily suspended operations pending a full safety review.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年3月23日，一架Cessna 172训练飞机在Florida坠毁，造成2人死亡。机上有一名学员飞行员和一名教员，飞机从North Perry Airport起飞，执行常规导航训练。飞行约25分钟后，飞机在Boynton Beach上空的飞行操纵系统发生灾难性故障。目击者报告称，飞机以大坡度螺旋下降，随后撞入一处居民区。NTSB初步报告排除了发动机故障，调查重点为升降舵操纵机构故障。地面无人受伤。飞机在撞击中完全损毁。这起坠机事故凸显了人们对老旧通用航空器和维修监管的持续担忧。该航校暂停运营，等待完成全面安全审查。

cards.audioText: On March 22, 2026, Jazz Air Flight 86 46, a C R J-900 operating for Air Canada Express, collided with a fire truck at New York's LaGuardia Airport. The accident occurred at 2 3: 3 7 as the flight landed on Runway 04. An airport fire department vehicle was crossing the runway in response to a separate, false alarm when it was struck by the jet's right wing. The impact severed the truck's cab; two firefighters were killed. The aircraft suffered substantial wing damage but remained controllable. The captain and first officer died in the accident, 9 passengers received serious injuries, 32 passengers received minor injuries. The NTSB found the fire crew had misheard ATC clearance and entered the active runway without authorization. This tragedy emphasized critical breakdowns in radio communication and situational awareness.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年3月22日，Jazz Air 8646航班使用一架CRJ-900代表Air Canada Express运营，在New York的LaGuardia Airport与一辆消防车相撞。事故发生于23:37，当时该航班正在04号跑道着陆。一辆机场消防部门车辆正在穿越跑道，以响应另一起误报，随后被飞机右翼撞击。撞击切断了消防车驾驶室，2名消防员死亡。飞机机翼受到严重损伤，但仍可操纵。机长和副驾驶在事故中死亡，9名乘客重伤，32名乘客轻伤。NTSB发现，消防人员误听了空中交通管制许可，未经授权进入正在使用的跑道。这起悲剧凸显了无线电通信和情景意识方面的严重失效。

cards.audioText: A tragic military aviation accident occurred on March 23, 2026, when a Lockheed C 1 3 0 Echo Hercules transport plane crashed in Colombia. The aircraft, carrying 69 military personnel and supplies, was on a routine supply mission to a remote outpost. During final approach in heavy rain and low visibility, the plane struck a mountain ridge shortly before landing. All aboard perished. The Colombian Air Force attributed the crash to controlled flight into terrain, likely caused by a combination of severe weather and inaccurate navigation data. Rescue efforts were hampered by the remote location and adverse weather. This crash stands as the deadliest aviation accident of 2026. Investigations continue regarding possible equipment malfunctions and crew resource management.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年3月23日发生了一起悲惨的军用航空事故，一架Lockheed C-130E Hercules运输机在Colombia坠毁。该机载有69名军事人员和补给物资，正在执行向一个偏远前哨运送补给的常规任务。飞机在大雨和低能见度条件下实施最后进近时，于着陆前不久撞上山脊。机上所有人员全部遇难。Colombia空军将这起坠机事故归因于可控飞行撞地，可能由恶劣天气和不准确导航数据共同造成。偏远的位置和恶劣天气阻碍了救援工作。这起坠机事故是2026年死亡人数最多的航空事故。有关可能存在的设备故障和机组资源管理问题仍在调查中。

cards.audioText: On May 2, 2026, China Eastern 5 4 0 6, an Airbus 3 5 0, experienced a ground incident after landing at Shanghai Pudong International Airport. During taxiing to the gate, the aircraft's left wing struck a passenger boarding bridge multiple times. Initial investigations pointed to a sudden mechanical failure in the nose wheel steering system, causing the pilot to lose directional control. Despite the impact, the crew maintained composure, deployed emergency slides, and safely evacuated all 320 passengers without injury. The wing sustained significant structural damage. This incident highlighted the risks during ground operations and the value of modern aircraft safety systems. C A A C has ordered enhanced maintenance checks for Airbus 3 5 0 steering components.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年5月2日，China Eastern 5406航班使用一架Airbus 350执飞，在Shanghai Pudong International Airport着陆后发生地面事件。飞机滑行前往登机口期间，左翼多次撞到一座旅客登机桥。初步调查指向前轮转向系统突然发生机械故障，导致飞行员失去方向控制。尽管发生撞击，机组仍保持镇定，放出应急滑梯，并将全部320名乘客安全撤离，无人受伤。机翼受到严重结构性损伤。该事件凸显了地面运行期间的风险以及现代航空器安全系统的价值。CAAC已要求加强对Airbus 350转向部件的维修检查。

cards.audioText: An Airbus 2 2 0 operated by Swiss International Airlines faced a critical in-flight emergency on May 9, 2026, en route to Zurich. While cruising at 37,000 feet, the aircraft's air data computer system failed completely. This caused erroneous readings on all cockpit displays, including airspeed and altitude. The crew immediately declared an emergency and initiated a rapid descent. With unreliable flight data, pilots relied on backup instruments and basic pitch-and-power settings. The aircraft diverted to Geneva Airport, where it performed a manual visual approach and landed safely. There were 132 passengers onboard; no injuries were reported. Investigators suspect a software glitch caused the dual failure of the redundant systems.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年5月9日，Swiss International Airlines运营的一架Airbus 220在飞往Zurich途中遭遇严重的飞行中紧急情况。飞机在37,000英尺巡航时，空中数据计算机系统完全失效，导致驾驶舱所有显示器均出现错误读数，包括空速和高度。机组立即宣布紧急情况并开始快速下降。由于飞行数据不可靠，飞行员依靠备用仪表以及基本的姿态和推力设置操纵飞机。飞机备降Geneva Airport，以手动目视进近方式安全着陆。机上有132名乘客，无人员受伤报告。调查人员怀疑，一个软件故障导致两套冗余系统同时失效。

cards.audioText: On February 10, 2026, a domestic flight in Somalia, operated by a Fokker 50 with 55 people, suffered a runway excursion upon landing at Mogadishu International Airport. After experiencing a technical fault shortly after takeoff, the crew decided to return immediately. However, upon landing, the aircraft's braking system failed to function properly. The plane overran the runway end and slid into the adjacent beach, partially submerging the fuselage in the Indian Ocean. Remarkably, all passengers and crew survived without serious injury. The evacuation was completed quickly as the aircraft began to sink. The Somali Civil Aviation Authority is investigating maintenance records and possible water contamination in the brake hydraulic system.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年2月10日，Somalia一架由Fokker 50执飞、机上共有55人的国内航班，在Mogadishu International Airport着陆时冲出跑道。飞机起飞后不久发生技术故障，机组决定立即返航。然而着陆时，飞机的刹车系统未能正常工作。飞机冲出跑道末端并滑入旁边的海滩，机身部分浸入Indian Ocean。值得庆幸的是，所有乘客和机组人员均幸存，没有人严重受伤。飞机开始下沉时，人员迅速完成撤离。Somalia民航局正在调查维修记录，以及刹车液压系统可能受到水污染的问题。

cards.audioText: A Lufthansa Airbus 3 2 1 neo encountered an engine fire indication on May 11, 2026, during climb-out from Athens International Airport. Immediately after takeoff, the crew received a fire warning for the left engine. Following standard procedures, they activated the fire suppression system, shut down the engine, and declared a emergency. The aircraft, carrying 189 passengers, dumped fuel to reduce weight before returning for a single-engine landing. Fire vehicles inspected the plane on the runway; no actual fire was found. The incident was later determined to be a false warning caused by a faulty sensor in the engine exhaust nozzle. This event demonstrated effective crew resource management and adherence to emergency checklists.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年5月11日，Lufthansa的一架Airbus 321neo从Athens International Airport起飞爬升时出现发动机火警指示。起飞后不久，机组收到左侧发动机火警。机组按照标准程序启动灭火系统、关闭发动机并宣布紧急情况。飞机载有189名乘客，在返回实施单发着陆前放油以减轻重量。消防车辆在跑道上检查飞机，没有发现实际火情。该事件后来被确定为一起虚假警告，原因是发动机排气喷口内的一个传感器出现故障。该事件体现了有效的机组资源管理以及对紧急检查单的遵守。

cards.audioText: On April 27, 2026, a serious near-miss occurred over Southern California involving a United Airlines Boeing 7 87 and a U.S. Army Black Hawk helicopter. The airliner, descending into Los Angeles International Airport, came within 150 meters vertically of the military helicopter. The incident happened in restricted airspace near San Bernardino. The 7 87's TCAS alerted the crew, prompting an immediate climb maneuver. The helicopter pilot also took evasive action. No collision occurred, and both aircraft landed safely. The F A A investigation revealed the helicopter had strayed from its assigned route due to a navigational error. This close call underscored the risks of mixed airspace usage and the critical importance of TCAS in preventing mid-air collisions.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年4月27日，Southern California上空发生了一起严重的危险接近事件，涉及United Airlines的一架Boeing 787和U.S. Army的一架Black Hawk直升机。客机正在向Los Angeles International Airport下降时，与军用直升机之间的垂直间隔一度仅有150米。该事件发生在San Bernardino附近的限制空域内。Boeing 787的TCAS向机组发出警报，促使机组立即实施爬升机动。直升机飞行员也采取了规避动作。两机没有相撞，随后均安全着陆。FAA调查发现，直升机因导航错误偏离了指定航线。这次危险接近凸显了混合使用空域的风险，以及TCAS在防止空中相撞方面的关键重要性。

cards.audioText: In early January 2026, a regional Embraer 190 flight with 98 passengers and four crew departed Bangkok for Chiang Mai. While cruising at FL3 1 0, the aircraft suddenly suffered severe turbulence without prior ATC weather alerts. Unfastened passengers and cabin crew were thrown violently inside the cabin; seven people sustained minor bruises and sprains. The captain promptly requested immediate descent and deviation around the storm cell. After stabilizing the aircraft, the crew decided to divert to Lampang Airport for medical checks. Ground medical teams waited at the terminal to assist injured passengers. Aviation authorities later reviewed real-time weather sharing loopholes between regional airports and en route control centers, urging upgraded turbulence early warning systems for all commercial fleets.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年1月初，一架载有98名乘客和4名机组人员的支线Embraer 190航班从Bangkok起飞前往Chiang Mai。飞机在FL310巡航时，在空中交通管制此前未提供天气警报的情况下突然遭遇严重湍流。未系安全带的乘客和客舱机组人员在客舱内被猛烈抛起，7人受到轻微挫伤和扭伤。机长立即请求马上下降并绕飞雷暴单体。飞机状态稳定后，机组决定备降Lampang Airport，以便进行医疗检查。地面医疗团队在航站楼等候，为受伤乘客提供协助。航空主管部门随后审查了支线机场与航路管制中心之间实时天气信息共享存在的漏洞，并敦促所有商业机队升级湍流预警系统。

cards.audioText: On February 14, 2026, a private Piper P A 28 training aircraft crashed shortly after takeoff from a small general aviation airfield in southern Australia. The plane carried one flight instructor and one student pilot practicing circuit training. Witnesses saw the engine sputter repeatedly before the aircraft banked sharply and crashed into a grassy field nearby. Both occupants survived with non-life-threatening injuries. Investigators found contaminated aviation fuel caused engine power loss during climb. The local aviation authority ordered all nearby airfields to conduct full fuel tank inspections and strengthen fuel quality supervision for flight schools. All similar single-engine training aircraft were required to complete extra engine system checks within one week.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年2月14日，一架私人Piper PA-28训练飞机从Australia南部一座小型通用航空机场起飞后不久坠毁。机上有一名飞行教员和一名正在进行起落航线训练的学员飞行员。目击者看到发动机反复运转不稳，随后飞机突然大坡度转弯并坠落在附近一片草地上。机上两人均幸存，所受伤势不危及生命。调查人员发现，受污染的航空燃油导致发动机在爬升期间失去动力。当地航空主管部门要求附近所有机场对油箱进行全面检查，并加强对航校的燃油质量监管。所有同类单发训练飞机都必须在一周内完成额外的发动机系统检查。

cards.audioText: On March 5, 2026, a large cargo Boeing 7 47 freighter experienced a nose gear malfunction while taxiing for departure at Dubai International Airport. The nose wheel failed to steer normally, leaving the aircraft stranded on the taxiway and blocking ground traffic. Airport staff towed the jet back to the maintenance apron after all cargo crew disembarked safely. No injuries were reported, but the incident delayed six departing flights. Maintenance teams confirmed a broken hydraulic valve caused the steering failure. Aviation regulators issued a service bulletin for all Boeing 7 47 operators to inspect nose gear hydraulic components regularly. The airport also adjusted taxiway emergency response procedures to reduce traffic disruption during similar ground incidents.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年3月5日，一架大型Boeing 747货机在Dubai International Airport滑行准备离场时发生前起落架故障。前轮无法正常转向，导致飞机滞留在滑行道上并阻塞地面交通。所有货机机组人员安全下机后，机场工作人员将飞机拖回维修机坪。无人受伤，但该事件造成6个离场航班延误。维修团队确认，一个损坏的液压活门导致转向失效。航空监管机构向所有Boeing 747运营人发布服务通告，要求定期检查前起落架液压部件。机场还调整了滑行道应急响应程序，以减少类似地面事件对交通的影响。

cards.audioText: On March 28, 2026, an Airbus 3 20 passenger flight encountered a bird strike during takeoff roll at a European coastal airport. A flock of large seabirds hit the right engine, causing loud abnormal noise and visible smoke. The captain followed standard procedures to reject takeoff immediately and evacuated all 167 passengers via emergency slides. Three passengers suffered minor injuries during evacuation. Fire crews inspected the engine and confirmed internal blade damage. Aviation investigators suggested adjusting runway bird deterrent schedules to match seasonal migration patterns. The airport added more radar bird monitoring equipment and increased patrols along the runway perimeter to prevent future bird strike accidents.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年3月28日，一架Airbus 320客机在欧洲一座沿海机场滑跑起飞时遭遇鸟击。一群大型海鸟撞击右侧发动机，导致巨大的异常噪声和可见烟雾。机长按照标准程序立即中断起飞，并通过应急滑梯撤离全部167名乘客。3名乘客在撤离期间受轻伤。消防人员检查发动机并确认内部叶片受损。航空调查人员建议根据季节性迁徙规律调整跑道驱鸟作业时间。机场增设了雷达鸟情监测设备，并加强跑道周界巡逻，以防止今后发生鸟击事故。

cards.audioText: On April 12, 2026, a low-cost airline Boeing 7 37 MAX flight made an emergency landing due to sudden cabin pressure failure halfway across a continental route. At cruising altitude, cabin pressure dropped rapidly, triggering oxygen mask deployment automatically. The crew initiated an emergency descent to a safe low altitude and contacted ATC for priority landing at the nearest alternate airport. All 174 passengers remained calm following crew instructions, with no fatalities or serious injuries. Technical inspection revealed a faulty seal on the rear pressure bulkhead caused slow air leakage. Civil aviation authorities ordered all same-model aircraft to undergo urgent pressure system inspections and revised routine maintenance checklists for cabin pressurization parts.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年4月12日，一家低成本航空公司的一架Boeing 737 MAX在飞越一条大陆航线的中途因客舱压力突然失效而紧急着陆。飞机在巡航高度时客舱压力迅速下降，氧气面罩自动释放。机组开始紧急下降至安全低高度，并联系空中交通管制，请求优先降落在最近的备降机场。全部174名乘客按照机组指示保持镇定，没有人员死亡或严重受伤。技术检查发现，后压力舱壁上的一个密封件发生故障，导致空气缓慢泄漏。民航主管部门要求所有同型号飞机紧急检查增压系统，并修订涉及客舱增压部件的例行维修检查单。

cards.audioText: On May 6, 2026, an international wide-body Airbus 3 30 flight suffered a minor runway excursion after landing at a South American airport. Heavy seasonal rain made the runway surface slippery, and the aircraft could not stop within the normal distance, sliding off the runway edge onto soft grass. The fuselage remained intact, and all 286 passengers and 11 crew evacuated safely without injuries. Airport investigators confirmed insufficient runway friction treatment after heavy rain was the main cause. The airport upgraded runway drainage systems and added anti-slip pavement layers. Regulators also reminded pilots to adjust landing speed and use full reverse thrust timely when landing on wet runways in rainy weather.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年5月6日，一架执行国际航班的Airbus 330宽体飞机在South America一座机场着陆后轻微冲出跑道。季节性大雨使跑道表面湿滑，飞机未能在正常距离内停下，滑出跑道边缘并进入松软草地。机身保持完整，全部286名乘客和11名机组人员均安全撤离，无人受伤。机场调查人员确认，大雨过后跑道摩擦力处置不足是主要原因。机场升级了跑道排水系统并增设防滑路面层。监管机构还提醒飞行员，在雨天湿跑道着陆时应调整着陆速度，并及时使用全反推。

cards.audioText: On June 2, 2026, a cargo turboprop aircraft overshot the runway during landing at a remote island airport in the Pacific. The pilot encountered sudden crosswind during final approach and failed to stabilize the landing path. The aircraft ran past the runway end and stopped on sandy coastal ground, avoiding falling into the sea. The two pilots on board were uninjured, but the aircraft sustained minor fuselage and landing gear damage. Investigators pointed to inadequate crosswind landing training and late adjustment of flight attitude. Local aviation training centers added more simulated crosswind landing sessions and updated operational guidelines for small island airports with complex wind conditions.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年6月2日，一架涡轮螺旋桨货机在Pacific一座偏远岛屿机场着陆时冲出跑道。飞行员在最后进近期间突遇侧风，未能稳定着陆航迹。飞机越过跑道末端并停在沿海沙地上，避免了坠入海中。机上2名飞行员均未受伤，但飞机机身和起落架轻微受损。调查人员指出，侧风着陆训练不足以及对飞行姿态调整过晚是相关因素。当地航空训练中心增加了更多模拟侧风着陆训练，并更新了针对风况复杂的小型岛屿机场的运行指南。

cards.audioText: On June 12, 2025, Air India Flight 1 7 1, a Boeing 7 87 8, departed Ahmedabad for London. Moments after liftoff, both engines lost power abruptly. The crew radioed "Mayday, Mayday, Mayday" reporting total thrust loss and inability to maintain altitude. Investigations later revealed both engine fuel switches had closed simultaneously for unknown reasons. The aircraft stalled and crashed into a residential area. All 241 people on board and 38 on the ground perished. It marked the first fatal crash of a Boeing 7 87. Cockpit voice recordings showed crew confusion: "Why did you shut off fuel? " "I didn't touch anything." The final report pointed to uncommanded fuel valve closure, with no mechanical defects found.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年6月12日，Air India 171航班使用一架Boeing 787-8执飞，从Ahmedabad起飞前往London。飞机离地片刻后，两台发动机突然同时失去动力。机组通过无线电呼叫“Mayday，Mayday，Mayday”，报告推力完全丧失且无法保持高度。后续调查显示，两台发动机的燃油开关因未知原因同时关闭。飞机失速并坠入一处居民区。机上全部241人和地面38人遇难。这是Boeing 787发生的首起致命坠机事故。驾驶舱语音记录显示机组感到困惑：“你为什么关闭燃油？”“我什么都没有碰。”最终报告指出，燃油活门未经指令关闭，且没有发现机械故障。

cards.audioText: On August, 28, 2025, a Delta Airlines Airbus 3 20-200, performing flight Delta 7 3 7 from Atlanta to Washington (USA) with 162 passengers and 6 crew, was nearing Washington when the crew requested a descent from FL2 9 0 in preparation for descending towards Washington. ATC cleared the flight to FL2 8 0 advising there was traffic below. While descending at about 1000 feet per minute, the crew received a TCAS resolution advisory to level off. The captain disengaged the autopilot, and stopped the descent at about FL2 8 5. At that time cabin crew were preparing the cabin for landing, a flight attendant in the aft galley was thrown to the floor and received fractures of both her kneecaps. Two other flight attendants received minor injuries. The aircraft continued for a safe landing at Washington National airport. The seriously injured flight attendant was taken to a hospital. the probable cause of the accident was the abrupt maneuver required to comply with a traffic alert and collision avoidance system resolution advisory during descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年8月28日，Delta Airlines的一架Airbus 320-200执行Delta 737航班，从Atlanta飞往Washington（USA），机上有162名乘客和6名机组人员。飞机接近Washington时，机组为准备向Washington下降而请求从FL290下降。空中交通管制许可该航班下降至FL280，并提示下方有其他航空器。飞机正以约每分钟1,000英尺的下降率下降时，机组收到TCAS要求改平的决断咨询。机长断开自动驾驶，并在约FL285停止下降。此时客舱机组正在为着陆做准备，后厨房内的一名乘务员被抛到地板上，双侧膝盖骨骨折。另外2名乘务员受轻伤。飞机继续飞行并安全降落在Washington National Airport。重伤乘务员被送往医院。该事故的可能原因是飞机在下降过程中为遵从空中交通警戒与防撞系统决断咨询而必须实施的突然机动。

cards.audioText: On May 30, 2026, a Virgin Atlantic Airbus 3 30 900, performing flight Virgin 1 6 5 from London Heathrow (UK) to Montego Bay (Jamaica) with 246 passengers and 13 crew, was enroute at FL3 6 0 over the Atlantic Ocean about 440 nautical miles west of Shannon (Ireland), when the crew needed to reduce their right hand engine to idle thrust following an engine stall. The aircraft turned around, drifted down to FL2 0 0 and diverted to Shannon for a safe landing on Runway 24. The aircraft stopped briefly on the runway for an inspection by emergency services before taxiing to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年5月30日，Virgin Atlantic的一架Airbus 330-900执行Virgin 165航班，从London Heathrow（UK）飞往Montego Bay（Jamaica），机上有246名乘客和13名机组人员。飞机在Atlantic Ocean上空、Shannon（Ireland）以西约440海里处以FL360飞行时，右侧发动机发生失速，机组需要将该发动机减至慢车推力。飞机掉头，逐渐下降至FL200并备降Shannon，安全降落在24号跑道。飞机在跑道上短暂停留，接受紧急服务人员检查后滑行至停机坪。

cards.audioText: On June 5, 2026, a Swiss International Airlines Airbus 330-300, performing flight LX-155 from Mumbai (India) to Zurich (Switzerland) with 231 people on board, was enroute at FL340 about 510nm north of Mumbai when the crew decided to return to Mumbai due to electrical problems, descended initially to FL330 and later entered a hold at FL130 to burn off fuel. The aircraft landed safely on Mumbai's Runway 27about 3 hours after turning around. The airline reported a technical problem affecting electrical systems including lighting, toilets, inflight entertainment and seats. A reset of the systems was not successful prompting the return. The aircraft needed to burn off about 20 tons of fuel before landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年6月5日，Swiss International Airlines的一架Airbus 330-300执行LX-155航班，从Mumbai（India）飞往Zurich（Switzerland），机上共有231人。飞机在Mumbai以北约510海里处以FL340飞行时，机组因电气问题决定返回Mumbai，最初下降至FL330，随后在FL130进入等待以消耗燃油。飞机在掉头约3小时后安全降落在Mumbai机场27号跑道。航空公司报告称，一个技术问题影响了包括照明、卫生间、机上娱乐系统和座椅在内的电气系统。系统重置未能成功，因此飞机返航。飞机在着陆前需要消耗约20吨燃油。

cards.audioText: On June 4, 2026, an Air Canada Boeing 7 37 8 MAX was taxiing for departure when the aircraft, in contact with Ground frequency, received taxi clearance via Bravo 5, backtrack Runway 05L and vacate via Bravo 2 due to taxiway Bravo being blocked. The aircraft turned off taxiway Bravo onto Bravo 5, entered Runway 05L and backtracked the runway. Just before that an Aeromexico Boeing 7 37 800 had been cleared for takeoff from Runway 05L, commenced takeoff and rejected takeoff at about 55 knots over ground on ATC instruction due to the runway incursion. The aircraft stopped on the runway just before the displaced runway threshold, just past Bravo 2 and about 640 meters short of Bravo 5. The aircraft subsequently turned right onto taxiway Bravo 3 and departed from Runway 05R.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年6月4日，Air Canada的一架Boeing 737-8 MAX正在滑行准备离场。该机与地面频率保持联系时收到滑行许可：经Bravo 5进入05L跑道反向滑行，再经Bravo 2脱离，因为Bravo滑行道受阻。飞机从Bravo滑行道转入Bravo 5，进入05L跑道并沿跑道反向滑行。就在此前，Aeromexico的一架Boeing 737-800已获准从05L跑道起飞并开始滑跑；由于发生跑道侵入，该机按照空中交通管制指令在地速约55节时中断起飞。飞机在移位跑道入口前方停下，刚刚越过Bravo 2，距Bravo 5约640米。该机随后右转进入Bravo 3滑行道，并从05R跑道起飞。

cards.audioText: On June 13, 2026, a KLM Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight KLM 1 1 6 4 from Bergen (Norway) to Amsterdam (Netherlands), was climbing through about FL3 8 0 out of Bergen when the right hand engine needed to be shut down due to a low oil pressure indication. The aircraft diverted to Billund (Denmark) for a safe landing on Runway 09about 35 minutes after stopping the climb. Passengers reported the departure had been delayed by about one hour, the captain announced a starter for one of the engines was not working. The problem was fixed and they departed. Two loud bangs occurred, smoke entered the cabin and a burning smell developed. The captain announced, that they had received indication of low oil pressure on their right hand engine, they shut the engine down after the bangs. The airline reported the crew shut one of the engines down and diverted to Billund.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年6月13日，KLM的一架Boeing 737-800执行KLM 1164航班，从Bergen（Norway）飞往Amsterdam（Netherlands）。飞机从Bergen起飞爬升并通过约FL380时，因出现低滑油压力指示而需要关闭右侧发动机。飞机备降Billund（Denmark），并在停止爬升约35分钟后安全降落在09号跑道。乘客报告称，该航班离场已延误约一小时，机长宣布其中一台发动机的起动机无法工作。问题修复后，飞机起飞。随后出现两声巨响，烟雾进入客舱，并产生烧焦气味。机长宣布，他们收到右侧发动机滑油压力低的指示，并在巨响后关闭该发动机。航空公司报告称，机组关闭了一台发动机并备降Billund。

cards.audioText: main gear did not retract On June 16, 2026, a Delta Airlines Boeing 7 67 400, performing flight Delta 53 from Zurich (Switzerland) to New York JFK (USA), was climbing out of Zurich's Runway 16when tower queried the crew "just to confirm, are you aware your gear is still out? " The crew advised they had a malfunction and needed to return. Tower added that only the nose gear had retracted, both main gear struts were still out. The aircraft stopped the climb at 6000 feet and returned to Zurich for a safe landing on Runway 14about 25 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 主起落架未收起。2026年6月16日，Delta Airlines的一架Boeing 767-400执行Delta 53航班，从Zurich（Switzerland）飞往New York JFK（USA）。飞机从Zurich机场16号跑道起飞爬升时，塔台询问机组：“只是确认一下，你们是否知道起落架仍然放着？”机组告知发生故障，需要返航。塔台补充称，只有前起落架已经收起，两侧主起落架支柱仍处于放下状态。飞机在6,000英尺停止爬升，并在起飞约25分钟后安全返回Zurich，降落在14号跑道。

cards.audioText: engine fire indication A Virgin Australia Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight Virgin 6 9 7 from Melbourne to Perth (Australia), was climbing out of Melbourne's Runway 34when the crew stopped the climb at 5000 feet due to a left hand engine fire indication, requested emergency services to meet them on the runway to check engine #1 and decided to return to Melbourne for a safe landing on Runway 34about 25 minutes after departure. The aircraft stopped on the runway for about 8 minutes for an inspection by emergency services, no evidence of fire was spotted. The aircraft subsequently taxied to the apron. The airline reported an engine issue.
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机火警指示。Virgin Australia的一架Boeing 737-800执行Virgin 697航班，从Melbourne飞往Perth（Australia）。飞机从Melbourne机场34号跑道起飞爬升时，机组因左侧发动机火警指示而在5,000英尺停止爬升，请求紧急服务人员在跑道上接应并检查1号发动机，同时决定返回Melbourne。飞机在起飞约25分钟后安全降落在34号跑道，并在跑道上停留约8分钟，接受紧急服务人员检查；未发现起火迹象。飞机随后滑行至停机坪。航空公司报告称，飞机出现发动机问题。

cards.audioText: pilot incapacitated On June 20, 2026, an Easyjet Airbus 3 20, performing flight Easyjet 3 3 1 5 from Edinburgh (UK) to Keflavik (Iceland) with 168 passengers and 6 crew, was on approach to Keflavik's Runway 01when one of the pilots became briefly unconscious. The other pilot continued for a safe landing on Runway 01a few minutes later. By that time the ill pilot had already regained consciousness. The airport reported one of the pilots fainted (unclear whether captain or first officer), the aircraft landed a few minutes later. The fainted pilot was awake again at that time.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员失能。2026年6月20日，Easyjet的一架Airbus 320执行Easyjet 3315航班，从Edinburgh（UK）飞往Keflavik（Iceland），机上有168名乘客和6名机组人员。飞机正在进近Keflavik机场01号跑道时，其中一名飞行员短暂失去意识。另一名飞行员继续操纵飞机，并在几分钟后安全降落在01号跑道。此时身体不适的飞行员已经恢复意识。机场报告称，其中一名飞行员昏厥，无法确定是机长还是副驾驶；飞机几分钟后着陆，昏厥的飞行员当时已经苏醒。

cards.audioText: runway excursion on landing On June 20, 2026, a Mehr Airways Avro RJ 100, performing flight MEH 4 1 6 9 from Shiraz to Tehran Mehrabad (Iran), landed on Mehrabad's Runway 29R at 1 0 1 8 Local time (0 6 4 8 Zulu) but veered right off the runway center line and came to a stop at the runway egde. Iran's C A A reported the aircraft "suffered damage to one of its landing gear wheels while landing at Mehrabad Airport at 1 0 2 4 a.m., and subsequently, after traveling a distance and reducing speed, it left the runway and stopped next to the runway edge for reasons that are under investigation." There were no injuries. An investigation team was dispatched to the airport. ADS-B data suggest, the aircraft on final approach was left of the runway centerline, touched down onto the centerline, slowed, veered right and exited the right runway edge at about 70 knots over ground and came to a stop on the parallel taxiway. Local media report the aircraft bounced on landing and suffered a tail strike, and damaged some runway signs. There were no injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 着陆时冲出跑道。2026年6月20日，Mehr Airways的一架Avro RJ 100执行MEH 4169航班，从Shiraz飞往Tehran Mehrabad（Iran）。飞机于当地时间10:18，即Zulu时间06:48，降落在Mehrabad机场29R跑道，但随后向右偏离跑道中线，并停在跑道边缘。Iran民航局报告称，该机“于上午10:24在Mehrabad Airport着陆时一个起落架机轮受损，随后在滑行一段距离并减速后，因仍在调查的原因离开跑道并停在跑道边缘旁。”无人受伤。一个调查小组已被派往机场。ADS-B数据显示，飞机在最后进近时位于跑道中线左侧，在中线上接地，减速后向右偏转，以约70节地速越过跑道右侧边缘，并停在平行滑行道上。当地媒体报告称，飞机着陆时发生弹跳并擦尾，还损坏了一些跑道标志。无人受伤。

cards.audioText: Bird strike On June 23, 2026, a LATAM Chile Airbus A320-200, performing flight LA-311 from Puerto Montt to Punta Arenas (Chile), was climbing out of Puerto Montt's Runway 35when a vulture was ingested by the left engine causing the engine to emit streaks of flames and bangs and produce vibrations. The crew levelled off at about 3000 feet, shut the engine down and entered a hold. The aircraft returned to Puerto Montt for a safe landing on Runway 35about 90 minutes after departure. Passengers reported the left engine emitted sparks, streaks of flames and bang. The captain subsequently announved, the vulture had impacted the left engine.
cards.audioTextZh: 鸟击。2026年6月23日，LATAM Chile的一架Airbus A320-200执行LA-311航班，从Puerto Montt飞往Punta Arenas（Chile）。飞机从Puerto Montt机场35号跑道起飞爬升时，一只秃鹫被吸入左侧发动机，导致发动机喷出条状火焰、发出爆响并产生振动。机组在约3,000英尺改平，关闭发动机并进入等待。飞机在起飞约90分钟后安全返回Puerto Montt，降落在35号跑道。乘客报告称，左侧发动机喷出火花和条状火焰，并发出爆响。机长随后宣布，秃鹫撞击了左侧发动机。

cards.audioText: fumes affect all flight attendants and 2 passengers On June 13, 2026, a Westjet Airlines Boeing 737-8 MAX, performing flight Westjet 6 5 from Glasgow (UK) to Toronto (Canada) with 153 people on board, was enroute at FL3 2 0 about 110 nautical miles northwest of Goose Bay (Canada) when the crew contacted Medilink and subsequently decided to divert to Goose Bay after all 4 flights attendants and two passengers experienced shortness of breath due to fumes in the aft cabin. The aircraft landed safely in Goose Bay about 30 minutes later. The Canadian TSB reported: "The flight attendants maintained their safety related duties and the aircraft landed without incident where ATC had deployed emergency services to meet the aircraft. The crew and passengers were assessed by paramedics and released. Fire crews inspected the aircraft for the source of the fumes and tested the air quality in the aircraft. Maintenance personnel identified the source of the fumes as a faulty aft galley oven."
cards.audioTextZh: 烟雾影响全部乘务员和2名乘客。2026年6月13日，Westjet Airlines的一架Boeing 737-8 MAX执行Westjet 65航班，从Glasgow（UK）飞往Toronto（Canada），机上共有153人。飞机在Goose Bay（Canada）西北约110海里处以FL320飞行时，机组联系Medilink。后客舱的烟雾导致全部4名乘务员和2名乘客呼吸困难，机组随后决定备降Goose Bay。飞机约30分钟后安全降落在Goose Bay。Canada运输安全委员会报告称：“乘务员继续履行与安全相关的职责，飞机顺利着陆，空中交通管制已安排紧急服务人员接应。医护人员对机组和乘客进行了评估，随后允许他们离开。消防人员检查飞机以查找烟雾来源，并检测飞机内的空气质量。维修人员确认烟雾来自后厨房内一台故障的烤箱。”

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff due to runway incursion On June 26, 2026, an American Airlines Airbus 3 1 9, performing flight American 3 0 8 from Miami (USA) to Bermuda (Bermuda), was cleared for takeoff from Miami's Runway 08R and was accelerating for takeoff when the crew rejected takeoff at low speed after spotting a business jet crossing the runway about 880 meters (2880 feet) down the runway. The Airbus 3 1 9 vacated the runway at the first right exit about 370 meters (1200 feet) down the runway. Ground Control subsequently told the crew of the Netjets business jet that they had just crossed an active runway, the crew claimed they had been cleared to cross which tower denied telling them he had cleared another aircraft with different callsign and numbers.
cards.audioTextZh: 因跑道侵入中断起飞。2026年6月26日，American Airlines的一架Airbus 319执行American 308航班，从Miami（USA）飞往Bermuda（Bermuda）。飞机获准从Miami机场08R跑道起飞并正在加速时，机组看到一架公务机在跑道前方约880米，即2,880英尺处穿越跑道，于是低速中断起飞。Airbus 319在跑道前方约370米，即1,200英尺处经第一个右侧出口脱离跑道。地面管制随后告诉Netjets公务机机组，他们刚刚穿越了一条正在使用的跑道。该机组声称已获准穿越，塔台予以否认，并告知他们，塔台许可的是另一架具有不同呼号和数字的航空器。

cards.audioText: hydraulic failure and fuel dump problem On June 28, 2026, an Air Atlanta Europe Malta Boeing 747-400 freighter on behalf of Saudi Arabian Airlines, performing flight SV-3902 from Liege (Belgium) to Riyadh (Saudi Arabia), was climbing out of Liege's Runway 22L when the crew stopped the climb at FL100 due to the loss of hydraulic system #4, the crew decided to return to Liege and dump fuel, however, only the right hand fuel dump valve opened, no fuel was dumped from the right hand wing. The aircraft entered a hold at FL100 to dump and landed safely on Runway 22L about 85 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 液压系统故障及放油问题。2026年6月28日，Air Atlanta Europe Malta的一架Boeing 747-400货机代表Saudi Arabian Airlines运营，执行SV-3902航班，从Liege（Belgium）飞往Riyadh（Saudi Arabia）。飞机从Liege机场22L跑道起飞爬升时，因4号液压系统失效而在FL100停止爬升。机组决定返回Liege并放油；然而，只有右侧放油活门打开，右侧机翼没有放出燃油。飞机在FL100进入等待以便放油，并在起飞约85分钟后安全降落在22L跑道。

cards.audioText: On June 29, 2026, a Jetblue Airbus 3 2 1, performing flight Jetblue 9 4 8 from Las Vegas to New York JFK (USA), was on approach to JFK's Runway 13L maintaining 3000 feet when the crew reported a drone hit the aircraft just above the windshield. The aircraft continued for a safe landing on Runway 13L. The F A A reported: "The pilot of JetBlue Airlines Flight 948 reported striking a drone at approximately 3,000 feet altitude while on final approach to John F. Kennedy International Airport around 07: 15 a.m. local time on Monday, June 29. A post-flight inspection did not reveal any damage to the aircraft. The FAA will investigate." About 40 minutes later a police helicopter advised tower they had the drone in sight at 2000 feet and proceeded to take a closer look at it.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年6月29日，Jetblue的一架Airbus 321执行Jetblue 948航班，从Las Vegas飞往New York JFK（USA）。飞机正在保持3,000英尺进近JFK机场13L跑道时，机组报告称一架无人机撞击了飞机风挡上方。飞机继续进近并安全降落在13L跑道。FAA报告称：“JetBlue Airlines 948航班的飞行员报告称，6月29日星期一当地时间约07:15，飞机正在对John F. Kennedy International Airport实施最后进近时，在约3,000英尺高度撞到一架无人机。飞行后检查未发现飞机有任何损伤。FAA将对此展开调查。”约40分钟后，一架警用直升机告知塔台，他们在2,000英尺高度看到该无人机，并继续靠近查看。

cards.audioText: One day in 2000, Flight 154 reported bird strike three minutes after takeoff, and requested return to the airport. But the controller told the crew that the RVR of the airport was below landing minima, so the captain made a decision to make an emergency landing at airport A. Air traffic controller quickly contacted A airport and gained permission for a landing on runway 15. However, the aircraft could not reach A airport due to lack of altitude. The crew decided to make a ditching in a river and they reported it to the controller. Finally, the crew made a ditching without power at about 150 miles per hour in the river.
cards.audioTextZh: 2000年的一天，154号航班起飞三分钟后报告遭遇鸟击，并请求返场。但管制员告知机组，该机场的跑道视程（RVR）低于着陆最低标准，因此机长决定在A机场紧急着陆。空中交通管制员迅速联系A机场，并获得在15号跑道着陆的许可。然而，由于高度不足，飞机无法到达A机场。机组决定在一条河流上实施水上迫降，并将这一决定报告给管制员。最终，机组以大约每小时150英里的速度，在无动力状态下迫降于河面。

cards.audioText: When SIA188 was approaching the airspace of Chicago Area Control Center, the controller instructed the flight crew to change radio frequency for the next sector on 132.1. The first officer acknowledged the frequency change and read back the correct frequency. However, the flight crew did not contact ATC on the new frequency. Because the controllers in the receiving units were preparing for a shift change, they didn't know that flight 188 did not establish radio contact, 30 minutes later, the controller at the next sector identified SIA188 on the radar. Although they attempted to establish contact with the airplane by calling the company dispatcher, they got no response from the pilots. The controller finally regained contact with SIA188 on the emergency frequency 50 minutes later.
cards.audioTextZh: 当SIA188接近芝加哥区域管制中心空域时，管制员指示机组将无线电频率改为下一扇区的132.1。副驾驶确认了频率转换指令，并正确复诵了该频率。然而，机组没有在新频率上联系空中交通管制。由于接收单位的管制员正在准备交接班，他们没有发现188号航班尚未建立无线电联系。30分钟后，下一扇区的管制员在雷达上识别出SIA188。尽管管制员尝试通过联系航空公司签派员与飞机建立联系，但始终没有收到飞行员的回应。50分钟后，管制员最终在应急频率上重新与SIA188取得联系。

cards.audioText: Landing light signal could provide useful information to controllers. One day, a B757 vacated runway 36L via taxiway A9 after landing. It was then cleared to cross runway 36R. But it stopped taxiing on taxiway A9 between runway 36L and runway 36R. The tower controller attempted to contact the pilot but received no reply. He saw the aircraft landing lights were also off. This made him believe that the B757 had a radio failure and had not received the clearance to cross runway 36R. So he issued takeoff clearance to A320 on runway 36R. Suddenly, the controller noticed the B757's lights came on and it began to move. Realizing the risk of runway incursion, he cancelled A320's takeoff clearance immediately.
cards.audioTextZh: 着陆灯信号可以为管制员提供有用信息。一天，一架B757着陆后经A9滑行道脱离36L跑道，随后获准穿越36R跑道。但飞机停在了36L与36R跑道之间的A9滑行道上。塔台管制员尝试联系飞行员，但没有收到回答。他还看到飞机的着陆灯处于关闭状态。这使他认为B757发生了无线电失效，并未收到穿越36R跑道的许可。因此，他向36R跑道上的一架A320发布了起飞许可。突然，管制员注意到B757的灯亮了起来，飞机也开始移动。意识到存在跑道侵入风险后，他立即取消了A320的起飞许可。

cards.audioText: It was a foggy day in 2002, SIA 686 was cleared to taxi to runway 36R. A few minutes later, the Cessna pilot requested engine start. The ground controller gave start-up clearance. Then he requested Flight 686 to contact the Tower controller. From then on, those two aircraft were on two different radio frequencies. The Cessna started to taxi, but the pilot made a mistake to taxi to right and entered taxiway R6. But the ground controller did not realize it and cleared the Cessna to continue its taxi. At the same time, the Tower controller cleared Flight 686 for takeoff. When the flight 686 was rolling on the runway, the Cessna crossed the runway holding sign and entered the active runway 36R. Unfortunately, the two aircraft collided, all 114 people on board died.
cards.audioTextZh: 2002年一个有雾的日子，SIA686获准滑行前往36R跑道。几分钟后，一架塞斯纳的飞行员请求启动发动机，地面管制员发布了开车许可。随后，他要求686号航班联系塔台管制员。从那时起，两架飞机分别使用不同的无线电频率。塞斯纳开始滑行，但飞行员错误地向右滑行并进入了R6滑行道。地面管制员没有意识到这一错误，仍许可塞斯纳继续滑行。与此同时，塔台管制员许可686号航班起飞。当686号航班正在跑道上滑跑时，塞斯纳越过跑道等待位置标志，进入了正在使用的36R跑道。遗憾的是，两架飞机相撞，机上114人全部遇难。

cards.audioText: Flight 345 nearly collided with Flight 101 at the intersection of runway 16 and runway 22. There were no injuries and no damage to either aircraft. But it was regarded as the most serious incident of this kind. That day, the tower controller cleared Flight 345 to land on runway 22. But he forgot the arriving aircraft when he cleared Flight 101 to take off from the intersecting runway 16. After Flight 345 touched down, the ground radar system alerted. The controller tried to instruct Flight 345 to stop short of runway 16. However, the aircraft managed to stop in the middle of the intersection. It was impossible for Flight 101 to abort takeoff. Flight 101 made an early liftoff and flew over Flight 345. The two aircraft missed colliding by only 50 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 345号航班与101号航班险些在16号跑道和22号跑道的交叉口相撞。事故没有造成人员受伤，两架飞机也均未受损，但它被视为此类事件中最严重的一起。当天，塔台管制员许可345号航班在22号跑道着陆，但在许可101号航班从相交的16号跑道起飞时，忘记了这架正在进场的飞机。345号航班接地后，地面雷达系统发出警报。管制员试图指示345号航班在16号跑道外停止，但飞机最终停在了跑道交叉口中央。101号航班已无法中断起飞，只得提前离地并从345号航班上方飞过。两架飞机仅以50英尺的间隔避免相撞。

cards.audioText: As American Flight 835 was approaching the terminal area of its destination, the flight crew contacted the Approach Control and requested ILS approach for runway 12. Tailwind conditions were reported on runway 12 at that time, so the controller advised the pilot to make a circling approach fro runway 30. But the crew insisted to land on runway 12 and the controller cleared them to land on the runway 12. The runway was wet and braking action was not good. During landing roll, the aircraft skidded to the left of the runway and went through the airport fences. The fuselage was broken into three pieces, the right engine and right main gear were separated from the aircraft. No one was killed, but many passengers suffered from serious injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 美国航空835号航班接近目的地终端区时，机组联系进近管制，并请求对12号跑道实施ILS进近。当时12号跑道报告有顺风，因此管制员建议飞行员进行盘旋进近，在30号跑道着陆。但机组坚持在12号跑道着陆，管制员随后许可其在12号跑道着陆。跑道湿滑，制动效应不佳。着陆滑跑期间，飞机向跑道左侧打滑并冲破机场围栏。机身断成三截，右发动机和右主起落架与机体分离。事故无人死亡，但许多乘客严重受伤。

cards.audioText: One day, Flight 123, a B737 carrying 152 passengers and 9 crews was flying to land at Tokyo International Airport. When it was transferred from Tokyo Control to Tokyo Approach, flight 123 was instructed to proceed to DA to hold because of traffic congestion. During the holding, the flight crew was informed that the local weather was deteriorating and the controller suggested the pilot divert to the alternate, but the pilot reported that their fuel was not enough to the alternate. So the controller vectored flight 123 by radar to land at runway 34R. Unfortunately, the pilot couldn't stabilize the aircraft on the localizer due to wind shear. Flight 123 went around and made a second approach. Later, it crashed into a hillside due to fuel shortage. The aircraft was broken into pieces and all the people on board were killed.
cards.audioTextZh: 一天，123号航班，一架载有152名乘客和9名机组人员的B737，正在飞往东京国际机场着陆。当该航班从东京区调移交给东京进近时，由于空中交通拥堵，123号航班被指示飞往DA点等待。在等待期间，机组获悉当地天气正在恶化，管制员建议飞行员备降，但飞行员报告剩余燃油不足以飞到备降机场。因此，管制员对123号航班实施雷达引导，使其在34R跑道着陆。遗憾的是，由于风切变，飞行员无法使飞机在航向道上稳定下来。123号航班复飞后进行了第二次进近。随后，飞机因燃油不足撞上山坡。飞机解体，机上所有人员全部遇难。

cards.audioText: One day, Indonesia 205 took off from Jinan to Hangzhou. About one hour later, the aircraft was transferred to Hangzhou Approach. Hangzhou Approach required Indonesia 205 to slow down to 190 knots and later the controller asked the pilot to reduce speed to 160 knots. Three minutes later, Indonesia 205 passed the outer marker inbound. At that time, the controller issued a missed approach clearance because of separation. He instructed Indonesia 205 to make a right turn to a heading of 180 and climb to 900 m. But during the missed approach, the aircraft was out of control because of mechanical problem. The aircraft continued to descend with a high angle of attack. The aircraft impacted trees and buildings and part of the fuselage was damaged.
cards.audioTextZh: 一天，印度尼西亚航空205号航班从济南起飞前往杭州。大约一小时后，该航班被移交给杭州进近。杭州进近要求205号航班减速至190节，随后管制员又要求飞行员将速度减至160节。三分钟后，205号航班向台飞越外指点标。当时，管制员因间隔原因发布了复飞许可，指示205号航班右转至航向180度并爬升至900米。但在复飞过程中，飞机因机械故障失去控制，以大迎角状态持续下降。飞机撞上树木和建筑物，部分机身受损。

cards.audioText: One day, AFR188 crashed at Singapore Changi Airport during takeoff. The tower controller instructed the crew to takeoff on Runway 02L, but the crew lined up runway 02R and began their takeoff rolling. The aircraft overran the runway, and crashed into the fence of the airport. Crew members and 110 passengers were killed, and the co-pilot was badly injured. The plane was destroyed by the impact and caught on an intense fire. According to the investigation, there were three reasons leading to the accidents. First of all, the crew didn't use effective methods to verify their position at the airport. Secondly, the crew forgot to check whether they were on the correct runway or not. Finally, the crew members' idle chatting during the taxi resulted the loss of situational awareness.
cards.audioTextZh: 一天，AFR188在新加坡樟宜机场起飞期间坠毁。塔台管制员指示机组从02L跑道起飞，但机组却在02R跑道对正并开始起飞滑跑。飞机冲出跑道，撞上机场围栏。机组成员和110名乘客遇难，副驾驶严重受伤。飞机因撞击而损毁，并燃起猛烈大火。调查显示，有三个原因导致了这起事故。首先，机组没有采用有效方法确认自己在机场内的位置。其次，机组忘记核实自己是否位于正确的跑道。最后，机组成员在滑行期间闲聊，导致情景意识丧失。

cards.audioText: One day, an A320 collided with a B737 during taxi. The right ailerons of B737 was severely damaged but A320 only had minor damage of its left wing. Luckily, there were no injuries. After receiving ATC taxi instruction, the A320 began to pass the B737 from the right side. The captain of A320 thought they had enough room to pass over the B737. But unfortunately, two aircraft collided together with the wings. Both captains reported the collision immediately to the controller. Because the Boeing aircraft was damaged seriously, fuel leakage was reported and fire services were required. Fortunately, the fuel leak didn't develop into fire. The crew of the Boeing aircraft complained that they just parked stationary with the parking brakes applied when they were hit.
cards.audioTextZh: 一天，一架A320与一架B737在滑行期间相撞。B737的右副翼严重受损，而A320的左翼仅轻微受损。幸运的是，没有人员受伤。收到空中交通管制的滑行指令后，A320开始从B737右侧通过。A320机长认为有足够空间可以从B737旁边通过，但两架飞机的机翼不幸发生碰撞。两位机长立即向管制员报告了相撞情况。由于波音飞机受损严重，机组报告发生燃油泄漏并请求消防救援。幸运的是，泄漏的燃油没有起火。波音飞机机组表示，他们被撞时一直停在原地，并已设置停留刹车。

cards.audioText: A pilot of Air China airline company told us an event with landing gear problem several days ago. After normal pushback, startup and taxi, he requested takeoff at the holding point of the active runway. However, he was instructed to hold short of the runway in order to give way to AFR123 on final. AFR123 declared emergency because of landing gear problem. AFR123 asked for a low pass to have a visual check. The controller verified the landing gear was still in up position during low pass. Then AFR123 requested a touch and go to jar the jammed gear. Unfortunately, after doing this, the landing gear still couldn't be extended. So, AFR123 had to make a belly landing on a foamed runway. AFR123 made a safe landing. There were no casualties except some minor injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名中国国际航空公司的飞行员向我们讲述了几天前发生的一起起落架故障事件。在正常完成推出、开车和滑行后，他在正在使用跑道的等待点请求起飞。然而，为了给最后进近中的AFR123让行，他被指示在跑道外等待。AFR123因起落架故障宣布紧急状态，并请求低空通场，以便从地面目视检查。低空通场期间，管制员确认起落架仍处于收上位置。随后，AFR123请求进行一次连续起飞，试图通过震动使卡住的起落架放下。遗憾的是，这样做之后起落架仍无法放出。因此，AFR123不得不在铺设了泡沫的跑道上实施机腹着陆。AFR123安全着陆，除少数人员轻伤外，没有其他伤亡。

cards.audioText: CSN341 was a flight from Beijing to Los Angles. When CSN341 initially contacted the tower controller, he was told the runway visual range was 500 m. The pilot executed a missed approach two minutes later because of no contact at minima. Then, CSN341 was given radar vectors for a second ILS approach. In the second approach, the controller issued landing clear to CSN341 at outer marker. One minute later, the controller observed the airplane was leaving the glide path on his radar display, so he issued missed approach instructions again. There was no further reply from the pilot. The airplane impacted the top of a tall building and crashed. According to the investigation, the poor visibility made the pilot nervous and he misunderstood the missed approach instructions and made a wrong turn.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN341是一个从北京飞往洛杉矶的航班。CSN341首次联系塔台管制员时，被告知跑道视程为500米。两分钟后，由于在最低标准处未能建立目视，飞行员实施复飞。随后，CSN341接受雷达引导，准备进行第二次ILS进近。第二次进近中，CSN341飞越外指点标时，管制员向其发布了着陆许可。一分钟后，管制员在雷达显示器上观察到飞机正在偏离下滑道，于是再次发布复飞指令。此后没有再收到飞行员的回答。飞机撞上一座高层建筑的顶部后坠毁。调查显示，低能见度使飞行员感到紧张，他误解了复飞指令并转向错误方向。

cards.audioText: This story is about runway incursion. One day, A B767 nearly collided with an A320 at New York Airport, which is operating with two intersecting runways. Although there was neither casualties nor aircraft damages for both aircraft, still the incident was regarded as one of the most serious incidents of this kind. The tower controller instructed B767 to land at runway 21, meanwhile, he cleared A320 to take off at runway 18. Just as B767 touched down, the ground radar system sounded the alarm. The tower controller realized the problem and instructed B767 to stop landing rolling immediately, trying to stay out of the intersection of runway 18. In spite of the effort, B767 could only stop in the middle of the intersecting runway. However, the pilot of A320 could not abort takeoff, and pulled up the aircraft in advance to avoid collision. They missed each other by only 60 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 这个故事与跑道侵入有关。一天，一架B767与一架A320在纽约机场险些相撞，该机场使用两条相交跑道运行。虽然两架飞机均无人员伤亡或飞机损伤，这起事件仍被视为同类事件中最严重的一起。塔台管制员指示B767在21号跑道着陆，同时许可A320从18号跑道起飞。就在B767接地时，地面雷达系统发出警报。塔台管制员意识到问题后，立即指示B767停止着陆滑跑，试图使其停在18号跑道交叉口之外。尽管采取了措施，B767最终只能停在相交跑道的中央。A320飞行员此时已无法中断起飞，只得提前拉起飞机避免相撞。两架飞机仅以60英尺的间隔擦肩而过。

cards.audioText: It was a sunny day in 2010, a Delta Airline's 767-300 departed from Shanghai Pudong International Airport to Seoul. It carried 256 passengers and 13 crew members on board. During takeoff rolling, an unknown foreign object was sucked into port engine and the engine fire warning light illuminated. Then the flight crew declared an emergency right after airborne and completed the emergency checklist procedure. Through good communication, the controller understood the flight crew wanted to return to land. But the pilot had to dump fuel before landing because the aircraft was overweight to land. So the controller vectored the aircraft by radar to the dumping area. After circling over the sea and dumping fuel for almost one hour, the plane returned to land at departure airport safely.
cards.audioTextZh: 2010年一个晴朗的日子，达美航空一架767-300从上海浦东国际机场起飞前往首尔，机上载有256名乘客和13名机组人员。起飞滑跑期间，一个不明外来物被吸入左发动机，发动机火警灯亮起。飞机离地后，机组立即宣布紧急状态，并完成紧急检查单程序。通过良好沟通，管制员了解到机组希望返场着陆。但由于飞机重量超过着陆限制，飞行员必须在着陆前放油。因此，管制员对飞机实施雷达引导，前往放油区。飞机在海上盘旋并放油近一小时后，安全返回起飞机场着陆。

cards.audioText: One day, a B737 flew into the terminal control area of its destination airport. After establishing contact with Approach control, the flight crew requested clearance for ILS approach runway 22. During the approach, the controller suggested the flight crew make a circling to land on runway 04 because strong tailwind on runway 22 was just reported by previous A330. But the crew insisted on using runway 22, so the controller gave them clearance to land on runway 22. It was at night, the runway was scattered with snow and ice. Unfortunately, the plane missed the proper landing point on the runway, overran the runway and crashed into the fence of the airport. The fuselage was broken into three parts with the starboard engine separated from the wing. Fortunately, there were no killings, but many passengers were seriously injured.
cards.audioTextZh: 一天，一架B737进入目的地机场的终端管制区。与进近管制建立联系后，机组请求获准对22号跑道实施ILS进近。进近期间，由于前一架A330刚刚报告22号跑道有强顺风，管制员建议机组实施盘旋，在04号跑道着陆。但机组坚持使用22号跑道，管制员随后许可其在22号跑道着陆。当时正值夜间，跑道上散布着冰雪。遗憾的是，飞机错过了跑道上的适当接地点，冲出跑道并撞上机场围栏。机身断成三截，右发动机与机翼分离。幸运的是，事故没有造成人员死亡，但许多乘客严重受伤。

cards.audioText: In November 1996 I was in a flight flying to New York. I was in the flight because I got a call from New York Hospital that a heart would be ready for me. The pilot called the tower and told them who we were. The ATC said we could not land because President Clinton was there and the security service would not let us land. The pilot told the ATC that he would report this to the press and TV stations. I think they would let us land because of the bad influence. However, it didn't work because the controllers wanted to have a look of Clinton. So we had to divert to the alternate airport instead. Fortunately, I got to the hospital on time. It was a great heart as you can see I am still alive almost 11 years after the operation. (145 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 1996年11月，我乘坐一个飞往纽约的航班。我之所以搭乘该航班，是因为接到纽约医院的电话，得知已经有一颗可供我移植的心脏。飞行员呼叫塔台并说明了我们的身份。空中交通管制员表示，由于克林顿总统当时在那里，安保部门不允许我们着陆。飞行员告诉管制员，他会把这件事报告给报社和电视台。我原以为他们会顾及不良影响而允许我们着陆，但这并没有奏效，因为管制员们想看一眼克林顿。因此，我们只得改降备降机场。幸运的是，我及时赶到了医院。那是一颗非常好的心脏——正如你所见，手术过去将近11年后，我仍然活着。（145词）

cards.audioText: On February 17th, 2005, United airline 123, an Airbus 320, collided with Air China 321, a Boeing 737, during taxi in the run-up area at the north end of runway 19. The right aileron of the Boeing 737 was severely damaged; the left wing of the Airbus 320 had minor damage. There were no injuries. The pilot of the Airbus 320 reported that he was positioned to the right of the Boeing 737. ATC cleared them for departure, which required them to taxi past the Boeing 737. The captain stated that he checked the position of the Boeing 737, and he thought he could clear it and then felt the impact. The captain notified ATC of the collision. Airport fire crews responded, but there was no fuel leak or fire. The crew of the Boeing 737 reported that they were stationary with the parking brake applied while awaiting ATC clearance. (150 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年2月17日，美联航123号航班，一架空客A320，在19号跑道北端的试车区滑行时，与中国国际航空321号航班的一架波音737相撞。波音737的右副翼严重受损，空客A320的左翼轻微受损，没有人员受伤。A320飞行员报告称，其飞机当时位于B737右侧。空中交通管制许可他们离场，这要求A320从B737旁边滑过。机长表示，他检查了B737的位置，认为能够安全通过，随后便感受到了撞击。机长将相撞情况通知了空中交通管制。机场消防人员赶到现场，但没有发生燃油泄漏或火灾。B737机组报告称，他们当时设置了停留刹车，停在原地等待空中交通管制许可。（150词）

cards.audioText: The crew of flight 523 found a traffic 20 miles at FL 294 right ahead of the airplane on TCAS at FL 290 near LAMEN. The captain reported to Shanghai Control immediately, but the controller responded that there was no indication on his radar screen and there had not been any flight advisory. The captain then instructed the crew to turn left and found the conflicting traffic closing to the flight path and a TCAS warning was initiated. The crew then immediately turns right for avoidance, disengage the autopilot and descended to a lower altitude. The crew reported to the controller about the conflict after the conflict had been cleared.
cards.audioTextZh: 523号航班机组在LAMEN附近以FL290飞行时，通过TCAS发现飞机正前方20海里处有一架位于FL294的航空器。机长立即向上海管制报告，但管制员回应称，雷达屏幕上没有相关显示，此前也没有收到任何飞行情报。随后，机长指示机组左转，并发现冲突航空器正不断接近本机航迹，TCAS警告随即触发。机组立即右转避让，断开自动驾驶并下降到较低高度。冲突解除后，机组向管制员报告了此次冲突。

cards.audioText: On September 28, 2003, United 552, a DC-9-82, experienced an in-flight engine fire during departure climb from New York City. During the return to the departure airport, the nose landing gear failed to extend, and the flight crew was instructed by the ATC to execute a go-around, during which the crew extended the nose gear using the emergency procedure. The flight crew conducted an emergency landing, and the 2 flight crew members, 3 flight attendants, and 138 passengers deplaned on the runway. No occupant injuries were reported, but the airplane sustained substantial damage from the fire. The National Transportation Safety Board determines that the probable cause of this accident was American Airlines' maintenance personnel's use of an inappropriate manual engine-start procedure, which led to the subsequent left engine fire. (128 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 2003年9月28日，美联航552号航班，一架DC-9-82，在从纽约市起飞爬升期间发生空中发动机火警。飞机返航起飞机场期间，前起落架无法放出，空中交通管制指示机组复飞；复飞过程中，机组使用应急程序放出了前起落架。机组随后实施紧急着陆，2名飞行机组成员、3名乘务员和138名乘客在跑道上撤离。机上人员均未受伤，但飞机因火灾严重受损。美国国家运输安全委员会认定，这起事故的可能原因是美国航空维修人员采用了不适当的人工启动发动机程序，进而引发左发动机火灾。（128词）

cards.audioText: On March 22, 2008, China Southern 303, a Boeing 757-200, lost a left upper wing trailing edge panel during cruise flight at FL270. Initially, ATC received a pilot report that the flight crew had experienced "light chop" at the time. The flight was en route from Greenyard Airport to Blueyard Airport. The broken panel struck the window of passenger row 19ABC and cracked only the outer portion of the window. Pressurization was not lost. The flight crew continued on to Blueyard. Upon approach to Blueyard, ATC instructed the flight crew to expedite for separation. the flight crew informed ATC that they could not increase their airspeed due to possible airframe damage. The flight landed safely. There were 174 passengers and 6 crew members on board with no reported injuries.(128 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 2008年3月22日，中国南方航空303号航班，一架波音757-200，在FL270巡航时，左翼上表面的一块后缘面板脱落。最初，空中交通管制收到飞行员报告称，机组当时遭遇了“轻度颠簸”。该航班正从绿园机场飞往蓝园机场。脱落的面板击中了19ABC排乘客的舷窗，仅使舷窗外层开裂，飞机没有失压。机组继续飞往蓝园机场。飞机进近蓝园机场时，空中交通管制为建立间隔指示机组加快速度；机组告知管制员，由于机体可能受损，他们无法提高空速。航班最终安全着陆。机上共有174名乘客和6名机组人员，没有人员受伤报告。（128词）

cards.audioText: On February 17, 2005, an Airbus 320 operated by United Airline, collided with an ERJ 145, operated by US Airways during taxi in the runup area of taxiway J at the north end of runway 19. The right aileron of the ERJ 145 was substantially damaged; the left winglet of the Airbus 320 had minor damage. There were no injuries. The pilot of the Airbus 320 reported that he was positioned to the right of the ERJ 145. ATC cleared them for departure, which required them to taxi past the ERJ 145. The captain stated that he checked the proximity of the ERJ 145, and it looked like he could clear it and then felt the impact. The captain notified ATC of the collision. Airport fire crews responded, but there was no fuel leak or fire. The crew of the ERJ 145 reported that they were stationary with the parking brake applied while awaiting ATC clearance. (155 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年2月17日，美联航运营的一架空客A320在19号跑道北端J滑行道试车区滑行时，与全美航空运营的一架ERJ145相撞。ERJ145的右副翼严重受损，空客A320的左翼梢小翼轻微受损，没有人员受伤。A320飞行员报告称，其飞机当时位于ERJ145右侧。空中交通管制许可他们离场，这要求A320从ERJ145旁边滑过。机长表示，他检查了与ERJ145之间的距离，认为能够安全通过，随后便感受到了撞击。机长将相撞情况通知了空中交通管制。机场消防人员赶到现场，但没有发生燃油泄漏或火灾。ERJ145机组报告称，他们当时设置了停留刹车，停在原地等待空中交通管制许可。（155词）

cards.audioText: Prior to initiating the first ILS approach to runway 10R, the pilot of Japan air 223 was advised by the tower controller that the runway visual range (RVR) was 600 feet, followed by being given a landing clearance. The pilot declared a missed approach two minutes later and was given radar vectors for a second ILS approach. After turning inbound on the localizer, the pilot was advised the runway visual range and then cleared to land. When the tower controller observed the airplane turning to the south of the runway on her radar display, she issued missed approach instructions. There was no further reply from the pilot. The airplane impacted the top of an 85-foot tall tree, and then continued to collide on the ground. The published missed approach procedure instructed the pilot to climb to 900 feet, then right turn to intercept the 160 degree radial of the VORTAC. It appears the pilot likely misinterpreted the missed approach instructions by making the right hand turn prior to initiating a climb to 900 feet, which resulted in the subsequent impact with the tree. (179 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 日本航空223号航班的飞行员在开始对10R跑道实施第一次ILS进近前，塔台管制员告知其跑道视程（RVR）为600英尺，随后向其发布了着陆许可。两分钟后，飞行员宣布复飞，并接受雷达引导进行第二次ILS进近。转入航向道向台飞行后，飞行员再次获知跑道视程，随后获准着陆。当塔台管制员在雷达显示器上观察到飞机正在向跑道南侧转弯时，她发布了复飞指令。此后没有再收到飞行员的回答。飞机撞上一棵85英尺高的大树顶部，随后继续撞击地面。公布的复飞程序要求飞行员先爬升至900英尺，然后右转切入VORTAC的160度径向线。飞行员很可能误解了复飞指令，在开始爬升至900英尺之前就进行了右转，最终导致飞机撞树。（179词）

cards.audioText: On February 28, 2001, A Boeing 757 and a Bombardier were substantially damaged when the tails of both airplanes collided during the pushback process from two adjacent terminal gates in Greenyard airport. The flight crew of the Bombardier reported that during the final stages of pushback from gate 79, they were in a stopped position while their ground crew was in the process of disconnecting the tug when the collision occurred.
