Company maintenance personnel stated they were pushing the 757 back from gate 80 and did not see the Bombardier. Review of ATC communication recordings between ground control and both airplanes revealed that the 757 was initially cleared for pushback onto taxiway alpha from gate 80. About 41 seconds later, the ground controller cleared the Bombardier to push back onto taxiway alpha from gate 79. The recordings revealed that the ground controller did not advise either aircraft of simultaneous adjacent pushback operations. The controller stated that he believed there was room for both aircraft to push back and did not forecast a traffic conflict. (174 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 2001年2月28日，在绿园机场两个相邻机位推出过程中，一架波音757和一架庞巴迪飞机的尾部发生碰撞，两架飞机均严重受损。庞巴迪机组报告称，他们从79号机位推出进入最后阶段时，飞机已经停住，地面人员正在断开牵引车，此时碰撞发生。航空公司维修人员表示，他们正将757从80号机位推出，没有看到庞巴迪飞机。对地面管制与两架飞机之间的空中交通管制通信录音进行审查后发现，757最初获准从80号机位推出至A滑行道。约41秒后，地面管制员又许可庞巴迪飞机从79号机位推出至A滑行道。录音显示，地面管制员没有向任何一架飞机通报相邻机位同时推出的情况。该管制员表示，他认为两架飞机都有足够的推出空间，没有预见到交通冲突。（174词）

cards.audioText: On December 11, 2002, Air France 551 departed runway 15R and over flew United83, which had landed on runway 10 at Atlantic international Airport. The tower controller had cleared United83 to land on runway 10 when United83 was approximately 6 mile on final approach. Simultaneously, the ATC local controller cleared Air France 551 for takeoff on runway 15R. Air France 551 was on taxiway A about 500 feet short of runway 15R when the takeoff clearance was issued. Air France 551 rotated at taxiway F and over flew United83 by 300 feet at the intersection of runways 10 and 15R. United83 exited runway 10 afterwards. The main cause of this incident is local controller's failure of maintaining awareness of the situation and failing to provide the appropriate separation between the two aircraft operating on intersecting runways. (136 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 2002年12月11日，在大西洋国际机场，法国航空551号航班从15R跑道起飞，并从已在10号跑道着陆的美联航83号航班上方飞过。当美联航83号航班在10号跑道最后进近约6海里处时，塔台管制员已许可其着陆。与此同时，本场管制员许可法国航空551号航班从15R跑道起飞。起飞许可发布时，法国航空551号航班位于A滑行道，距15R跑道约500英尺。法国航空551号航班在F滑行道处抬前轮，并在10号与15R跑道交叉口上方，以300英尺垂直间隔飞越美联航83号航班。随后，美联航83号航班脱离10号跑道。事件的主要原因是本场管制员未能保持情景意识，也未能为在相交跑道上运行的两架飞机提供适当间隔。（136词）

cards.audioText: The Piper and Cessna pilot were both inbound to the same airport. The Cessna pilot reported to the local controller that he was 13.5 miles to the northeast of the airport. The LC directed the pilot to report entering a left downwind, and the pilot continued on south heading for 4 miles before turning right to a southwest heading. The Piper pilot contacted the LC and reported 10 miles to the north of the airport. The LC directed the Piper pilot to enter a left downwind. The LC noticed two VFR targets close to one another. Assuming the target on a southwest heading was a VFR helicopter when it was actually the Cessna, the LC issued conflict traffic to the southbound aircraft, assuming it was the Cessna pilot when it was actually the Piper pilot, and the Cessna pilot acknowledged the traffic call. Forty one seconds later, the Piper pilot informed the LC of the collision and declared an emergency. (161 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 一架派珀和一架塞斯纳都在飞往同一机场。塞斯纳飞行员向本场管制员报告，飞机位于机场东北方向13.5英里处。本场管制员指示其报告进入左三边，飞行员继续向南飞行4英里后，右转至西南航向。派珀飞行员联系本场管制员，报告位于机场以北10英里处。本场管制员指示派珀进入左三边。随后，管制员注意到两个目视飞行规则雷达目标彼此接近。他误以为向西南飞行的目标是一架目视飞行规则直升机，而实际上那是塞斯纳；他又向南行航空器通报了冲突交通，以为该航空器是塞斯纳，实际上却是派珀，而塞斯纳飞行员确认收到了这份交通通报。41秒后，派珀飞行员通知本场管制员两机已经相撞，并宣布紧急状态。（161词）

cards.audioText: On August 15, 2006, a runway incursion occurred at Los Angeles International Airport, California. Japan air 4421 landed on runway 22R and exited at taxiway Y then changed to ground control frequency without authorization. The airplane was holding between the parallel runways. Meanwhile, the tower controller cleared Qantas180 for takeoff from runway 22L. The pilot of Japan air 4421 contacted ground control and said, "Ground, Japan air 4421 with you on taxiway yankee for gate 35. " The ground controller believed that the aircraft has crossed runway 22L and responded, " Japan air 4421, Los Angeles tower, taxi via taxiway echo to the gate. " Ten seconds later, the pilot of Japan air 4421 confirmed whether they were cleared to cross runway 22L. The ground controller then realized that Japan air 4421 had not been instructed to cross runway 22L and told Japan air 4421 to stop. The two aircraft missed colliding by 37 feet as Qantas180 departed runway 22L.(154 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 2006年8月15日，美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶国际机场发生一起跑道侵入事件。日本航空4421号航班在22R跑道着陆，经Y滑行道脱离后，未经许可便转换到地面管制频率。飞机停在两条平行跑道之间。与此同时，塔台管制员许可澳洲航空180号航班从22L跑道起飞。日本航空4421号航班飞行员联系地面管制并说：“地面，日本航空4421，在Y滑行道，前往35号登机口。”地面管制员以为飞机已经穿越22L跑道，回答：“日本航空4421，洛杉矶塔台，经E滑行道滑往登机口。”十秒后，日本航空4421号航班飞行员确认他们是否获准穿越22L跑道。此时地面管制员才意识到，日本航空4421号航班并未得到穿越22L跑道的指令，于是指示其停止。澳洲航空180号航班从22L跑道起飞时，两架飞机仅以37英尺的间隔避免相撞。（154词）

cards.audioText: The Flight 004 was a scheduled passenger flight from Hong Kong to Sydney with an en route stop in Bangkok, Thailand. The flight departed Bangkok at 1602 hours on May 26, 1991 for the final flight sector to Sydney. All pre-flight, ground, and flight operations appear routine until five minutes after the cockpit voice recorder recorded the sounds of engine power being advanced for takeoff. The crew discussed this alert for several minutes. The Quick Reference Handbook was consulted to determine appropriate crew actions in response to the alert. No actions were required. Ten minutes into the flight the co-pilot advised the captain of the need for rudder trim to the left. The pilot-in-command acknowledged the co-pilot's statement. Fifteen seconds later the CVR recording ended with multiple sounds thought to be structural breakup. The airplane crashed in mountainous jungle terrain at approximately 1617 hours. 10 crew member and 213 passengers were killed. (153 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 004号航班是一班从香港飞往悉尼、途中经停泰国曼谷的定期客运航班。1991年5月26日16时02分，航班从曼谷起飞，执行前往悉尼的最后一个航段。起飞前、地面和飞行操作看起来一直正常，直到驾驶舱话音记录器记录到发动机加大推力起飞的声音五分钟后。机组围绕这一警报讨论了几分钟，并查阅《快速检查单手册》，以确定针对该警报应采取的适当措施；检查结果显示无需采取任何行动。飞行十分钟后，副驾驶告知机长需要向左配平方向舵，机长确认了副驾驶的报告。15秒后，驾驶舱话音记录器的录音在多次疑似结构解体的声响中终止。飞机于大约16时17分坠毁在山地丛林中，10名机组人员和213名乘客全部遇难。（153词）

cards.audioText: The incident occurred on 22 October 2005. An Airbus 319 was operating a scheduled passenger flight from London to Paris. As the aircraft climbed to FL 200 at night, there was a major electrical failure. This resulted in the loss of some important aircraft systems. The crew reported that both the captain's and co-pilot's PFDs and NDs didn't work, nor did the upper ECAM display. The autopilot and autothrust systems disconnected, the VHF radio and intercom were inoperative and most of the cockpit lighting went off. The captain maintained control of the aircraft with standby instruments. The co-pilot carried out the abnormal checklist actions which appeared on the lower ECAM display, the only available electronic flight display in the aircraft. Most of the affected systems were restored after about 90 seconds, when the co-pilot selected the AC Essential Feed switch to Alternate. There were no injuries to any of the 76 passengers or 6 crew. (152 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 该事件发生于2005年10月22日。一架空客A319正在执行从伦敦飞往巴黎的定期客运航班。飞机夜间爬升至FL200时，发生严重电气故障，导致部分重要机载系统失效。机组报告称，机长和副驾驶的主飞行显示器（PFD）及导航显示器（ND）均不工作，上部ECAM显示器也失效。自动驾驶和自动推力系统断开，甚高频（VHF）无线电和内话系统无法使用，驾驶舱内大部分照明熄灭。机长依靠备用仪表保持对飞机的控制。副驾驶按照下部ECAM显示器上出现的非正常检查单执行操作；这是飞机当时唯一可用的电子飞行显示器。大约90秒后，副驾驶将交流基本汇流条供电开关选择至备用位，大多数受影响的系统恢复。机上76名乘客和6名机组人员均未受伤。（152词）

cards.audioText: On July 13, 2003, Air Sunshine Airlines, a Cessna was ditched in the Atlantic Ocean following the in-flight failure of the right engine. Four of the nine passengers sustained no injuries, three passengers and the pilot sustained minor injuries, and one adult and one child passenger died after they evacuated the airplane. The airplane sustained substantial damage. The airplane was being operated as a scheduled international passenger commuter flight from F Hollywood International Airport, Florida, to MYAT. Visual meteorological conditions prevailed for the flight, which operated on a visual flight rules flight plan. The National Transportation Safety Board determines that the probable cause of this accident was the in-flight failure of the right engine and the pilot's failure to adequately manage the airplane's performance after the engine failed. The right engine failure resulted from inadequate maintenance that was performed by Air Sunshine's maintenance personnel.
cards.audioTextZh: 2003年7月13日，阳光航空一架塞斯纳飞机因右发动机在飞行中失效，迫降于大西洋。9名乘客中有4人未受伤，3名乘客和飞行员轻伤，1名成人和1名儿童乘客在撤离飞机后死亡。飞机严重受损。该机当时正在执行从佛罗里达州F好莱坞国际机场飞往MYAT的定期国际通勤客运航班。航班在目视气象条件下运行，并按目视飞行规则飞行计划飞行。美国国家运输安全委员会认定，这起事故的可能原因是右发动机在飞行中失效，以及发动机失效后飞行员未能妥善管理飞机性能。右发动机失效源于阳光航空维修人员实施的维修不当。

cards.audioText: On November 22, 2004, a Gulf-stream airlines aircraft struck a light pole and crashed about 3 miles southwest of Hobby Airport, Houston, Texas, while on an instrument landing system approach to runway 4. The two pilots and the flight attendant were killed, an individual in a vehicle near the airport received minor injuries, and the airplane was destroyed by impact forces. The airplane was being operated on an instrument flight rules flight plan. Instrument meteorological conditions (IMC) prevailed at the time of the accident. The accident flight was scheduled to depart from Dallas Airport. The flight crew planned to pick up former President George Bush and other passengers at Houston. The flight was scheduled to depart HOU about 0654. The flight departed Dallas Airport about 0530, the departure was delayed because of poor weather conditions at DAL. The captain was the flying pilot, and the first officer performed the non-flying pilot duties. Before flight the flight crew received ATIS information "Quebec," which reported that the winds were calm, the visibility was low in fog, and the clouds were broken at 100 feet and overcast at 9, 000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 2004年11月22日，湾流航空一架飞机在仪表着陆系统进近休斯敦霍比机场4号跑道时，撞上一根灯杆，并在机场西南约3英里处坠毁。两名飞行员和一名乘务员遇难，机场附近一辆汽车中的一人轻伤，飞机因撞击力完全损毁。该机按照仪表飞行规则飞行计划运行，事故发生时为仪表气象条件（IMC）。事故航班原计划从达拉斯机场起飞，机组计划在休斯敦接前总统乔治·布什及其他乘客。该航班计划于大约06时54分从HOU起飞。航班约于05时30分离开达拉斯机场；由于DAL天气不佳，起飞受到延误。机长担任操纵飞行员，副驾驶承担非操纵飞行员职责。飞行前，机组收到了代号为“Quebec”的自动终端情报服务（ATIS）信息，其中报告风平静、雾中能见度低、云层在100英尺处为多云、在9000英尺处为阴天。

cards.audioText: On March 23 1994 the aircraft named Glinka, after the father of Russian music, was flying from Moscow to Hong Kong. There were sixty-three passengers with twelve crew members on board. The aircraft crashed after a captain allowed his child to manipulate the controls of the plane. The pilot's 11 year old daughter and 16 year old son were taking turns in the pilot's seat. While the boy was flying, the captain inadvertently disengaged the autopilot linkage to the ailerons and put the airliner in a bank of 90 degrees which caused the nose to drop sharply. The co-pilot pulled back on the yoke to obtain level flight but the plane stalled. With his seat pulled all the way back, the co-pilot in the right hand seat could not properly control the aircraft. After several stalls and rapid pull-ups the plane went into a spiral descent. In the end, the co-pilot initiated a pull-up and nearly regained a stable flight path but the aircraft struck the ground in an almost level attitude killing all 75 aboard.
cards.audioTextZh: 1994年3月23日，以俄罗斯音乐之父命名的“格林卡”号飞机正从莫斯科飞往香港，机上有63名乘客和12名机组人员。事故发生前，机长允许自己的孩子操纵飞机。机长11岁的女儿和16岁的儿子轮流坐在飞行员座椅上。男孩操纵飞机时，机长无意中断开了自动驾驶仪与副翼的连接，使客机形成90度坡度，导致机头急剧下沉。副驾驶向后拉驾驶盘试图恢复平飞，但飞机发生失速。由于座椅被调到最靠后位置，坐在右座的副驾驶无法正确操纵飞机。经过数次失速和快速拉起后，飞机进入螺旋下降。最后，副驾驶开始拉起并几乎恢复了稳定航迹，但飞机以接近水平的姿态撞击地面，机上75人全部遇难。

cards.audioText: On June 10 1990 there was a flight from Birmingham, England to Malaga, Spain, when the aircraft was flying at FL 173, a large section of windshield fell away from the aircraft. The decompression pulled the captain out from under his seatbelt. Despite trying to hold onto the yoke, the captain was sucked out into the opening. He was in an immediate danger. A steward in the cockpit was fortunately able to grab hold of his legs. Another steward was able to strap him into the vacant seat and aid in holding onto the captain's legs. The copilot wearing full restraints made an emergency landing at Southampton. The captain remained half way out of the aircraft for 15 minutes and suffered only frostbite and some fractures. Improper bolts used to replace the windshield two days earlier resulted in the accident.
cards.audioTextZh: 1990年6月10日，一架飞机执行从英国伯明翰飞往西班牙马拉加的航班。当飞机在FL173飞行时，一大块风挡从飞机上脱落。失压将机长从安全带下方向外拉出。尽管机长试图抓住驾驶盘，他还是被吸出风挡开口，立即陷入危险。幸运的是，驾驶舱内一名乘务员抓住了机长的双腿。另一名乘务员将自己固定在空座椅上，协助抓住机长双腿。系着全套安全带的副驾驶在南安普敦实施了紧急着陆。机长身体有一半悬在飞机外长达15分钟，最终仅遭受冻伤和部分骨折。事故原因是两天前更换风挡时使用了不合适的螺栓。

cards.audioText: On August 14, 2005 at approximately 12:00 p.m local Greek time, a Boeing 737-300, crashed into rolling terrain northeast of Athens, Greece. The aircraft had departed Larnaka Airport, Cyprus, two hours and 57 minutes prior to the accident. According to the investigation, during climb-out as the aircraft passed 12, 000 feet, the cabin altitude warning horn sounded. The captain then began radio communications with his company maintenance base at Larnaka. The aircraft was on autopilot at the time and followed its FMCS inserted route. It subsequently entered the missed approach holding pattern. Two Air Force F-16 fighter aircraft intercepted the aircraft emergency call and one of the pilots noticed that the captain's seat was empty and the first officer's seat was occupied by an incapacitated person. Shortly thereafter, one person was seen to enter the cockpit wearing an oxygen mask. After 1 hour and 12 minutes in the holding pattern the left engine flamed out due to fuel starvation and 10 minutes later the right engine also flamed out. The cabin altitude warning horn subsequently stopped sounding after the aircraft later descended below 10, 000 feet during its final descent. Greek authorities suggested the failure of pressurization in the aircraft may have caused the crash when they ruled out a terrorist attack.
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年8月14日希腊当地时间大约12时，一架波音737-300在希腊雅典东北部起伏地带坠毁。事故发生前2小时57分，飞机从塞浦路斯拉纳卡机场起飞。调查显示，飞机起飞爬升通过12000英尺时，座舱高度警告喇叭响起。机长随后开始通过无线电与拉纳卡的公司维修基地通信。当时飞机由自动驾驶操纵，并按照飞行管理计算机系统（FMCS）中输入的航路飞行，随后进入复飞等待航线。两架空军F-16战斗机对该机实施拦截，其中一名飞行员注意到机长座椅无人，副驾驶座椅上坐着一名已经失去行动能力的人。不久后，有人被看到戴着氧气面罩进入驾驶舱。飞机在等待航线飞行1小时12分钟后，左发动机因燃油耗尽而熄火；10分钟后，右发动机也熄火。此后飞机在最后下降过程中降至10000英尺以下，座舱高度警告喇叭随即停止鸣响。希腊当局排除恐怖袭击后认为，飞机增压失效可能导致了这起坠机事故。

cards.audioText: The flight departed Peachtree Airport, moments later the pilot radioed that the airplane had a landing gear problem, and there was smoke in the cockpit. The pilot was instructed to enter visual traffic for Runway 2R. Once the airplane was in the traffic pattern, the controller told the pilot that it appeared that the landing gear was extended, and cleared the flight to land. As the airplane neared touchdown the controller told the pilot that the landing gear was not down and locked, and then instructed the pilot to go - around. As the pilot maneuvered the airplane for a landing on runway 27, the pilot was again instructed to go around. Seconds later the aircraft touched down in a grassy area the approach ends of runways 2R. Examination of the airplane disclosed that the airplane had sustained extensive fire damage to the floor area beneath the pilot's seat. The examination revealed that a flex hydraulic fluid supply line was missing, and there had been electrical arcing in the immediate vicinity of the hot spot. The National Transportation Safety Board determines the probable cause(s) of this accident as follows: The failure of the flex hydraulic line and the chaffing of an electrical line under the pilot seat that resulted in an in-flight fire.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机从桃树机场起飞。不久后，飞行员通过无线电报告飞机出现起落架故障，驾驶舱内有烟雾。管制员指示飞行员加入2R跑道的目视起落航线。飞机进入起落航线后，管制员告诉飞行员，起落架看起来已经放出，并许可航班着陆。飞机接近接地时，管制员又告知飞行员起落架并未放下锁定，随后指示其复飞。飞行员操纵飞机准备在27号跑道着陆时，再次被指示复飞。数秒后，飞机在2R跑道进近端附近的一片草地上接地。对飞机的检查发现，飞行员座椅下方地板区域遭受严重火灾损坏。检查还发现，一根柔性液压油供油管缺失，热点附近存在电弧痕迹。美国国家运输安全委员会认定，这起事故的可能原因是柔性液压管路失效，以及飞行员座椅下方一根电线磨损，从而引发空中火灾。

cards.audioText: On 18 August 2006, a Boeing 747 aircraft, with a crew of 18 and 243 passengers departed Hong Kong, China, on a scheduled passenger service to Melbourne, Australia. While in cruise, one of the cabin crew notified the flight crew that there was a smell of fuel in the first class cabin. One of the pilots verified the fuel smell and then proceeded to inspect the engines from the cabin windows. A fluid trail was evident from the rear of the number-3 engine. During this time, it was noted by the other pilots that the number-3 engine had a higher than normal fuel flow. The flight crew conducted an in-flight shut down of the number-3 engine and diverted the aircraft to Darwin. A subsequent inspection of the number-3 engine revealed the fuel manifold return line had fractured, causing a fuel leak. The fuel line was replaced and the aircraft was returned to service. In 2005, the ATSB investigated two other fuel manifold return line fractures, from the same engine type, under similar circumstances.
cards.audioTextZh: 2006年8月18日，一架波音747载有18名机组人员和243名乘客，从中国香港起飞，执行前往澳大利亚墨尔本的定期客运航班。巡航期间，一名客舱机组人员通知飞行机组，头等舱内有燃油气味。一名飞行员确认存在燃油气味，随后从客舱舷窗检查发动机。3号发动机后部有明显液体流痕；与此同时，其他飞行员注意到3号发动机的燃油流量高于正常值。机组在飞行中关闭3号发动机，并将飞机备降至达尔文。后续检查发现，3号发动机的燃油总管回油管断裂，造成燃油泄漏。更换燃油管后，飞机恢复运行。2005年，澳大利亚运输安全局（ATSB）还调查过同型发动机在类似情况下发生的另外两起燃油总管回油管断裂事件。

cards.audioText: On 18 January 2005, a Beech aircraft sustained damage when its main landing gear collapsed during touchdown on runway 24 at Perth Airport, WA. The aircraft had earlier departed the aerodrome on a charter flight with one pilot and seven passengers on board. Shortly after takeoff, the pilot selected the landing gear up and subsequently observed that the red 'gear-in-transit' warning light remained illuminated. An aerodrome controller noticed that the aircraft's landing gear did not retract and passed that information to the departures controller. The departures controller cleared the pilot to climb to 4, 000 ft and provided radar vectors to a suitable area where the pilot could complete troubleshooting of the aircraft systems. The pilot completed the checklist actions in an attempt to manually extend the landing gear. However, the green 'gear down' indicator lights did not illuminate The pilot returned to Perth Airport and conducted a fly-past of the aerodrome control tower and maintenance facility at an altitude of about 500 ft. Engineer and air traffic control witnesses to that flypast indicated to the pilot that the landing gear appeared to be in the extended position. During the subsequent landing, the right main landing gear collapsed and retracted into the wheel well. The left main landing gear partially retracted into the wheel well and the nose gear remained extended. The right engine nacelle fuel tank was punctured, requiring removal of the remaining fuel in that tank prior to the aircraft's removal from the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年1月18日，一架比奇飞机在西澳大利亚州珀斯机场24号跑道接地时，主起落架折叠，飞机受损。此前，该机载有1名飞行员和7名乘客，从该机场起飞执行包机航班。起飞后不久，飞行员选择收起起落架，随后观察到红色“起落架转换中”警告灯持续亮起。一名机场管制员注意到飞机起落架没有收上，并将该信息告知离场管制员。离场管制员许可飞行员爬升至4000英尺，并用雷达引导飞机前往合适区域，以便飞行员排查机载系统故障。飞行员按照检查单操作，尝试人工放出起落架，但绿色“起落架放下”指示灯没有亮起。飞行员返回珀斯机场，并以大约500英尺高度飞越机场管制塔台和维修设施。工程人员和空中交通管制目击者在飞机通场后告知飞行员，起落架看起来处于放出位置。随后着陆时，右主起落架折叠并收入轮舱，左主起落架部分收入轮舱，前起落架则保持放出。右发动机短舱燃油箱被刺穿，因此在将飞机移出跑道前，必须先抽走该油箱内的剩余燃油。

cards.audioText: The Scott Aviation aircraft with two crew members and four passengers on board, took off from Montréal, Quebec, for a night instrument flight rules flight to Bromont, Quebec. Upon approaching Bromont, the co-pilot activated the lighting system and contacted the approach. The flight crew was advised that the runway edge lights were out of order. However, the approach lights and the visual approach slope indicator did turn on. The flight crew executed the approach, and the aircraft touched down at 300 feet to the left of Runway 05L and 1800 feet beyond the threshold. It continued on its course for a distance of approximately 1800 feet before coming to a stop in a ditch. The crew tried to stop the engines, but the left engine did not stop. The co-pilot entered the cabin to direct the evacuation. One of the passengers tried to open the emergency exit door, but was unsuccessful. All of the aircraft's occupants exited through the main entrance door. Both pilots and one passenger sustained serious injuries, and the three remaining passengers received minor injuries. The aircraft suffered major damage.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架斯科特航空公司的飞机载有2名机组人员和4名乘客，从魁北克省蒙特利尔起飞，执行前往魁北克省布罗蒙的夜间仪表飞行规则航班。接近布罗蒙时，副驾驶启动了灯光系统并联系进近管制。机组被告知跑道边灯故障，但进近灯和目视进近坡度指示器确实已经点亮。机组实施进近，飞机在05L跑道左侧300英尺、越过跑道入口1800英尺的位置接地。飞机沿原方向继续滑行约1800英尺后，停在一条沟中。机组试图关闭发动机，但左发动机没有停车。副驾驶进入客舱指挥撤离。一名乘客尝试打开应急出口门，但未能成功。机上所有人员最终都通过主入口舱门撤离。两名飞行员和一名乘客严重受伤，其余三名乘客轻伤，飞机严重受损。

cards.audioText: A witness reported that he observed the aircraft taxi to the eastern end of the runway and commence the take-off roll but lost sight of the aircraft as it moved along the runway. The pilot stated that the take-off roll was from a rolling start with power being slowly applied until engine output stabilized. At about 90 kts indicated air speed, the pilot attempted to rotate the aircraft but encountered resistance to rearward movement of the control column. He decided to reject the takeoff because the aircraft speed at the time was below his nominated decision speed of 100 kts. The pilot reported that he then reduced the engine power to idle and applied maximum braking. The aircraft overran the runway, passed through the airport boundary fence, continued across a public road, and passed through another fence before coming to a stop 162 m beyond the end of the runway. An inspection of the runway revealed a skid mark from the aircraft's right tire, which commenced 65 m before the end of the runway. After the aircraft came to a stop, the pilot exited the aircraft via the crew door, assisted the passengers to evacuate the aircraft through the rear cabin door and marshalled them to an area away from the aircraft. A passenger then used a mobile phone to contact emergency services, who attended the scene soon after.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名目击者报告称，他看到飞机滑行至跑道东端并开始起飞滑跑，但飞机沿跑道移动后便离开了他的视线。飞行员表示，飞机以滑行中不停顿的方式开始起飞滑跑，发动机功率逐渐增加，直至输出稳定。在指示空速约90节时，飞行员尝试抬前轮，却发现驾驶盘向后移动受到阻力。由于当时飞机速度低于其设定的100节决断速度，他决定中断起飞。飞行员报告称，他随后将发动机功率减至慢车并实施最大制动。飞机冲出跑道，穿过机场边界围栏，继续越过一条公共道路，再穿过另一道围栏，最终停在跑道末端以外162米处。对跑道的检查发现了飞机右轮留下的刹车痕迹，痕迹从距跑道末端65米处开始。飞机停稳后，飞行员经机组舱门离机，协助乘客通过后客舱门撤离，并将他们引导至远离飞机的区域。一名乘客随后使用手机联系应急服务部门，救援人员很快赶到现场。

cards.audioText: A Boeing 737-200 was scheduled to operate a regular public transport flight from Hobart to Sydney on 17 May 2005 departing at 0600 Eastern Standard Time with 6 crew members and 26 passengers. During the starting of the right engine, the aircraft dispatcher informed the flight crew that there was smoke and sparks shooting from the right engine and advised to get everyone off. The pilot in command called for an emergency evacuation without initiating the Passenger Evacuation Checklist. As a result, the wing flaps were not set to the extended position and the tail section of the aircraft was dark without emergency lighting while passengers were exiting the aircraft. The forward Door Right 1 escape slide fell to the ground un-inflated when the door was opened. A number of ground personnel ran to the front of the aircraft and helped 22 passengers off the forward Door Left 1 slide and directed them towards the terminal. Four passengers exited by the Door 2 slide at the rear of the aircraft and ran into the middle of the apron. The over-wing exits were not opened. The aircraft's dispatcher had not received any education in emergency communications with flight crew nor aircraft evacuations at the terminal. The reported smoke and sparks was a result of the right engine air turbine starter failing during the engine start sequence.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架波音737-200计划于2005年5月17日澳大利亚东部标准时间06时00分从霍巴特起飞，执行前往悉尼的定期公共运输航班，机上有6名机组人员和26名乘客。右发动机启动期间，飞机签派员通知飞行机组，右发动机喷出烟雾和火花，并建议让所有人员撤离。机长没有启动《旅客撤离检查单》，便下令紧急撤离。因此，在乘客撤离时，机翼襟翼没有设置到放出位置，飞机尾部一片黑暗，应急照明也未点亮。前部右1号舱门打开时，其逃生滑梯未充气便落到地面。多名地面人员跑到飞机前部，帮助22名乘客从前部左1号舱门滑梯撤离，并引导他们前往航站楼。4名乘客从飞机后部2号舱门滑梯撤离后，跑到了机坪中央。翼上应急出口没有打开。飞机签派员此前没有接受过关于与飞行机组进行应急通信或在航站区实施飞机撤离的任何培训。报告的烟雾和火花是右发动机空气涡轮起动机在发动机启动过程中发生故障造成的。

cards.audioText: The DC-10 aircraft was flying from Kingston to Toronto Airport. The aircraft departed Kingston at 1400 Eastern Standard Time with the first office designated as the pilot flying. During the initial climb following take-off, the first officer noted that abnormal forward pressure on the control column was required to keep the aircraft from pitching nose up. To counter the pitch-up, he trimmed the aircraft nose down. Thirty seconds after becoming airborne, the aircraft was 350 feet above ground level and the first officer had applied full nose-down trim. The amount of forward pressure on the control column continued to increase as the aircraft accelerated, and the first officer notified the captain of the control difficulties and requested his assistance in holding the control column forward. As the aircraft climbed, the captain declared an emergency, indicating that they were experiencing control difficulties and that the aircraft may have to land nearby. The flight crew leveled the aircraft at 4000 feet on the sea level and pulled the elevator pitch disconnect handle, isolating the left and right elevators. The captain's elevator control functioned normally after the disconnection, and he decided to continue the flight. The flight crew conducted a flapless landing at Toronto without further incident. When the aircraft was inspected after landing, the right-side elevator spring tab was jammed in the trailing-edge-down position.
cards.audioTextZh: 这架DC-10正在从金斯敦飞往多伦多机场。飞机于东部标准时间14时00分从金斯敦起飞，由副驾驶担任操纵飞行员。起飞后的初始爬升期间，副驾驶发现，为防止飞机机头上仰，必须对驾驶盘施加异常的向前压力。为抵消上仰趋势，他将飞机配平至机头向下。离地30秒后，飞机位于距地面350英尺高度，副驾驶已使用全部机头向下配平。随着飞机加速，驾驶盘所需的向前压力继续增大，副驾驶将操纵困难告知机长，并请求机长协助向前稳住驾驶盘。飞机继续爬升时，机长宣布紧急状态，称飞机存在操纵困难，可能需要在附近着陆。机组在海拔4000英尺处改平飞机，并拉动升降舵俯仰断开手柄，将左右升降舵隔离。断开后，机长一侧的升降舵操纵恢复正常，他决定继续飞行。机组最终在多伦多实施无襟翼着陆，未再发生其他事件。飞机着陆后接受检查时，发现右侧升降舵弹簧调整片卡在后缘向下位置。

cards.audioText: June 21, 2002 FAA reminds all pilots to be particularly alert in their own flight preparations as well as activities at their local airports. This week incident with the Cessna 182, which is flying into restricted airspace in Washington, D.C. clearly indicates that flight preparation is more important than ever. The C-182 was intercepted by military aircraft after inadvertently straying into the restricted airspace while attempting to avoid bad weather. Before taking off, the pilots should contact FAA Flight Service to receive the latest information; know and understand all applicable NOTAMs, and know where the Temporary Flight Restrictions are. Also maintain high vigilance at local airports, report suspicious activities to local authorities, and take the time to secure the airplane before you leave. It is critical that pilots continue to use the highest levels of preparation, responsibility and judgment, and that they encourage others to do so as well.
cards.audioTextZh: 2002年6月21日，美国联邦航空局（FAA）提醒所有飞行员，在准备自身飞行以及参与本地机场活动时都要保持特别警惕。本周一架塞斯纳182误入华盛顿特区限制空域的事件清楚表明，飞行准备比以往任何时候都更加重要。该C-182在试图避开恶劣天气时无意中偏入限制空域，随后遭到军机拦截。起飞前，飞行员应联系FAA飞行服务部门获取最新信息；了解并理解所有适用的航行通告（NOTAM），并掌握临时飞行限制区的位置。此外，在本地机场也应保持高度警惕，向当地有关部门报告可疑活动，并在离开前花时间确保飞机得到妥善锁闭。飞行员继续保持最高水平的准备、责任心和判断力，并鼓励其他人也这样做，至关重要。

cards.audioText: On 25 July 2005, a Piper Aircraft Corporation's aircraft overran runway 27 at Nhill aerodrome following a rejected night takeoff. The aircraft was being operated on an instrument flight rules charter flight to Charlton, with the pilot and three passengers on board. The pilot reported that, during the pre-flight preparation he set the elevator trim to the take-off position by winding the trim wheel. The pilot recalled removing the lock from the control column prior to starting the engines for departure. The operator's Operations Manual included a series of checklists to be used during operation of the aircraft. The 'Start Up' and 'Pre takeoff' checklists included checking full and free movement of the flight controls. The pilot stated that the take-off roll was from a rolling start with power being slowly applied until engine output stabilized. At about 90 kts indicated air speed, the pilot attempted to rotate the aircraft but encountered resistance to rearward movement of the control column. He decided to reject the takeoff because the aircraft speed at the time was below his nominated decision speed of 100 kts. The pilot then reduced the engine power to idle and applied maximum braking. After the aircraft came to a stop160 m beyond the end of the runway, the pilot exited the aircraft via the crew door, assisted the passengers to evacuate the aircraft through the rear cabin door and marshalled them to an area away from the aircraft. A passenger then used a mobile phone to contact emergency services, who attended the scene soon after.
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年7月25日，派珀飞机公司的一架飞机在尼尔机场夜间中断起飞后冲出27号跑道。该机当时执行前往查尔顿的仪表飞行规则包机航班，机上有1名飞行员和3名乘客。飞行员报告称，飞行前准备期间，他通过转动配平轮将升降舵配平设置到起飞位置。飞行员记得在启动发动机离场前，已从驾驶盘上取下操纵锁。运营人的《运行手册》包含飞机运行期间应使用的一系列检查单，其中“启动”和“起飞前”检查单都要求检查飞行操纵装置是否能够全行程自由活动。飞行员表示，飞机以滑行中不停顿的方式开始起飞滑跑，发动机功率逐渐增加，直至输出稳定。在指示空速约90节时，飞行员尝试抬前轮，却发现驾驶盘向后移动受到阻力。由于当时飞机速度低于其设定的100节决断速度，他决定中断起飞。随后，飞行员将发动机功率减至慢车并实施最大制动。飞机最终停在跑道末端以外160米处。飞行员经机组舱门离机，协助乘客通过后客舱门撤离，并将他们引导至远离飞机的区域。一名乘客随后使用手机联系应急服务部门，救援人员很快赶到现场。

cards.audioText: on october 14, 2005, flight 522 crushed on the ground with running out of fuel cost 121 people on board killed include both captain and the first officer. Before the air crash, there were two fighters followed the aircraft. However, they didn't find any fire or smoke from the site, only to see someone waving his hand in the cockpit. After the investigation, it proves that both the pilot in command in the copilot both faint due to hypoxia, and it was the attendant who was trying to save the airplane in the cockpit. The engineer also find that the compression switch was turned to manual position because the maintain staff failed to finish his work. It is clear that the continual decompression and human error caused this accident
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年10月14日，522号航班因燃油耗尽坠毁在地面，机上121人全部遇难，包括机长和副驾驶。坠机前，有两架战斗机跟随该机飞行。然而，战斗机飞行员没有发现飞机上有任何火焰或烟雾，只看到驾驶舱内有人挥手。调查证明，机长和副驾驶都因缺氧昏迷，驾驶舱内试图挽救飞机的人是一名乘务员。工程人员还发现，由于维修人员未能完成工作，增压选择开关被置于人工位。显然，持续失压和人为错误共同导致了这起事故。

cards.audioText: On Oct 2nd 2010, two aircraft with similar callsign caused an unsafe situation. CCA102 was instructed to dove to 2700 meters by controller when approaching destination airport. Meanwhile, CCA101 was descending to 3000 meters when he first had radio contact with controller. Later on, the controller asked CCA102 to continue descent to 1800 meters, but got readback with loud noise. A few minutes later, he noticed that CCA101 was passing 2700 meters and seemed to continue. Simultaneously, there was an aircraft levelling at 2400 meters in opposite direction. The controller stopped CCA101 descending, but the TCAS still sounded alarm. Investigator found it was because CCA101 mistakenly executed descent instruction and controller didn't find the differential in frequency noise.
cards.audioTextZh: 2010年10月2日，两架呼号相近的飞机导致了一起不安全事件。CCA102接近目的地机场时，管制员指示其下降至2700米。与此同时，CCA101首次与管制员建立无线电联系时，正在下降至3000米。随后，管制员要求CCA102继续下降至1800米，但收到的复诵伴有很强的噪声。几分钟后，管制员注意到CCA101正通过2700米并且似乎仍在继续下降。与此同时，相反方向有一架飞机正在2400米改平。管制员制止CCA101继续下降，但TCAS仍然发出了警报。调查人员发现，事故原因是CCA101错误执行了下降指令，而管制员没有从频率噪声中发现复诵内容的差异。

cards.audioText: A runway incursion occurred at Sydeny airport on Tuesday. CSN321, bound for London, was holding short of runway. Meanwhile, JAL578 was on long final for landing. After receiving reports from both flight, the tower controller asked CSN321 to line up and wait after the JAL578 landing. At that time, the radio communication broke down. The rear part of instruction was interrupted by static noise. The pilot of CSN321 misunderstood that he was cleared for departure, and then lined up. The tower controller identified the potential danger. Without hesitation, he instructed JAL578 to pull up immediately and initiate go-around in an attempt to avoid collision. The two aircraft missed colliding by only 100 feet. The subsequent investigation revealed the improper syntax of the controller's instruction was one of contributors to such incident.
cards.audioTextZh: 星期二，悉尼机场发生一起跑道侵入事件。飞往伦敦的CSN321正在跑道外等待，与此同时，JAL578正在远距离最后进近。收到两个航班的报告后，塔台管制员要求CSN321在JAL578着陆后进跑道对正并等待。此时，无线电通信出现故障，指令的后半部分被静电噪声中断。CSN321飞行员误以为自己已获准起飞，随后进入跑道对正。塔台管制员发现了潜在危险，毫不犹豫地指示JAL578立即拉起并开始复飞，以避免相撞。两架飞机仅以100英尺的间隔避免碰撞。后续调查显示，管制员指令使用了不恰当的句法，这是导致该事件的因素之一。

cards.audioText: On Sep 15th 1995, DAL716 performed a scheduled flight with 105 tons of fuel. When he approached the destination airport, the controller instructed DAL716 to enter holding procedure due to traffic congestion. After three times of holding procedure, the controller told DAL716 that he was expected to continue holding for another 20 minutes. The pilot informed he could only hold for another 5 minutes because of fuel shortage, and intended to land as soon as possible. Upon receiving the request, the controller delivered landing clearance immediately. During the final approach, visibility got worse as a result of heavy shower. DAL716 had to execute missed approach. At last, this aircraft impacted hillside following fuel starvation. There were no survivors.
cards.audioTextZh: 1995年9月15日，DAL716执行一班定期航班，载有105吨燃油。接近目的地机场时，由于空中交通拥堵，管制员指示DAL716进入等待程序。完成三次等待后，管制员告知DAL716，预计还要继续等待20分钟。飞行员报告，由于燃油不足，他们最多只能再等待5分钟，并希望尽快着陆。收到请求后，管制员立即发布着陆许可。最后进近期间，受强阵雨影响，能见度进一步恶化，DAL716不得不实施复飞。最终，飞机因燃油耗尽撞上山坡，无人生还。

cards.audioText: On a sunny day in July, CCA101 departed from Nanjing bound for Los Angles. After takeoff, the pilot reported a passenger suffered acute pain in the heart area and requested return to land. However, they had to dump fuel before landing because of overweight. Upon receiving the request for fuel jettison, the controller instructed CCA101 to proceed to fuel dumping area with heading 060. After fuel dumping was completed, the pilot reported the sick passenger's situation got worse and had fainted. The crew informed their company of details. The dispatcher contacted pertinent airport authorities, and then advised flight crew to divert to Shanghai Pudong airport due to first-aid service supply. Afterwards, the pilot told ATC they intended to proceed to Shanghai Pudong airport. The controller coordinated with relevant units, and got landing permission to the flight. Finally, CCA101 landed safely on runway 35L, and the sick passenger was carried off on a stretcher.
cards.audioTextZh: 7月一个晴朗的日子，CCA101从南京起飞前往洛杉矶。起飞后，飞行员报告一名乘客心脏部位剧烈疼痛，并请求返场着陆。然而，由于飞机超重，他们必须在着陆前放油。收到放油请求后，管制员指示CCA101以航向060度飞往放油区。放油完成后，飞行员报告患病乘客的情况恶化，已经昏厥。机组将详细情况通知航空公司。签派员联系了相关机场部门，随后鉴于急救服务保障情况，建议机组备降上海浦东机场。之后，飞行员告知空中交通管制，他们计划飞往上海浦东机场。管制员与相关单位协调，并为该航班取得着陆许可。最终，CCA101安全降落在35L跑道，患病乘客由担架抬下飞机。

cards.audioText: One day, Flight 218 performed schedule flight carrying 108 passengers and 8 crew. When he was transferred to the Approach Control, two engines flamed out due to unexpected destructive weather caused by typhoon. The flight crew worked the contingency checklist immediately and decided to return to land. Unfortunately, most of their attempts were unsuccessful. The engines sustained severe damage beyond repair after all. Finally, Flight 218 plunged into ground before reaching the runway. 98 passengers including 2 Frenchmen were killed, and 10 passengers were badly injured. The airline set up an emergency center following this miserable tragedy. The subsequent investigation revealed that this aircraft had experienced around two hours delay due to bad weather before takeoff. When the weather trend looked promising, the flight crew insisted on departure in spite of ATC's suggestion. The airline exhausted all means to help the families of the victims. They also dispatched the expert squad for further investigation.
cards.audioTextZh: 一天，218号航班载有108名乘客和8名机组人员执行定期航班。该航班被移交给进近管制时，受台风造成的突发破坏性天气影响，两台发动机熄火。飞行机组立即执行应急检查单，并决定返场着陆。遗憾的是，他们的大部分尝试都没有成功，两台发动机最终遭受无法修复的严重损坏。218号航班在到达跑道前撞向地面。包括2名法国人在内的98名乘客遇难，另有10名乘客严重受伤。这场惨剧发生后，航空公司成立了应急中心。后续调查显示，由于天气恶劣，该机起飞前曾延误大约两小时。当天气趋势看起来有所好转时，尽管空中交通管制提出劝告，飞行机组仍坚持起飞。航空公司想尽一切办法帮助遇难者家属，并派出专家组开展进一步调查。

cards.audioText: On May 24th, United Airlines 126 departed from New York to Los Angeles with 85 souls on board. In the process of its climbout, the captain found the left engine thrust loss. Upon reaching 7000 feet, the port engine surge warning sounded. In the meantime, the crew requested to return. But they needed fuel dumping prior to land. During the fuel dumping process, the situation deteriorated. The captain heard a loud bang and the flight attendants saw flames coming out the front and the rear of the engine. Without any hesitation, the crew sent out a distress call and received clearance to make a forced landing. About two minutes later, the radar target of United Airlines 126 disappeared from the radar screen. The controllers tried their best to contact the crew. However, there was no reponse. Finally, the aircraft crashed into a densely populated residential area, killing all occupants except an infant. The contributor to the engine issue is still unveiled.
cards.audioTextZh: 5月24日，美联航126号航班载有85人，从纽约起飞前往洛杉矶。爬升过程中，机长发现左发动机推力下降。飞机到达7000英尺时，左发动机喘振警告响起。与此同时，机组请求返场，但必须在着陆前放油。放油期间，情况进一步恶化。机长听到一声巨响，乘务员看到火焰从发动机前后部喷出。机组毫不犹豫地发出遇险呼叫，并获得强迫着陆许可。大约两分钟后，美联航126号航班的雷达目标从雷达屏幕上消失。管制员竭尽全力联系机组，但没有收到回应。最终，飞机坠入人口稠密的居民区，除一名婴儿外，机上所有人员全部遇难。发动机问题的成因仍未查明。

cards.audioText: On May 17, 1986, two B747, Flight 1205 and Flight 1627 collided on the runway at Tenerife Airport killing 461 people, which is considered as the worst disaster in aviation history. A terrorist incident at another airport had caused many flights to be diverted to Tenerife Airport, including the two accident aircraft. The airport quickly became congested and forced departing aircraft to taxi on the runway instead. And the thick patches of fog also prevented aircraft and control tower from seeing each other. The collision occurred when Flight 1205 initiated its takeoff run while Flight 1627 was still on the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 1986年5月17日，两架B747——1205号航班和1627号航班——在特内里费机场跑道上相撞，造成461人死亡，被认为是航空史上最严重的灾难。另一座机场发生的恐怖事件导致许多航班备降特内里费机场，其中包括这两架事故飞机。机场很快变得拥堵，迫使离场飞机改在跑道上滑行。浓密的雾团也使飞机与管制塔台彼此无法看见。1205号航班开始起飞滑跑时，1627号航班仍在跑道上，碰撞由此发生。

cards.audioText: One day in 1998, an B747 collided with mountains and crashed 6 miles from the runway. After the accident, some authorities and organizations carried out investigations and managed to figure out the fatal reasons causing this disaster. One of the main reasons was the misunderstanding of the two words TWO and TO in communication between controller and the pilot. In the beginning, the controller instructed the pilot to "descend to two seven zero zero", and the pilot readback as "cleared to two thousand seven hundred". But later on, the controller gave the instruction as "Descend two four zero zero", and the pilot readback as "OK, four zero zero". That means, unfortunately, the pilot misunderstood "descend two four zero zero "as "descend to four zero zero". Finally, the aircraft crashed on the mountain during descending to 400 feet. According to this accident, standard phraseologies, readback and hear back play the key roles in communication between controller and pilot
cards.audioTextZh: 1998年的一天，一架B747撞山并坠毁在距跑道6英里处。事故发生后，一些主管部门和组织开展调查，并设法查明了造成这场灾难的致命原因。其中一个主要原因，是管制员与飞行员通信时对“TWO”和“TO”两个词产生了误解。起初，管制员指示飞行员“descend to two seven zero zero（下降至二七零零）”，飞行员复诵为“cleared to two thousand seven hundred（获准下降至二千七百）”。但后来，管制员发布指令“Descend two four zero zero（下降二四零零）”，飞行员却复诵为“OK, four zero zero（好的，四零零）”。这意味着，飞行员不幸将“descend two four zero zero”误解为“descend to four zero zero（下降至四零零）”。最终，飞机在下降至400英尺过程中撞山。该事故表明，标准通话用语、复诵与监听复诵在管制员和飞行员之间的通信中起着关键作用。

cards.audioText: On October 4th, 2010, International Flight 142 was cleared by ATC to follow the VOR/DME approach to runway 36L. But the captain decided to request for RNAV approach regardless of the fact that his aircraft was not equipped with mandatory navigation equipment (GNSS)required for RNAV approach. The Approach controller found the flight being right of track and asked cockpit crew to verify it. The Captain quickly asked first officer to tell the Approach that they were following RNAV procedure. Actually, the cockpit crew was carrying out VOR/DME approach. The captain kept flying the aircraft with no visual cues due to poor visibility. Increased stress level, loss of situational awareness and reduced mental ability caused the pilots flying low on approach with high speed. The aircraft bounced on the runway after touchdown and skidded off. All passengers were safely evacuated, but the aircraft wings and two engines sustained extensive damage after landing gears collapsed.
cards.audioTextZh: 2010年10月4日，空中交通管制许可国际航空142号航班按照VOR/DME进近程序飞向36L跑道。但机长无视飞机未配备RNAV进近所必需的导航设备（GNSS）这一事实，决定申请RNAV进近。进近管制员发现航班偏在航迹右侧，要求驾驶舱机组进行核实。机长立即让副驾驶告诉进近管制，他们正在按照RNAV程序飞行。实际上，驾驶舱机组正在执行VOR/DME进近。由于能见度不佳，机长在没有目视参照的情况下继续操纵飞机。压力水平上升、情景意识丧失和认知能力下降，导致飞行员以过高速度进行低高度进近。飞机接地后弹跳并冲出跑道。所有乘客均安全撤离，但起落架折断后，飞机机翼和两台发动机严重受损。

cards.audioText: On a cloudy day in July, a B737 departed from Guangzhou to Jinan via Hefei. When it was cruising at 7500 meters in Hefei controlled area, it encountered chronic decompression. The crew reported that there was a cabin altitude warning horn sound and the cabin pressure was dropping gradually. Considering the safety of passengers, the crew requested to descend immediately and land at local airport. However, there were a lot of flights below the Boeing 737 so that it was difficult for controller to give the descent instructions initially. Then Hefei Air Traffic Control Center cooperated with other relative units efficiently and requested maneuvering airspace from military. A few minutes later, controllers instructed the pilot to deviate to the west and descend, and then direct to Hefei airport. Finally, as the crew required, the Boeing 737 landed at Hefei Airport in 25 minutes without any injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 7月一个多云的日子，一架B737从广州起飞，经合肥飞往济南。当飞机在合肥管制区内以7500米高度巡航时，发生缓慢失压。机组报告座舱高度警告喇叭响起，座舱压力正逐渐下降。考虑到乘客安全，机组请求立即下降并在当地机场着陆。然而，B737下方有大量航班，管制员起初难以发布下降指令。随后，合肥空中交通管制中心与其他相关单位高效协作，并向军方申请机动空域。几分钟后，管制员指示飞行员向西偏航并下降，随后直飞合肥机场。最终，按照机组请求，这架B737在25分钟内降落合肥机场，没有人员受伤。

cards.audioText: On Saturday, June 14th, 1956, TWA Flight 201 departed from Los Angeles to Washington D.C. United Airlines Flight 718 left Los Angeles for Chicago. Both aircraft were initially assigned the same route, with the TWA aircraft climbing to 17000 feet and the United aircraft climbing to 21000 feet. About one hour later, the pilots of both aircraft requested that they intended to take short-cuts to their destination. Air traffic controllers routinely approved this route deviation. Then the two flights entered uncontrolled airspace and operated under VFR flight rules. When the pilots of both aircraft failed to make any additional position reports, an intensive ground and air search was begun. The wreckage of the two aircraft was eventually found scattered in a remote gorge. There were no survivors. According to the ensuing investigation, the underlying reason was that additional airways had not been developed due to insufficient funding during the previous decade. This midair collision finally persuaded the government to embark on massive ATC modernization plans
cards.audioTextZh: 1956年6月14日星期六，环球航空201号航班从洛杉矶起飞前往华盛顿特区；美联航718号航班则从洛杉矶飞往芝加哥。两架飞机最初被分配了同一条航路，环球航空飞机爬升至17000英尺，美联航飞机爬升至21000英尺。大约一小时后，两架飞机的飞行员都请求采用捷径飞往目的地，空中交通管制员按惯例批准了这一航路偏离。随后，两架航班进入非管制空域，按照目视飞行规则（VFR）运行。当两架飞机的飞行员均未再提交任何位置报告时，地面和空中随即展开大规模搜索。两架飞机的残骸最终被发现在一处偏远峡谷中，散落各处，无人生还。后续调查显示，根本原因是此前十年间资金不足，未能建设更多航路。这起空中相撞事故最终促使政府启动大规模空中交通管制现代化计划。

cards.audioText: One day, a B747 was flying over the Southeast of Asia, but there was a volcano located in Indonesia erupting thousands of kilometers away. The flight crew did not realize what would happen to them because there was no any abnormal indication on the weather radar screen. Suddenly, one of the four engines failed without any previous warning. The crew followed the checklist and tried to deal with it. however, the other three engines failed subsequently. So the flight crew decided immediately to divert to Indonesia. Fortunately, this B747 landed successfully in the poor visibility even without power. The investigation reported that this aircraft happened to run into the volcanic ash cloud and a large amount of volcanic ash had been ingested into power plant, which caused deformed blades and overheated engines.
cards.audioTextZh: 一天，一架B747正在东南亚上空飞行，而数千公里外印度尼西亚的一座火山正在喷发。由于气象雷达屏幕上没有任何异常显示，飞行机组没有意识到接下来会发生什么。突然，四台发动机中的一台在没有任何先兆的情况下失效。机组按照检查单进行处置，但其余三台发动机随后也相继失效。因此，飞行机组立即决定备降印度尼西亚。幸运的是，这架B747在能见度不佳且没有动力的情况下成功着陆。调查报告称，飞机恰好进入了火山灰云，大量火山灰被吸入发动机，导致叶片变形和发动机过热。

cards.audioText: On Aug 23rd 2018, a United Boeing 789, undertook scheduled flight from San Francisco to Singapore. This aircraft was climbing out of San Francisco's runway 28-right. When upon contacting departure the crew advised they had about 4 bird strikes on departure. The aircraft continued the climb, and was cleared to climb to flight level 340. However, they stopped the climb at flight level 300 advising they had a couple of bird strikes on departure and were consulting with the company and wanted to return to San Francisco. The crew advised they were concerned about the integrity of the airframe, since the bird strikes occurred when the flaps were down. The aircraft dumped fuel and landed safely back on San Francisco's runway 28- left about 80 minutes after departure. The aircraft vacated the runway and stopped for an inspection by emergency vehicles.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年8月23日，一架美联航波音789执行从旧金山飞往新加坡的定期航班。飞机从旧金山机场28右跑道起飞爬升。与离场管制建立联系后，机组报告起飞过程中大约遭遇了4次鸟击。飞机继续爬升，并获准爬升至FL340。不过，飞机在FL300停止爬升。机组报告起飞时遭遇了数次鸟击，正在与公司商议，并希望返回旧金山。由于鸟击发生时襟翼处于放下状态，机组担心机体结构的完整性。飞机随后放油，并于起飞约80分钟后安全返回旧金山机场，在28左跑道着陆。飞机脱离跑道后停下，由应急车辆对其进行检查。

cards.audioText: On Oct 14th 2018, a Xiamen Airlines Boeing 737, registration Bravo-5278, performed passenger transport flight from Chongqing to Lhasa with 88 people on board. He was descending towards Lhasa when the crew applied flaps, the flaps however became stuck. The crew aborted the approach. Due to the jammed position of the flaps the aircraft was no longer able to divert and was committed to land in Lhasa. The aircraft entered a hold to burn off fuel and prepare for a high speed landing. The runway length is 13, 120 feet, and the elevation is 11, 710 feet. The potential risk was that the aircraft highly likely would overrun the runway. Fortunately, the aircraft landed safely at a higher than normal speed about 45 minutes after aborting the first approach. The occurrence aircraft is still on the ground in Lhasa about 19 hours later.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年10月14日，一架注册号为Bravo-5278的厦门航空波音737执行重庆至拉萨的客运航班，机上共有88人。飞机向拉萨下降过程中，机组放襟翼时襟翼发生卡阻。机组中止进近。由于襟翼卡在当前位，飞机已无法改航，只能在拉萨着陆。飞机进入等待以消耗燃油，并为高速着陆作准备。跑道长13,120英尺，机场标高11,710英尺，潜在风险是飞机很可能冲出跑道。所幸，飞机在中止首次进近约45分钟后，以高于正常的速度安全着陆。事发约19小时后，该飞机仍停留在拉萨地面。

cards.audioText: On Oct 2nd 2018, an Interjet Airbus 320, undertook scheduled transport flight from Mexico City to Chetumal. This aircraft landed on Chetumal's runway 10 at 23:22 but temporarily veered right off the runway before returning onto the runway. Mexico's Aeronautical Inspection Board reported there were some injuries, there was unknown damage when the aircraft exited the runway to the right while landing on Chetumal's runway 10. Some stewardesses suffered minor bruises. Besides, one pregnant woman miscarried due to strong force of impact on board. The occurrence was rated a serious incident and is being investigated. The contributing factor hasn't yet been determined. The occurrence aircraft remained on the ground for about 7 hours until next morning before departing for the return flight 4-Yankee-2649 on schedule. According to the meteorological unit report, light snow over this airport lasted 8 hours until the incident happened.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年10月2日，一架因特捷特航空空客A320执行从墨西哥城飞往切图马尔的定期运输航班。飞机于23:22在切图马尔机场10号跑道着陆，但一度向右偏出跑道，随后又回到跑道上。墨西哥航空调查委员会报告称，飞机在切图马尔机场10号跑道着陆时向右冲出跑道，造成一些人员受伤，飞机损伤情况尚不明确。数名乘务员受轻微挫伤。此外，一名孕妇因机上受到强烈冲击而流产。该事件被定性为严重事故征候，调查正在进行，促成事件的因素尚未确定。事发飞机在地面停留约7小时，直到次日上午才按计划执行返程航班4-Yankee-2649。气象部门报告称，在事件发生前，该机场的小雪天气已持续8小时。

cards.audioText: On Nov 16th 2010, a Ryanair Boeing 737-800, performing flight Foxtrot-1192 from Sevilla Spain to Toulouse France, was en route at flight level 340 about 12 nautical miles south of Pamplona Spain nearing the reporting point Golf-Lima. A Ryanair Boeing 737-800, performing flight Delta-724 from Santiago to Mallorca, was en route at flight level 340 about 3 nautical miles south of Pamplona nearing reporting point Golf-Lima at the same time. Both aircraft received TCAS resolution advisories (RA), the crews complied with the RA, Delta-724 climbed about 500 feet before returning to flight level 340, Foxtrot-1192 descended to flight level 330 and began the descent into Toulouse, both aircraft became clear of conflict and continued to their destinations for safe landings. On Nov 18th 2010, the competent authority reported according to preliminary data the separation between the aircraft reduced to 400 feet vertical and 2.2 nautical miles horizontally. The occurrence is being investigated.
cards.audioTextZh: 2010年11月16日，一架瑞安航空波音737-800执行从西班牙塞维利亚飞往法国图卢兹的Foxtrot-1192航班。当时飞机在FL340飞行，位于西班牙潘普洛纳以南约12海里，正接近Golf-Lima报告点。与此同时，另一架瑞安航空波音737-800执行从圣地亚哥飞往马略卡岛的Delta-724航班，同样在FL340飞行，位于潘普洛纳以南约3海里，正接近Golf-Lima报告点。两架飞机均收到TCAS决断咨询（RA），机组都按RA指令操作。Delta-724爬升约500英尺后返回FL340；Foxtrot-1192下降至FL330，并开始向图卢兹下降。两机脱离冲突后，继续飞往各自目的地并安全着陆。2010年11月18日，主管部门根据初步数据报告，两机间隔一度缩小至垂直400英尺、水平2.2海里。该事件正在调查中。

cards.audioText: On Sep 2nd 2016, an Iceland air Boeing 757-200, executing flight Alpha-688 from Orlando to Keflavik with 155 passengers and 7 crew, was en route at flight level 350 about 50 miles southeast of Bagotville when the crew observed icing in the right corner of the captain's forward windshield. The crew turned the windshield heating off, however, shortly afterwards a loud cracking sound was heard. Both flight crew donned their oxygen masks, declared Mayday and initiated an emergency descent but stopped the emergency descent at about flight level 250. The crew continued a normal descent and diverted to Bagotville for a safe landing on runway 11 about 20 minutes after leaving flight level 350. The Canadian Trasnportation Safety Board reported the crew noticed that the cabin pressure remained constant while descending through flight level 250 and stopped the emergency descent, the captain removed his oxygen masks while the first officer kept his oxygen mask on as a precaution. A normal descent and diversion to Bagotville followed.
cards.audioTextZh: 2016年9月2日，一架冰岛航空波音757-200执行从奥兰多飞往凯夫拉维克的Alpha-688航班，机上有155名乘客和7名机组成员。飞机在FL350飞行、位于巴戈特维尔东南约50英里时，机组发现机长前风挡右上角出现结冰。机组关闭了风挡加温，但不久后听到一声巨大的开裂声。两名飞行机组成员都戴上氧气面罩，宣布MAYDAY并开始紧急下降，但在约FL250停止紧急下降。机组随后继续正常下降，并改航巴戈特维尔；飞机离开FL350约20分钟后，在11号跑道安全着陆。加拿大运输安全委员会报告称，机组在下降通过FL250时发现客舱压力保持稳定，因此停止紧急下降。机长摘下氧气面罩，副驾驶为预防起见继续佩戴。随后飞机正常下降并改航巴戈特维尔。

cards.audioText: On Oct 23th 2018, an Argentina Airbus A330-200, performing flight Tango-1303 from Miami to Buenos with 192 passengers, was en route at flight level 390 about 90 miles north of Rio Branco. The aircraft deviated around thunderstorm cells when the aircraft encountered severe turbulence causing an altitude deviation of more than -700 feet and +1500 feet around about 18:25 Zulu time. The ADS-B transponder reported climb rates in excess of 2200 feet per minute and sink rates in excess of 2700 feet per minute. The captain subsequently reported 10 to 15 injuries on board and requested medical services upon arrival. The aircraft continued to Buenos for a safe landing about 3:55 hours later. Medical services already awaited the aircraft and treated the injured, 8 passengers were taken to a hospital. On Oct 24th 2018, relevant safety units reported they have opened an investigation into the severe turbulence event, which resulted in 25 minor injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年10月23日，一架阿根廷航空空客A330-200执行从迈阿密飞往布宜诺斯艾利斯的Tango-1303航班，机上有192名乘客。飞机在FL390飞行、位于里约布兰科以北约90英里时绕飞雷暴单体。约在18:25协调世界时，飞机遭遇严重颠簸，导致高度向下偏差超过700英尺、向上偏差达1,500英尺。ADS-B应答机数据显示，飞机爬升率超过每分钟2,200英尺、下降率超过每分钟2,700英尺。机长随后报告机上有10至15人受伤，并请求抵达时提供医疗救护。飞机继续飞往布宜诺斯艾利斯，并于约3小时55分钟后安全着陆。医疗人员已在机场等候并救治伤员，其中8名乘客被送往医院。2018年10月24日，相关安全机构报告已对这起严重颠簸事件展开调查；事件共造成25人轻伤。

cards.audioText: On Oct 24th 2018, a American Airline CRJ-700 performing flight Alpha-2985 from Chicago to Flint with 54 people on board, was in the initial climb out of runway 28R when the crew reported an engine failure and advised they needed to return as soon as possible onto the longest runway available. The crew stopped the climb at 4000 feet when they had a left hand engine fire indication and heard a loud bang followed by power reduction. They declared emergency and decide to position for an approach to runway 28C. Fortunately, the aircraft returned to land safely about 10 minutes after departure. After landing the crew reported they had no fire indication anymore and vacated the runway. The FAA reported a blade went through the cowling when the engine failed. A visual inspection of the left hand engine revealed extensive turbine damage, a large hole to the engine cowl. The NTSB is investigating the occurrence rated an incident.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年10月24日，一架美国航空CRJ-700执行从芝加哥飞往弗林特的Alpha-2985航班，机上共有54人。飞机从28R跑道起飞初始爬升时，机组报告发动机失效，并表示需要尽快返回、使用可用的最长跑道。飞机在4,000英尺停止爬升。机组收到左发火警指示，并听到一声巨响，随后发动机推力减小。机组宣布紧急情况，决定定位进近28C跑道。所幸，飞机在起飞约10分钟后安全返回着陆。着陆后，机组报告火警指示已经消失，并脱离跑道。美国联邦航空局报告，发动机失效时有一片叶片穿透整流罩。对左发的目视检查发现涡轮严重损坏，发动机整流罩上有一个大洞。美国国家运输安全委员会正对这起被定性为事故征候的事件展开调查。

cards.audioText: On Dec 27th 2015, a Qatar Airways Airbus 320, undertaking flight Charlie-307 from Doha to Helsinki with about 150 people on board, was en route at flight level 360 about 70 miles southeast of Yerevan when the crew decided to return to Doha. The aircraft initially descended to flight level 350 for the return and subsequently descended to flight level 270 about 40 minutes after the turn around. The aircraft landed safely back in Doha about 4:50 hours after departure. A replacement Airbus 320 reached Helsinki with a delay of 7:50 hours. A passenger reported the captain announced there was an unusual sound in the cockpit, they wouldn't be able to hear back in the cabin, and that's why they were returning to Doha. Back in Doha staff told them the aircraft returned due to a technical issue.
cards.audioTextZh: 2015年12月27日，一架卡塔尔航空空客A320执行从多哈飞往赫尔辛基的Charlie-307航班，机上约150人。飞机在FL360飞行、位于埃里温东南约70英里时，机组决定返回多哈。返航过程中，飞机先下降至FL350；转弯约40分钟后，又下降至FL270。飞机起飞约4小时50分钟后安全返回多哈。替换执行航班的另一架空客A320最终抵达赫尔辛基，延误7小时50分钟。一名乘客称，机长广播说驾驶舱里出现了异常声响，客舱里听不到，因此决定返回多哈。回到多哈后，工作人员告诉乘客，飞机是因技术问题返航。

cards.audioText: On Jan 27th 2014, a Qatar Airways Boeing 777, performed flight Quebec-635 from Dhaka to Doha with about 350 people on board. This aircraft was in the initial climb out of Dhaka's runway 14 when the crew stopped the climb at 5000 feet due to abnormal gear indications suggesting the gear doors on the main gear struts did not close. The aircraft entered a hold while the crew worked the related checklists. Simultaneously, he climbed to 8000 feet burning off fuel and returned to Dhaka for a safe landing on runway 14 about 90 minutes after departure. The occurrence aircraft is still on the ground in Dhaka 28 hours after landing back. After a thorough check, the maintenance staff reported that unexpected hydraulic system problem was the cause of such event.
cards.audioTextZh: 2014年1月27日，一架卡塔尔航空波音777执行从达卡飞往多哈的Quebec-635航班，机上约350人。飞机从达卡机场14号跑道起飞初始爬升时，出现异常起落架指示，显示主起落架支柱上的起落架舱门未关闭，机组因此在5,000英尺停止爬升。飞机进入等待，机组执行相关检查单；同时飞机爬升至8,000英尺以消耗燃油。起飞约90分钟后，飞机返回达卡并在14号跑道安全着陆。返航着陆28小时后，事发飞机仍停留在达卡地面。经全面检查，维修人员报告事件原因是一起意外的液压系统故障。

cards.audioText: On Oct 20th 2018, a Polar Air Cargo Boeing 747 freighter, performing flight Papa-243 from Anchorage to Cincinnati with 3 passengers and 2 crew, was on approach to Cincinnati's Airport's runway 27 when the crew went around. This freighter positioned for another approach to runway 27 and touched down about 12 minutes later at 23:32 Zulu time. The aircraft however veered right off the runway and came to a stop on soft ground between taxiways Kilo 6 and Kilo 7. There were no injuries, the aircraft did not sustain any damage. A ground observer reported even the following morning around 01:00 Zulu time there were still a lot of flashing lights out at runway 27 and 36 left, both runways were closed and only runway 36 right was available for operations. The Boeing 747 appeared to be facing south which the observer thought was unusual.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年10月20日，一架极地航空货运波音747货机执行从安克雷奇飞往辛辛那提的Papa-243航班，机上有3名乘客和2名机组成员。飞机进近辛辛那提机场27号跑道时，机组实施复飞。货机重新定位进近27号跑道，并于约12分钟后的23:32协调世界时接地。不过，飞机向右偏出跑道，最终停在Kilo 6与Kilo 7滑行道之间的松软地面上。无人受伤，飞机也没有受损。一名地面观察人员报告，直到次日清晨约01:00协调世界时，27号跑道和36左跑道仍有许多闪光灯不工作；两条跑道均被关闭，仅36右跑道可供运行。这架波音747看起来机头朝南，观察人员认为这一姿态并不寻常。

cards.audioText: On Sep 20th 2016, a Southwest Airlines Boeing 737, undertook flight Whiskey-4921 from Tampa to Los Angeles with 179 people on board. When he was on final approach to Los Angeles' runway 25L, the crew initiated a go-around from about 1000 feet subsequently advising air traffic controller they had a "hydraulic problem or flap malfunction", and they needed 10 minutes to run the related checklists. The aircraft entered a hold at 5000 feet for about 20 minutes, then positioned for another approach to runway 25L. During the holding, the air traffic controller instructed an aircraft which had potential conflict with Whiskey-4921 to descend. At last, Whiskey-4921 landed safely at a normal speed about 35 minutes after the go-around. The occurrence aircraft returned to service about 17 hours after landing. The investigation is ongoing.
cards.audioTextZh: 2016年9月20日，一架西南航空波音737执行从坦帕飞往洛杉矶的Whiskey-4921航班，机上共有179人。飞机在最后进近洛杉矶机场25L跑道时，机组从约1,000英尺实施复飞，随后向管制员报告出现“液压问题或襟翼故障”，需要10分钟执行相关检查单。飞机在5,000英尺进入等待约20分钟，随后重新定位进近25L跑道。等待期间，管制员指挥一架可能与Whiskey-4921发生冲突的飞机下降避让。最终，Whiskey-4921在复飞约35分钟后以正常速度安全着陆。事发飞机在着陆约17小时后恢复运行。调查仍在进行中。

cards.audioText: On Feb 25th 2018, an American Airlines Boeing 737 performed flight Charlie-1322 from Dallas to Philadelphia. When he was en route at flight level 370 about 180 miles southwest of Columbus, the cew initiated an emergency descent due to the loss of cabin pressure, and the passenger oxygen masks were released. The aircraft levelled off at 10, 000 feet and diverted to Columbus. The crew advised they did not show any apparent damage, they would be able to vacate the runway and taxi to the terminal. The aircraft landed safely about 40 minutes after leaving flight level 370. A passenger reported a number of fellow passengers as well as the passenger suffered from nose bleeds as well as ear bleeds, the passenger was diagnosed with hemorrhage of both ears. The occurrence aircraft remained on the ground in Columbus for about 15 hours, then ferried to Tulsa climbing to a maximum of 10, 000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年2月25日，一架美国航空波音737执行从达拉斯飞往费城的Charlie-1322航班。飞机在FL370飞行、位于哥伦布西南约180英里时，因客舱失压开始紧急下降，客舱旅客氧气面罩自动释放。飞机在10,000英尺改平，并改航哥伦布。机组报告飞机没有明显损坏，能够脱离跑道并自行滑行至航站楼。飞机离开FL370约40分钟后安全着陆。一名乘客称，包括本人在内的多名乘客出现鼻出血和耳出血，该乘客被诊断为双耳出血。事发飞机在哥伦布地面停留约15小时，随后调机飞往塔尔萨，全程最高爬升至10,000英尺。

cards.audioText: On Sep 14th 2009, a Delta Airlines MD-88, performing flight Lima-2309 from Atlanta to Saint Louis with 127 passengers and 5 crew. When he was on approach to Saint Louis about to maintain 5000 feet, the crew reported a left hydraulic system failure, requested the longest runway available and advised they needed about 5 minutes to run a checklist. The crew subsequently declared emergency and advised they would be able to vacate the runway via left turns then stop and be towed to the apron but were not able to do any right turns. The aircraft landed safely on runway 30L, vacated the runway and was towed to the apron. The aircraft remained on the ground for about 5.5 hours, then was able to depart for the return flight still flight Lima-2309 and reached Atlanta with a delay of about 4.5 hours.
cards.audioTextZh: 2009年9月14日，一架达美航空MD-88执行从亚特兰大飞往圣路易斯的Lima-2309航班，机上有127名乘客和5名机组成员。飞机进近圣路易斯、准备在5,000英尺保持时，机组报告左液压系统失效，请求使用可用的最长跑道，并表示需要约5分钟执行检查单。随后机组宣布紧急情况，称飞机能够通过左转脱离跑道，之后停下并由牵引车拖至机坪，但无法进行任何右转。飞机在30L跑道安全着陆，脱离跑道后被拖至机坪。飞机在地面停留约5.5小时后，继续以Lima-2309航班号执行返程航班，抵达亚特兰大时延误约4.5小时。

cards.audioText: On Aug 26th 2007, a Jetblue Airbus A321 performing flight Alpha-1701 from New York to Fort Lauderdale with 186 passengers and 6 crew, was on final approach to Fort Lauderdale's runway 10 left when the crew initiated a go-around and requested to enter a hold to work on an issue. While in the hold the crew declared emergency reporting they had no indication the left main gear was down and locked and couldn't work out whether this was an indication problem or the gear really wasn't down, they were still troubleshooting. The crew subsequently requested to execute the approach advising they would shut down on the runway. The aircraft landed on runway 10 left about 45 minutes after the go-around, smoke was reported from the left landing gear. The aircraft stopped on the runway and was shut down. Subsequently the aircraft was towed to the apron where the passengers disembarked normally. The occurrence aircraft remained on the ground for repairs for about 21 hours then returned to service.
cards.audioTextZh: 2007年8月26日，一架捷蓝航空空客A321执行从纽约飞往劳德代尔堡的Alpha-1701航班，机上有186名乘客和6名机组成员。飞机最后进近劳德代尔堡机场10左跑道时，机组实施复飞，并请求进入等待以排查故障。等待期间，机组宣布紧急情况，报告没有左主起落架已放下并锁定的指示，无法确定是指示系统故障，还是起落架确实没有放下，仍在排故。随后机组请求实施进近，并说明将在跑道上关车。飞机在复飞约45分钟后于10左跑道着陆，有人报告左起落架冒烟。飞机在跑道上停下并关闭发动机。之后飞机被拖至机坪，乘客正常下机。事发飞机在地面维修约21小时后恢复运行。

cards.audioText: On Jan 17th 2009, an American Airlines Boeing 787 performing flight Alpha-263 from Dallas to Beijing, was en route at flight level 360 about 200 miles east of Fond-du-Lac when the crew decided to divert to Edmonton due to a medical emergency with a passenger. On approach to Edmonton the aircraft suffered flaps and slats problems prompting the crew to declare emergency and enter a hold to burn off fuel because of overweight. While working the checklists the crew decided to divert to Calgary due to the longer runway available. Upon landing on Calgary's runway 17L at a higher than normal speed about 192 knots over ground, the crew reported a nose gear steering issue, stopped on the runway and was met by emergency services. The aircraft was subsequently towed to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 2009年1月17日，一架美国航空波音787执行从达拉斯飞往北京的Alpha-263航班。飞机在FL360飞行、位于Fond-du-Lac以东约200英里时，因一名乘客突发医疗紧急情况，机组决定改航埃德蒙顿。进近埃德蒙顿期间，飞机出现襟翼和缝翼问题，机组因此宣布紧急情况；由于飞机超重，飞机进入等待以消耗燃油。执行检查单时，机组考虑到卡尔加里有更长的跑道，决定改航卡尔加里。飞机以高于正常的约192节地速在卡尔加里17L跑道着陆后，机组报告前轮转弯系统有问题，飞机停在跑道上，由应急服务车辆接应，随后被拖至机坪。

cards.audioText: On May 24th 2011, an Airbus A320 on behalf of Air France, performing flight Foxtrot-1605 from Rome to Paris, was en route at flight level 320 about 70 miles south of Milan when the crew reported they suspected a fuel leak on one of the engines and shut the engine down. The aircraft decided to divert to Milan, and then the airport temporarily suspended all departures and landings on both runways while preparing for the arrival of the aircraft. The aircraft landed safely on runway 35 right about 22 minutes after leaving flight level 320, and then vacated the runway. Departures and landings on runway 35 left resumed immediately after Foxtrot-1605 was on the ground. Runway 35 right returned to service soon after following a runway inspection. The occurrence aircraft remained on the ground for about 16 hours then returned to service.
cards.audioTextZh: 2011年5月24日，一架空客A320代表法国航空执行从罗马飞往巴黎的Foxtrot-1605航班。飞机在FL320飞行、位于米兰以南约70英里时，机组报告怀疑一台发动机漏油，并将该发动机关车。机组决定改航米兰。机场为准备该机到达，临时暂停两条跑道上的所有起降。飞机离开FL320约22分钟后，在35右跑道安全着陆并脱离跑道。Foxtrot-1605落地后，35左跑道立即恢复起降；35右跑道经跑道检查后不久也恢复使用。事发飞机在地面停留约16小时后恢复运行。

cards.audioText: On Feb 17th 2018, a Fly Jamaica Airways Boeing 757, executed passenger transport flight Oscar-256 from Georgetown to Toronto with 120 passengers and 8 crew. When he was climbing out of Georgetown when the crew stopped the climb at flight level 200 due to a hydraulic failure and intended to return to Georgetown. The aircraft landed on Georgetown's runway 06 at 06:53 Zulu time but veered right off the runway and came to a stop to the right of the runway just short of the runway end. The aircraft was evacuated via slides. There were six minor injuries. The aircraft sustained substantial damage with the right main gear collapsed, the right engine separated from the wing and right wing damage. The injured were taken to a hospital. Guyana's Minister of Public Infrastructure reported the aircraft carried 118 passengers, two infants and 8 crew. The leading cause of hydraulic failure is still undetermined.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年2月17日，一架牙买加飞翔航空波音757执行从乔治敦飞往多伦多的Oscar-256客运航班，机上有120名乘客和8名机组成员。飞机从乔治敦起飞爬升时，因液压系统失效在FL200停止爬升，机组计划返回乔治敦。飞机于06:53协调世界时在乔治敦机场06号跑道着陆，但向右偏出跑道，最终停在接近跑道末端的跑道右侧。机上人员通过滑梯撤离。共有6人轻伤。飞机严重受损：右主起落架折断、右发与机翼分离，右翼也受到损伤。伤员被送往医院。圭亚那公共基础设施部长报告，机上实际有118名乘客、2名婴儿和8名机组成员。液压故障的主要原因仍未确定。

cards.audioText: On Mar. 16th 2015, an Endeavor Canadair CRJ-900 on behalf of Delta Airlines, performing flight Lima-3306 from Detroit to Indianapolis, was climbing out of Detroit when the crew stopped the climb at 7000 feet due to a brakes overheat indication. After working the checklists the crew determined the indication was likely false, left the gear extended and continued the flight to Indianapolis at 7000 feet. The aircraft landed safely in Indianapolis about one hour after departure. A passenger reported about 5 minutes after takeoff they heard the gear being cycled several times, then the gear was left extended, however, the aircraft did not turn. After about 20 minutes the captain announced a brakes temperature sensor was showing an overheat condition, a sensor malfunction was likely, they would continue the flight at low altitude and with gear extended, a significant delay was possible on arrival. Landing was otherwise normal, emergency services received the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 2015年3月16日，一架奋进航空加拿大区域喷气CRJ-900代表达美航空执行从底特律飞往印第安纳波利斯的Lima-3306航班。飞机从底特律起飞爬升时，因刹车过热指示在7,000英尺停止爬升。执行检查单后，机组判断该指示很可能是误报，于是保持起落架放下，并在7,000英尺继续飞往印第安纳波利斯。飞机起飞约1小时后安全着陆。一名乘客报告，起飞约5分钟后听到起落架反复收放数次，之后起落架一直保持放下，但飞机没有返航。约20分钟后，机长广播称刹车温度传感器显示过热，很可能是传感器故障；飞机将以低高度、起落架放下的状态继续飞行，抵达时可能严重延误。除上述情况外，着陆正常，应急服务车辆在现场接应。

cards.audioText: On Apr. 21st 2016, an American Airlines Boeing 767, undertaking flight Alpha-1570 from Miami to San Juan with 215 passengers and 10 crew and 32 small bags of dry ice, was climbing out of Miami when the crew stopped the climb at about 10, 000 feet advising they needed to check something and requested to descend to 8000 feet. The crew subsequently advised they had a pressurization problem and might need to descend to 6000 feet, air traffic controller issued a block clearance between 6000 and 8000 feet. The aircraft returned to Miami and was on final approach to runway 27 when the crew initiated a go-around reporting the landing gear came down but the gear doors remained open. The aircraft climbed to 5000 feet and entered a hold while the crew was working the checklist, then positioned for another approach to runway 27 and landed safely about 50 minutes after departure and 23 minutes after the go around. Emergency services reported the nose gear doors had remained open.
cards.audioTextZh: 2016年4月21日，一架美国航空波音767执行从迈阿密飞往圣胡安的Alpha-1570航班，机上有215名乘客、10名机组成员以及32小袋干冰。飞机从迈阿密起飞爬升时，机组在约10,000英尺停止爬升，称需要检查某个问题，并请求下降至8,000英尺。随后机组报告增压系统出现问题，可能需要下降至6,000英尺，管制员批准飞机在6,000至8,000英尺高度块内飞行。飞机返回迈阿密，最后进近27号跑道时，机组报告起落架虽已放下，但起落架舱门仍然打开，因此实施复飞。飞机爬升至5,000英尺进入等待，机组执行检查单，随后重新定位进近27号跑道。飞机在起飞约50分钟、复飞约23分钟后安全着陆。应急服务人员报告前起落架舱门一直处于打开状态。

cards.audioText: On Sep. 21st 2017, a Skylease Cargo Boeing 747 carrying out flight Golf-4854 from Chicago to Halifax with 4 crew, landed on Halifax's runway 14 at 09:06 Zulu time but was unable to stop before the end of the runway, overran the end of the runway, went down a slope and through the localizer antenna and came to a stop about 200 meters past the runway end. When the aircraft was on an ILS approach to runway 14, tower reported the winds from 260 degrees at 14 knots on initial contact. About 90 seconds later tower reported the winds were now from 260 degrees at 16 knots gusting 21 knots and queried whether runway 14 was still acceptable, the crew confirmed, tower cleared the aircraft to land on runway 14. A short time prior to touchdown tower reported winds from 250 degrees at 15 gusting 21 knots. 5 minutes after initial contact the crew reported they had gone off the runway and needed full emergency support. The four crew received minor injuries, the aircraft received substantial damage with all gear collapsed, and creases in the fuselage skin. The airport was closed. The Canadian Transportation Safety Board has dispatched investigators on site.
cards.audioTextZh: 2017年9月21日，一架天空租赁货运波音747执行从芝加哥飞往哈利法克斯的Golf-4854航班，机上有4名机组成员。飞机于09:06协调世界时在哈利法克斯机场14号跑道着陆，但未能在跑道末端前停住，冲出跑道末端，沿斜坡下滑并撞穿航向台天线，最终停在跑道末端外约200米处。飞机实施14号跑道ILS进近，首次联系塔台时，塔台报告风向260度、风速14节。约90秒后，塔台报告风向仍为260度、风速16节、阵风21节，并询问14号跑道是否仍可接受；机组确认可以，塔台遂许可其在14号跑道着陆。接地前不久，塔台报告风向250度、风速15节、阵风21节。首次联系5分钟后，机组报告已冲出跑道，需要全面应急支援。4名机组成员均受轻伤。飞机严重受损，所有起落架折断，机身蒙皮出现褶皱。机场关闭。加拿大运输安全委员会已派调查员赶赴现场。

cards.audioText: On Oct. 17th 2017, A Lufthansa Cityline Canadair CRJ-900 carrying out scheduled flight Hotel-2382 from Munich to Geneva with 38 passengers and 4 crew, was descending through flight level 150 towards Geneva when the crew reported smoke in the cockpit. The aircraft continued for a safe landing on Geneva's runway 22 about 13 minutes later. The aircraft stopped on the runway, the passengers disembarked onto the runway via stairs and were bussed to the terminal. The runway was briefly closed, one flight was diverted as result. The return flight LH-2383 was cancelled. The occurrence aircraft is still on the ground in Geneva about 13 hours after landing. The airline reported the crew noticed an unusual odour like a burning wire in the cockpit and made a precautionary landing in Geneva, there had been no smoke. Maintenance is currently checking the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 2017年10月17日，一架汉莎城市航空加拿大区域喷气CRJ-900执行从慕尼黑飞往日内瓦的Hotel-2382定期航班，机上有38名乘客和4名机组成员。飞机向日内瓦下降通过FL150时，机组报告驾驶舱内有烟。约13分钟后，飞机继续在日内瓦机场22号跑道安全着陆。飞机停在跑道上，乘客经客梯下到跑道，并由摆渡车送往航站楼。跑道短暂关闭，导致一个航班改航；返程航班LH-2383被取消。着陆约13小时后，事发飞机仍停留在日内瓦地面。航空公司报告，机组在驾驶舱闻到类似电线燃烧的异常气味，因此预防性降落日内瓦，实际并未出现烟雾。维修人员正在检查飞机。

cards.audioText: On Oct. 20th 2018, A Philippine Airlines Airbus 340, performing flight PR-117 from Vancouver to Manila, was accelerating for takeoff from Vancouver's runway 08 right when the tower controller heard a loud boom. The aircraft continued takeoff, climbed out and continued the flight. The controller closed the runway for an inspection, which found tyre debris as well as other debris on the runway. The crew was advised via air traffc controller. The runway was closed for about 15 minutes until the debris had been cleaned up. The aircraft landed in Manila without further incident. The Canadian Transportation Safety Board reported after landing in Manila several holes were found in the fuselage skin in the landing gear area. There was substantial damage to the belly as well as the center landing gear fairing door. The occurrence was rated an accident, however, no investigation was opened.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年10月20日，一架菲律宾航空空客A340执行从温哥华飞往马尼拉的PR-117航班。飞机在温哥华机场08右跑道加速起飞时，塔台管制员听到一声巨响。飞机继续起飞、爬升并继续航程。管制员关闭跑道进行检查，在跑道上发现轮胎碎片和其他残骸。管制员将情况通知机组。跑道关闭约15分钟，直到残骸清理完毕。飞机随后在马尼拉安全着陆，没有发生进一步事件。加拿大运输安全委员会报告，飞机在马尼拉着陆后，检查发现起落架区域的机身蒙皮上有多个孔洞，机腹和中部起落架整流罩舱门严重受损。事件被定性为事故，但未启动调查。

cards.audioText: On Apr 24th 2017, a South African Airways Airbus 319, undertaking scheduled flight Sierra-64 from Johannesburg to Lusaka, was in the initial climb out of Johannesburg's runway 03L when the crew requested to cease the climb at 8000 feet and commence a hold reporting they had a nose wheel problem. Some rubber debris came out and the crew believed the debris had departed one of their nose wheels. The aircraft performed a low approach to runway 21 left about 40 minutes after departure, slightly offset to the left to overfly taxiway Yankee for an inspection from the ground, ground observers reported a left hand nose tyre had blown out, the right hand tyre was still intact. The aircraft subsequently positioned for an approach to runway 21 right, landed safely, vacated the runway and stopped for an inspection by emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: 2017年4月24日，一架南非航空空客A319执行从约翰内斯堡飞往卢萨卡的Sierra-64定期航班。飞机从约翰内斯堡机场03L跑道起飞初始爬升时，机组报告前轮有问题，请求在8,000英尺停止爬升并进入等待。飞机掉落了一些橡胶碎片，机组认为碎片来自其中一个前轮。起飞约40分钟后，飞机对21左跑道实施低空进近，并稍向左偏以飞越Yankee滑行道，供地面人员检查。地面观察人员报告左侧前轮轮胎爆裂，右侧轮胎仍完好。随后飞机定位进近21右跑道，安全着陆并脱离跑道，之后停下接受应急服务人员检查。

cards.audioText: On Apr. 12th 2017, a Delta Airlines Boeing 767, carrying out flight Lima-420 from New York to Accra with 250 people on board, was accelerating for takeoff from New York's runway 13 right when the crew rejected takeoff due to disagreeing airspeeds. The crew advised they didn't need assistance at this time and they were ready to return to the gate. The aircraft vacated the runway via taxiway Lima about 2700 meters down the runway and taxied via taxiway Alpha around the terminal complex and was near the intersection of taxiways Alpha and Whiskey when a ground observer notified Ground about flames from the back of the aircraft. Ground subsequently advised the Delta crew there were flames from the right main gear, at least a strong glow, emergency services had already been dispatched. The aircraft stopped near the intersection taxiways Alpha and Whiskey. Emergency services foamed the right main gear and stamp the fire out. The passengers disembarked via mobile stairs after the fire was put out.
cards.audioTextZh: 2017年4月12日，一架达美航空波音767执行从纽约飞往阿克拉的Lima-420航班，机上共有250人。飞机在纽约机场13右跑道加速起飞时，因空速指示不一致中断起飞。机组表示当时不需要协助，准备返回登机口。飞机在跑道上滑跑约2,700米后经Lima滑行道脱离，随后沿Alpha滑行道绕行航站区。当飞机接近Alpha与Whiskey滑行道交叉口时，一名地面观察人员向地面管制报告飞机尾部出现火焰。地面管制随后通知达美机组，右主起落架处有火焰，至少可见强烈火光，应急服务车辆已经出动。飞机停在Alpha与Whiskey滑行道交叉口附近。应急人员向右主起落架喷洒泡沫并扑灭火焰。灭火后，乘客通过移动客梯下机。

cards.audioText: On Aug 24th 2015, a Lufthansa Airbus 380, performing flight Hotel-401 from New York to Frankfurt, was en route at flight level 370 about 220 miles northeast of Halifax when the crew decided to turn around and divert to Boston reporting oil fumes on board and the reducing engine oil quantity on the number 2 engine. Cabin crew donned their smoke hoods. The aircraft dumped fuel on the way to Boston. Approaching Boston the flight crew reported one of the flight attendants was not feeling well and requested medical services available on arrival of the aircraft. The aircraft landed safely on Boston's runway 15 right about 90 minutes after turning around. The entire crew went to a hospital. Preliminary information received indicates there had been a strong burning odour related to oil fumes as well as visible smoke in the cabin. All cabin crew donned their smoke hoods, the flight crew donned their oxygen masks. Two cabin crew felt very sick. After landing flight and cabin crew went to a hospital, passengers including babies needed medical attention as well. Maintenance determined an oil leak at number 2 engine.
cards.audioTextZh: 2015年8月24日，一架汉莎航空空客A380执行从纽约飞往法兰克福的Hotel-401航班。飞机在FL370飞行、位于哈利法克斯东北约220英里时，机组报告机上出现机油烟雾，且2号发动机机油量正在下降，因此决定返航并改航波士顿。客舱机组戴上防烟面罩。飞机前往波士顿途中实施放油。接近波士顿时，飞行机组报告一名乘务员身体不适，请求飞机到达时提供医疗服务。飞机转向约90分钟后在波士顿机场15右跑道安全着陆，全部机组成员随后前往医院。初步信息显示，客舱内有强烈的烧焦气味，与机油烟雾有关，同时还能看到烟雾。所有客舱机组戴上防烟面罩，飞行机组戴上氧气面罩。两名乘务员严重不适。着陆后，飞行机组和客舱机组均前往医院，包括婴儿在内的乘客也需要医疗照护。维修人员确定2号发动机存在机油泄漏。

cards.audioText: On May 24th 2011, a Southwest Airlines Boeing 737, undertaking flight Whiskey-5421 from Omaha to Houston Hobby, was on approach to Houston's runway 13 right cleared to descend to 2000 feet and for a visual approach, when the crew reported a flaps failure and aborted the approach stopping the descent at 3000 feet. The aircraft commenced a hold at 3000 feet while the crew was working the checklists, however without being able to resolve the flaps issue. The aircraft subsequently positioned for another high speed approach to runway 13 right and landed safely (with 187 knots during touchdown) about 45 minutes after the aborted approach. The aircraft slowed safely, vacated the runway and stopped, the crew requested emergency service to have a look at the hot brakes. A replacement Boeing 737 continued the next sector to Albuquerque. The occurrencè aircraft returned to service 24 hours after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 2011年5月24日，一架西南航空波音737执行从奥马哈飞往休斯顿霍比机场的Whiskey-5421航班。飞机进近休斯顿13右跑道，获准下降至2,000英尺并实施目视进近时，机组报告襟翼失效并中止进近，在3,000英尺停止下降。飞机在3,000英尺进入等待，机组执行检查单，但未能排除襟翼故障。随后飞机重新定位，以高速进近13右跑道，并在中止进近约45分钟后安全着陆，接地速度为187节。飞机安全减速、脱离跑道并停下，机组请求应急服务人员检查过热的刹车。另一架波音737替代执行下一航段前往阿尔伯克基。事发飞机在着陆24小时后恢复运行。

cards.audioText: On May 22nd 2018, an Air Astana Airbus 320 performing flight Kilo-352 from Shymkent to Astana with 97 passengers and 9 crew, landed on Astana's runway 22 at 07:22 Zulu time but went right off the runway temporarily, crossed taxiways Bravo and Charlie and returned onto the center line of the runway. There were no injuries, the aircraft sustained damage to the left hand engine inlet. Thunderstorms associated with winds gusting up to 49 knots were battering the city at that time causing a building crane to collapse, houses being unroofed and about 20 people on the ground being injured. Kazakhstan's Civil Aviation Department reported the aircraft went off the runway during roll out. The aircraft was towed to the apron. The airport was closed for about 40 minutes as result. On Oct 18th 2018 Germany's BFU reported the left hand engine inlet and low pressure compressor were damaged when the aircraft exited the runway. The responsible pilot is German citizen, the BFU was therefore informed and joined the investigation.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年5月22日，一架阿斯塔纳航空空客A320执行从奇姆肯特飞往阿斯塔纳的Kilo-352航班，机上有97名乘客和9名机组成员。飞机于07:22协调世界时在阿斯塔纳机场22号跑道着陆，但一度向右偏出跑道，穿过Bravo和Charlie滑行道后返回跑道中心线。无人受伤，飞机左发进气道受损。当时，伴随最高49节阵风的雷暴正在袭击该市，造成一台建筑起重机倒塌、房屋屋顶被掀翻，约20名地面人员受伤。哈萨克斯坦民航部门报告，飞机在着陆滑跑中偏出跑道，之后被拖至机坪。机场因此关闭约40分钟。2018年10月18日，德国航空事故调查局报告，飞机冲出跑道时左发进气道和低压压气机受损。由于责任机长是德国公民，德国航空事故调查局获知此事并参与调查。

cards.audioText: On May 24th 2011, a United Air Boeing 737, performing flight Uniform-580 from Sochi to Moscow with 176 people on board, was climbing out of Sochi's runway 24 when the crew ceased the climb at flight level 200 due to a problem with the landing gear and decided to divert to Krasnodar, located about 100 miles north of Sochi. Luckily, the aircraft landed safely on runway 05 right about 65 minutes after departure from Sochi. Krasnodar Airport reported the aircraft diverted to Krasnodar due to a technical malfunction. The airline reported the aircraft suffered a bird strike on departure, which damaged a sensor affecting the gear retraction. A replacement Boeing 737 reached Moscow with a delay of about 7 hours. The occurrence aircraft departed Krasnodar about 12 hours after landing as flight Tango-9956, climbed to a maximum flight level 260 and positioned to Moscow Vnukovo. The aircraft is still on the ground in Vnukovo 3 hours after landing in Moscow.
cards.audioTextZh: 2011年5月24日，一架联合航空波音737执行从索契飞往莫斯科的Uniform-580航班，机上共有176人。飞机从索契机场24号跑道起飞爬升时，因起落架问题在FL200停止爬升，并决定改航至索契以北约100英里的克拉斯诺达尔。所幸，飞机从索契起飞约65分钟后在05右跑道安全着陆。克拉斯诺达尔机场报告，飞机因技术故障改航。航空公司称，飞机起飞时遭遇鸟击，损坏了一个影响起落架收起的传感器。替换的波音737抵达莫斯科时延误约7小时。事发飞机着陆约12小时后，以Tango-9956航班号离开克拉斯诺达尔，最高爬升至FL260，调机飞往莫斯科伏努科沃机场。抵达莫斯科3小时后，该机仍停留在伏努科沃地面。

cards.audioText: On Sep 26th 2018, an Air Transat Airbus 310, performing flight Sierra-258 from Montreal to Barcelona with 205 passengers and 9 crew, was en route at flight level 340 near the position about 410 miles west of Shannon when the aircraft encountered clear air turbulence causing serious injuries to a passenger and minor injuries to two passengers and two cabin crew.
