The aircraft continued to Barcelona and landed in Barcelona about 2.5 hours later. The seriously injured passenger was taken to a hospital. The Canadian Transportation Safety Board reported the aircraft encountered clear air turbulence, the autopilot disconnected and the aircraft climbed 300 feet very rapidly. The crew regained control and descended the aircraft to flight level 340. The fasten seat belt signs had not been illuminated due to lack of advanced indication. The 4 minor injuries were treated on board, both cabin crew were able to continue duties. The aircraft was inspected after landing in Barcelona and was returned to service.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年9月26日，一架越洋航空空客A310执行从蒙特利尔飞往巴塞罗那的Sierra-258航班，机上有205名乘客和9名机组成员。飞机在FL340飞行、位于香农以西约410英里时遭遇晴空颠簸，造成1名乘客重伤、2名乘客和2名客舱机组成员轻伤。飞机继续飞往巴塞罗那，并于约2.5小时后着陆。重伤乘客被送往医院。加拿大运输安全委员会报告，飞机遭遇晴空颠簸后自动驾驶断开，飞机迅速爬升300英尺。机组重新控制飞机并将其下降至FL340。由于事先没有任何征兆，当时安全带指示灯并未点亮。4名轻伤人员在机上接受处理，两名受伤的客舱机组成员仍能够继续工作。飞机在巴塞罗那着陆后接受检查，随后恢复运行。

cards.audioText: On Sep. 30th 2018, an Expressjet Embraer ERJ-145 on behalf of United, carrying out flight Xray-4104 from Chicago to Ottawa, was en route at flight level 350 about 60 miles north of Rochester in Canadian Airspace when the crew requested to descend and several minutes later requested to divert to Rochester. On approach to Rochester the aircraft was high for the approach, the crew however declined to increase the rate of descent and instead requested to fly a 360 (full circle) to lose height. Emergency services assumed their stand by positions for the arrival. The aircraft continued for a safe landing on Rochester's runway 22 at a higher than normal speed about 35 minutes after leaving flight level 350. A passenger reported the captain explained after landing they had problems with the elevator prompting the diversion to Rochester and on approach to Rochester a flaps failure resulting in the full circle. The competent authorities have joined forces with FAA to investigate.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年9月30日，一架快捷航空巴航工业ERJ-145代表联合航空执行从芝加哥飞往渥太华的Xray-4104航班。飞机在加拿大空域FL350飞行、位于罗切斯特以北约60英里时，机组请求下降；几分钟后又请求改航罗切斯特。进近罗切斯特时，飞机高度偏高。机组拒绝增加下降率，改为请求做一个360度整周盘旋以降低高度。应急服务人员就位待命。飞机离开FL350约35分钟后，以高于正常的速度在罗切斯特机场22号跑道安全着陆。一名乘客称，机长在着陆后解释，升降舵出现问题促使飞机改航罗切斯特；进近罗切斯特时又发生襟翼故障，因此实施整周盘旋。主管部门已与美国联邦航空局联合调查。

cards.audioText: On Sep 1st 2018, a United Air Boeing 737, performing flight Tango-579 from Moscow to Sochi with 164 passengers and 6 crew, landed on Sochi's runway 06 at 23:57 Zulu time but overran the end of the runway and came to a stop in a river bed past the runway. The aircraft was initially vectored for an approach to runway 02 by approach, however, runway assignment was changed to runway 06 due to the weather developing. The aircraft aborted the first approach to Sochi's runway 06 descending through about 2300 feet due to changing winds. He positioned for another approach to runway 06 and went around from about 400 feet again due to changing winds. After the aircraft overran the runway, his landing gear and wings collapsed, the left engine ignited. The aircraft was evacuated, 18 occupants were injured, the others remained unhurt, one airport worker died of a heart attack. The aircraft received substantial damage beyond repair.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年9月1日，一架联合航空波音737执行从莫斯科飞往索契的Tango-579航班，机上有164名乘客和6名机组成员。飞机于23:57协调世界时在索契机场06号跑道着陆，但冲出跑道末端，最终停在跑道外的河床中。进近管制最初雷达引导飞机进近02号跑道，但因天气变化，使用跑道改为06号跑道。飞机下降通过约2,300英尺时，因风向变化中止对06号跑道的首次进近。飞机再次定位进近06号跑道，又因风向变化从约400英尺复飞。飞机冲出跑道后，起落架和机翼折断，左发起火。机上人员撤离，18人受伤，其余人员未受伤；一名机场工作人员因心脏病发作死亡。飞机严重受损，已无法修复。

cards.audioText: On Sep 14th 2011, an Alitalia Airbus 320 carried out flight Alpha-1358 from Trieste to Rome with 98 people on board. When he was in the initial climb out of Trieste's runway 27, the aircraft flew through a flock of birds and experienced a jolt prompting the crew to level off at 2300 feet and return to Trieste for a safe landing on runway 09 about 11 minutes after departure. Passengers reported the aircraft had just become airborne when there was a huge jolt. Soon after the captain announced they had been hit by a flock of birds that had hit both engines, and they were returning to Trieste. The flight was cancelled, the passengers were rebooked onto the next flights. The subsequent inspection found there was blood and feather inside the number one engine. It was really fortune that the engine was not out of order.
cards.audioTextZh: 2011年9月14日，一架意大利航空空客A320执行从的里雅斯特飞往罗马的Alpha-1358航班，机上共有98人。飞机从的里雅斯特机场27号跑道起飞初始爬升时穿过鸟群，并受到一次强烈冲击，机组因此在2,300英尺改平并返回的里雅斯特；飞机起飞约11分钟后在09号跑道安全着陆。乘客报告，飞机刚离地就出现一次剧烈震动。不久后，机长广播称飞机遭遇鸟群，两台发动机都受到鸟击，飞机将返回的里雅斯特。航班被取消，乘客改签后续航班。随后检查发现1号发动机内部有血迹和羽毛。幸运的是，发动机并未失效。

cards.audioText: On May. 1st 2014, a Vim Airlines Boeing 737 undertook charter flight Mike-9945 from Riga Latvia to Ufa Russia with about 40 passengers and 7 crew. When the aircraft was about to accelerate for takeoff from runway 18 at about 10:00 Zulu time, he began to yaw right turning about 90 degrees off the runway center line, skidded sideways, departed the right hand runway edge, and then collided with runway signs and a RVR sensor. Finally, the aircraft became disabled on the runway. There were no injuries. The right hand engine, right hand wing leading edge and the left hand engine inlet received damage. The runway was closed for about 2 hours. Ground observer reported that there appeared to be a problem with the right hand engine, the aircraft veered right, went off the runway onto soft ground and subsequently managed to re-enter the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 2014年5月1日，一架维姆航空波音737执行从拉脱维亚里加飞往俄罗斯乌法的Mike-9945包机航班，机上约有40名乘客和7名机组成员。约10:00协调世界时，飞机准备在18号跑道加速起飞时开始向右偏航，机头相对跑道中心线转过约90度。飞机侧滑，冲出跑道右侧边缘，随后撞上跑道标志牌和一个跑道视程（RVR）传感器，最终失去移动能力并停在跑道上。事件无人受伤。飞机右发、右翼前缘以及左发进气道受损，跑道关闭约2小时。地面观察人员报告，右发似乎出现问题，飞机向右偏转，冲出跑道进入松软地面，随后又设法回到跑道。

cards.audioText: On Apr. 25th 2017, an Easyjet Airbus 320, performing flight Uniform-5831 from Berlin Tegel to Tel Aviv, was in the initial climb out of Tegel's runway 26 left when the crew ceased the climb at 3500 feet due to being unable to retract the landing gear. The aircraft returned to Berlin Tegel for a safe landing on runway 26 right about 40 minutes after departure. A replacement A320 reached Tel Aviv with a delay of 6.5 hours. The occurrence aircraft is still on the ground in Berlin about 39 hours after landing back. A passenger reported shortly after takeoff they perceived abnormal wind rush sounds, then realized they had stopped climbing. After a while the captain announced that they were unable to retract the landing gear and would return to Berlin. A replacement aircraft and crew was flown in from Berlin Schoenefeld Germany.
cards.audioTextZh: 2017年4月25日，一架易捷航空空客A320执行从柏林泰格尔飞往特拉维夫的Uniform-5831航班。飞机从泰格尔机场26左跑道起飞初始爬升时，因起落架无法收起在3,500英尺停止爬升。飞机起飞约40分钟后返回柏林泰格尔，并在26右跑道安全着陆。替换的A320抵达特拉维夫时延误6.5小时。返航着陆约39小时后，事发飞机仍停留在柏林地面。一名乘客称，起飞后不久听到异常的强烈气流声，随后发现飞机停止爬升。过了一会儿，机长广播说起落架无法收起，飞机将返回柏林。航空公司从德国柏林舍讷费尔德调来替换飞机和机组。

cards.audioText: On Jun. 2nd 2015, an American Airlines Boeing 777 performing flight Alpha-101 from London Heathrow to New York with 206 passengers and 13 crew, was en route at flight level 320 about 20 miles southeast of Shannon when the crew reported they needed to divert to their Alternate, because they had a left engine fire. The crew worked the related checklists, shut the engine down and discharged the fire bottle. The aircraft turned around, drifted down and diverted to Dublin Ireland. Air traffic controller asked whether they were able to vacate runway 28 at Bravo 7, because emergency services would check them at Bravo 7, the crew agreed they could do that. On final approach the crew advised in case of a go-around they'd climb out straight at runway heading to 2000 feet. The aircraft landed on runway 28 without further incident. Ground control as well as emergency services reported seeing no smoke from the left engine. The airline reported the aircraft diverted due to an indication of a possible mechanical issue.
cards.audioTextZh: 2015年6月2日，一架美国航空波音777执行从伦敦希思罗飞往纽约的Alpha-101航班，机上有206名乘客和13名机组成员。飞机在FL320飞行、位于香农东南约20英里时，机组报告左发起火，需要改航至备降机场。机组执行相关检查单，将发动机关车并释放灭火瓶。飞机转弯、飘降，并改航爱尔兰都柏林。管制员询问飞机能否在Bravo 7脱离28号跑道，因为应急服务人员将在Bravo 7对飞机进行检查；机组确认可以。最后进近时，机组说明若复飞，将沿跑道航向直线爬升至2,000英尺。飞机在28号跑道安全着陆，没有发生进一步事件。地面管制和应急服务人员均报告未看到左发冒烟。航空公司称，飞机因可能存在机械问题的指示而改航。

cards.audioText: On Dec. 12th 2017, a US-Bangla Boeing 737 carried out scheduled flight Sierra-141 from Dhaka to Cox's Bazar with 164 passengers and 7 crew. During the final approach to Cox's Bazar's runway 17, the crew went around from about 1500 feet after receiving indication the nose gear had not extended. The aircraft climbed to 3000 feet, the crew worked the related checklists and performed another low approach to Cox's Bazar's runway 17 to have the nose gear checked from the ground which confirmed the nose gear was not down. The crew decided to divert to Chittagong, about 50 miles north of Cox's Bazar, and prepared for a landing without nose gear. The aircraft landed on Chitagong's runway 23 and came to a stop on the runway on the main gear and the aircraft nose. The aircraft was evacuated. No injuries are being reported.
cards.audioTextZh: 2017年12月12日，一架孟加拉优速航空波音737执行从达卡飞往科克斯巴扎尔的Sierra-141定期航班，机上有164名乘客和7名机组成员。飞机最后进近科克斯巴扎尔机场17号跑道时，收到前起落架未放下的指示，机组从约1,500英尺复飞。飞机爬升至3,000英尺，机组执行相关检查单，并再次对17号跑道实施低空进近，让地面人员检查前起落架；检查确认前起落架未放下。机组决定改航至科克斯巴扎尔以北约50英里的吉大港，并准备在没有前起落架的情况下着陆。飞机在吉大港机场23号跑道着陆，以主起落架和机头支撑，最终停在跑道上。机上人员撤离，无人受伤。

cards.audioText: On Sep 21st 2018, an Iberia Airbus 350 performing flight India-6252 from New York to Madrid Spain with 265 passengers and 11 crew, was en route at flight level 410 about 70 miles southeast of Halifax Canada when the crew reported they had needed to shut the left hand engine down. The aircraft drifted down to flight level 250, then turned around. The crew decided to return to New York's JFK Airport, but when already cleared direct to New York Airport they changed their mind to divert to Boston. The aircraft was re cleared direct to Boston. The crew advised they would be able to vacate the runway, and no assistance was needed. The aircraft landed on Boston's runway 33 left about 96 minutes after leaving flight level 410, vacated the runway and taxied to the apron with emergency services in trail. On Sep 24th 2018 the Canadian Transportation Safety Board reported the crew received a " ENGINE ONE EGT OVER LIMIT" indication followed by an "ENGINE ONE FAIL" message during flight.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年9月21日，一架伊比利亚航空空客A350执行从纽约飞往西班牙马德里的India-6252航班，机上有265名乘客和11名机组成员。飞机在FL410飞行、位于加拿大哈利法克斯东南约70英里时，机组报告不得不将左发关车。飞机飘降至FL250后返航。机组最初决定返回纽约肯尼迪机场，但在已获准直飞纽约机场后改变决定，改航波士顿，随后重新获准直飞波士顿。机组表示能够自行脱离跑道，不需要协助。飞机离开FL410约96分钟后，在波士顿机场33左跑道着陆，脱离跑道后在应急服务车辆跟随下滑行至机坪。2018年9月24日，加拿大运输安全委员会报告，机组在飞行中先收到“1号发动机排气温度超限”指示，随后又收到“1号发动机失效”信息。

cards.audioText: On Apr. 2nd 2013, a Lufthansa Cargo MD-11 performing flight Lima-8231 from Los Angeles to Frankfurt, was at flight level 370 en route near London when first indications of a problem with the fuel pump system occurred. After leaving cruise level on descent into Frankfurt the crew advised they might not be able to access all available fuel and thus may be short on fuel. Emergency services deployed to their stand by positions at Frankfurt, the aircraft landed safely on Frankfurt's runway 25 left about 50 minutes after the first problems surfaced and about 15 minutes after the crew selected the emergency transponder code. The airport reported the crew made a precautionary, not an emergency landing advising of a problem with the fuel supply systems. It is unclear whether sufficient fuel had been loaded in Los Angeles. The airline reported the crew received a warning indication about one hour prior to landing of a possible problem in one of the multiple fuel supply lines. The crew declared emergency to receive priority, emergency services were therefore called out for the landing. The aircraft landed safely and taxied to the parking position.
cards.audioTextZh: 2013年4月2日，一架汉莎货运MD-11执行从洛杉矶飞往法兰克福的Lima-8231航班。飞机在伦敦附近以FL370巡航时，首次出现燃油泵系统故障指示。飞机离开巡航高度向法兰克福下降后，机组报告可能无法使用机上全部可用燃油，因此可能出现燃油不足。法兰克福机场应急服务人员到待命位置。飞机在首次出现问题约50分钟、机组选择紧急应答机编码约15分钟后，在法兰克福机场25左跑道安全着陆。机场报告称，机组因燃油供应系统问题实施的是预防性着陆，而非紧急着陆。尚不清楚飞机在洛杉矶是否装载了足够燃油。航空公司报告，机组在着陆前约1小时收到警告，显示多条燃油供应管路中的一条可能出现问题。机组为获得优先权宣布紧急情况，因此应急服务人员出动保障着陆。飞机安全着陆并滑行至停机位。

cards.audioText: On Nov. 29th 2017, a United Boeing 737 performing flight Alpha-326 from Washington to Seattle, reported ready for departure and was instructed to line up runway 19 Center and wait. Tower controller advised there were a couple of runway crossings ahead of their departure. About 40 seconds later Tower cleared Alpha-326 for takeoff, the aircraft commenced its takeoff roll at some stage. About 40 seconds after the takeoff clearance Tower cleared two aircraft to cross runway 19 Center. When the crew of Alpha-326 saw one of the aircraft on the runway they rejected takeoff and announced they were seeing an aircraft on the runway. Tower queried whether they had been cleared to takeoff, the crew affirmed they had received clearance for takeoff. The second aircraft cleared to cross had stopped ahead of the runway. Tower cancelled the takeoff clearance, instructed Alpha-326 to vacate the runway and cleared the two crossing aircraft to continue crossing. Alpha-326 was able to depart about 15 minutes later, was cleared for departure by the same controller, and reached Seattle on time.
cards.audioTextZh: 2017年11月29日，一架联合航空波音737执行从华盛顿飞往西雅图的Alpha-326航班。机组报告准备起飞后，被指令进入19中跑道并等待。塔台管制员提醒，起飞前还有几架飞机需要穿越跑道。约40秒后，塔台许可Alpha-326起飞，飞机随后开始起飞滑跑。起飞许可发布约40秒后，塔台又许可两架飞机穿越19中跑道。Alpha-326机组看到其中一架飞机进入跑道后中断起飞，并报告看到跑道上有飞机。塔台询问Alpha-326是否曾获起飞许可，机组确认已经收到起飞许可。第二架获准穿越跑道的飞机停在跑道外。塔台取消Alpha-326的起飞许可，指令其脱离跑道，并许可两架穿越飞机继续通过。约15分钟后，Alpha-326由同一名管制员再次放行起飞，并准时抵达西雅图。

cards.audioText: On Aug. 14th 2011, a Go2Sky Airline Boeing 737 on behalf of Czech Airlines, undertaking flight Kilo-508 from Prague to Copenhagen, was climbing out of Prague's runway 12 when air traffic controller issued a radar vector to turn left onto a heading of 360. The aircraft however was on a heading of about 060, air traffic controller queried, the crew confirmed they were on heading 360. Shortly afterwards the crew reported they had lost all their primary navigation, they wanted to return and requested radar vectors to join the ILS, they would be able to maintain a heading using their stand by compass, no assistance was needed on the ground. The crew stopped the climb at about fight level 125 and returned to Prague for a safe landing on runway 12 about 20 minutes after departure and taxied to the apron. The occurrence aircraft returned to service about 13 hours after landing back.
cards.audioTextZh: 2011年8月14日，一架Go2Sky航空波音737代表捷克航空执行从布拉格飞往哥本哈根的Kilo-508航班。飞机从布拉格机场12号跑道起飞爬升时，管制员雷达引导其左转航向360度。然而，飞机实际航向约为060度。管制员提出质疑，机组却确认其航向为360度。不久后，机组报告所有主要导航设备均已失效，希望返航，并请求雷达引导加入ILS进近。机组表示可以使用备用罗盘保持航向，地面不需要协助。机组在约FL125停止爬升，飞机起飞约20分钟后返回布拉格，在12号跑道安全着陆并滑行至机坪。事发飞机返航着陆约13小时后恢复运行。

cards.audioText: On Mar. 18th 2016, a Delta Airlines Boeing 767 performing flight Dlta-472 from Sao Paulo to New York, was descending towards New York when the crew reported a hydraulic failure and requested emergency services on stand by. The aircraft continued for a safe landing on runway 31 left, the crew indicated they were able to vacate the runway and needed assistance afterwards, they would need to get towed to the apron. The aircraft vacated the runway and stopped. The crew indicated the brakes temperatures were increasing, the crew shut the engines down while waiting for the tug, the brakes temperatures on the left hand brakes were still increasing beyond 700 degrees, the right hand side was "nicely" catching up, smoke began to rise from the brakes prompting emergency services to cool down the brakes. The airport authority reported emergency services responded to a Delta 767 with a hydraulic failure causing overheated brakes. Emergency services handled the condition. The airline reported the aircraft landed safely and was towed to the apron due to a potential mechanical issue.
cards.audioTextZh: 2016年3月18日，一架达美航空波音767执行从圣保罗飞往纽约的Dlta-472航班。飞机向纽约下降时，机组报告液压系统失效，并请求应急服务人员待命。飞机继续进近并在31左跑道安全着陆。机组表示能够自行脱离跑道，但之后需要协助，并需由牵引车拖至机坪。飞机脱离跑道后停下。机组报告刹车温度不断升高，在等待牵引车时关闭了发动机。左侧刹车温度继续升至700度以上，右侧刹车温度也快速追上。刹车开始冒烟，应急服务人员随即对刹车进行冷却。机场当局报告，应急服务人员处置了一架因液压失效导致刹车过热的达美航空767。航空公司称，飞机因潜在机械故障安全着陆，随后被拖至机坪。

cards.audioText: On Mar, 26th 2018, a Lufthansa Airbus 340 performing flight Lima-444 from Frankfurt to Atlanta, was climbing out of Frankfurt's runway 25 Center when the crew stopped the climb at flight level 100 reporting they had a "smell event" on board. The crew indicated that the aircraft was completely okay, however, it was possible they would not continue the flight, they wanted to remain in the vicinity of the airport while troubleshooting. A number of passengers began to complain about nausea and dizziness. About 20 minutes after levelling off at flight level 100 the crew advised their decision was taken. A number of crew reported being dizzy because of the odour, they didn't want to risk anything, they were therefore returning to Frankfurt, fuel dump was not necessary, time was more important, a normal landing was to be expected. The aircraft landed safely back on runway 25 Center about 40 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年3月26日，一架汉莎航空空客A340执行从法兰克福飞往亚特兰大的Lima-444航班。飞机从法兰克福机场25中跑道起飞爬升时，机组在FL100停止爬升，报告机上发生“异味事件”。机组表示飞机本身完全正常，但可能不会继续航程，希望留在机场附近排查问题。多名乘客开始出现恶心和头晕症状。飞机在FL100改平约20分钟后，机组报告已作出决定。多名机组成员因异味感到头晕，他们不愿冒险，因此决定返回法兰克福。机组表示无需放油，时间更为重要，预计可以正常着陆。飞机起飞约40分钟后安全返回，在25中跑道着陆。

cards.audioText: On Nov. 15th 2017, a Delta Airlines Boeing 757 performing flight Delta-1658 from San Francisco to Detroit, was accelerating for takeoff from San Francisco's runway 01 Right when the crew rejected takeoff at high speed (about 123 knots over ground) due to a starboard engine fire indication. The crew requested fire trucks to be rolled while the aircraft was still slowing down. Tower reported: "it does appear your left engine is on fire. " Tower closed both runways 01 Right and 01 Left and instructed approaches to runways 28 Left and 28 Right to continue their approaches without issuing landing clearances, emergency services responded to runway 01 Right crossing runway 01 Left. After it was clear the Boeing 757 had passed both runways 28, the approaches to 28 Left and 28 Right were cleared to land. Emergency services stamped out the fire and reported seeing no fire on the left hand side. The aircraft taxied to the apron about 20 minutes after the rejected takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 2017年11月15日，一架达美航空波音757执行从旧金山飞往底特律的Delta-1658航班。飞机在旧金山机场01右跑道加速起飞时，因右发火警指示以高速中断起飞，当时地速约123节。飞机仍在减速时，机组请求消防车出动。塔台报告：“看起来你们的左发确实着火了。”塔台关闭01右和01左两条跑道，并指令进近28左和28右跑道的飞机继续进近，但暂不发布着陆许可。应急服务车辆穿越01左跑道，赶往01右跑道。确认波音757已通过两条28跑道后，进近28左和28右跑道的飞机获准着陆。应急服务人员扑灭火焰，并报告左侧未见火情。飞机在中断起飞约20分钟后滑行返回机坪。

cards.audioText: On Sep 17th 2018, a Canadian Airlines CRJ-200, carrying out flight Sierra-721 from Kathmandu to Biratnagar with 48 passengers and 4 crew, was climbing out of Kathmandu when the port engine ingested a bird. In the absence of abnormal indications the crew decided to continue the flight to destination, however, about half way into the flight the left engine began to develop vibrations. The aircraft landed safely in Biratnagar. A post flight inspection revealed two fan blades of the left engine were damaged requiring repair. As the second CRJ-200 of the airline is currently in maintenance, the airline needed to cancel all flights of Sep 17th 2018. The airport reported the crew did not advise of a bird strike, however, a dead bird was found on the runway after the departure. Nepal's Civil Aviation Authority reported the crew was not sure about a bird strike, they had heard and felt something but couldn't identify what it was and as there were no abnormal indications they continued the flight.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年9月17日，一架加拿大航空CRJ-200执行从加德满都飞往比拉特纳加尔的Sierra-721航班，机上有48名乘客和4名机组成员。飞机从加德满都起飞爬升时，左发吸入一只鸟。由于没有任何异常指示，机组决定继续飞往目的地；但航程进行约一半时，左发开始出现振动。飞机最终在比拉特纳加尔安全着陆。飞后检查发现左发两片风扇叶片受损，需要维修。由于航空公司的另一架CRJ-200当时正在检修，航空公司不得不取消2018年9月17日的全部航班。机场报告，机组没有报告鸟击，但该机起飞后在跑道上发现一只死鸟。尼泊尔民航局报告，机组不确定是否发生了鸟击；他们听到并感觉到某种异常，但无法判断是什么。由于没有异常指示，机组继续了航班。

cards.audioText: On Aug 26th 2018, an Air Canada Boeing 767 carried out flight Victor-1940 from Vancouver to Dublin with 257 passengers and 8 crew. When he was climbing through 10, 000 feet out of Vancouver, a loud bang was heard from the right hand engine, the engine lost power and abnormal engine indications occurred. The crew reduced the engine to idle, declared emergency and returned to Vancouver for a safe landing on Vancouver's runway 08 right about 25 minutes later. A runway inspection discovered debris on the runway, then the runway was closed. The Canadian Transportation Safety Board rated the occurrence an accident but did not open an investigation. The TSB reported: "An initial visual inspection of the engine revealed extensive damage to the aftmost turbine blades. The inboard aileron and the fuselage just aft of the baggage door were punctured by debris. The engine was sent to the manufacturer for teardown and inspection. Root cause analysis is on-going. "
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年8月26日，一架加拿大航空波音767执行从温哥华飞往都柏林的Victor-1940航班，机上有257名乘客和8名机组成员。飞机从温哥华起飞爬升通过10,000英尺时，右发传出一声巨响，随后发动机失去动力，并出现异常发动机指示。机组将该发动机收至慢车，宣布紧急情况并返回温哥华；约25分钟后，飞机在温哥华机场08右跑道安全着陆。跑道检查发现跑道上有碎片，随后跑道关闭。加拿大运输安全委员会将事件定性为事故，但未启动调查。委员会报告：“对发动机的初步目视检查发现，最后端的涡轮叶片严重受损。内侧副翼以及行李舱门后方的机身被碎片击穿。发动机已送往制造商拆解检查，根本原因分析仍在进行中。”

cards.audioText: On Aug. 21st 2017, a Frontier Airlines Airbus 320 performing flight Foxtrot-452 from Denver to Washington, was in the initial climb out of Denver's runway 08 cleared to climb flight level 230 when the crew requested to level off at 10, 000 feet due to a bird strike to figure out what is going on. The crew decided to initially continue the departure route. The crew subsequently advised they were slowing to 250 knots, and they were already in the climb past the runway end when there was a really loud bang. The crew advised they would return as a precaution, no need to declare emergency, they needed to burn off some fuel, the crew commented it probably was a "duck on a bad day". The aircraft entered a hold on the localizer runway 16 right, burned off fuel and landed safely back on Denver's runway 16 right about one hour after departure. A passenger reported the crew announced after landing that there was a large dent.
cards.audioTextZh: 2017年8月21日，一架边疆航空空客A320执行从丹佛飞往华盛顿的Foxtrot-452航班。飞机从丹佛机场08号跑道起飞初始爬升，获准爬升至FL230时，机组因鸟击请求在10,000英尺改平，以确认具体情况。机组起初决定继续沿离场航路飞行，随后报告将减速至250节。机组称，飞机已爬升飞过跑道末端时听到一声巨响。为预防起见，机组决定返航，认为无需宣布紧急情况，但需要消耗部分燃油；机组还评论说，那可能是“一只倒霉的鸭子”。飞机在16右跑道航向台上进入等待，消耗燃油后，于起飞约1小时后安全返回丹佛机场，在16右跑道着陆。一名乘客称，机组着陆后广播说飞机上有一个很大的凹痕。

cards.audioText: On Sep. 12th 2016, a Skywest Canadair CRJ-200 on behalf of United performing flight Oscar-5480 from Chicago to Ottawa with 50 passengers and 3 crew, was descending towards Ottawa when the flight attendant observed an odour in the cabin near seat row 9 and identified the fumes originated from the overhead bin. The flight crew declared emergency and expedited the approach. The captain advised the flight attendant it would be a normal landing, she should be ready for an evacuation however. The aircraft landed safely with emergency services on stand by. The Canadian Transportation Safety Board reported emergency services found no trace of fire, heat, smoke or any source of the odour. The aircraft taxied to the apron. Maintenance tested both packs, the APU and both engines but did not find any anomaly. Maintenance concluded the smoke was result of water condensation from the lower air conditioning vent.
cards.audioTextZh: 2016年9月12日，一架天西航空加拿大区域喷气CRJ-200代表联合航空执行从芝加哥飞往渥太华的Oscar-5480航班，机上有50名乘客和3名机组成员。飞机向渥太华下降时，一名乘务员在客舱第9排座位附近闻到异味，并确认烟气来自头顶行李舱。飞行机组宣布紧急情况并加速进近。机长告知乘务员将正常着陆，但应做好撤离准备。飞机在应急服务人员待命的情况下安全着陆。加拿大运输安全委员会报告，应急人员没有发现任何着火、发热、烟雾痕迹，也未找到异味来源。飞机滑行至机坪。维修人员测试了两套空调组件、APU和两台发动机，均未发现异常。维修人员最终认定，烟雾是下部空调通风口产生的冷凝水所致。

cards.audioText: On Oct 28th 2018, a Condor Boeing 757 performing flight Dlta-1440 from Hamburg to Ventura with 275 passengers and 8 crew, was being pushed back from the gate, when the engines were started. An odour of "old socks" developed on board, that continued during taxi, departure and climb. Only after levelling off at cruise level the odour subsided. A number of passengers complained about headache, nausea and dizziness. The crew continued the flight to Ventura where the aircraft landed without further incident. At least two passengers required medical attention after landing. Passengers described the odour as very strong like old or wet socks. Germany's BFU reported on Oct 29th 2018, that the occurrence was reported to them. Data collection is in progress to rate the occurrence. The occurrence aircraft remained on the ground in Ventura for two hours, then departed for the return flight. The aircraft subsequently remained on the ground in Hamburg for about 9 hours and departed the following morning on schedule.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年10月28日，一架神鹰航空波音757执行从汉堡飞往文图拉的Dlta-1440航班，机上有275名乘客和8名机组成员。飞机正在推出登机位时启动发动机。机上随后出现一股“旧袜子”气味，并在滑行、起飞和爬升期间持续存在，直到飞机在巡航高度改平后才逐渐减弱。多名乘客出现头痛、恶心和眩晕。机组继续飞往文图拉，飞机安全着陆，没有发生进一步事件。着陆后至少有两名乘客需要医疗救治。乘客形容异味非常强烈，像旧袜子或湿袜子的气味。德国航空事故调查局于2018年10月29日报告已收到该事件报告，正在收集数据以确定事件等级。事发飞机在文图拉地面停留2小时后执行返程航班，随后在汉堡地面又停留约9小时，并于次日上午按计划起飞。

cards.audioText: On Dec. 5th 2014, a Swiss Airbus 330 performing flight Lima-19 from Newark to Zurich with 166 passengers and 12 crew, was descending through flight level 340 about 100 miles southeast of Paris and about 160 miles northwest of Zurich when the crew increased the descent to an emergency descent due to the loss of cabin pressure. The aircraft levelled off at flight level 100 and continued to Zurich, where the crew requested a shallow descent due to the cabin pressure problems and an extended downwind to accommodate the shallow descent. After levelling at 4000 feet on approach to Zurich's runway 14 the crew cancelled the emergency. The aircraft landed safely on Zurich's runway 14 about 35 minutes after initiating the emergency descent and taxied to the apron. On Dec 9th 2014 the French BEA reported in their weekly bulletin, that the occurrence has been rated a serious incident and is being investigated by Switzerland's SUST.
cards.audioTextZh: 2014年12月5日，一架瑞士国际航空空客A330执行从纽瓦克飞往苏黎世的Lima-19航班，机上有166名乘客和12名机组成员。飞机下降通过FL340、位于巴黎东南约100英里且苏黎世西北约160英里时，因客舱失压将下降加大为紧急下降。飞机在FL100改平后继续飞往苏黎世。由于客舱压力问题，机组请求采用小下降角，并延长三边以配合缓慢下降。进近苏黎世机场14号跑道期间，飞机在4,000英尺改平后，机组取消紧急状态。飞机开始紧急下降约35分钟后，在苏黎世机场14号跑道安全着陆并滑行至机坪。2014年12月9日，法国航空事故调查局在每周通报中报告，该事件已被定性为严重事故征候，正由瑞士安全调查局调查。
